image767×395 135 KB

The following are all chat logs that were featured on Wizards of the Coasts website. These were archived and I’ve dug up what was still available online. It appears that chat sessions continued on for a while after but WotC stopped updating the chat archives/ transcripts in November 2000. If you have any additional details or logs to add please do!

Hope you all enjoy the trip down memory lane and if you find any cool or interesting snippets please share them!

Click on each spoiler to view entire log:

Thurs. Feb 3, 2000 - Weekly Pokemon TCG Q&A

Pokémon Online Help
Offered every Thursday 2-5 PST in the TCG Forum of the Wizards.Community chat site!
Featuring Master_Trainer from Customer Service

Thurs. Feb 3, 2000

Master_Trainer: Are you SEAKING to WEEDLE answers to your ODDISH Pokemon questions no matter how FARFETCHE’D? GEO-DUDE, don’t feel GASTLY, we are here to remove your JINX and lift you out of the MUK with Master_Trainer power! So you know the BEEDRILL, close your MEOWTH, don’t be a SLOWPOKE and type in your questions RAPID(edly).

  1. I have a KABUTO with a gold WD on it. What does this mean and ias it worth anything?
    You have one of the Wizards’s stamped Kabuto’s. It’s a promo card that was given out with an earlier issue of TopDeck. As far as its value, we don’t keep track of those, check out magazines like TopDeck or Scrye.

  2. Why are there holo and non-holos in jungle and fossil?
    After hearing many people’s comments on not wanting to play with their holo cards from base set, we decided to make the rare’s in both forms. So you can keep your holos mint, and play with the non-holo cards.

  3. TopDeck reported 65 cards in Team Rocket. Will “Here Come the Rockets!” be in the set? And if so, which rarity?
    Sorry, we can’t give out a specific card set list yet. To be honest, I don’t even know the full set yet.

  4. Clefairy Doll here . . . Situation: Hitmonchan vs. Mime. Hitmo has 2 plus powers attached. He jabs mime for 20. Is this considered a KO, or do plus powers add 20 to the attack itself (for 40) and so fail due to Mime’s wall?
    Trainer card effects are added before Pokémon powers are figured, so the attack would do 40 total, which Mr. Mime’s Power would negate.

  5. I understand that WotC will be switching over to the Japanese Hologram format soon. Will Base Set 2 be the first expansion with the new format, and will there be any other format changes in store?
    Well, we will be switching foil format soon (running out of the old foil). No official announcements as to what format or exactly when, sorry.

  6. Do you know if there are any plans to have Pro Tour type events with large prizes? Or is this the wrong person to ask? Also, will Team Rocket rares be printed in both holo/non holo versions?
    There are no plans for a Pro Tour yet. We are working on tournament formats for the future though. As for Team Rocket, we don’t have any specific information on that card set yet, sorry.

  7. What is the card going to be in the Pokémon TCG for Gameboy?
    Good question. Wish I knew the answer. Sorry gang, we don’t announce cards or specifics before they are available.

  8. Hello, when does the Pokémon mall tour come to northern New Jersey I need to know now?
    Well, this year’s Mall Tour is still being worked out. When we have specific dates and locations, it will all be listed on our web site.

  9. Can the switch card be used to retreat a paralyzed, confused, or sleeping Pokémon?
    Yes, you can use a switch card to retreat a confused or asleep or paralyzed Pokémon.

  10. Does Magmar’s smokescreen affect when the Defending Pokémon evolves?
    Since Magmar’s Smoke screen attack references the Defending Pokémon, by it evolving, it removes that effect.

  11. Is the Birmingham AL tournament DCI sanctioned? Will actual DCI people be there?
    Just checked my list, only see sanctioned tournaments in Montgomery and Huntsville in Alabama. I would check with the people running it to be sure.

  12. Will there be better odds of getting foils in Base Set 2 and Rocket?
    No, the same odds. Basically a 1 in 3 chance of a foil card in a booster pack.

  13. Does Fearow’s Agility attack block Kangaskahn’s fetch?
    Actually it does not, Fearow’s agility says stops damage done to Fearow, and the Fetch just draws a card. This is the new ruling from R&D.

  14. Any idea of plans for DCI accrediting of Pokémon Judges any time soon? I would assume that would go hand-in-hand with the tournament formats in the works? A customer service rep once told me that WotC considers Pokémon primarily oriented towards ‘casual’ play, but how can there be ‘serious’ play without accrediting and professional formats?
    Good question. There are no plans for official accrediting of Pokémon Judges at this time.

  15. Hi. Do you know what the gym card with a Mr.Mime running from a wheel with arms is called; it’s in the gym sets?
    Sorry, but as earlier stated, we don’t announce cards until they have been released.

  16. A lot of buzz about some holo promo Meowth.
    True. I’ve seen them. Since we have not released those cards yet, I can’t comment on them, sorry.

  17. In the upcoming TR series, do evil Pokémon count as separate cards from regulars? Example: I can have four evil Jolteon and four Jolteon in a deck?
    No, you can only have 4 of a particular named Pokémon max in your deck. There are already several different Pikachu’s out but you can still only have 4 total.

  18. Can the switch card be used to retreat a paralyzed, confused, or sleeping Pokémon?
    Yes, it can, the Trainer (you) plays NOT the Pokémon, a Trainer Card NOT the Pokémon, so it being Paralyzed, etc. does not stop a Trainer Card’s effects (generally).

  19. For the evil Pokémon - they actually have different names and it would make sense that you could have more of them in addition to other Pokémon of that name?
    Well guess what, I’ve just been corrected. The “evil” Pokémon are considered differently named Pokémon and you can have them in addition to the others, sorry.

  20. Can online tournaments be sanctioned if the tourney director is a DCI judge?
    We don’t have any plans for sanctioned online tournaments at this time.

  21. Can you Raindance onto a Shifted Venamoth?
    Yes you could do that.

  22. Why did they take out the real mew from fossil (truth please)?
    The Japanese felt that it shouldn’t have been included in Fossil to begin with (#151 and all). We wanted it to be readily available for everyone. FREE!

  23. When is your next DCI sanctioned tourney?
    Ok, as for the DCI question, it differs for each tournament.

  24. If I use Charizard’s Energy Burn on some Grass energy could I still use Venusaur’s Energy Trans on them, and if Charizard is confused, paralyzed or asleep and he had some energy burned cards on him would they still be burned or would they change back?
    Ok, 1st if the energy is changed to Fire energy then Venosaur can no longer Energy Trans them (they are no longer grass). If Charizard is paralyzed, etc. then the energy reverts (it also only changes to fire for that turn only).

  25. When will the rocket set and base set two be released, and when will the first edition of these sets be released, and will they sell for the same price?
    Base Set 2 should be out the end of February, Rocket in Mid April. No 1st edition Base Set 2 cards, but Rocket 1st edition will be out the same time as unlimited. As far as prices, stores set whatever price they want for the cards.

  26. I heard that DCI is going to ban the cards Computer Search, SER, and Pro. Oak, is that true?
    There are no plans to ban any cards at this time.

  27. Is there a listing anywhere as to the odds of receiving each card when purchasing a booster pack?
    It’s based on the size of the set and the cards rarity. One rare card in each booster.

  28. I mean out of a thousand cards printed, Charizards are printed?
    Charizard is no more rare than any other rare in the base set.

  29. What will the prefixes of rocket cards (example: ‘Evil Jolteon’) be? I’ve heard ‘bad’, evil’ even ‘devil’ in different magazines and such, and how rare is the ‘here comes team rocket’ card going to be?
    Sorry but that information hasn’t been released yet either:) Again, until a set comes out, we don’t mention specifics, sorry.

  30. Does benching a Pokémon end ALL effects, including those of attacks? For example, if I have a Scyther against a Magmar, and Magmar smokes me… I retreat Scyther, and put up another Pokémon, which I then retreats and return Scyther. Does smokescreen no longer apply? I say no, but there have been a lot of arguments about this online… please settle this once and for all.
    Benching a Pokémon removes the effects of any attacks that reference them. In this case, benching Scyther removed the Smokescreen effect.

  31. How many cards are you planning for the Team Rocket expansion?
    Sorry guys, again that information is not yet available. Wait until the set comes out.

  32. The potion card says to remove “2 damage counters”, some people play with 10 and 30 point damage counters. SO: Can a regular potion take off two 30point damage counters or just 20 damage total? And can you place energy on a mysterious fossil?
    Ok, whenever a card or effect or attack mentions damage counters, it is always assuming a counter to be equal to 10 points of damage.

  33. How are you supposed to get surfing Pikachu to play the mini game in yellow?
    Sorry, we only make the translated Pokémon game cards. Nintendo makes the Game Boy games and could answer that for you.

  34. Snorlax’s Pokémon power says that it cant be paralyzed, poisoned, confused, or put to sleep, so why does it say that the power stops working if its paralyzed, confused or put to sleep?
    Well, say Muk was in play, all Pokémon Powers stop working. Snorlax gets confused, then Muk leaves play, and his power can’t turn back on until he is no longer confused.

  35. I have opened booster boxes (tons) and found that the distribution is not random. There is always 1 booster every 4 packs, with 2 breaks in the box. How come WotC tells us the odds are 1:3?
    When the cards are printed, the number of foils is 1 in 3 packs. Some people get better odds, some get worse.

Fri. Feb 4, 2000 - Pokemon Jr. Game Intro and Q&A

RPG Hour: Pokémon, Jr. Game
Featuring Stan!, game designer

TSRO Ginger: Okay, folks, thanks for coming to our Pokémon, Jr. chat, featuring Stan, game designer extraordinaire!! Any words for the people to open with, Stan, or shall we dive right into questions?

Stan: Well, I guess I’ll start with a quick overview of what Pokémon, Jr. is… and what it isn’t.

Stan: This is a storytelling game for a parent and up to 6 children (ages 6-8). The kids get to play Pokémon Trainers, collecting and battling their Pokémon against one another, trainers in the stories, and the nasty Team Rocket. It’s a very easy game, because it’s supposed to be playable by kids and parents who do not usually play hobby games (like D&D or Magic), there’s definitely roleplaying involved, but this is NOT a typical RPG.

Stan: Anyone looking for a “Guide To Pokémon In Your Campaign” book might be disappointed, but those who try it out (those of ALL ages) have found it to be a fast, fun game.

TSRO Ginger: Okay, question and answer time. Go ahead, Guest 494.

Guest 494: How much will it retail at?

Stan: Because it’s a mass market game, we do not have a manufacturer’s suggested retail price on the box, but I’ve seen it in a few major stores (like Toys R Us, and WalMart) selling for between 9 and 12 dollars.

TSRO Ginger: MLM? You’re up.

MLMartin: Stan!–has Wizards of the Coast considered using games in this format as introductions to any of its other properties and/or licenses, such as Star Wars or even D&D?

Stan: Good question! Pokémon, Jr. is the first time we’ve tried such a game concept (easy roleplaying for a LARGE audience). As we worked on it, we realized that it had a much wider application than just Pikachu and his friends, and we’ve talked about how we might use it for other settings.

Stan: So far, though, we don’t have any hard and fast plans to use this game for other settings . . . but we ARE talking about it.

MLMartin: Stan, sounds good!

Stan: I guess we’ll just have to see how successful this game is.

494: Where will it retail?

Stan: Well, you can buy it at most national toy stores. I KNOW it’s in most (if not all) Toys R Us, WalMart, and Target stores. And I know you can get it at Wizards of the Coast and Game Keeper retail stores. And many hobby retailers ordered it too, so you should be able to find it any number of places.

Stan: If you want help finding a retailer in your area, contact Wizards of the Coast customer service … they’ll be able to give you some clues.

494: Will prices vary store to store?

Stan: I think that prices will be the same in all the stores in a single chain, but will vary from chain store to chain store.

TSRO Ginger: Does anyone else have a question?

TSRO Ginger: Unicorn, go ahead.

TSRO Unicorn: Stan, how much prep does a parent need to start a game with the kids?

Stan: Another good question! Very little prep time. In fact, we tried to design the game so that you could pick it up and just play right away! In truth, the parent would do well to take 5 or 10 minutes to read the rules, but it’s certainly possible to just play immediately. The BEST thing is that the parent doesn’t need to know ANYTHING about Pokémon in order to play-it’s all there in the book! So they have fun AND look Poke-smart!

TSRO Ginger: Arkana, go ahead.

TSRO Arkana: My husband and I are both players of D&D. Would this be a good game to try and introduce our kids into RPGs?

Stan: Oh yes, certainly. One of our designers came in and told me this story yesterday: It seems his little girl just got the game (she’s too young to play D&D). She was so excited that she made him come in to watch her fight against a tough opponent… then she carried her new Pokémon with her everywhere she went, and she wanted to play again the next morning (at some hideously early hour). That’s pretty much the way I was when I first found D&D.

TSRO Arkana: That sounds just like I was when I discovered D&D.

Stan: Anyway, she’s now making up stories on her own and pretty much getting ready to be a DM … well, as soon as she can read.

TSRO Ginger: (grinning) That’s a cute story, Stan.

TSRO Ginger: Do you actually watch the cartoons to get the ideas, or do they have transcripts for you?

Stan: I watch them! In fact, after I finish this chat I have to go watch two more tapes for the next project I’ll be working on.

TSRO Arkana: Talk about work! Watching cartoons…

TSRO Ginger: (solemnly) You have my deepest sympathy, Stan.

TSRO Arkana: I’m not much of a Pokémon fan but I may actually look into getting this for my kids.

Stan: Arkana, I think you should. It’s a fun game. I’ve wanted to write a game like this for years, and when I finally got the chance I threw myself into it wholeheartedly. And with the help of Bill Slavicsek, we crafted a really focused and fun game (in my humble opinion).

TSRO Ginger: Arkana, you really should. It’s a blast.

TSRO Ginger: Okay, Stan, any suggestions for me on how to get my kids not to expect the “episodes” to be exactly like the cartoon?

Stan: Ginger, hmmmmm . . . tough question. You might try telling them that this happens after the cartoon episode.

TSRO Ginger: I shall try that. They are at that perfectionist age, do you know what I mean?

Stan: Ginger, I know what you mean. They want to relive the experience of the TV show, but they also want the thrill of not knowing who will win.

TSRO Ginger: Welcome to our Pokémon, Jr. chat, Yosuchi.

Stan: Hi, Yosuchi!

Yosuchi: Hello. So this is a real thing?

TSRO Arkana: Yes, it is, Yosuchi.

TSRO Ginger: Yosuchi, Pokémon, Jr.? Yes, it sure is.

Yosuchi: The Pokémon RPG is based around what?

Stan: Yosuchi, it’s a simple storytelling game for parents and kids. A new game system and stories based off the Pokémon TV show

Yosuchi: Oh. SO they get to play as Ash, Misty, Brock/Tracy?

Stan: Well, Yosuchi, a child gets to pretend that he is a Pokémon Trainer, and he collects Pokémon for himself. Some kids pretend to be Ash or Misty, but most are happier being themselves.

Yosuchi: Oh. So how do they play?

Stan: When a kid captures a Pokémon, he gets a game card to represent it. He uses that card in combat. It’s a little hard to explain here in a chat room, but it’s very simply at the table. Even non-gamers seem to pick it up very quickly.

Yosuchi: Ah. Thanks. I’ve got to go, but I thank you.

TSRO Ginger: You should include tips on creating episodes for the non-gaming parents that buy it.

Stan: Ginger, I think that TopDeck magazine will be providing new episodes and printing an article about how to write your own.

TSRO Ginger: I’ll have to check that out then, thanks.

TSRO Arkana: Stan, do you need to collect any cards for this game?

Stan: No. All the cards come with the game. It’s an all-in-one package deal.

TSRO Arkana: OK. That I can deal with.

TSRO Ginger: I really do recommend it, Arkana. It even comes with keen little damage counters.

Necro: I hope it’s not gonna cost sky high… I say this because there seems to be some bad price fixing here in Singapore.

Stan: No. It usually costs between 9 and 12 dollars.

Necro: Pokémon theme decks works out to US$29.40!!! And children are forking out moola to buy them. Yes, this is sort of a complaint that I have always wanted to bring up.

Stan: Pokémon, Jr. isn’t collectable. All the cards come in the box!

Necro: Great! Gotta check out the local price though.

Treiss: Stan, one question from me (not sure if it has been answered): what about those that don’t at all see this cartoon (yes it is true it doesn’t run in Denmark)-how would they learn the game and figure up episodes for Pokémon RPG?

Stan: Treiss, the game teaches you what you need to know about Pokémon and the world. After that, making up your own stories is… well… just like making up your own stories! The kids can help you figure out what’s right and what’s wrong.

TSRO Arkana: Treiss, I have no knowledge of the Pokémon game. But, if it is anything like the basic sets of D&D, you don’t need any previous knowledge or anything else to play.

TSRO Ginger: Arkana is correct. Everything is in the box. It’s cute. But then, I happen to like playing the card game with my kid, so there you go.

TSRO Arkana: I’ve heard of many adults getting hooked on Pokémon through their kids.

Stan: I work with several people like that

TSRO Ginger: I’m not exactly hooked, but I do think the game is fun. And the creatures are darned cute.

Necro: I agree… they are C-U-T-E!

TSRO Ginger: Adults probably would not want to play the Pokémon, Jr. game by themselves. It’s really basic, but it’s great for kids.

Stan: Actually, I would use Pokémon, Jr. to teach roleplaying to people like my parents or cousins.

TSRO Ginger: Do we have any more questions, or shall we let Stan go free a bit early?

TSRO Ginger: Stan, I had a Pikachu backpack, but my rotten kid stole it from me.

TSRO Ginger: Okay, folks, I think we can safely say that there’s not much more to say, except if you have kids, buy the game. I got mine at Toys R Us for ten bucks. And my kid has played it all the way to the end at least three times. He likes getting different Pokémon. So it’s always fun.

TSRO Zugran: Ginger, bring it to Gen Con, so we can play it.

TSRO Ginger: I think I shall do that, Zugran.

TSRO Ginger: We can make Stan be the GM.

TSRO Arkana: Is everybody asleep? This is a big difference from last night.

Treiss: (chuckles) Nope, Arkana, just waiting for a Pokémon to turn up.

TSRO Zugran: No, just listening to another cool game design.

Stan: Any questions, RoyalCharizard?

RoyalCharizard: No, I’m just watching.

Stan: I sure know how to pack ’em in, don’t I?

TSRO Ginger: Well, this game is mostly played by non-gamer parents and their little kids. I think most of the customer base is not really conversent with the Ichat site.

Stan: Probably not. Some time I’d like to go to one of the Pokémon events (maybe a League site) and see what the kids and parents there think of the game.

TSRO Ginger: But we all love Stan, right!!

Treiss: Yep, Stan is “da” man.

TSRO Zugran: Stan? Oh yes, we love Stan. Stan is the Man.

Stan: Awwww … no need to bolster my ego … it’s BIG enough as it is … but thanks for the thought!

Treiss: (chuckles) I know we can’t leave because of it, Stan. You know it blocks the exit!

TSRO Ginger: Well, is there anything else, or shall we let Stan go get dinner?

TSRO Arkana: He’s buying??? *eager look*

Stan: Well, if this is what we’re reduced to chatting about, then we ought to call this thing over … race ya back to RPG forum!

TSRO Ginger: Works for me.

Stan: Stan is not buying dinner.

Treiss: Good call, Stan.

TSRO Ginger: I now pronounce this chat good and done.

Thurs. Feb 10, 2000 - Weekly Pokemon TCG Q&A

Pokémon Online Help
Offered every Thursday 2-5 PST in the TCG Forum of the Wizards.Community chat site!
Featuring Master_Trainer from Customer Service

Thurs. Feb 10, 2000

Master_Trainer: Are you SEAKING to WEEDLE answers to your ODDISH Pokemon questions no matter how FARFETCHE’D? GEO-DUDE, don’t feel GASTLY, we are here to remove your JINX and lift you out of the MUK with Master_Trainer power! So you know the BEEDRILL, close your MEOWTH, don’t be a SLOWPOKE and type in your questions RAPID(edly).

  1. Are the promo Mewtwo 16 and Meowth 10 real?
    We have not released these cards and so we cannot comment on them, sorry

  2. Why do none of the Pokémon tours come to Canada?
    We are still working out this year’s Pokémon tour dates and locations, so I don’t know about this year’s yet. I believe the choices are made based upon population and mall interest.

  3. Do you know when the other expansions will come out?
    Base Set 2 will be coming out at the end of this month, Team Rocket will be released in April; the Gym expansions will be out later this year.

  4. I missed the Pokémon Jr. Adv. chat. When will Pokémon Jr. 2 be released? What licensing problems are you having? When will the more advanced version of Pokémon Adventure (RPG) be released?
    We are still working out schedules and negotiations with Nintendo for the expansions for the Pokémon Jr. Adventure game, so we don’t have specific dates yet, sorry.

  5. Is it true that the Base Set 2 expansion might not have 1st edition prints?
    Since Base Set 2 is a set reprinting cards from the Base and Jungle sets, there will NOT be 1st edition cards for Base Set 2.The next new 1st edition cards will be out for Team Rocket.

  6. What happens if the opponent benches the Pokémon after the fossil Magmar uses smokescreen?
    Since that attack references the opponent’s Pokémon, if he benches it, the effect is removed.

  7. Will there be the white star ultra rare card in the team rocket set?
    Sorry, but we don’t announce what specific cards will be in a set until it is released.

  8. Is there going to be any new promo cards?
    There certainly will be! However, as I just said, we don’t mention specifics until they are released.

  9. How come my holo Nidoqueen has no symbol.
    There are some Jungle Hologram cards that were printed without the jungle symbol. These are real cards but misprints. The error has been corrected on later print runs.

  10. Exactly how many first edition base set boosters were released?
    Sorry, but we do not release print run numbers, sorry.

  11. If you have a defender on a Chansey, and you use double edge, is 20 of the damage to Chansey prevented?
    Yes, it would be. Defender will protect your Pokémon from attacks form your opponent AND from your own attacks while it is in play.

  12. Can I lay a double colorless energy and another energy down on the same turn?
    No, you can only attach 1 energy card per turn.

  13. Will there be the holo trainer in Rocket?
    Sorry, but no comments on set contents until they are released.

  14. Are there any plans for banning cards in the game?
    We have no plans on banning any Pokémon cards.

  15. Is the yellow cheek Pikachu (base set) a misprint?
    Actually, the red cheeked Pikachu is the misprint.

  16. How long until you will stop having these Thursday night chats?
    As long as you want them, we will have them.

  17. Will there be new precon decks for base/jungle 2, gym and rocket and what will they be called?
    Yes, there will be. We can’t be specific about them until the set is out but there will be PCD’s for Base Set 2 and for Rocket.

  18. Will there be any new attack side effects (poison, asleep, confuse, paralyze) I thought I had heard something about “scorch”, but I wasn’t sure if it was true
    There aren’t plans for anything new like this, no.

  19. How come you skipped over promo card #6?
    Different Promo cards are released by different companies, it’s hard to keep them in order.

  20. Does the cards with darker text mean that they are misprints?
    Nope, text and coloring changes are normal in different print runs.

  21. What plans are there for future Pokémon league giveaways?
    You join the League to earn your Pokémon badges. Anything else is just extra, it happens when it happens.

  22. Does Magmar’s smokescreen still works if I switch Pokémon?
    Yes, it would. It references the opponent’s active Pokémon. If he benches THAT, the effect ends.

  23. Are there any plans for wizards to make their own Pokémon cards not from Japan?
    There are no plans at this time to do so.

  24. Some people are saying, with all the cards and added confusion, Pokémon will be like MTG. Any plans to avoid doing this?
    Pokémon is much more basic than Magic, think of Pokémon like Checkers and Magic like Chess (but with many more pieces).

  25. How come my 1st edition Zapdos has hardly any holo stuff?
    If you are referring to the 1st edition Fossil Zapdos, it is a misprint. The holo on the top left is missing where there would have been a stage stamp.

  26. Will there be a holo us Mew?
    We cannot comment on unreleased cards, sorry.

  27. How much does 1st edition worth right now?
    Sorry, but we don’t keep track of card prices; a card is worth whatever you can get for it.

  28. I have agreed to run our Pokémon League’s first tournament in a month or so.Do you have to be a DCI member to be either the organizer or the head judge? In a related vein, is there a way to become a DCI member online, or only at existing tournaments?
    If you organize a tournament you automatically get a DCI number. Otherwise, you can get a DCI number through a tournament or through the League.

  29. When gold and silver for Gameboy comes out will you make cards for the 152 to 251 Pokémon?
    We are still involved in the next few sets (Rocket, and Gym sets). That is too far away to comment on at this time.

  30. If you have used Scythers swords dance and your opponent uses a gust of wind on your next turn you retreat the active Pokémon and put Scyther back out does it do 30 or 60
    If you retreat Scyther, of course, Swords Dance is canceled. So if he Gust of Winded, same thing.

  31. Does WotC have the ability under their contract to alter or adjust rules? And are they likely to?
    The answer is yes but we have no plans on doing so, outside of making it easy to understand.

  32. What are the rules on foreign cards in DCI play?
    You can use cards that are copies of already released English cards only. And you must have at least 1 English copy with you for translation purposes.

  33. If one of your Pokémon was poisoned, and a few turns later it is KO’d by the poison, does your opponent take a prize card although the poison KO’d the Pokémon and not your opponents Pokémon? And what if you’re own Pokémon knocks itself out?
    Yes, he would still draw a prize card. Whenever a Pokémon in knocked out, the other player gets prize cards even if you knock out your own.

  34. What’s going to happen to league after all the cities have been traveled to?
    The League is in over 2700 locations in North America every week. If you mean the Mall Tour it is still being set up for this year.

  35. If my opponent has an active Ditto and I switch my Pokémon, is ditto my new Pokémon, or Ditto with 50hp?
    Ditto always turns into a copy of whatever Pokémon he is facing when he is the active Pokémon (and not paralyzed, confused, or asleep).

  36. How long does Porygon’s conversion attack (changing weakness) last?
    It lasts until the Pokémon it was used on is benched.

  37. Is there any plan for a Pokémon Duelist style magazine?
    TopDeck has articles on Pokémon every month.

  38. Why do I have a jungle Electrode with a base set picture?
    You have a misprint.

  39. How many cards will there being the Rocket series and how many will be holos, rares, and etc?
    Sorry, but we cannot comment on unreleased cards.

  40. I am a DCI Member how come my personal web page won’t work?
    There are many thousands of league members and we are putting up your information as fast as we can. There is a bit of a lag though.

  41. Is the art going to change on base set 2? And I heard something about the holo being different. Is this true?
    The art will be identical, there will be a base set 2-expansion symbol on them.

  42. Will anymore CDs be released with promos like Japan with there 10 promos in one CD?
    There are no such plans that I know of.

  43. Why do you guys make Holo’s and Non-Holos? Why not like the Japanese?
    We make them this way so the collectors can keep their holos, but players can play with their cards.

  44. Are there any plans to release Togepi or Marril in any form before the release of Neo?
    There are no plans on translations of those at this time.

  45. Is Porygon’s Conversion 1/2 canceled if Porygon or your opponents Pokémon is knocked out or benched?
    If the opponent’s Pokémon is benched, the Conversion effect ends, it doesn’t matter if Porygon is.

  46. Would Magmar’s Smokescreen stop Kangaskhan’s Fetch?
    Yes, it would since Fetch is an attack.

  47. What’s base set 2?
    Base Set 2 is a re-release of cards form Base Set and Jungle.

  48. In my personal stats center for the DCI website as a legends members, I can review play statistics for Magic the gathering. I cannot appear to also review play history/statistics for Pokémon. Is support of this function for Pokémon going to be added?
    Your Pokémon stats (for the league) will appear on the Pokémon League page on our web site (though we are a bit behind).

  49. Would I get a prize if I knocked out a doll/fossil?
    No, you wouldn’t.

  50. Is there gonna be a Pokémon pro tour type event, ever?
    We have not announced anything like that yet.

  51. Are there any plans to release the Imkakuni? Cards to America? How about felt playmats like in Japan? Or the challenge passport?
    Sorry, but to be honest, I don’t know. I haven’t heard of any such plans though.

  52. How come the Pokémon tours always stop in NJ and not NY? So far only 1 tour has stopped in NY.
    Since the tour is so big, locations are based upon a mall’s willingness to host it.

  53. If the Pokémon neo cards were released like 2 months after the game gold and silver came out will ours be released after the English gold and silver come out or will we have to wait for rocket gym leader one and 2 before we get the Neo’s?
    The next sets, this year will be Rocket and the Gym sets.

  54. Will there ever be a Pokémon card fan club like in Japan?
    We have no plans for anything like that at this time.

  55. If my Clefairy does metronome and I do Chansey’s double edge attack…does Clefairy do 80 damage to itself
    Yes, it does.

  56. When will the Snorlax card be released?
    Snorlax was released in the Jungle set last summer.

  57. Why are you making a base set 2?
    These cards are being re-released to make them more available for everyone.

  58. What basic set 2 card’s will have and not have?
    The latest issue of TopDeck has the complete list.

  59. Why doesn’t the Energy Search card tell you to show the card to your opponent?
    All moves in the Pokémon game, are public knowledge. You do not hide what you are doing.

  60. How come my Charizard card has silver around the edges?
    It is just a result of the manufacturing process.

  61. Will TopDeck be giving away a Pokémon booster in its next month’s issue, or a booster from another game?
    The next issue should have a Magic Nemesis booster in it.

  62. How many English Pokémon cards (including promos) have been officially released?
    Roughly 242 or so, so far.

  63. Why did you only put out 2 jungle/ fossil precon decks but four base?
    They are much smaller sets.

  64. Who makes up the card’s attacks, damage, and powers?
    Creatures Inc.–the people who made the game in Japan.

  65. If a super energy removal is used on a Dragonair with two double colorless energies, do you remove one, or both?
    Your opponent can remove up to 2 energy CARDS, so he could take off both DCEs.

  66. Can fossil Gastly use his energy conversion to retrieve double colorless?
    Sure, he can retrieve 2 energy CARDS, either or both could be DCE’s.

  67. Does Mew do 10 times the energy card on the defending Pokémon or 10 damage for each energy card on the defending Pokémon?
    Does 10 damage times the number of Energy cards attached to the Defending Pokémon.

  68. If you use an attack that puts your opponents Pokémon to sleep (like haunter’s nightmare), and the defending Pokémon was already asleep before you attacked, Do you still have to flip a coin after the attack to see if it wakes up?
    Yes, they get to flip at the end of each player’s turn.

  69. If Mr. Mime is played against a Mewtwo with 20 damage on it, and uses Meditate, does it do ten, doubled, plus 20, or 10 plus 20, doubled?
    You calculate the base damage first, then double it for weakness, so 60 points damage total.

  70. Can you evolve a Pokémon right after Mew devolves it or do you have to wait a turn?"
    If you devolve your own, you just did an attack and your turn is over. If you devolved the opponent’s Pokémon, he can evolve it on his turn.

  71. Why do holos bend over time or when they are in a cold climate?"
    There are 2 different materials that make the holo cards, they have different contraction rates. You can press them flat under heavy books.

  72. If a mysterious fossil is the only “basic” card you have at the start of a game, does it count as a basic or do you have to shuffle and try again?
    You have to reshuffle, it counts as a Trainer card when it is in your hand.

  73. Will base set 2 have a expansion symbol?
    Yes, it will, It will have a number “2” with a Poke-ball on it.

  74. Will there be a promo in the video of Pokémon first movie?
    I’ve heard there will be but until it is released we can’t comment on it sorry.

  75. Will base set and jungle stop running?
    Eventually, we have not announced any end to the reprint runs yet though.

  76. Does Charizard’s energy burn change an energy forever…or until the end of the turn?
    The energy changed using Charizard’s energy burn only stays fire energy until the end of the turn.

  77. What is “Pikablu”?
    That is a nickname for the Japanese Pokémon card, Marril.

  78. Is there an e-mail we can write to WoTC for suggestions and comments on the Pokémon card game?
    Sure, just write to us here at custserv@wizards.com

  79. Can I use Tentacool’s cowardice as many times as I want?
    No, once you scoop Tentacool back into your hand, you could put him on the bench again, but you can’t use the power the turn Tentacool comes into play.

  80. Can you use energy transfer after Charizard has energy burned a grass energy?
    No, since that energy was changed into fire energy (until the end of the turn), Venasaur can’t energy transfers it.

82.Could you make oversized cards and decks for the visually challenged?
I will pass that suggestion along.

Fri. Feb 11, 2000 - Pokemon League Q&A

TCG Hour: Pokémon League
Featuring Jennifer Wood, Pokémon Organized Play Coordinator

Fri Feb 11, 2000

WizO_Arkana: Welcome to the TCG Hour. Make the most of your Pokémon know-how by joining your local League. Jennifer Wood, Pokémon Organized Play Coordinator, will tell you the perks of participating.

WizO_Ginger: Okay, Jennifer! Do you have any opening comments, or should we go right into Q and A?

WotC_Jennifer: Hi everyone!! Are any of you currently league members?

OKIEPOKE: Yes.

WizO_Ginger: My seven year old son is a member of our local league.

guest5: Yes.

Drako151: I think I am—I signed up for it.

WOTC_Mel: ::toes ground with shoe:: Nope.

WizO_Arkana: Nope. Don’t play Pokémon.

WizO_Unicorn: I’m not . . . but I do play.

WotC_Jennifer: For those who aren’t league members, but would like to be, you can check out the store locator in the Pokémon League section of our website at <Wizards of the Coast> and enter your area to see what is near you. Now, let’s go to Q & A and see where that goes.

WizO_Ginger: Okay, great. I have a question, Jennifer. How long does the “season” last? Meaning, will there be league during the summer months?

WotC_Jennifer: There are eight seasons that last six weeks each. We are currently in our 3rd season. The dates are: Season #2 Oct. 23, Season #3 Jan. 8, Season #4 Feb. 19, Season #5 April 1, Season #6 May 13, Season #7 June 24, and Season #8 August 5. So, yes, at the minimum there will be locations operating through September. In addition, new stores are always entering the program, and they will run later.

WizO_Ginger: Keen! I’m sure my son will be happy to hear that.

Drako151: So, right now, the Thunder badge is being given out. What badge is there for next month?

WotC_Jennifer: Rainbow! But you can always start at any time and work your way toward the current badges—it is never too late to join!

Drako151: Cool!

WizO_Unicorn: Okay, what’s a badge?

WotC_Jennifer: A badge is a pin. They correspond to the eight badges in the cartoon and Gameboy game.

WizO_Ginger: Do you have to attend every week to gain anything from it?

WotC_Jennifer: No, you can come as often or as little as you like.

Drako151: I heard a promo Pikachu was given out in the first season, then Mew this season. When’s the next promo coming out?

WotC_Jennifer: That is top secret information! But probably soon.

Drako151: OK.

guest5: How does someone become a Pokémon League Gym Leader? (I’ll get my terminology correct sometime soon). Is there a qualifying test or something else needed?

WotC_Jennifer: No, Gym Leaders are only store employees who run the league. The stores assign them. But there is a Certified Coach test that you can take that allows you to receive points for teaching others how to play.

WizO_Ginger: What do you have to do to qualify for the Certified Coach test?

WotC_Jennifer: Nothing—you can just take the test.

WOTC_Mel: Jennifer, where would I go to get the Coach test?

WotC_Jennifer: The Gym Leader can provide the test. If you answer 13 or more right, you get a cool, shiny Certified Coach sticker for the back of your book.

WOTC_Mel: What is your status for having all eight badges? And will they be different badges next year?

WotC_Jennifer: Next year’s plan will be revealed later in the year.

guest13: Are they ever going to come out with a holographic Mew?

WotC_Jennifer: Holo-Mew — as I said before, promo cards are top secret!

Drako151: After all eight seasons are done with, do you think that there will probably be another series of seasons?

WotC_Jennifer: There may be another series of eight seasons, or it may change. We are currently developing next year’s program.

Drako151: After Base Set 2 is released, are they going to stop printing Base 1 and Jungle 1?

WotC_Jennifer: Regarding Base Set 2 — I don’t have that info; that is out of my area.

OKIEPOKE: I’m currently helping at Waldenbooks as Gym Leader. (The store employees could barely spell Pokémon, let alone play, so they asked me to help.) I was wondering what the average rate of badge-earning should be for the league members.

WotC_Jennifer: Well, there really isn’t an average rate. The league is designed to go at each individual’s pace.

guest13: Jen, is Wizards gonna come out with a Togape card? That’s probably top-secret, isn’t it?

WotC_Jennifer: Can’t comment on future cards — please stick to league questions. Thanks!

guest5: There is a stipulation at the league I play in concerning the Coach test. We must make it to the finals of that week’s tournament to qualify to take the test.

WotC_Jennifer: That is not how we outline the league. They should let anyone who wants to take the test.

Drako151: What are some of the ways to earn points?

WotC_Jennifer: Attendance, bringing a new member, league activity, trading a card, helping the Gym Leader, completing sets, playing a game, and winning a game.

Drako151: How many do you get for playing and winning?

WotC_Jennifer: Ten points for playing, and an additional ten if you win.

guest14: If you collect an entire set, do you get the 10 points for completing it every season?

WotC_Jennifer: Yes, you can earn them every season.

guest14: Thanks!

Drako151: In the place I play, each game is two rounds. (You get 0 pts for losing (both rounds), 1 pt each for a tie (both win one round), and 3 pts for winning both rounds, then finalists are determined by the number of pts.) If I won both, would that count as 20 for each round, or 20 for the whole game?(Or does it just depend on the store?)

WotC_Jennifer: It should be that you play one game, the winner gets 20 points, and the loser gets 10.

Drako151: OK, thanx!

WizO_Ginger: Jennifer, some of the kids play it with only three prizes, so that when you play with six prizes, it counts as two games.

Drako151: No, you play two rounds, and if each person wins a round, that’s a tie, so each player gets 1 point.

OKIEPOKE: There can’t be a tie — you use sudden death to determine a winner, right?

WotC_Jennifer: To earn points for playing a game, you need to play a game following the rules in the rulebook.

WOTC_Mel: Hmm, Drako, better talk to that Gym Leader of yours!

Drako151: I play at the gathering grounds. That’s where Mike Jente and some other high ranking people play. (I’m not too good though.)

guest5: Once a person signs up for the Pokémon League, approximately how long should it take to become registered with WOTC and get access to the “Trainer Personal Web Pages” at http://www.wizards.com/Pokémon/league\_intro.asp?

WotC_Jennifer: It should take two to three weeks — that is if the Gym Leader sends in the paperwork right away.

guest14: On WOTC’s trainer pages, what do they mean by prizes earned?

WotC_Jennifer: I am unable to pull up a page at the moment, but I think that is where the badges you have earned are displayed.

guest14: But what about prizes? When I see a page, it says prizes earned and badges earned. What are prizes on the pages?

WotC_Jennifer: Prizes are the prize cards you select to dress up your web page.

WOTC_Mel: Yeah, I am looking at the page guest14 was talking about — it is prize cards.

guest5: Is there an official DCI rulebook that has a more expanded rules explanation than the rulebooks we receive with the Starter Set and Preconstructed decks?

WotC_Jennifer: There is no official DCI rulebook. There are floor rules on the wizards.com website. In Base 2 PCDs there will be a new rulebook. I mean, in the new starter set there is a new rulebook.

guest5: Where are the “floor rules” located? Are these the same rules that are in the rulebooks we receive with the Starter Set and Preconstructed Decks?

WotC_Jennifer: No, on the main web page (wizards.com). I think you click on DCI on the left and through there you can get floor rules.

WOTC_Mel: Floor Rules can be found at: www.wizards.com/DCI/UTR_POK.asp.

WotC_Jennifer: Thanks Mel!!!

guest5: Thanks, Mel. Jennifer, do you know the version number of the rulebook that is included with the Base Set 2 Starter Set? The latest version I have is Version 3.

WotC_Jennifer: No, that would probably be a question for customer service.

OKIEPOKE: I noticed in the box that was received at Waldenbooks where I help, there was a videotape. Can you tell me what it has on it?

WotC_Jennifer: The videotape has information for the Gym Leader on how to run the league.

OKIEPOKE: OK.

Drako151: What stores are required to have the Pokémon League?

WotC_Jennifer: No stores are “required” to run the league — unless it is a mass Market chain and they decide to run it in every store.

Drako151: OK, well what stores normally have it?(I know Toys R Us has it.)

WotC_Jennifer: Toys R Us, Books-A-Million, Zany Brainy, Wizards of the Coast, Game Keeper, Noodle Kidoodle, select Borders, select Walden, Select KB Toyworks. Also, many independent retail stores — you can check out store locator at Wizards of the Coast. Click on the league logo and scroll down for locations near you.

OKIEPOKE: Each week seems a little hectic what with forty little rascals all around. Any suggestions on making things less chaotic?

WotC_Jennifer: You could suggest that the store increase its number of league sessions. That way, the Trainers are spread out on different days/times.

guest5: Yes, at the league I attend there are two days a week where the tournaments are held. Also, Okiepoke could try to recruit other adults to help out.

WOTC_Mel: Okie, I feel your pain. The customer service chat we have on Thursdays here is *crazy*.

OKIEPOKE: We discussed that last week about having a beginner session where we teach game play and deck construction and an advanced session for skilled players.

WotC_Jennifer: I have heard of stores that do that and it works for them. However, you want to make sure that as kids learn how to play better, they are paired with more advanced kids so they are challenged.

OKIEPOKE: Understood. I think we’ll try that.

guest5: I currently have a rulebook that is listed as Version 3. Do you know if the new Base Set 2 Starter Set rulebook will be a newer version?

WotC_Jennifer: I am not sure — that is out of my area. Try emailing questions@wizards.com.

guest5: Will do, thanks.

WotC_Jennifer: Actually, now that I think of it, I think it is.

OKIEPOKE: This may not be your area, but we are in great need of more sign-up cards and haven’t received them. Is there anyone special that we could contact to get additional cards? Not the promo cards — the ones used to join the league.

WotC_Jennifer: There isn’t a card used to join the league exactly. Which card are you referring to specifically?

OKIEPOKE: It is the card each person fills out. The Gym Leader sends them in to WotC.

WotC_Jennifer: OK, DCI cards. You order those as you normally order all supplies; it is different for every chain.

OKIEPOKE: OK, it’s a Walden’s and they probably go through their main office or something. Again, I am just an Adult Volunteer that helps.

Drako151: OK, to see my DCI stats, I go to DCI on the wizards main page, then is it in personal stats? (I’ve tried before and nothing came up. I thought it might be because they hadn’t sent in the membership yet.)

WotC_Jennifer: DCI and league is different. To see your badges, etc., you go to Wizards of the Coast, click on the league logo, then scroll down to personal trainer pages.

Drako151: Oh, OK.

guest5: In the February 2000, TopDeck magazine, there was a writeup about Base Set 2. One of the new training items being made available was a CD-ROM. Have you seen it and if so, would this be a good item to suggest for new league members to get?

OKIEPOKE: If the CD is from WotC, then Jennifer is required to say that yes, everyone should buy it! LOL!

WotC_Jennifer: Guest 5 — yes I have seen it briefly. If it is the CD I am thinking of, it is a good way to learn the game. (It is pretty cool, too!) We also have an online demo on our website.

Drako151: I think new league members should buy it. That’s why it’s being released, to teach new players!

WizO_Ginger: Okay, Jennifer, do you have any last words before we call it quits for the night?

WotC_Jennifer: Thank you everyone for bearing with me on my first chat. I had fun!

WizO_Ginger: We are glad you came, Jennifer. Come again soon!

WotC_Jennifer: Bye!

WOTC_Mel: And remember Poke folks — you can come to our Thursday Customer Service chats, now going for a record three hours! They run from 2-5 pm PST.

Thurs. Feb 17, 2000 - Weekly Pokemon TCG Q&A

Pokémon Online Help
Offered every Thursday 2-5 PST in the TCG Forum of the Wizards.Community chat site!
Featuring Master_Trainer from Customer Service

Thurs. Feb 17, 2000

Master_Trainer: Are you SEAKING to WEEDLE answers to your ODDISH Pokemon questions no matter how FARFETCHE’D? GEO-DUDE, don’t feel GASTLY, we are here to remove your JINX and lift you out of the MUK with Master_Trainer power! So you know the BEEDRILL, close your MEOWTH, don’t be a SLOWPOKE and type in your questions RAPID(edly).

  1. I’m wondering about the discontinuing of production of the base card and jungle series of Pokémon cards. I’ve heard conflicting stories.
    Good question. Base set and Jungle will be discontinued at some point. That date has not been set yet, but we will announce it when it is.

  2. Ditto is out against (F) Magmar. Magmar uses smokescreen. Then the trainer with ditto uses gust of wind and puts a different Pokémon out does Ditto still have to flip to attack?
    Yes, it does. The Smokescreen attack only references the defending Pokémon (in this case Ditto). Benching Magmar does NOT remove this effect (though benching the Ditto would).

  3. Why don’t you use translations from the Scyre to translate future sets?
    Scrye magazine is not an official Pokémon publication. Their translations are only approximations and not official.

  4. Where can Pokémon TCG fans make suggestions to Wizards of the Coast?
    Send email to custserv@wizards.com

  5. Will Wizards go to the Japanese format of a holo in every booster?
    There are no plans to do so at this time.

  6. Will Wizards of the Coast have any plans to release a Pokémon Challenge Passport where you receive a free promo card after battling 50 people and having their names signed in the passport?
    Sorry but we have no plans for anything like that at this time.

  7. When is the next promo card due to release at the Pokémon league?
    We don’t announce information on specific cards before they are released sorry. I believe there are plans for another promo for the next season for the league though.

  8. Is there going to be a new Arcanine promo at the Pokémon league?
    I think this will be the next promo card through the league (listed in TopDeck magazine).

  9. When will wizards have the Base Set 2 on their online store?
    They should be available online about the same time they will be available in stores (should be at the end of the month).

  10. I was playing a game at the Pokémon TCG League and the kid used a Ditto. He transformed into my Electabuzz. I eventually did 60 damage to it so the Ditto had 50 damage. I than retreated and sent in a Hitmonlee, shouldn’t it have been KO’d. I though
    You’re right it should have, Ditto would have turned into the Hitmonlee (which only has 60 HP), since you had already done 60 to it, and Ditto would have been knocked out.

  11. What promo cards are available and up coming please give me the name of the Pokémon and where to find them?
    Sorry but we can’t comment on cards that we have not released.

  12. Is there a new Wizards card inserted with the March TopDeck magazine?
    Yes, there is a Wizard’s stamped Wartortle from Base Set 2.

  13. If I have Zubat up and retreat him, can I bring him back as active or do I have to bring up another benched Pokémon?
    When you retreat a Pokémon, you are swapping it with another on the bench. So in this case, Zubat goes to the bench, and you bring up a different Pokémon from your bench.

  14. Is there a date for rocket to come out?
    It looks like mid-April at this point for Team Rocket.

  15. Is it still possible to get a Prerelease Clefable? If yes, how?
    Sorry, but we do not have any more copies of that card. They were all sent out to the Leagues last year. Check on the secondary market.

  16. Is it legal to have a deck with absolutely no Pokémon so that you mulligan and the opponent will draw cards till he looses?
    It is legal but the opponent has the choice of drawing 2 extra cards, he does not have to. So what would be the point? The game would never start.

  17. How does Wizards of the Coast plan to release the Vending Machine cards?
    We have no plans to do so at this time.

  18. I heard when base set 2 comes out some of the cards are going to be taken out, like Evees and all his evolutions, is this true
    Yes, there will be 130 cards in Base Set 2, so some of the cards from Base and Jungle won’t be in it. The Eevee cards are some of those. There will be versions of Eevee available in Team Rocket though.

  19. Will Wizards of the Coast have ANY plans to hold national tournaments like in Japan or international torments?
    We are looking into that but there are no specific plans at this time.

  20. Does Machamp do damage if he is hit by a stretch kick?
    Yes, his Pokémon power Strikes Back would damage the other Pokémon even if Machamp is hit when he is on the bench.

  21. Do you plan to have a card list like Decipher.com/ use to look at cards for Pokémon TCG?
    We do have card lists on our website already. We are working on an improved list that will be up soon.

  22. Can holo cards that are “mint” or directly from a pack still have hairline scratches on the foil portion?
    Yes, the manufacturing process causes them.

  23. Will powerful cards like Super Energy Removal, Proffesor Oak, and ECT ever is a “banned” card similar to banned cards in Magic the Gathering?
    There are no plans on banning any Pokémon cards at this time.

  24. When will the Arcanine Promo be released?
    It will be an upcoming League promo card, yes.

  25. Will Pokémon TCG Starter Deck cards ever become 60 random cards?
    No, the pre-constructed decks are for playing the game. You need multiples of certain cards to play.

  26. Will there be a 1st Edition of Base Set 2?
    No.

  27. My friend has a Snorlax without a Jungle symbol found in a base set booster. Was this a miss-print or something?
    Yes, a recent printing of the Jungle holos were missing the Jungle symbol. They are real cards.

  28. What is your favorite deck type, Pokémon Help guy?
    I like fighting/grass decks with lots of small, quick hitting Pokémon like Hitmochan and Scyther

  29. If a Ditto goes against a Blastiose, can Ditto use Raindance on any type of energy?
    No, Raindance says you must take water energy from your hand and place it on one of you water Pokémon.

  30. Are you going to make something on this site to play Pokémon TCG online?
    There are no plans to do so.

  31. Do you have to add energy to a Pokémon and attack with your active Pokémon if you have energies in your hand?
    No, you don’t have to.

  32. When is the next Pokémon movies expected to be out in the U.S.?
    We don’t make the Pokémon movies, but we’ve heard it’s due sometime in July

  33. Are the Gym cards gonna be released in English?
    Yes, they will be released later this year.

  34. When do the seasons start of the Pokémon League?
    Different League locations are on different schedules, but I think season #4 should be starting soon.

  35. Will DCI sanctioned Pokémon tournaments allow Base Set 1 and Jungle Set after the release Base Set II?
    Yes, they will.

  36. At the Pokémon League, my opponent used a Ditto and I used Electabuzz, after a few turns his Ditto had 60 damage. I retreated and sent Hitmonlee with 60 HP. I was told Ditto’s power is automatic and it specifically says it transforms into the "Defender
    Right, so when Ditto transforms into Hitmonlee, he will be knocked out.

  37. Will Pokémon accessories like coins, damage counters and such are sold separately licensed by Wizards of the Coast?
    We will be looking into making other Pokémon accessories available.

  38. Are there plans to have a first edition Team Rocket and if yes, will it be available in the online store?
    Yes, but I don’t know about the online stores plans for this.

  39. Where can I get the Pokémon TopDeck magazine and is it ALL about POKÉMON?
    You can find it at hobby, game and bookstores. It covers a lot of different TCG’s and other games.

  40. I’ve heard that there will be a promo in the March issue of top deck when’s the new issue going to be released and what promo is in it?
    TopDeck #4 should be hitting stores soon and it will come with a Wizards foil-stamped Wartotle from Base Set 2.

  41. If I use jab with Hitmonchan on Scyther and I attach a pluspower does it do 10?
    No, because Plus Power will only do the extra damage if the original attack does damage (after applying weakness and resistance).

  42. Do you like donuts?
    All Pokémon Trainers like donuts.

  43. When will the Pokémon Strategy guide come out?
    I believe the release date for that is March.

  44. Will the Base Set 2 cards be the same as Base Set 1 or will they be different (new pictures, different moves, etc.)
    They will be the same.

  45. Will there be non-holos in English rocket of the holos
    Yes, just like Jungle and Fossil.

  46. What promo cards are available, please give me the name of the Pokémon and where to find them?
    There is a great list of the promos in issue #4 of Top Deck.

  47. I heard that you have extra of Jigglypuff from the Movie Soundtrack. If so are you going to release them like you did to Mew?
    For right now the Promo Jigglypuff is only available through the movie soundtrack

  48. So you don’t have to draw two cards if your opponent doesn’t draw a basic Pokémon?
    No, you MAY draw two cards; you do not have to.

  49. Are planning on having an online Pokémon TCG game like you do with Magic the Gather?
    There are no plans at this time, sorry.

  50. How do you receive pre release Aerodactyl from a league?
    That card was sent out to Leagues last year. We do not have any more of them. Check the secondary market.

  51. Someone I know got a movie promo with the Jigglypuff promo he got for purchasing the soundtrack… what’s the possibility of that happening to me?
    Well, the movie promotion is through Warner Brothers, and the sound track is through Atlantic records. You would have to ask them.

  52. How will the bad or evil evolution be played?
    Like any other Pokémon card, no special rules.

Thurs. Feb 24, 2000 - Weekly Pokemon TCG Q&A

Pokémon Online Help
Offered every Thursday 2-5 PST in the TCG Forum of the Wizards.Community chat site!
Featuring Master_Trainer from Customer Service

Thurs. February 24, 2000

Master_Trainer: Hi Trainers! We’re here at the top of the Space Weedle to answer your Pokémon TCG questions. Please remember that we try to answer gameplay questions first and we cannot comment on cards that aren’t out yet.

  1. I am just learning about the Pokémon cards. I have three cards that I recently got from jungle booster packs and they don’t have the jungle symbol on them. Is this normal?
    Those are misprinted cards.

  2. Has the foil odds in Base Set 2 increased?
    The premium card odds are exactly the same as Base Set 1.

  3. Will Wizards of the Coast produce a Challenge Passport where you receive a free card after playing 50 people?
    I know of no plans to do anything like that at this time.

  4. In Japan, Media Factory has Professor Ooyamo as the card expert. Who is the card expert for Wizards of the Coast?
    We have a staff of 14 trainers that exist on donuts and Mountain Dew that answer questions.

  5. What is the difference between Base Set 1 cards and Base Set 2 cards?
    Base Set 2 is a combination of Base Set 1 and Jungle with some cards removed.

  6. Help Guy, I know this question sounds stupid but in your opinion, what is the most powerful card out in America for?
    I always come back to Professor Oak.

  7. When using Scoop Up, can you put all into hand or only basic?
    Only basic.

  8. How many holos are there in base set 2?
    20

  9. Do I have to discard defender, if resistance cancels out the damage done by the defending, or does it stay until some damage is done?
    You have to discard Defender at the end of your opponent’s next turn.

  10. In Base Set 2,will there be non-holo versions of cards such as Charizard?
    No, there will not be non-holo versions of holo cards.

  11. Does base set2 contain fossil cards?
    No.

  12. Who are you? We know that Mike is gone… what’s your credentials?
    I’m Master Trainer Patrick taking over for MT Mike this week.

  13. What Card is coming in the Stadium bundle?
    Sorry, but we can’t comment on cards that we have not released.

  14. Does Muk’s Power ignore ALL in play or just your opponent’s Power?
    All Powers except for Toxic Gases. This includes your own.

  15. I have this trainer card, it’s American, and called Meowth’s Meow Mix… It says to flip a coin, if heads, Meowth is invincible, is it real?
    Hmmm. I’ve never heard of that one.

  16. We have a set of BS2 but there is no Machamp. Why wasn’t this identified as a missing card in TopDeck?
    The Machamp is still available in the Starter Set, but it’s not a Base Set 2 card.

  17. During a game of TCG, what do you do if you draw an extra basic if your bench is full?
    Keep it in your hand for later.

  18. May I discard a basic energy card as the cost of Energy Retrieval, only to retrieve it as one of the 2 energy cards?
    Yes.

  19. Alakazam’s power states “you may move 1 damage counter from 1 of your to another”. Does to another mean you may move one of your counters over to your opponents?
    No, you have to move the damage counter to another one of your

    Since you’re playing the card Item Finder it won’t be in your discard pile to pull back.

    All the holos that don’t appear in a Theme Deck will be equally rare.

  22. Can I play a power plus then a gambler and play a power plus I got from the gambler?

  125. How much damage would metronome do when the damage of the attack copied is dependent on the amount of energy discarded (ex: Blanes Charizard’s fire breath
    Ok. Here we go: the Metronome attack copies the attack and negates the cost (a.k.a. the energy cost of the attack). It also negates any payments to complete the attack like Charazards fire spin where it says you have to discard energy in order to do this attack. However on cards like Blastoise and any other card that has and added attack bonus for extra energy or attached cards you have to follow those rules as normal. Example if Clafable copied Hydro pump he would do 40 points of damage unless he had extra water energy on him, the same holds true for discarding for extra effects.

Thurs. March 2, 2000 - Weekly Pokemon TCG Q&A

Pokémon Online Help
Offered every Thursday 2-5 PST in the TCG Forum of the Wizards.Community chat site!
Featuring Master_Trainer from Customer Service

Thurs. March 2, 2000

Hello all, Master Trainer here to answer questions for you. We are working on our server today so it may be a bit slow. First though I’d like to tell you about a couple of new rulings from R & D.

New Metronome rules from the latest R & D meeting this week:
Whenever Metronome is used to copy and attack that “refers to itself” like Chansey’s Double Edge, does 80 to defending Pokémon AND does 80 damage to Chansey, you would replace the self reference with Clefable or Clefairy. So the attack would read "does 80 damage to defending Pokémon and 80 damage to itself (Clefable or Clefairy).

If an attack does refer to other Pokémon, like Bellsprout’s Call for Family attack:
Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon named Bellsprout and put it onto your Bench, you would NOT replace the reference with Clefable or Clefairy. So if you used Metronome to copy this attack, you could only search your deck for Bellsprout’s.

Also, when you use a trainer card, first you pay the cost (if any), then you resolve the effect of the trainer card, then you discard that trainer card. So you could NOT use Item Finder to bring itself back from the discard pile (you would discard 2 other cards from your hand, then pull a trainer card from your discard pile to your hand, THEN you would discard the Item Finder).

So, we here at the Space Weedle. Start in on your questions!

  1. Can a Ditto against a Venusaur use Energy Trans on any type of energy?
    Not really, since you can make energy attached to Ditto be any type you could use a copied Venusar’s Energy Trans to move THAT energy to any Pokémon, but energy on OTHER Pokémon would still have to be grass energy to use this power.

  2. Has NEO been confirmed an official American release?
    Nope, not yet.

  3. If I use Scotch tape to tape up one of my worn out card selves, will it be considered as “marked” in a Pokémon tournament?
    Yes, it would, sorry.

  4. Will there be any Pokémon Challenge Passport -eque type stuff coming to America?
    Not that we know of yet.

  5. If you where Smokescreen-ed by a Fossil Magmar and retreated, would you still have to flip to attack?
    No, benching your Pokémon would end the Smokescreen effect on you.

  6. Have you ever met Professor Ooyamo?
    No, but he does have a cool name with lots of vowels.

  7. Can Wizards of the Coast modify rules for Pokémon?
    If needed but we don’t unless there is some confusion over translations.

  8. Would you be so kind to explain to use what exactly Ditto copies with his Pokémon Power, Transform?
    It just copies whatever is written on the opponent’s Active Pokémon card.

  9. What are your opinions on Pojo.com?
    It’s a good unofficial resource.

  10. The trainer card “Energy Search” says nothing about showing the card to your opponent once you have found it in your deck. Shouldn’t you have to show it as part of “good-gamesmanship?”
    The other player must be able to see what energy card you pull out of your deck. This is done to verify that they in fact pulled an energy card. If the card just said to pull out any card, then they would NOT have to show it.

  11. Any official dates on the release of Team Rocket?
    None specific yet, mid-April is all we know so far.

  12. I played against trainers who “hid” attached energy cards on benched Pokémon under the Pokémon card. Is this legal? (I don’t think it is). How you advise the player it’s not okay since the issue is not directly addressed in the rule? Thank you.
    That is not legal. Any card that is in play must be visible. This is a standard card game rule and is done so you can make sure each other is playing correctly.

  13. Is the new promotional card “Arcanine” now available at our local Pokémon Leagues?
    Should be soon. It’s this season’s card. I’ve heard of stores just starting to get it.

  14. Hello, We get the hardest rules questions in our league; this is some Debatable question. I want to verify that Magmar’s Smokescreen wears off when the defending Pokémon (the one who got smoked) retreats and When Scyther does Sword Dance and gets gusted out and can’t do its 60 anymore next turn. Just want to verify it. Thanks.
    You are correct. Whenever an effect of an attack references a particular Pokémon and it is benched, that effects ends. So even Scyther’s Sword Dance effect ends.

  15. Any banned Pokémon cards in the future?
    Nope.

  16. When Clefable metronomes Big Eggplosion how much damage does it do…And what is needed?
    You would flip a coin for each energy card attached to CLEFABLE (not Exxegcutor). For each heads that comes up it would do 20 damage.

  17. Do you have any ideas on how to fix a worn out Pokémon card sleeve?
    Umm…no. You could always use them to gather rainwater if you were trapped on a deserted desert island though.

  18. Can you Rain Dance on a ditto as long you have the water energy _in your hand_ but not any other energy such as a fighting energy?
    Correct, Ditto’s effect of changing energy types does NOT effect cards in your hand, only attached to Ditto.

  19. I have heard there will be differences with the foil in future cards. What exactly is this major difference with the foil on the current cards and current cards?
    True, it started with Base Set 2 cards. We ran out of the old foil, the new foil looks pretty cool.

  20. Why was Mew released as a promo and not part of the Fossil set, and why is he non-holo?
    Fossil was made to complete the original 150 Pokémon, Mew is 151. The Japanese felt that Mew should NOT have been in Fossil so we changed that when it came here. We released it as a Promo since he was very popular and now everyone has a great chance of getting him.

  21. What is the penalty for drawing 2 cards instead of 1 at the beginning of your turn? Is it disqualification?
    Hmmm, I’d recommend a charley horse. Seriously though, it would depend on whether it was a sanctioned tournament or not and whether it was intentional. You would probably get a warning the first time it happened. It would depend on the level of the tournament?

  22. I know you may not be able to answer this, but what will the cards packaged with Nintendo’s Stadium Bundle and the new Pokémon TCG Game Boy Game be?

  24. I know this one’s a bit odd, but how do you score damage if Porygon’s Conversion1 attack changes an opponent’s weakness to the same color as its resistance? Do you double first and then apply resistance or do you apply resistance 1st and then double?

  35. Is there a difference between “trading” your cards Such As Energy Retrieval and “discarding” your cards such as an Item Finder?     No, you don’t. You MAY draw two extra cards.

  42. I’ve seen a Holofoil English Mew stating it’s the 9th promo card. Is it true? (Not bothering about the release date?)

Master_Trainer Pat: Mike’s back. And he types a LOT faster.
Master_Trainer Mike: Thanks for covering for me, Pat!

  1. Is the 152-252 Pokémon going to be in the future expansions?

    Waving your arms around disjointedly. (Ahem), He ran across the room with his arms all-akimbo.

  62. Why don’t you up the booster pack card count to 13 and add energies into every booster (like in magic)?
    If we increased the number of cards, the cost would increase and it would cost you more for cards. Don’t think many people would like that.

  63. Why is Poilwhirl on EVERYTHING?
    Because he is so hypnotizing.

  64. A different company than the usual Japanese made Neo. Cards so does that mean you won’t make them?

  65. Are there any non-holo rare Pokémon in Base 2?

  66. What is the Base Set 2 Starter set Rare card(s)?
    It’s still a Machamp.

  67. Are there any plans for a holo mew promo?
    Maybe.

  68. Is it possible for the WotC update some of the information in the Pokémon web page?
    We are aware that we are falling behind on updating it. There are many people joining all of the time, we are working on it pronto.

  69. Are any Pokémon resistant to grass?
    We aren’t aware of any.

  70. Why isn’t Electabuzz a hologram and Clefairy was?
    Clefairy got better grades in homeroom class. Hee hee hee.

  71. Is the holo in the starter set Machamp and if so is it from Base 1 or Base 2?
    It’s actually from Base Set 1 (and it is a Machamp).

  72. Could you tell me the rares that come in the theme decks in base set 2?
    Grass Chopper has Clefairy, Hot Water has Poliwrath, Lightning Bug has Chansey, and Psch Out has Wigglytuff.

  73. In regards to #141 is Machamp 1st edition?
    Yes, it is. There will never be a non 1st edition Machamp (at least so far).

  74. Why did the show pick Pikachu? I think it should have been Bulbasaur
    It reminds Ash of his pet hamster Herbie. Kidding!

  75. Will there be any other Pokémon games? (Ex. an rpg card game)

  76. Will there be a WotC section at the Stadium 2000 tour?
    We will have a small presence in that tour, yes.

  77. If Ditto copies Scythers swords dance attack, and on my opponents turn, he benches Scyther and brings up his other Scyther, on my turn, would swords dance be active?
    Yes, it would still be active, there is no mid point where Ditto would have reverted to himself in this case, he stayed a Scyther and the Swords Dance was referencing himself.

  78. Let’s say Clefable Metronomes Scyther’s Sword Dance, then Scyther retreated for a. Machop. Next turn, would Clefable’s Metronoming of a Machop’s Low Kick deal 20 or 40 damage?
    No.

    Base Set Machamp.

  80. Are any Pokémon s special things (weakness, resistance, attack energy cost or retreat) changed in base set 2?
    Nope.

  81. Is the unlimited Machamp worth more than the first edition yet?
    There is no unlimited Machamp.

Master_Trainer Mike: So, I’m going to swap back with Pat again. TAG!

  1. I noticed on the “Wizards Store” webpages that only the Base Set 2 Starter Set with the CD is available. Do you know when the Base Set 2 Starter Set with the CD and video will be available?

  2. I heard something about WotC not making 1st edition base 2’s because you didn’t want to make 1st edition Charizard and Blastoise so widely available again?
    The truth is all the Base Set 2 cards have already been seen before, why do first editions of cards we’ve already done first edition for?

  3. Are there any plans to release movie promo(s) for the new movie?
    Plans, yes. Specifics…not yet.

  4. In your judgement, how many basic Pokémon should be in a deck?
    I would say about 16.

  5. Is Wizards going to make an official program for playing Pokémon online like apprentice for magic?
    Nothing is in the works as of right now.

  6. Any plans for another Pokémon Card Tour (like current Stadium tour, but for TCG)?
    There will be a mall tour this year. I think they’re finalizing the schedule now.

  7. Do you collect Pokémon cards? If so how many do you have?
    Yes, after I built a 1/8th-size model of the Space N(W)eedle in my backyard, I had enough left over to mosaic of Jimi Hendrix on my bedroom wall.

  8. Are you going to give out cards on the Stadium 2000 tour?
    I don’t know.

  9. If someone made up a set of like say 68 new cards and sent them to you (with what all the cards say exactly), would they be considered?

  10. My friend’s dad told me he pulled a 1st edition Machamp from a base 1 unlimited booster pack…is that possible?
    It’s not supposed to, but that doesn’t mean it’s impossible.

  11. If a Ditto copy Swords Dance which says his SLASH does 60, could it copy Charmeleon’s for 60?
    No, the Swords Dance refers to Scyther’ s Slash.

  18. Why don’t tours come to Canada?

  19. When will the Pokémon league come to Europe?

  21. What do you do at WotC?

  22. Are there any restrictions to using the “paper” coins that come with the preconstructed decks in tournaments or league play. ie: if they become worn, with curled up edges?

  26. What does the Space N(W)eedle card do?

  27. I want to collect all the promo card. So is it possible for WOTC to update this kind of info regularly? (On the web site)

  28. Would Plus Power be doubled if the defending Pokémon had a weakness? Or added after the attacks damage is doubled?
    No, the effects of Plus Power are applied after Weakness ands Resistance.

  30. I did run the light test on them, but come on Toys R Us selling fake cards?
    If they passed they’re for real.

  31. Do I have to pay full price (pay for each pack) if I buy a box at Wizard’s store?
    Yes.

  32. Are you guys gonna put different are on rocket-gym2 sets because after fossil the art kind of goes downhill?

Master_Trainer Pat: Tag Team, Mike!

  1. Is there really a holo Metapod?

  2. How about a Card Tour in NYC, please?

  3. How can I become a DCI judge?

  4. When you use Pokémon breeder do you discard it immediately or do you leave it on the Pokémon?

  7. When Clefable metronomes Moltres’ wildfire, what are the rules? Is it true you can burn the opponent’s whole deck automatically?

  8. Will the promo Arcanine be like the on from the Japanese Best Collection’s CD?
    Dunno, its like the one we made, haven’t seen theirs, sorry.

  9. Is there a reason why the Promo numbers skipped around so much (i.e. Mew=8, Arcanine=6, etc.)?

  10. I was wondering about the new jungle prints. Their holos have no Jungle Symbol. Were they having another print run or Printing Bs2 while they were at it?

  12. Why didn’t you fix Vulpix’s “HP 50” Misprint on Bs2?

  16. Does Wizards create the promo cards?

  17. Can you give me a list of basic Pokémon that I could you in the first turn?

  18. Has Team Rocket been printed yet?
    Not yet, no.

  19. What kind of donuts you like?
    Anything but meat flavored ones.

  20. Were you at the New York toy fair?
    I didn’t make it to the Toy Fair this year.

  21. I mean what Basic Pokémon you most often use in your game (the first turn)(your own recommendation)
    Past suggest Hitmonchan and Scyther. Of course I use Weedle extensively, but again, I lose all the time.

  22. What do you guys think of PSA?
    Public Service Announcements? Okay, while we appreciate the questions, they should cover the game and not our personal preferences (though to answer pizza, anything by the B-52’s, and Arkansas).

  23. My base 2 holos have horizontal and vertical lines on or in the foil…would this make them depreciate in value
    No, the manufacturing process causes those. If you end up getting a card that is damaged in any way, we will replace them for you though.

  24. Does Persian’s pounce attack’s -10 accumulate such that it can ward off any attacks, even from Charazard?
    No, they don’t accumulate.

  25. Why are there so many PokeModerators?
    There is only 1 or 2; they need to act like they work here. Hee hee hee.

  26. How could you be a Master if you lose so often? (Just kidding!
    Well. Ummmm. I’m a Master of LOSING!

  27. What do you think of the JP Pokémon Neo set?
    Pretty cool. (BTW, please don’t refer to Japanese cards or products as “JP”, some find it offensive, thanks.)

  28. Will the DCI ever ban cards in play, like in Japan?
    No plans for it.

  29. Why does the Holos Tend to “bend”?
    There is a difference in the contraction rate from the foil and the cardboard. If they bend, place them under a heavy book or weight to press them flat again.

  30. Do you guys own any Japanese cards?
    Some of us do personally.

  31. Charizard1016 indicated that he/she was “smarter than you” numerous times last week. Unfortunately he/she left the chat session before you answered his/her question. Any rebuttal?
    Ummm, I’m a better dresser?

  32. Why Is there Rare cards, and not all Rare-Holo cards like in Japan, also, why are there 1st ed cards where there weren’t in Japan?
    We are not Japan.

  33. Drowzee’s pound attack requires a colorless energy, even though it’s psychic, if I attach a grass energy, does the resistance to psychic still apply?

  34. Is it true that BS2 holos look like Japanese holos?

  35. Do you like Slowpoke?

  36. Will there ever be an extensive rulebook?
