  38. How do we e-mail you?
    Write to us at custserv@wizards.com

  39. What is the best card in the card game?
    Professor Oak, he’s such a snappy dresser.

  40. What does Wizards think about the large prices for cards like Charizard and Blastoise?
    We don’t set the secondary market prices. It’s crazy how much people want certain cards. Personally I think WEEDLE is priceless.

  41. Will there be a promo card in the Pokémon stadium set?
    Yes, I’ve heard there will be.

  42. Will WoTC write the Official Pokémon Guide?
    Yup.

  43. Do you think Charizard is better than WEEDLE?
    Well, he runs a faster 400 meters, but WEEDLE, hands down is the mamma-jamma.

  44. I heard a Rumor that there is going to be a Mewoth promo in the TCG for GB?
    Yup, me too. Sorry, can’t comment on unreleased cards.

  45. I have a Pokémon League question. My kids just finished up their first 6 weeks or “season”. Since they are new to this, they were unable to earn enough points to get a badge. Are these points now lost? Will they have the opportunity to get this back?

  46. Will we expect more oversized (Weedle) cards such as the Pikachu from (Weedle) TopDeck? (Weedle)
    What a great IDEA! Then Pat and I could make a 1/3 scale model of the Space Weedle!

    Each location is different, most are free, some charge up to $5. Check your local location.

    Each card is checked separately. Some will come over, some won’t.

  49. Have you ever met or played anyone with DCI rating in Pokémon for the top 10 in the world for constructed?
    No, sorry. Bet my Weedle deck would lose in a minute though. My boss says we are all top 10 here!

  50. Is there a combination of energy types that you would recommend in a deck?
    Well, that’s up to you, the grass/psychic combo is pretty tough though.

  53. Does your Game Boy Team consist of six Weedles?
    Well, I did try that at first but never was able to win anything.

  54. What will the “Evil” Pokémon be called when Rocket comes out in English?

    Yes, it is. Sorry.

  57. What’s the ruling of the Dark Pokemon?

    Dunno.

  62. Why does Rhydon have Weakness to Grass?
    Probably for game balance purposes. And the fact that he is afraid of the mighty WEEDLE!

  63. Why did you get rid of some cards for base set 2?
    Once Rocket comes out and the fact that Fossil is still in print, with Base Set 2 you will be able to get all 150 original Pokémon. We didn’t want multiple copies of Pokémon to be available at the same time. Plus if the set were TOO large it would be harder to complete.

  64. When will you have chat logs? I want them bad.
    They are being worked on!

Thurs. March 9, 2000 - Weekly Pokemon TCG Q&A

Pokémon Online Help
Offered every Thursday 2-5 PST in the TCG Forum of the Wizards.Community chat site!
Featuring Master_Trainer from Customer Service

Thurs. March 9, 2000

Hi gang, Mike the Master Trainer here from Wizards of the Coast to answer your questions. First, I have a few quick announcements though. Team Rocket now has a street date of approximately April 24th. Also, as an exclusive I want to tell you that there will be a super secret card in that set. One that you WON’T find listed anywhere! And btw, don’t bother asking me what it is, I can’t tell you (they’d have me rubbed out if I did!) So, feel free to start sending me questions and I will do my best to answer them for you.

  1. What are the Base 2 W stamped Wartortle supposed to look like?
    It looks just like the original base set Wartortle except that it has the base set 2 expansion symbol and a gold foil W stamped in the bottom right of the picture.

  2. Mine has black color text for HP AND W is in the picture. Is mine a missprint?
    The HP on the wizards stamped Wartortle does appear darker than normal (almost black). They were all printed that way.

  3. I’ve seen people that have English holo mew, how do I get one?
    That card will be available to be earned through the Pokemon League in the soon-to-be future.

  4. Will there be 1st edition team rockets?
    Yes there will.

  5. If I have an evil Charizard and a regular Charizard in my deck, can I have 4 of each since they have different names?
    Very good! Yes you could!

  6. What is out of Base2?
    Well, (off the top of my head), Eevee and its evolutions, Pontya and Rapidash, I think the Gloom, Oddish Pokémon, and several trainer cards.

  7. Does a Buzzap’d Electrode providing Green Energy count as a Green (not Basic) Energy card since it counts as an Energy Card?
    Well technically, it just counts as an energy card that provides (in this case) 2 green energy.

  8. If Porygon changes the weakness of a Pokémon to the same type as its resistance, which do you do first
    You always calculate weakness before resistance.

  9. Are you guys going to put prices on the boosters and theme decks because where I live they charge me 10 dollars a booster and 25 dollars for a theme deck! So I thought if you can put the prices on the products so they can’t charge me higher
    We’ve looked into that but Pokémon is becoming an international product. It would cost quite a bit more to make different wrappers in the local currency for each locality. Unfortunately we cannot dictate what a store sells our products for (that would be price fixing and is illegal). If a store is charging too much, don’t shop there. We sell the cards at the regular $3.29 a booster pack through our web site and we also have a retail locator on our site that could help you find other stores in your area that might not charge as much.

  10. What cards are different in base 2 from the basic/jungle versions?
    Well, except for the added on base set 2-expansion symbol, the cards are the same. Same art, same moves, etc.

  11. Anything from Japanese that isn’t in American?
    Hmmm, well except for the Mew car, which we gave away free instead of being in the Fossil set, so far we have translated each card in the sets released.

  12. When Team Rocket is released, will there be 1st edition ones as well? (Btw, are you the one who likes Weedle?)
    WEEDLE RULES! Actually, I just like to say the word Weedle. Ahem. Anyway, (Weedle) there will be 1st (Weedle) edition cards for Team (Weedle) Rocket. They should be (Weedle) available when the set releases around April (Weedle) 24th.

  13. Follow-up on the difference between base 2 and basic/jungle cards. There are no wording changes to clear up confusion?
    Nope there isn’t, sorry.

  14. I heard people buying base set boosters and there was some sort of triangle on it! What’s up with that?
    There had been a printing error on the wrappers from one print run. The triangle is just a correction to the wrapper. They are the same otherwise.

  15. Is WOTC part of the Pokémon stadium Tour?
    We will have a small presence on that tour, yes.

  16. First edition unlimited team rocket cards will be released at the same time?
    Most likely, that is how Jungle and Fossil were released.

  17. Will there be Pokémon cards from the gold and silver (the new Pokémon) being made soon?
    We are talking with Nintendo about that possibility. The next announced sets will be Team Rocket April 24th and the Gym sets later this year.

  18. Nintendo Power says next issue they’ll send a Mewtwo promo card with my subscription, what number is it?
    I believe that that will be number 12.

  19. What is difference from Japanese and American Team Rocket?
    Well our set will be in English.

  20. Can anyone sponsor/run a DCI sanctioned Pokémon tourney, or can only stores? So far no one in my area runs any.
    Pretty much anyone can as long as they have the space and staff/people available to do so. Check our web site for the sanctioning process and forms.

  21. Follow-up to Pokémon Stadium question- Maybe speculate was a bad choice…can you tell us what card will be included?
    Can I tell you? Well I physically could but I can’t, sorry.

  22. People who are selling Pokemon card for game boy say a holo Meowth is included, is this true?
    There will be a promo card included with the ETCG for Game Boy, yes.

  23. Is the plan to release gym leader decks like in Japan?
    I believe so, yes but that is not certain.

  24. Are energy on Ditto counted as whatever type needed for anything, or just for purposes of meeting attack requirements? For example, can any energy on Ditto be used to discard cards with Moltres’ Wildfire, or beef up a Water Gun?
    You can treat energy attached to Ditto as any type for whatever reasons as long as Ditto isn’t asleep, confused, or paralyzed.

  25. Any idea what will happen with the 900,000 Jigglypuffs that were not given away with the first music CD?
    Well, we are still working with Atlantic Records to get the cards out. If anyone sent away for them and didn’t receive them, you can email or call us with your contact information and we will pass it along for you.

  26. How long is each season of Pokémon TCG League?
    Generally 6 weeks.

  27. How long have you played the game?
    About 8 months now.

  28. Does a full heal trainer remove all damage also, it is not mentioned on the card? If not, how can the Pokémon have gotten fully healed?
    No, it heals effects for attacks like asleep, confusion, paralysis, or poisoned.

  29. Say Ditto has had its weakness changed by Porygon. Porygon retreats for another Pokémon, which Ditto now copies. Does Ditto retain the changed weakness as a result of Porygon’s attack, or does it now switch to the new Pokémon being copied?
    It would have the weakness of the Pokémon it copied. If it changed back to Ditto (and wasn’t benched or scooped up) then it would have the Poygon changed weakness.

  30. What methodology is used to balance the cards, or is there one used? Some cards just seem useless.
    You would have to talk with Creatures Inc. in Japan, they design the cards, and we basically just translate them.

  31. Will Toys R Us be handing out promos like with Mew?
    There aren’t any free promo giveaways (like Mew) planned right now.

  32. What is your best card?
    Weedle of course, after that would be all those silly 1st edition cards.

  33. A lot of us have noticed that much of the hoped-for rules and card-text clarifications were not seen in BS2 – some of the cards still have the same glaring layout errors as in their original run. What happened?
    We have to go through a long process to get approval to change card text even in the slightest. The rulebook for Base Set 2 was designed to make interpreting the cards a bit more obvious and easy.

  34. Do you have a mew in the card game?
    Yes, it was and may still be given away free at all Pokémon League locations (while supplies last).

  35. Are you able to change the art of a card? As I noticed on one of your promo Mewtwo’s.
    We do make art changes from time to time.

  36. Can Clefairy dolls evolve into Clefable?
    No they can’t.

  37. Would the retired cards from Base Set 1 and Jungle increase value?
    Hmm, well it is entirely up to the secondary market. We don’t set single card prices, you the public, do.

  38. If I use smokescreen and he retreat and send new active Pokémon, he must flip a coin or not?
    He would not; the Smokescreen refers to the defending Pokémon when the attack is done. If that Pokémon is benched or evolved, that effect is negated.

  39. How many energies do u think should be in a deck?
    Depends on the style of your deck. How many energy types you are playing with, trainer cards, etc. Anywhere from 24-34 is a good start (though 30 are a good starting value).

  40. Were will the foil mew card be handed out?
    That will be earned through the Pokémon League soon.

  41. Does double colorless energy count as the natural energy needed an attack?
    Not sure what you mean, a DCE gives you 2 colorless energy only.

  42. So a Buzzap’d Electrode providing Green Energy couldn’t be Energy Trans’d by Venusaur because the card is not explicitly named ``Green Energy’’ even though its considered an Energy Card?
    Correct.

  43. Do Clefairy dolls and mysterious fossil count when counting bench numbers for Wigglytuffs “do the wave”?
    Yes they would, they count as basic Pokémon when in play.

  44. Will Lugia be included with the other three announced promo cards from the new Pokémon movie?
    That’s way off, I have no idea what the promo cards will be for the movie, honest

  45. Will there be a new Pikachu promo card out?
    Not that I know of yet.

  46. Regarding Ditto and Smokescreen: Ditto is smoke screened by Magmar, who then retreats for, say, a Weedle. Would Ditto still have to flip, or does the act of “dittoing” a new Pokémon remove the effect?
    Since Ditto is still active (not benched or evolved) the Smokecsreen would still effect him, regardless of him transforming.

  47. Double colorless does not count for electric, grass, etc.? Just two energy?
    Correct, a DCE only gives you 2 colorless energy.

  48. In start game, I have only 1 basic Pokémon but I don’t like that. Can I mulligan like Magic the Gathering?
    Not in the official rules (or in league or tournament play), no. In a friendly game, that would be up to you and your opponent.

  49. Any chance for a Mac OS version of the tutorial CD?
    That is in the works.

  50. Is Chansey good? It does 80 HP to itself.

Thurs. March 16, 2000 - Weekly Pokemon TCG Q&A

Pokémon Online Help
Offered every Thursday 2-5 PST in the TCG Forum of the Wizards.Community chat site!
Featuring Master_Trainer from Customer Service

Thurs. March 16, 2000

Hi gang, Pat and I just got back from Hong Kong and are ready to answer your Pokémon questions. So here we go!

  1. [Missed this one, sorry. --Ed.]I’ve heard an unsubstantiated rumor that the “Here Comes Team Rocket” card may not be included in the Team Rocket set, like Mew re: Fossil. I know you can’t comment on cards until they are released, so instead allow me to plead: Please, please doesn’t do this. It didn’t work with Mew, and I don’t feel it can work with this expansion either. What could have been a rare, sought-after (and thusly, a better booster-selling) card instead turned out to be one of the most common “non-common” card in circulation, with everyone and their brother having a dozen. I get the feeling WotC got stung with that marketing decision and I would like to ask WotC not to make the same mistake again. Of course, since it’s almost the middle of May, it might be too late to do anything about it. Still, one can always hope…
    Well, you hit the nail on the head, can’t comment on sets not yet released. I can say, that I have not heard of any similar plans to the Mew promo though.

  2. Will there ever be some sort of consistent “repository” for Pokémon rulings (as opposed to simply having FAQs and logs, which, believe me, is a good first step)? It seems if you ask three different people at WotC about a rules question, you are likely to get three different answers, presumably because there is little or no baseline/precedent for them to refer back to.
    Hmmm, well you SHOULD get the same answer when you ask different people here. Keep in mind since we don’t own Pokémon it is harder for us to make definitive rulings (we are dealing with other companies as well). We are working on giving you consistent interpretations though.

  3. How many cards (amount) are in the rocket set?
    Sorry can’t comment on specifics of unreleased sets, though it will be larger than jungle or fossil.

  4. Moltres’ Wildfire says you MAY discard, as opposed to all other similar Fire attacks, which REQUIRE you to discard. In other words, it sounds like discarding with Wildfire is not a REQUIREMENT to use the attack, but an effect OF the attack.   12. Can bilingual Exegutor (a Japanese promo with English words on it) be used in a DCI tournament?

  13. Regarding Moltres and discarding energy BEFORE the Confusion flip, that was what I was referring too earlier – I got an email from WotC this morning saying the exact opposite.

  14. Similarly, if Ditto is copying Moltres, and wishes to do the Wildfire attack, can Ditto discard any number of ANY color energy to create the deck-depletion effect, or must he discard only ACTUAL Fire energy attached to him? Or does he need to discard any on him at all?

  15. Since Ditto allows Energy attached to Ditto to be of any type, can you use Venusaur’s Energy Trans power to Trans a Buzzap’d Electrode attached to Ditto so that it is now attached to another Pokémon by treating it as Green Energy?

  16. When Ditto goes from copying a particular Pokémon to copying another (when the Defending Pokémon retreats, for example) do either status effects (such as poison or sleep) or attack-based effects (such as Magmar’s Smokescreen or Porygon’s Conversion) disappear as a result?

  19. In Clefairy’s Metronome is used on Molter’s wildfire does he have to discard.
    Yes you do if you want the attack to have any effect. Metronome says to ignore effects or discards that are needed IN ORDER TO DO THE ATTACK, such as discarding 2 fire energy to use Charizard’s Fire Spin, Moltres’s Wildfire says you MAY discard any number of fire energy for increasing the effect of the attack, NOT to do it.

  22. Ditto says “you may treat any Energy attached to Ditto as Energy of any type.” Does that mean that if Ditto is copying Venusaur, he could Energy Trans, say, a DCE from himself to a Grass Pokémon? Or does it mean the Energy can be treated ONLY for the purposes of satisfying attack REQUIREMENTS?

  144. With regards to Kori and accreditation, etc.: There are always people of varying skill with regards to any given game. With mtg., you aren’t going to see a lot of 8 year olds at PT. Same with any possible Poke equivalent. I think, however, that there are more 17-18+ Poke players than realized. As far as strategy goes: Just because the rules are simple doesn’t mean there’s no depth. The WCW TCG brand manager said something like this once.
    True. Now I will venture more of my opinion only (not official WOTC line). Since there is a much smaller amount of cards available and the game is simpler in some ways, there are far fewer deck archetypes than many of the other games. Can you name more than 6 or 7 archetypes (not counting variations)? This would limit true originality in a higher level competitive field. And we do know that there are many older players but there are MANY younger players.

Thurs. March 23, 2000 - Weekly Pokemon TCG Q&A

Pokémon Online Help
Offered every Thursday 2-5 PST in the TCG Forum of the Wizards.Community chat site!
Featuring Master_Trainer from Customer Service

Thurs. March 23, 2000

Ok, let’s get started! First some announcements… There will be secret card, #66 in the upcoming Team Rocket Expansion (street date April 24th)! Foil Mew (promo #9) is coming to the Pokémon League April 1st! Foil Meowth (promo #10) is coming in the Gameboy Electronic TCG game due out soon! Promo Mewtwo (promo #14) is coming out in the WB Pokémon Movie Video and DVD! And the much-asked-about promo card in the N64 Stadium System Bundle is a Cool Porygon Foil (promo #15)!

  1. Can I try and retreat after failed attempts because of confusion…as long as I pay the retreat cost?
    Nope, as stated in the rulebooks, if you fail retreating (due to confusion) you cannot try and retreat that Pokémon again that turn.

  2. Buzzap reads: “…choose a type of Energy. Electrode is now an Energy card…that provides 2 Energy of that type.” However, if you have chosen Grass, you still can’t Energy Trans Electrode. Ditto reads: “…you may treat any Energy attached to Ditto as Energy of any type.” As it says Energy, and not Energy cards, I would think that Ditto changes the type of Energy an Energy card provides. However, you can Energy Trans an Electrode that’s on Ditto by treating it as Grass Energy. If the type of Energy provided by an Energy card doesn’t determine its type, how is this possible? Does Ditto change the Energy type of the card as well as the type of Energy provided, or does changing the Energy provided change the Energy card type, or what? Or is Electrode just an aberration that basically counts as a Colorless type Energy card providing 2 Colored Energy because the text can be taken to mean that Electrode is explicitly “typing” itself to have no Energy type (as a card)?
    Ok, long question and we needed to check on it. Yes, you could NOT energy trans a buzzaped electrode even if grass was selected because it is NOT a grass energy card, but an energy card that provides 2 (in this case grass) energy. Ditto says you may treat any Energy attached to Ditto as Energy of any type, so if this buzzaped Electrode was on Ditto, then you COULD change it to Grass Energy for that turn (that provides 2 grass energy) and then you COULD energy trans it…

  3. Does Magmar’s smokescreen stops anything from fetch to energy absorption to firespin?
    Yes it does.

  4. Have you started posting these chat logs yet? If so how do we get to them?
    They have been submitted from us and we are just waiting for final approval, they will be available through the chat web site soon.

  5. Can I remove any energy card with energy removal…like Buzzaped electrode?
    Yes you could. Double Colorless energy (and a Buzzaped Electrode) are Energy cards and therefore may be discarded with Energy Removal.

  6. Does agility stop fetch, stretch kick, and wildfire?
    No, the Agility only stops effects of attacks DONE to Rapidash.

  7. How long dose it takes to become a member of this chat I submitted last week and it still did not come.
    Hmmm, not sure on that. If you haven’t received it yet, I would send an email to community@wizards.com.

  9. If I attach a defender to Arcanine and do takedown…would it reduce the damage down to 10?
    Yes, Arcanine would only do 10 to itself from the Takedown attack in this case.

    Not sure what you mean. You always draw a card at the start of your turn, if you are out of cards and can’t do this draw, you lose.

  11. If I attach a defender to Electabuzz and do thunder punch, flipping tails…I take 10 damage…and my opponent does 20 damage next turn, would the damage be reduced any?
    Why would you take 10 damage? Thunder punch does 10 damage to your opponent. If his attack to you did 20, Defender would reduce it to zero.

  12. When does the team rocket set come out in American?
    Ah, a Chansey Fan! (Though Weedle is better.) The street date for Rocket is April 24th.

    Yup!

  14. Can I use Energy Retrieval or Attacks (like Energy Absorption) to retrieve my Buzzapped Electrode (the card never says when it stops being an energy card)?
    No you couldn’t. When a card hits the discard pile it always reverts to its basic form (like a Mysterious Fossil would be a Trainer Card, not a basic Pokémon).

  15. What is the official ruling for smokescreen attack I need to know because I judge tourneys and don’t know what to call?
    If the opponent tries to do ANY attack next turn (whether it does damage to Magmar or it’s something like Fetch: Draw a Card), they must flip a coin. If it comes up tails, that attack does. If that player benches or evolves the Pokémon affected by the Smokescreen though, the effect ends (since it is referencing the Defending Pokémon).

  28. Clarification needed: The rulebook states that you may use Pokémon Powers at any time during your turn before your attack. However, “continuous” Pokémon Powers are always considered to be “on” and do not need to be “invoked” (or else Machamp’s Strikes Back would be utterly useless). Ditto’s Power is also continuous, yet it sports some features, which could be considered to require “invocation”. For instance, you may treat Energy attached to Ditto as any kind of Energy. But it was said that when Charizard Energy Burns, says, all the Grass Energy attached to him into Fire Energy, that if he were to then become Confused, etc., then the Energy would revert back to Grass.   76. On previous rulings: It was said that if Moltres is Confused, you must discard any Fire Energy attached to Moltres you wish to use to activate Wildfire before you flip for Confusion during your attack. However, this discarding of Fire Energy isn’t a requirement for you to use the attack (step c in attack precedence), only an optional step for it to actually do anything. It also isn’t an effect (step d). So how come it doesn’t count as “do whatever the attack says” (step f), which comes after Confusion (step e). Is this because it (the Energy discard) counts as a “choice” (step b), even though it doesn’t specifically say “choose”? Usage of the word “may” seems to imply making a choice, and as such may be the cause for confusion over this Confusing question.
    There is no TIMING in Pokémon. You are trying WAY too hard to make a simple game had. The attack states, You may discard any number of Energy cards attached to Moltres, when you use this attack. You use the attack (i.e. perform it) BEFORE confusion is rolled for. As simple as that.

Thurs. March 30, 2000 - Weekly Pokemon TCG Q&A

Pokémon Online Help
Offered every Thursday 2-5 PST in the TCG Forum of the Wizards.Community chat site!
Featuring Master_Trainer from Customer Service

Thurs. March 30, 2000

Hello again gang. You guys hit us with several tough questions last week, so I went to R&D and got the official answers. We were correct on some answers and wrong on some others. But we wanted to give you the latest “official” answers. Here they are:

If a card gives off energy of any type then that card COUNTS as an energy card of that type. This means a buzzaped Electrode that was chosen to give 2-grass energy COUNTS as a Grass Energy Card and can use Venusaur’s Pokémon Power Transfer Energy.

Energy attached to Ditto COUNTS as all-basic energy types at once. So any energy type attached to Ditto could ALSO use Venusaur’s Transfer Energy.

If you have a DCE or a buzzaped Electrode attached to Ditto, then those particular cards would still count as all basic energy types at once but that particular card would give you 2 energy of any type. This means you could use a DCE or the buzzaped Electrode to give you one of two different basic energy types (like 1 grass and 1 psychic). This also means if Ditto is copying, say, a Charmander, you could discard ANY type of energy card from Ditto to pay the Discard COST for the Ember attack.

Clarification on the whole Moltres Wildfire/Confusion thing. When flipping for confusion, you must pay all Attack Costs BEFORE you flip for confusion. This means anything that is written as “IN ORDER TO DO THIS ATTACK,” such as Charizard’s Fire Spin. (Discard 2 Fire Energy card attached to Charizard IN ORDER TO use this attack.) However, anything that does not state IN ORDER TO gets done AFTER the Confusion flip, this means for Moltres’s Wildfire you do NOT discard cards for the effect of the attack until AFTER you see if the attack even occurs.

More clarification for Ditto: His Pokémon Power is continuous–NOT invoked. You do NOT decide what energy attached to him counts as; it simply counts as all basic energy types. When a Pokémon hits the discard pile it reverts back to its normal type BEFORE you count it as a knocked out Pokémon or not. This explains why Mysterious Fossil and Clefairy Doll do NOT count as Knocked Out Pokémon as they revert to Trainer Cards when they hit the Discard Pile. So if you’re Ditto was Transformed into a copy of one of these. It would STILL count as a Knocked Out Pokémon as it would revert back to Ditto when it hits the pile.

AND FINALLY, an announcement of an upcoming Team Rocket card you can get BEFORE Team Rocket comes out! The newest issue of TopDeck Magazine (issue #6) will have a free Dark Charmeleon from the Team Rocket set for you. Should be out soon! On to the questions!

  215. What number promo do you think you will stop making at?
    Dunno, there are plans for more in the future already.

  216. Could you make your own cards, not previously released in Japan?
    Its possible but unlikely that we would.

  217. What do you mean by earn it?
    You have to earn 250 points in the League to get a Foil Mew.

  218. How are they going to keep track of the “points towards Mew”; is there going to be a separate League book for that?
    Nope, there should be a separate sheet for keeping trading.

  219. What should you do when you’ve realized you’ve bought fake cards? Contact police? Wizards?
    First ask the merchant for a refund and explain that selling counterfeits is illegal. If they don’t help you should contact the Police, Better Business Bureau, and could also contact us with the name and address of the store and we will pass it on to Nintendo for investigation.

  220. What are foil mew’s attacks?
    The same as the non-foil Mew.

  221. Do you know if there’s any time limit for earning the 250 points (i.e. eight weeks only)?
    Yes, you have the 6 weeks of the correct season to earn the 250 points.

  222. Just saying “thank you” and good night!

scratchdesk June 26, 2017, 4:31pm 3

Click on each spoiler to view entire log:

Thurs. April 6, 2000 - Weekly Pokemon TCG Q&A

Pokémon Online Help
Offered every Thursday 2-5 PST in the TCG Forum of the Wizards.Community chat site!
Featuring Master_Trainer from Customer Service

Thurs. April 6, 2000

Hi Gang, Mike (and Pat later) here once again to answer your many Pokémon questions. No real announcements (yet) so let’s get started, OK?

  1. Will WOTC ever release a non-promo Mew card?
    Not that I know of.

  2. Why did the hours get dramatically shortened?
    Hmmm, don’t know we’ll get back to you on that. [They didn’t, it was just a typo on the web—Ed.]

  3. What is the league activity to get the promo Dark Gyarados card?
    Sorry, I haven’t heard.

  4. How do you get the promo Dark Charizard card?
    There’s no such card that I know of.

  5. How do I contact someone to be a pokeleague center?
    Contact Merchant Relations at Wizards of the Coast. You must be a store to be a League Location.

  6. What date will the prerelease dark Gyrados be given out?
    I don’t know. Any further questions about the Dark Gyrados card will be met with my infamous “I don’t know clip”

  7. Do you always release your sets on Monday/Tuesday?
    No.

  8. How many cards will be in the Team Rocket set?

  10. Does it cost anything to be a league center?
    No, but you must be a store.

  11. Could you give the approximate months that the Gyms will be out?
    If I could, then they would both be later this year.

  12. If you use Smokescreen then retreat the Pokémon that is Smoke screened or if Magmar Retreats is it still in effect?
    Smokescreen references the defending Pokémon, so if you bench that Pokémon the effect ends. If you bench Magmar then Smokescreen is in effect.

  13. Can I still get the promo Pikachu from the league?
    I don’t think the promo Pikachu is still available, it was first given out during the first season of the Pokémon Leagues

  14. Will the “secret” card in the Rocket set be released as a 1:33 like other rares or will it be harder to pull?
    Yes, as a regular rare. (Though secret)

  15. What attacks will the Meowth promo in the Trading Card GB have?
    I can’t give you the specific attacks, I can just tell you where you’ll be able to get it.

  16. Have you ever heard of e-league?
    Nope

  17. Can I now get the promo Arcanine anywhere?
    No, once again the Promo Arcanine will only be available through the Pokémon Leagues.

  18. Does Defender prevent damage done by a failed attack due to Confusion?
    Yes, but it’s important to note that your wording is slightly incorrect. If an attack fails due to the effects of Confusion than that Pokémon attacks itself with that attack.

  19. Since the players are taking Pokémon more seriously than planned will there be more and larger tournaments in the future?
    If the fan response continues to be high, yes.

  20. When will the Team Rocket cards be released?
    April 24th

  21. If your using a Pokémon that has a resistance to the opponent’s Pokémon would you flip 4 coins to see if you do damage?
    No you wouldn’t

  22. When will the Gym Leader series be released?
    This fall.

  23. Clefairy vs. Blastoise. Clefairy metronomes Blastoise what determines the amount of damage? The amount of water on Blastoise or Clefairy? Or neither?
    The amount of extra water energy on Clefairy.

  24. Since you don’t answer anything about Japanese cards, where/who can I ask then?
    I don’t have a good suggestion for you. Do you speak Japanese?

  25. Does the Base Set 2 combine the Base set and the Jungle Set?
    Yes, minus several cards.

  26. Will there be any other way to get the Cool Porygon promo besides buying the bundle/trading for it?
    No, not that we know of.

  27. Is there going to be a Prerelease Dark Charizard?
    No, not that I know of.

  28. If no Mew card will be released with the Neo set, then how will WOTC explain the gap from PKMN#150- #152?
    There won’t be a gap, if you have the Promo Mew.

  29. In question 7 I was asking if there is a number/site I can go to sign up to be a league center. Is there?
    If you own a store you can call us at 1800-324-6496 and press the extension for retailers.

  30. If it’s a Hitmonchan with 2 PP’s on it does Invisible Power absorb it? Or does it KO Mr. Mime?
    Invisible Wall will absorb it because you calculate the effects of trainer cards before applying Pokémon Powers from the defending Pokémon.

  31. I have only one question for Japanese cards: If you have a book that translates the attacks and Powers, would that allow you to play them in League games? (Not tournaments).
    No, you can only use card in the League that has been released in English. In other words, you could use a Japanese Jungle Scyther in your deck if you have the English translation available.

  32. Do you think Pokémon will be like any other fad and just go away or become less popular lime Tomigochi?
    I think it has way more staying power than Tamogochi.

  33. Is there a place we can get the list of cards in each of the TR theme decks?
    Not yet, though that will be available on our website after Team Rocket comes out.

  34. If you flip HEADS for a agility attack may your opponent use a attack like Hitmonlee’s Stretch Kick or Kangakhan’s Fetch that turn?
    If you’re talking about Rapidash, Agility will prevent any attacks or effects of attacks DONE to Rapidash. So effects to other Pokémon will still happen.

  35. Well, here’s another one. When playing, my opponent placed DCE and then Grass Energy on Scyther for one turn, then attacked with Slash. When I called him on it, he stated that DCE wasn’t a basic energy and could play 2 like that. Which of us is right?
    You are right, the DCE counts as your energy placement for that turn.

  36. Was the secret card in Rocket released in Japan?
    No, the super hyper mega secret card is one that is unique and has never appeared in print before, in English or Japanese.

  37. Why are cards that are marked “Evil” in Japan being translated as “Dark” for the U.S.?
    That fits better with the Wizards image of the cards.

  38. Do you think the drawings on the Pokémon cards are good are could use some improving?
    I think the artworks fine for the most part.

  39. Is there anything in development that will allow online Pokémon Play like Apprentice and Magic Encyclopedia for Magic?
    Not that I know of.

  40. Can you put 4 fossil Dragonites and 4 movie promos in your deck?
    You can only have 4 of any particular named card. Since both cards have the name Dragonite, then no, you can’t have 4 of each.

  41. If Kadabra is confused will a failed attack do 20 or 40 damage to him because of weakness?
    A failed attack in this case will do 40 to Kadabra.

  42. Do I have to flip 4 coins to do damage to Mr. Mime?
    No, unless you’re using a Pokémon that you need to flip 4 coins for.

  43. Can we expect The Pokémon Neo set to be released exactly when Pokémon Gold and Silver is?
    NO.

  44. BIG question: How will pre-evolved Pokémon from Neo affect evolution in the TCG (such as Basic Pichu and Basic Pikachu)?
    I don’t have the answer for that one yet.

  45. How would the damage on Clefairy count towards hydro pump if it doesn’t read the attack’s costs?
    You would have to count the extra energy on Clefairy above the necessary cost to use Metronome, in order to calculate the final damage done by copying Hydro Pump.

  46. If Ditto is copying a Pokémon whose attacks are dependent on the number of Fire (or Psychic, or Grass, etc.) Energy Cards attached, and Ditto’s attached energies are considered to be all basic energies at once (per last week’s chat), can one choose to limit how many of the energies are considered of a particular type, so as to get a limited effect, or it is treated that all are of that energy type for purposes of that attack? As an example, Ditto’ing Water Gun attacks and other similar effects. I realize this question is a little obtuse, but only because I can’t ask about Ditto’ing TR Zapdos yet, which this question was actually in reference to?
    No, you can’t limit the amount that you choose to use as a specific type. All energy on Ditto counts as all types, all the time.

  47. How many weeks do you have to earn the Promo Mew in League?
    As long as your League location is on the current season (I believe season #5) than you can earn the foil Mew.

  48. I’d like to clear this up, if Ditto uses Sword’s Dance, but Scyther retreats next turn, is SD still there? I don’t see why not because effects should only go away when you retreat a Pokémon and you are not retreating Ditto.
    Yes, the effect is still there, but unless the new Pokémon that Ditto copies has a Slash attack, then Ditto will not be able to take advantage of the SD effect.

  49. If Ditto is copying Scyther and does Swords Dance, and your opponent retreats his Sycther to bring up a different Pokémon (say, to remove poison), then switches that new one again with the Scyther, does Ditto lose the advantage of Swords Dance? And if so, is it because there is a Ditto-as-something-else between the two Ditto-as-Scyther stages?
    I just covered this one above. In this case, Ditto would still be able to take advantage of the SD effect.

  50. Why is the Cool Porygon called Cool Porygon? Is it because it can attack?
    That does make it ‘cooler’ than the old Porygon. But, actually it’s so you can make an entire Porygon theme deck 'cause you can use 4 of each in a deck.

  51. The TR Dark Charmeleon included in the latest issue of TopDeck has an attack – Fireball – which requires at least one energy card attached to be a Fire Energy Card in order to use it. In last week’s chat, you gave us some of the rulings from R&D on energy, specifically “If a card gives off energy of any type then that card COUNTS as an energy card of that type.” and used the example that a grass-buzzap’d Electrode counts as such and could be moved by Energy Trans. Does this mean then that an appropriate Rainbow Energy or Buzzap’d Electrode is sufficient for powering Dark Charmelon’s attack? And if not, why?
    Uh-huh. Aren’t you glad you typed all that?

  52. How can you get a promo Mew?
    At the Pokémon Leagues by earning 250 and 500 points. You get a promo Mew at each level.

  53. 2 weeks ago I had Ditto questions, about Ditto using Charmander’s ember. What was the final ruling on whether or not Ditto has to use FIRE ENERGY CARDS for Charmander’s Ember or Moltres’ Wildfire?
    Any energy on Ditto counts as any energy type, so you could use any energy card attached to Ditto as Fire energy cards.

  54. Will you eventually have more than one day for TCG forum on Pokémon?
    There aren’t any plans yet to do so.

  55. When will the Promo Gyradios be out?
    Sorry, I don’t know.

  56. Has any information been released on the English promo card #16 or #17?
    No, not yet.

  57. Why did they call promo 15 “Cool” Porygon?
    So that you could use 4 of these with 4 original Porygons. If you wanted to that is.

  58. How does the ruling saying that ditto’s energy can be moved around, say a fire energy, with Venusaur? Especially since Ditto’s power doesn’t change energy types, just how it applies damage.
    Energy on Ditto counts as all energy types.

  59. Do you know of anywhere I can go to find out if there are tournaments around where I live? And I don’t mean Toys ‘R’ Us.
    I would check two places. One, the tournament locator on our website for ’ Pokémon ’ tournaments and two, you local hobby or game store. Ask to see if they have any info on upcoming tournaments in your area.

  60. Will Dark Muk’s Pokémon power only work when it is the active Pokémon or when it is just in play?
    You should know I can’t answer that specific stuff about Team Rocket cards yet. No donuts for you.

  61. If we are a creative person and have ideas for cards, would we send them to Wizards or Gamefreaks?
    Gamefreaks.

  62. How many times do you flip to see if a Pokémon wakes up?
    Once at the end of each player’s turn until the Pokémon wakes up.

  63. Have there been any plans to set a release date for the Gym series for the TCG?
    There are no specific dates yet, I only know that they will be showing up this fall.

  64. Will the "dark Gyrados prerelease be first edition & will it be available this season or the next?
    I can’t answer that for you.

  65. I’m from Fort McMurray, Alberta, Canada.we Don’t have a TCG league outlet. Could I still join in Edmonton, Alberta?
    Yes, you can still join there if they have room for you.

  66. You just answered that the secret card is brand new. Will Wizards be making more of their own cards in the future? I like that idea!
    I don’t know, this is the first one we’re doing for Pokémon.

  67. What kind of card is DCE?
    Sorry, DCE stands for Double Colorless Energy. I don’t like typing it every time.

  68. When Team Rocket comes out, will you be able to use 4 dark Charizards and 4 normal Charizards in your deck?
    Yes, because they have different names.

  69. MT< Guest14 here seems to think that a DCE is a Trainer card that acts as an energy, as opposed to an energy card in it’s own right. Could you clarify that it is not a Trainer Card for him/her? Sure, the Double Colorless Energy (DCE from now on) counts as an energy card just not a ‘basic’ energy card.

  70. Can you have 4 dark Muk and 4 Fossil Muk in a deck?
    Yes, and before everyone asks if this is true for their favorite Pokémon and it’s “Dark” equivalent, let me say that this is true for any Pokémon with different names.

  71. Can Pokémon cards like the Dark Charmeleon evolve into Base Set Charizard or do you need Dark Charizard?
    Hmmm, Team Rocket not out yet, no answer yet for you!

  72. If you use metronome on a Ditto (as a Clefable), what do you do?
    Hmmm, waste your time?

  73. Will the holo background on Fossil cards be changed?

  74. When is the promo Gyrados from TR coming out in Pokémon League?
    We’ve answered this 10 times already. It ain’t out yet, so no news for you.

  75. So to Clarify, Clefable with any 3 energy could do the “extra” damage in a hydro pump? They would not have to be water energy?
    Nope! You could use any kind of energy to pay for the metronome attack, THEN energy PAST that would have to be water energy to do the extra Water Pump damage.

  76. After Scyther uses swords dance and is sent back to the bench by GOW etc. If I send him back out will the swords affect still be on?
    Nope, the Swords Dance effect is ended when Scyther is benched.

    Yes, they are.

  78. Is the Illustration of Misty’s Tears going to be changed so mothers don’t think their kids of illegal pictures?

  79. 2 weeks ago you said that if a Ditto is copying a Mysterious Fossil and is knocked out your opponent DOES get a prize, but you later said you were unsure. Does your opponent get a prize if they knock out Ditto like this, or no?
    Yes they do. Ditto changes back to Ditto, when it hits the discard pile and counts as a knocked out Pokémon.

  80. What is the final word on what format Wotc is using on Holos U.S. or Japanese?
    What do you mean? We changed the holo format for Base Set 2 since we ran out of the old foil material.

  81. Is there going to be anther way to get Cool Porygon besides the N64 bundle Pack?
    Nope.

  82. Are anymore promos from the Japanese CD going to be released in the U.S.?
    Dunno.

  83. Can you have 4 Regular Pokémon Like Blastoise and 4 Dark Pokémon like Dark Blastoise in the Same Deck?
    Yes you can since they have different names.

  84. What is Fire type Pokémon 's best type to be with in a deck?
    That would depend on what the player’s in your area are using.

  85. Do you think, after tonight, there should be a rulebook made on Ditto and his attacks? Or is he a simple Pokémon whose attacks are easy to figure out?
    Nope, to be honest Metronome and Ditto cause us confusion as well. We do our best to try and explain them though.

  86. What are the extra cards that were put in the Team Rocket set?
    Sorry but we can’t comment on cards that we have not released.

  87. What are the attacks for the extra cards and their rarities?
    Sorry but we can’t comment on cards that we have not released.

  88. Is there any use for Pokémon League Badges other then to impress your friends?
    Hmmm, to button up your jacket if you are missing a button?
    .

  89. Are there going to be first edition Rocket cards?
    Yes

  90. Have any plans been made to change that attacks, rarities of the blank’s Chansey and Imankanie’s Dodou?
    Sorry but we can’t comment on cards that we have not released.

  91. How does using a Clefable/Clefairy’s Metronome on Moltres’ Wildfire work? Because Clefable says to ignore card discarding.
    NO. Metronome says to ignore COSTS required to do the attack. The discarding is an effect that affects the amount of cards discarded (not the same thing). Basically Metronome ignores anything that says " IN ORDER TO". This would not affect the discarding.

  92. Will there be 4 new Promo cards with Pokémon the Movie 2000?
    Yes.

  93. Are there any plans to put promos in the Gold/Silver Boxes?
    Dunno, though there might be.

    Nope, sorry.

  95. If Pidgeotto or Spearow gets attacked by a Self destructing Magnemite and survives could it use it to the next PKMN?
    Sure.

  96. Will Americans ever get an Ancient Mew for a promo card?
    Maybe, but here’s the macro again. Sorry but we can’t comment on cards that we have not released.

  97. While I was looking at your TR Section, you had some errors (Magikarp and Porygon was marked Common! and Grimer’s Poison gas makes them asleep). Anyway, Can you actually use Charmander’s power to attach a Rainbow energy to Charmander? Cause I was thinking that it’s not a fire energy on your hand.
    Sorry but we don’t do rulings on Dark cards until Rocket is available to the public (April 24th).

  98. Some players freely examine their own discard pile (or their opponent’s) whenever they want. Is this allowed? Or can a discard pile only be examined when you have official business there (like after playing Item Finder).

  99. Besides the Team Rocket set, what is the next one to be released?
    We have two planned Gym sets out later this year.

  100. So, could I have a Misty’s Psyduck, Sabrina’s Psyduck, and a plain Psyduck in the same deck because they are named differently?

    Sorry but we can’t comment on cards that we have not released.

  102. What are the 2 gyms going to be changed to?
    Sorry but we can’t comment on cards that we have not released.

  103. Some stores charge for playing at Pokémon League, and some don’t charge. Is there a fixed policy they are supposed to follow regarding charging for League play?
    No, it’s actually up to each store. There is a fee for them to run the league; larger chains can probably afford to not charge whereas other stores may not.

  104. Are there gonna be new promos for the Pokémon league?
    Sure.

  105. And on the heels of that, what about a Slash attacks with a base damage of something other than 30 (Sandslash, for example)?
    NOPE! Swords Dance says During your next turn, Scyther’s Slash attack’s base damage is 60 instead of 30, SO the Slash attack done after the Swords Dance MUST have a base damage of 30.

  106. Are we going to have to start taking statistics on how often you answer ambiguously?
    Sure! So far the count is.umm.2

  107. What can we do if we don’t agree with your rulings? Is there anyway we can contact WOTC and tell them they are wrong?

  108. If the current popularity of Pokémon falls off but a hardcore group still remains as in Magic, will you still print the new expansions?
    We will have to see where the future takes us (DING! Ambiguous answer number 3).

  109. Are there extra cards in the Rocket set?
    Well, there is the super duper mega unknown soon to be known secret card. (Don’t ask what it is, can’t tell you).

  110. Are Poliwrath and Ninetails “retired”?

    Not sure if there will be an updated rulebook or not. Answers DO get posted in the Pokémon chat logs. Otherwise we are working on FAQ’s for the game.

  114. Any idea on how many cards Rocket will have?

  116. Is Dark Charmeleon (from TopDeck) usable in DCI tournaments? By the way, the Rocket cards pictured in that mag look cool.

    ‘Cuz it’s not official yet, and may change again.

Thurs. April 13, 2000 - Weekly Pokemon TCG Q&A

Pokémon Online Help
Offered every Thursday 2-5 PST in the TCG Forum of the Wizards.Community chat site!
Featuring Master_Trainer from Customer Service

Thurs. April 13, 2000

Hi gang! Mike and Pat here again! Mike here first with the announcements. Announcements first gang.

Clarification on Team Rocket (since it will be out soon). You can have 4 Charizards AND 4 Dark Charizards in the same deck as they have different names. The rule is that you can only 4 of a particular named card. This also means you could have 4 Porygon AND 4 Cool Porygon in the same deck for the same reason.

Also, Dark Pokémon evolve from Basic Pokémon. There are no Dark Basic Pokémon. Only Dark Stage 1 and Stage 2 Pokémon. Once you evolve a basic Pokémon into a Dark Stage 1 Pokémon, it CANNOT evolve into a non-Dark Stage 2 Pokémon, only a Dark Stage 2. “Once you walk down the Dark Path, forever will it dominate your destiny” - Yoda the non-Pokémon.

A ruling on Metronome and Dark Charmeleon (available in Top Deck #6). Metronome states that it copies that attack except for Energy costs and anything else required IN ORDER TO use that attack. The important part of this text is the IN ORDER TO part. This means that Metronome ignores anything listed in an attacks requirements but ONLY if it has the words IN ORDER TO in its text (such as Charizard’s Fire Spin). If the words IN ORDER TO are NOT part of the text then Metronome does NOT ignore it. So, in the case of Dark Charmeleon’s Fireball text: Use this attack only if there any fire energy cards attached to Dark Charmeleon, Metronome does NOT ignore this condition. This attack was specifically worded this way so that Metronome couldn’t copy it without the Clefable/Clefairy actually having fire energy on it. There will be other cards in the future that will use this same sort of wording to make it hard for Metronome to copy it.

Also, keep an eye on the Team Rocket theft that just occurred. We have the latest information about it on our web site at www.wizards.com/Pokémon/tr/apb.asp. Help us get our cards back!

Going back to question #5 player two has 3 prizes left and player one has no more Pokémon on his/her bench P1’s Rapidash gets KO’d and P2’s Ditto has 50 damage on it. Who wins?
Player two wins since Player One has his last Pokémon knocked out and doesn’t have anyone on the bench to move up.

  1. A traded a non-holo fossil haunter for two promo mews that were Amercian. Was that a good deal for me?
    Sorry but we can’t help with trades or card values. It’s up to you.

  2. Will there be a Pokémon Trainer Showdown Battle (or something like that.) this summer?
    Yes, there are plans for a premiere event this summer. When we have details on it, it will be posted on our web site.

  3. I saw something in the most recent issue of Scrye about the Gym Leader sets… according to them, Gym 1 will be called Heroes, Gym 2 will be called Villains, that true or not?
    Sorry but we have not announced what they will be called yet.

  4. At my league we are divided on the question of weather or not plus power would work with Hitmonlee’s stretch kick?
    Yes it would.

  5. Does benching ALWAYS ‘reset’ the Pokémon completely? For instance, if I use Scyther’s swords dance one turn, and then he gets benched and comes back out next turn, how much damage will Slash do? 30 or 60?
    It would do 30; Benching always reset attack effects.

  6. If Ditto was facing a Scyther and had Sword danced, and is now facing a Parasect on the VERY next turn does the swords dance still applied to the slash attack?
    Yes it does. Good question.

  7. The Pokémon League has a new activity called “Brock’s Challenge” where you get a special sticker if you get ten “victory points”. First question: is that 2pts.
    For win & 1 pt. for lose or ten distinct wins total? 2 points for a win, 1 point for a loss.

  8. What is the deal with the Brock and Misty Challenge in the League?
    They are just extra actives (like the TM stickers) for members to do once they’ve earned their badges.

  9. With Dodrio retreat costs can be reduced to 0 right?
    Correct.

  10. Is here comes Team Rocket going to be a foil or not?
    Can’t comment, BUT the latest issue of Top Deck has a card list (minus the super-duper secret card of course).

  11. “Brock’s Challenge” rules state that you must play with “at least 5 Level 2 evolutions in your deck”, but what is considered a “Level 2 evolution”? Using the Gastly family as an example is Haunter considered Lvl 2 or is it Gengar?
    They mean Stage 2 cards, not level 2. So in this case it would be Gengar.

  12. I have seen something new at my Pokémon League; they are called Brock’s Challenge and Misty’s Challenge. Why did WotC do that?
    See earlier answer.

  13. Does Aerodactyl’s Pokémon power cancel out a Pokémon breeder?
    Correct, you cannot evolve anything (even with a breeder) while Aerodactyl’s Pokémon power is active.

  14. Would the same apply to regular Charizard? Would you only discard after flipping to see if the confusion works or not?
    No, since it states IN ORDER TO on the discard for Charizard. You must attempt the attack BEFORE you flip for Confusion and so must pay its activation costs.

  15. What holo. Is going to be in team rocket pre-construction decks?
    Sorry but it hasn’t been released yet so I can’t tell you.

  16. Is there ANY chance whatsoever that we will see the Base and Jungle cards that were omitted from BS2 in another expansion?
    Those specific cards? Probably not, other versions of those Pokémon, yes.

  17. What’s happening, 2 chats ago you said you were gonna make the chat only 1 hour, that’s what it says on the site, now its still the same? (I’M not complaining.)

  18. What season (badge) is League supposed 2 be on?
    I think it’s the Soul Badge.

  19. I have the Japanese Team Rocket Charmander/Charmeleon/Charizard and on Charizard it says “Bad Charmeleon Evolution” and on Bad Charmeleon it says “Charmander Evolution”. I don’t know Japanese, BUT I do know what the Japanese symbols for Bad are.
    Sorry but we don’t make or give rulings on the Japanese cards.

    It’s number #13.

    Holo!

  24. Do you have any information on the American PROMO card #11?
    Not for public release, nope.

  25. Is it possible to get two badges in a season?
    Only if you are a new member and you are catching up.

  26. If I do Scyther’s Sword Dance and my Opponent gusts of wind out another Pokémon during their turn, then I make Scyther active again; will his slash do 60?

    Sure! Its card #83.

  29. Mr. Mime PP Invisible Wall whenever an attack does 30 or more damage to Mr. Mime, prevents that damage. I had a kid at the league last week tell me that WOTC told him it is 40 and not 30. I said I go by what is on the card. So, until WOTC makes new?

  32. Will the “Dark Gyarados” card that will be given away on 04.22.00 have the “PRERELEASE” Holofoil stamp on it or not?

  33. MT on Q62 you said PlusPower would work with Stretch Kick, but the text says if the “Defending Pokémon” takes damage. Stretch Kick hits the Bench. I think you should rethink that answer.

  34. So in question 62 you are saying if they used a Hitmonlee’s stretch kick and a plus power it could knock out my benched Abra
    See above answer, Plus Power DOES state If this Pokémon’s attack does damage to the Defending Pokémon then add 10 so it would NOT help the Stretch Kick.

  35. With Venusaurs energy trans how many energy can you transfer in one turn?
    You are only limited by how much energy you have out (grass energy or energy that counts as grass energy). You must use this Power (as often as you’d like) BEFORE your attack.

  36. Are there any awards or “prizes” given away for completing the “Brock’s Challenge” and “Misty’s Challenge”?

  37. Is there a way to get the TM’s, after you get all of the badges, but you never got the TM’s.

  38. Are you ever going to fix the artwork on the Psych-Out deck box–it shows Poliwrath not Chancey?
    We know, it will be fixed in future print runs.

  39. Will there be another Trainer Showdown Battle (or something like that) this summer or anytime soon?
    Yup, keep an eye on our web site for upcoming details.

  40. Can you play multiple energies if some of them are DCE’s? Example 2 DCE’s and 1 basic.
    You can only play 1 energy per turn (unless you use a trainer card or Pokémon Power or attack to change this rule).

  41. Would you please tell me if the “Super-Secret” card in the Team Rocket Set was included in the Japanese Team Rocket Set?
    NOPE! That’s too big a hint!

  42. Will Here Comes Team Rocket be a white star card when the Team Rocket set is released, or will it be a regular star card?

  43. If an opponent was just de-evolved by Mew can they play the card back down on their very next turn? The online rulebook states that “you cannot evolve a Pokémon that you just played or evolved on that turn”.

    Do you have an idea what to do after the eight season ends?
    Seriously, there will be a new league starting soon thereafter.

  45. If my active Pokémon is the victim of Victreebel’s Acid attack, may I still use a switch trainer card to switch my active for a benched Pokémon?

  58. If ditto has 40 damage on him, and I use Electabuzz’s thundershock and paralyze him, would ditto be knocked out?

  62. On Mew’s attack it says, “Just as if it had evolved”, since it de-evolved then it shouldn’t be able to evolve?

OK, that will bring us to a close till next week. Once again, Master Trainer Mike will be at the Mall of America Team Rocket event next weekend. If you’re in the area you can go to the event in costume and get a Dark Gyrados Pre-release.

Thurs. April 20, 2000 - Weekly Pokemon TCG Q&A

Pokémon Online Help
Offered every Thursday 2-5 PST in the TCG Forum of the Wizards.Community chat site!
Featuring Master_Trainer from Customer Service

Thurs. April 20, 2000

Hi ya gang! Master Trainer Mike and Pat here for another fun-filled chat! But first the announcements!

First, I know many of you have already seen or heard specifics about Team Rocket even though its street date is this Saturday (stores that broke this date are in TROUBLE). We can’t talk about that set, rulings, specific cards (like the Super Secret Card), misprints (there are a few), or anything else about that set until after the street date, ok? So please don’t ask.

Secondly, just so you know, we DO read many of the unofficial Pokémon Online Helpweb sites and their forum cuz we care! We really do! <Was that a bit much?> Anyhow, we’ve seen that there has been a debate about the Devolution Trainer card. Here’s the official answer; you CAN evolve a Pokémon that you devolved that turn. Playing the Devolution Trainer card has the same effect as evolving as far as removing attack effects but it does NOT count as evolving a Pokémon. So you could devolve a Pokémon, then evolve it that turn, then even Devolve it again! But then you would NOT be able to evolve it again that turn (you only evolve a particular Pokémon once per turn).

Thirdly, here is lots of info on the upcoming Super Trainer Showdown. When: July 22,2000 10 am- 7 PM Where: The Queen Mary Long Beach, CA. What is it? A Swiss Style Invitation-only tournament for 3 age division: age 10 and under, 11-14 years old, and 15+ and up.

How do I earn an invitation? There will be qualifying tournaments at each stop of the Pokémon Mall Tour, which is listed on our web site. The top 10 ranked DCI Pokémon players will get an automatic invite. There will be International Invitations in each country to be earned/given out.

And lastly, ANYONE who has earned 3 or more badges in the Pokémon league can take part! Other stuff: There is no admission to take part and there are lots of cool prizes to be given, including the winner of each age group will be given the “Master Trainer Champion” title!

Okay day! Let’s get started!

  1. When is the TEAM ROCKET set going to come out in Pennsylvania?
    Ok, the one Team Rocket release questions that I will answer for a while. Team Rocket comes out this Saturday the 22nd in all Pokémon League stores. You can also get a free Pre-release Dark Gyrados (while supplies last) so head on down! Other stores will get Team Rocket on the 24th.

  2. When will the poke-league come to England?
    Good question! I’ve heard it will be starting there soon! I would contact the UK WOTC office for specifies at UK @ wizards.com .

  3. What is with all the negative press for Team Rocket? I am personally offended by it. I love Team Rocket, and treating them like this in their own expansion *really* turns me off of the game.
    What negative press? I haven’t heard any.

  4. Does anyone know what promo 11 is? I heard it might be Lily Pad Mew.
    Ah, I should have mentioned that we couldn’t talk about unreleased cards or sets too. Should I use my macro so early?

  5. What will happen to the unclaimed prizes in the “Catch Team Rocket” contest?
    We thought they might make good decorations on the Space Weedle.

  6. How many promos were released so far?
    Roughly 22 in English so far.

  7. Are you able to use Devolution Spray on a Pokémon, then evolve onto that Pokémon? I say no, they say Yes, What’s the verdict! (Example: I Use Devolution spray on my Kakana back into a Weedle, Am I able to evolve that weedle back into Kakuna (with the necessary cards) in the same turn?)
    Yes you can. Devolving a Pokémon does not count as evolving a Pokémon.

  8. I have a Venusaur that is blue, and its solar beam letters are small like the Pokémon power, but its holo. Is it fake?
    I would try the light test on it to see if it is real or not.

  9. Out of the ten stopover locations listed on the new Pokémon TCG Tour, only two of those locations are east of the Rockies – one in Minnesota and one in Indiana. Will we be seeing more locations or additional opportunities to place for the Pokémon TC?
    We are working on setting up other Mall tour locations and they will be posted as they are finalized.

  10. On Devolution Spray, it says all status effects are removed, “just as if you had evolved it”. I assume this also mean that attack effects (Smokescreen, Agility) are also removed?
    Correct!

  11. Also, regarding Devolution Spray: can you re-evolve a Pokémon on the same turn you de-evolved them with Devolution Spray? As an example, de-evolving Charmeleon to Charmander, then immediately evolving him back up to another Charmeleon or Dark Charmelon?
    Yes you can.

  12. If you CAN immediately use Devolution Spray (if the answer to my last question was you can’t, just ignore this question), does that interrupt the normal flow of evolution? For example, on your turn can you evolve up from X to Y, use Y’s Pokémon Power?

    Those kinds of specific questions are still being worked out. Watch the web site for further details.

  15. What’s “Swiss Style”?
    Points earned, paired against equally rated individuals pair you up.

  16. You recently ruled that if Confused, the coin flip to see if the Confused Moltres can attack successfully would come before discarding the Energy Cards as an effect of the Wildfire attack. Am I correct in assuming the same sequence would be involved?

    Correct! Kori, you do make us think here.

    There intent is clear, even though that Pokémon has a new name (an earlier evolution) it is still the SAME Pokémon. So, you CAN evolve a Pokémon that you just devolved.

Thurs. April 27, 2000 - Weekly Pokemon TCG Q&A

Pokémon Online Help
Offered every Thursday 2-5 PST in the TCG Forum of the Wizards.Community chat site!
Featuring Master_Trainer from Customer Service

Thurs. April 27, 2000

Ok gang, Master TRainer Mike and Pat here again for the fun chat time!
Let’s start with the announcements. First of all, we are working on East Coast stops for the Pokémon Mall Tour, which should include Qualifying events for the Super Trainer Showdown in July in Long Beach, CA. Remember though, if you earn 3 badges through the Pokémon League, you can also be in it.

Secondly, we are aware of several misprints in the Team Rocket set. Any misprints that DON’T effect game play (such as Arbok’s 23000 copyright, Rapidash missing the word “length”, and the non-foil Dark FDragonite incorrectly numbered as 5out of 82, and Dark Raichu’s incorrect “Put Raichu on Pikachu” instead of Dark Raichu) will all be corrected in future print runs. The misprints that DO affect game play (The non-foil Dark Vileplume having Fighting as its Weakness and Grimer having a Poison Gas attack that puts the other Pokémon Asleep) will NOT be corrected. The game play effect misprints will be played as is, on the cards. When playing in an English League or Tournament, you will play these cards as is. If playing in an International event, then the cards will be played, as they originally should have been. This will be announced at those events beforehand.

As for Team Rocket Rules you might be unsure on, we went ahead and got some rulings for you. Dark Charizard’s Continuous Fireball attack- A Buzzap’ed Electrode that was chosen as fire energy would count as ONE Fire Energy card (and would only give you one flip of the coin). Dark Dugtrio’s Sinkhole Pokémon Power is assuming a SUCCESSFUL Retreating of the Defending Pokémon. So if that Pokémon were confused, that player would pay the retreat cost, then flip to see if it is successful from the confusion. If it were, THEN that Pokémon would take the 20 damage from the Sinkhole Power. The Rocket MagicKarp attack Rapid Evolution does NOT count as evolving the Pokémon (just has the same effects thereof). What this means is that if you can RainDance 3 water energy onto it the turn you play the MagicKarp you CAN play this attack and pull out a Gyarados or Dark Gyarados and place it on the Magickarp, THE SAME TURN YOU PLAYED IT. Also Aerodacty; s Pokémon Power would NOT stop this attack from working. Lastly, the Dark Rapidash attack Flame Pillar’s extra effect (where you may discard 1 fire energy to do an extra effect) works like the Moltres Wildfire cost as far as Confusion is concerned. You would flip for Confusion BEFORE you discard the fire energy for the extra effect. (Phew)…Lastly my boss Mike and I met some great players and people that work for the Pojo at the Team Rocket Release this last weekend. It was a fun event and you managed to chase away that dastardly Team Rocket.

A quick hello to Kittyfox, Paul Young, and others that we met there. Ok,Let’s get started!

  1. On my Dark Alakazam, it says that it evolves from Dark Kadabra. I wanted to know if Dark Alakazam could evolve from a regular Kadabra.
    Nope it cannot. The evolution rule for the Dark Pokémon is as follows: Since there are no Dark Basic Pokémon, you always start with a non-dark basic. Then you can choose to evolve it to a dark or non-Dark stage 1.
    Once it chooses to be dark or non-dark, it can only evolve to the stage 2 version of the same type So Dark Kadabra can only evolve into Dark Alakazam.

  2. I got a Devastation theme deck, and I got a sheet of cardboard “coins” with “10” printed on them. What exactly are they?
    Those are the new improved damage counters.

  3. Why did wizards choose Dark Raichu as the secret card? I think it should have been Mewtwo because of his involvement with Giovanni and Team Rocket in the TV show and the movie.
    Because we do, the unexpected. hee hee hee hee

  4. Are there any current plans to release a non-promo Mew?
    Not that I know of.

  5. Have there been any changes in the Neo set negotiations?
    Nope, we are still negotiating with them.

  6. Can movie promo Pikachu use Recharge to get a Rainbow Energy from the deck, or does it have to be a basic Electric Energy card? (If Rainbow Energy is OK, I assume it does not cause damage, since it is not played from the hand?)
    That would not work. Rainbow Energy only counts as all-basic energy types WHILE IN PLAY. This is not the case when it is in the deck.

  7. Is Grimer’s (rocket) poison gas attack meant to put to sleep or poison the other Pokémon?
    That is one of the misprints I already mentioned in the opening announcements. Play it as written.

  8. Will Aerodactyl (resistance to fighting) do confusion damage to itself?
    Nope, it has resistance to fighting.

  9. Dark Gloom is on my bench, the defender is Haunter, and I use Gloom’s Pokémon power and flip heads. Must I flip again due to Haunter’s transparency? Or is that unnecessary, since a Pokémon power is not the same as an attack, even if it does damage?
    You would NOT have to flip for Transparency. It has you flip for ATTACKS against it, not Pokémon Powers.

  10. Will the gym sets be called heroes and villains?
    No official name has been released yet.

  11. Suppose Ditto is poisoned, then Snorlax becomes active opposite Ditto. Does Ditto’s poison cease? It says Snorlax cannot BECOME poisoned, but what if Ditto (as Snorlax) is already poisoned?
    The poisoning does NOT cease. Snorlax’s Power says it can’t BECOME poisoned but in this case, the Ditto as Snorlax already IS.

  12. Will there be a new card for the next Pokémon league sign up, or will it be an old one?
    There will be future promo cards, no specific information is given out though (you all know that right?).

    Yes there are, coming out soon.

    It does 50 to itself (OUCH!).

    Yes you can.

    Yes it was.

    Correct! That would work! Good question.

    They are still loose in the office (C’MERE SQUIRTLE! We are working on it.

  19. If an opponent already has Nidoking’s Toxic double-poison, then next turn I use a “normal-poison” attack, does the opponent retain Toxic’s double-poison condition (20) or does it now become a single-poison condition (10)?
    It would gain a single poison effect (the new effect replaces the old one).

  20. If I use a Dark Vileplume with the error, what would it’s weakness be considered?
    As is on the card, Fighting.

    We announced those in the opening announcements.

  22. Several websites have pointed out that Non-holo Dark Vileplume’s (30/82) weakness is Fighting but Holo Dark Vileplume’s (13/82) weakness is Fire like all the rest of the Oddish line. Wow, what’s the ruling gonna be on this one?
    Already mentioned it.

  23. Clarification for Dark Hypno, the damage calculated by its Bench Manipulation attack is applied to the *defending* Pokémon, not to the benched Pokémon, right?

  24. Is Grimer’s “Poison Gas” a misprint?
    Yup, but play it as written.

  25. For Dark Charmeleon, would 3 Rainbow Energy and/or 2 “Buzzapped Fire Electrodes” satisfy the requirement of having “any fire Energy cards attached”?
    Yes they would (they both count as fire energy cards).

    REALLY? An error? US! Yeah, we know about that one, it will be corrected in future print runs.

    Not that I can announce yet, sorry.

    Sorry they are still working out specifics here too but there will be multiple invitees from each event. That much I know.

  32. What does dark Magneton’s magnetic lines attack do if your opponent has no benched Pokémon? Do you discard the energy card?
    Nope, you don’t do anything with it.

  33. Can you evolve dark Wartortle in dark Blastoise?
    Yup.

    Same as the odds of getting any other hologram card.

  35. First off, a simple one: are there Holo and non-Holo versions of Dark Raichu, or just Holo versions?
    Hi Kori, only holo versions of Dark Raichu (thanks for starting on us easy.

  36. Can Devolution Spray be played on a Basic Pokémon? Am I correct in assuming this?
    Nope, the assumption is that you are picking a stage of evolution that is in play.

  37. Am I correct in assuming that Dark Primeape’s Frenzy Pokémon Power (which adds +30 to all attacks when Confused) also applies to damage taken from a failed Confusion flip to attack? In other words, if a Confused Dark Primeape flips tails on an attack attempt, it ends up attacking itself for 20+30=50 damage.
    Correct (we are checking R&D on you previous questions Kori).

  38. In the game I have a choice of weaknesses with dark Vileplume: With the holo it’s grass; non-holo=fire, correct?
    No, the holo has Fire for Weakness, the non-holo has Fighting.

  39. Regarding why you do get a prize for KOing Ditto when he is copying a Clefairy Doll, you said “When a Pokémon hits the discard pile it reverts back to its normal type BEFORE you count it as a knocked out Pokémon or not.” So would this mean if Ditto is copying a Dark Gyarados and is KO’d, he would NOT use the copied Final Beam Pokémon Power because he would revert back to Ditto BEFORE being counted as a Knocked Out Pokémon (which is when Final Beam would kick in)?
    Okay, got the official answer. Ditto copying Dark Gyarados WOULD still check to see if it gets its final beam off. The official rule is that when a Pokémon gets Knocked out, you check for powers and other effects. Then the Ditto would revert to itself WHEN it hits the discard pile. And a prize card would be given. I know this is somewhat confusing. The ruling though is that when Ditto copies a Clefairy Doll or Mysterious Fossil and is knocked out, the other player still gets a prize card.

  40. Also regarding Ditto copying a Dark Gyarados – assuming that the KO’d Ditto CAN use Final Beam (if it can’t, please ignore this question :->), am I correct in assuming that it would do 20 damage for each Energy card of ANY type attached to Ditto, since all Energy Cards attached to Ditto are considered to be all types (including Water) simultaneously?
    Correct.

  41. Since Rainbow Energy counts as all types simultaneously when attached, am I correct in assuming that Rainbow Energy would also counts as Water towards calculating the damage done by Gyarados’ Final Beam?
    Correct.

  42. How is the Dark Raichu acquired?

  43. Dark Dragonite’s Pokémon Power does not have the “you cannot use this Power if your bench is already full” text like most other Bench-building powers and attacks do. Does this mean that by using Dark Dragonite you can bypass the normal five-Pokémon limit to your bench?

  44. If I have a Squritle on the bench and I Computer Search and then take a Pokémon Breeder and use a Professor Oak Than use a different Computer Search and take Item Finderand use Item Finder to take a Breeder can I use the breeder?

  45. Why did you put only 1 non-evolving basic in TR? (Porygon)

  46. Now that WotC has passed the first hurdle and designed their own ‘in-house’ card (Dark Raichu), do you think we may be seeing similar WotC-exclusive cards in future sets, or was this pretty much a one-time deal?

  47. On Rainbow Energy, it states “Doesn’t count as a basic Energy Card when not in play.” I assume from that statement then that it DOES count as a Basic Energy Card while in play?

  48. Do you no wen the tcg league will give away dark Charizard cuz that’s what 1 of the gym leaders said?

  49. In the rules it states that when a Pokémon evolves it becomes free of Poison, Sleep, Confusion, Paralysis, or anything else that may be the result of an attack. Does this mean that damage is also taken off of it when it evolves?

  50. Earlier you had ruled that a Buzzap’d Electrode can only choose to provide the six basic energy forms. With Team Rocket’s addition of Rainbow, Full Heal and Potion Energy, has that list been expanded? And if so, how does Electrode handle abilities of special energy cards?

  51. Is first edition Team Rocket out of print?

  52. On the Team Rocket Zubat, under it’s Sneak Attack Pokémon Power; it finishes with "Apply Weakness and Resistance.” but without a space between it and the preceding sentence.
