    We miss a space and it changes the ruling? Geez you guys are a tough crowd. Nope. Play it as written. And you meant Dark Golbat not Zubat, correct? (Zap!)

  53. Does Ditto copy status or attack effects of a Pokémon? For example, if Ditto went up against a Pokémon that had been previously Converted by Porygon, would he copy the original stats or the Converted stats? What about copying a Shifted Venomoth?
    Ditto always copies the original. It does not copy any effects on the defending Pokémon (like Poison, or Shift or any of those).

  54. Are the dark Charizards holo and/or prerelease and how do you get it?
    Dark Charizard holo appears randomly mixed in the Rocket boosters. The Pre-Release Dark Gyarados was given out last weekend at league? locations.

  55. When will I get my Team Rocket Sweepstakes prize in the mail?
    Not sure. It usually takes 6-8 weeks by my understanding.

  56. How does (TR)Porygon’s Conversion 1 attack? Does the attack last even after Porygon is retreated? If not, then what is the point of the attack?
    Yes it does. If the defending Pokémon retreats or evolves it would lose the effect but you can retreat Porygon and bring up a Pokémon that has attacks that are the same as the changed Weakness (that is the point of Porygon).

  57. I assume that if Dark Vileplume is active, Mysterious Fossil cannot be played?
    Correct.

  58. How can you get the “Dark Raichu” you spoke of? I know it isn’t in the Team Rocket expansion legally. So what would I have to do to get one?
    Course its in there legally. We got permission for it. It appears randomly mixed in the booster packs.

  59. On Snorlax’s Pokémon power? If he can’t be put to sleep and all that stuff, then why does it say the power doesn’t work if he’s ALREADY asleep and stuff?
    There are ways to stop a Pokémon power (like Goop Gas attack). If Snorlax is put Asleep or Confused while his power is inactive., it would NOT come back on while that effect was still in place.

  60. Why weren’t the misprint Team Rocket cards discovered as misprints before printing began?
    I talked with the brand team. There are literally THOUSANDS of lines of text on all the cards that go through many many processes. Our company’s release of cards (and all of our products) runs at a 99.67% accuracy, which is darn amazing. You have to realize that it is not a simple process to release a set of cards and a .33% error rate is pretty darn good.

  61. About the Misprint Vileplume? You mean if we go to league we use its weakness as fighting? Shouldn’t that be fixed?
    There is no way of doing errata for Pokémon cards. Keep in min that most players are fairly young and play the cards as they read them.
    Think of it as an advantage, now you have 2 versions to choose from.

  62. Does the extra Dark Gyarados Prerelease get called back or does the Pokémon League continue to give them out until they’re out?
    They give them out until they are gone.

  63. Why was Mew left out of Fossil?
    Creatures Inc. in Japan felt that they should NOT have included Mew in Fossil as Fossil was supposed to complete the original 150 only. We also wanted everyone to have a chance to get Mew easily so we made millions and gave them out.

  64. Hold on, you should now be able to see me AND Pat here at the same time (isn’t technology wonderful???)

  65. TR was Misprint City!! anyway Does Grimer’s Poison Gas actually makes the Pokémon fall asleep, or was it a misprint that it supports to make it poisoned…
    Grimer’s Poison Gas should result in poisoning the defending Pokémon, but as you know our TR version was misprinted and so it will only put them to sleep. Play this card as written.

  66. Is there a list for the cards in the Rocket theme decks on this site?
    Not yet (C’MERE YOU DARN SQUIRTLE! PAT HELP ME CATH THIS GUY).

  67. How many Rainbow Energy cards can you have in your deck and how about the other TR Energy card?
    Four of any non-basic energy allowed per deck.

  68. If trying to evolve into, for instance, Dark Charizard, would you need to have a Dark Charmeleon out to evolve from?
    Yes, exactly.

  69. What is your favorite deck type(s)? And your favorite trainers and your strategy to that(those) trainer(s)?
    Wow, that’s al long question. I play a Raindance variant and like the Professor Oak trainer. Pat plays a Haymaker variant.

  70. Why are you keeping the fighting weakness on Vileplume? Now even Hitmonchan could kill it easily!
    Because we don’t want to start down the road of issuing errata for cards like in Magic The Gathering. Plus now you can use the one that will work best against the popular decks in your area.

  71. Your answer to question 29 was confusing. Please re-state and clarify exactly who receives Dark Hypno’s damage, and how much.
    Dark Hypno states the Your opponent flips a number of coins equal to the number of benched Pokémon he has in play. For each tails the attack does 20 damage to him.

  72. Again on the Alakazam question. What do you mean as many times? Do you mean if you change your mind you can redo it?
    You can move as many as you want before your attack, but you have to move them one at a time.

  73. Does 1 ed. dark Rapidash have length written on it on it?
    Nope.

  74. When you use Dark Hypno’s Bench Manipulation attack, the text is unclear as to whether the damage goes onto the benched Pokémon or if the damage goes onto the defending Pokémon. It says “this attack does 20x the # of tails” but to whom?
    Just the defending Pokémon, that’s all.

  75. Why does some trainers like Sleep! have “(Rocket’s Secret Machine)” next to the name of the Trainer?
    Good question, probably because they all represent Rocket Machines that have those effects.

  76. If you have a Snorlax as your active Pokémon and use the Pokémon power of Drowzee (Rocket), would Snorlax’s Pokémon power resist Drowzee’s or would he become asleep?
    Snoralax’s Thick Skin Pokémon Power would resist it.

  77. My friend who is not able to chat, wants me to ask you, if you know if the tour will go near Kansas.
    We have the list of the announced locations so far on our web site at www.wizards.com/Pokémon/tour2000.asp. It also has the qualifier tournament rules there as well. Check it out.

  78. Can you give us some kind of outline of when the future sets will be released? Geez, Team Rocket just came out and I’m all ready wondering about Gym.
    Short attention span, huh? I have that problem too. The Gym sets are slated for late summer or early falls.

  79. I thought you said they were no basic darks? Then how come you said that mentioned Dark Charmander had a Pokémon power?
    There is no Dark Charmander, maybe he meant Charmeleon?

  80. Is Dark Raichu in Japanese Team Rocket?
    Nope.

  81. What is the worst Pokémon card?
    That would be an opinion as well. We do like to pick on Porygon here though.

  82. What is the number of the Dark Raichu card?
    83 out of 82. How’s that for math?

  83. Will they ever make base set and Jungle cards again?
    They won’t be printed as limited editions again, but they will continue to be printed in Base Set 2.

  84. What are the odds of getting a Dark Raichu card?
    The same as the odds of getting any particular holo card in a booster pack. 1 in 54 approximately.

  85. Why do WotC stop making TR 1st edition cards in a few days… that isn’t enough time for us!
    1st edition cards are only printed the first 3 days we make the cards. They are for sale as long as the supply lasts. We still have them for sale on our online store if you can’t find them in your area.

  86. Will there be future Promo cards with the foil “W” stamp?
    Yes, in fact there will be more ‘W’ cards that are not Pokémon cards.

  87. Is it right that the Pokémon gym leader and his friends keep all the promo cards you send them. who can I tell?
    No, give us a call at Wizards Customer Service and let us know about it.

  88. Hey, I was at Pokémon League last Saturday (22 Apr 2000) and I didn’t receive a prerelease Dark Gyarados! What’s up with that?
    Dunno. I would give your location a call and ask them. Maybe they were delayed in getting there.

  89. Do all Leagues HAVE to do the Brock/Misty challenge thing(everywhere I go, the Leader goes “huh?”)? And What exactly is it
    No, those activities are optional for those trainers that finish earning their badge for that season.

  90. What would happen if used Porygons conversion 1 attack and change a Pokémon weakness to the same as the Pokémon resistance
    You always calculate Weakness before Resistance. So you would double the damage (if it was of the appropriate type) and then subtract 30.

  91. If your Pokémon is confused and you failed to retreat it, can you still attack? (If you still have the energy to do it)
    Sure.

  92. What will the official ruling on Dark Vileplume’s weakness be?
    Play Dark Vileplume as it reads.

  93. So ‘effected’ Pokémon can retreat to become ‘cured’. And if the Pokémon that affected the Pokémon retreats, there is no curing of effect. For example, I changed Jigglypuff’s weakness to psychic with TR Porygon and I can retreat Porygon with the weak?
    It depends on the particular attack and whom it references. For example if it only mentions the defending Pokémon, then benching or evolving that one amends the effect.

  94. Will there be anther method of getting the Cool Porygon card?
    Yeah, trade for one.

  95. If it references the active AND the defending Pokémon, then benching or evolving either would end the effect.
    It all depends on who is mentioned in the text.

  96. If you use fossil Magmar’s smoke screen and your opponent retreats its Pokémon. Is the effect of the attack still on or is it canceled?
    It is ended (it is referencing the defending Pokémon).

  97. Any new news on the Mac version of the CD in the starter pack?
    No word on the Mac version yet, sorry.

  98. What I meant about the Dark Raichu was that it is not official. It is not part of the set of 82. So what is the rarity, the white star, or a reg. black star that is in every booster?
    The rarity is the same as any other holo rare card in Team Rocket.

  99. Why is the non-holo Dark Vileplume have weakness to fighting? Do I follow this rule while playing in the actual game?
    It is a misprint! Play the card as is (unless playing in an international tournament, then play by the official weakness of fire).

  100. How many cards in team rocket set?
    82…not counting that unofficial card.

  101. Was there an error for TR Grimer? I can’t read the opening announcements anymore.
    Yes, Poison Gas attack should have poisoned the defending Pokémon but it says that it puts them to sleep. Play this as it is written.

  102. What cards are in the team rocket decks?
    Trouble is a grass, psychis deck with Dark Arbok. Devestation is a grass, water deck with Dark Weezing.

  103. Like the Grimer’s poison gas ruling, does the non-holofoil Vileplume have to be played with the weakness to fighting?
    Yes, play the cards AS ARE.

  104. What is the point of base set 2? It’s the same stuff!
    Base Set 2 was released so that the out of print cards from Base and Jungle would still be available for new players to get. Since they need the basic cards in those sets we re-released them in a reprint set so that the old cards wouldn’t lose their value AND the cards would be available for game play.

  105. When will the 1st Edition Team Rocket Cards stop circulating?
    When the supply runs out.

  106. How does one apply to become a playtester?
    First, you have to live in the Seattle-Tacoma area. We don’t accept applications for those positions, we take a selection of people that have played in tournaments at our Game Center or display an interest in our games.

  107. Do you know if Jigglypuff promo is still being made or still in stock. Or would trying to buy the soundtrack now would be a waste of time?
    That card promotion ended Feb 28th. You can’t get that card. Although, I’ve heard that you can still get that card in the CD that was released in England.

  108. How come American cards have holos and non-holo rares and Japanese have Holo rares only?
    We had many collector/players complain to us that they did not want to play with their holos and ruin them but wanted to use those cards in game play, so we made both for you.

  109. I’m confused about the Trainer: Challenge. Could you explain how it works.
    It is a special extra activity that league members can do if they choose. You must have already earned this season’s badge, promo cards and TM stickers. They are extra activity/challenges that you can do to earn some special Brock or Misty stickers.

  110. What happens when you Metronome Selfdestruct? Do you take the damage?
    Yes, you’ll still take the damage, if that’s what you meant.

  111. Does this mean that if I simply get 3 badges at a Pokémon league and transportation to California, I’m guaranteed to have a free cruise and entrance into the Super Trainer Showdown thing? Or is it-limited capacity?
    There is no cruise. The Queen Mary is dry-docked. But yes you could participate if you have 3 badges and get there.

  112. What would your favorite Team Rocket Pokémon be? Mine would be Dark Dragonair and it’s awesome Pokémon power: evolutionary light.
    I’m digging Dark Vileplume cause Mike always bats me around with his Rain Dance deck and that depends heavily on trainer cards.

  113. Regarding Dark Dragonite’s Summon Minions, if your bench is full (or only one slot left) can you keep the two cards in your hand or are you not allowed to use the power at all?
    No, you can only take one Pokémon from your deck in that case.

  114. I’ve heard Dark Vileplume has a Pokémon Power called Hayfever. What does it do?
    When that Pokémon is NOT Confused, Asleep, or Paralyzed and it is in play, NO Trainer cards can be played.

  115. Would pokedex, Here comes Team Rocket, and TR Rattata Pokémon power: Trickery be a good combo?
    Sure, also try Mankey from Jungle.

  116. What made wizards put a secret card in the team rocket expansion? (I think it was a cool idea)
    We’ve wanted to do something like that for awhile just to add something interesting that is not in the Japanese sets.

  117. On the trainer card challenge can you play a mysterious fossil or Clefairy doll?
    No you can’t. Those are Trainer Cards while they are still in the deck. You can only pull basic Pokémon from the deck with Challenge.

  118. Will be Fossil, BS2, or Team Rocket out of print in the future, like the year 2001?
    They should be but we don’t have specific dates yet.

  119. The next three questions are all re-statements of this question, so let’s get this out of the way.
    The Dark Raichu is unique to the English Team Rocket set, we received special permission from Nintendo to put it in Team Rocket. It is a legit card.

  120. Can you find a Dark Raichu in booster packs or is it gotten some other way?
    It only appears randomly mixed in the booster packs.

  121. Are wizards ever going to make a promo Marril Card?
    Dunno.

  122. Is it possible to knock out more than one of your opponent’s Pokémon at the same time?
    Sure!

  123. What do you mean the odds of a holo in a booster are 1 in 54? Or is that just Dark Raichu? What is the 1:33 ratio then?
    That is the odds of getting ANY holo card. There are 18 holos, you have a 1 in 3 chance getting 1 in a pack, so 3 times 18= a 1 in 54 chance of getting a particular hologram in a booster pack.

  124. When (if ever) will the TCG Tour come to Canada? I’ve seen the listing of dates and places, but there are no Canadian Cities mentioned.
    We’re still trying to set up some more dates for the tour. It really comes down to locations that have the space and desire to do an event of this magnitude.

  125. Will there be place for 15+ Pokémon players in the league?
    Depends on your location. We do not have an age limit set for the league. I do know some places have to limit due to space limitations.
    Try going to a larger league location in your area.

  126. If you use the trainer, Here Comes Team Rocket, then you use the TR Ratatta’s Pokémon Power, would you switch your prize, then the top card of your deck would be face up or facedown?
    Does it matter? Your opponent will know what you’re putting there anyway? For the record though, put the Trainer face down on top of your deck.

  127. About the master trainer showdown, you still say I’m in if I have 3 badges. My league doesn’t send stuff to dci, will that be a problem?
    Yes, that will be a problem.

  128. I really want a Cool Porygon. Since I don’t need another N64, and no one is willing to trade the card if they get one, will there ever be another way to get one?
    Nope, Nintendo owns Pokémon and they decided how that card will come out. This is the only way to get it unless you find it on the secondary market.

  129. The chances are probably next to none. But will the Southern Island Series ever make it to the US shores?
    We just don’t know about that one yet.

  130. Where will I get a dark Gyadose. Will I get it at the Pokémon league? there was none last week since it was Easter?
    The Pre-release Dark Gyarados’s were given out at all North American League locations last Saturday. If your location didn’t have any, call and check again, they might have been delayed.

  131. Do you know if the Venusaur promo for the Pokémon TCG videogame strategy book "I think it?
    The promo Venusaur comes in the Strategy Guide for the Game Boy Trading Card Game.

  132. What if you play A Mulligan Mewtwo deck and all your Pokémon are in your prizes. What will happen?
    Well first of all, that is a lousy deck design, take the fun out of the game. You would keep reshuffling, never drawing a basic Pokémon, your opponent would stop taking extra cards, the game would never start, and people would boo you. If it was a tournament, you would get a delay of game penalty.

  133. Is there a team rocket Mewtwo?
    Nope.

  134. Does Wizards have a page were you can translate Japanese cards?
    Nope. Once we translate a set, we release it. Anything unreleased is not allowed in North America.

  135. If you Metranome on Moltras how many energy cards can you discard?
    As many fire energy cards as you have attached to Clefable/Clefairy.

  136. What are the sets that will be released this year?
    The two Gym sets are due later this year. That’s all we have scheduled for 2000.

  137. If you have an Alakazam move 30 damage from a Chansey to a Mr. Mime with its Pokémon Power on, does it put the damage on it, does it not take the damage? Or does it still?
    Ok, Alakazam can only move 1 damage counter at a time so Mr. Mime’s Power wouldn’t kick in. Secondly you are moving damage counters, NOT attack damage so again no effect.

  138. Will the Dark Raichu be legal at international battles?
    Good question! To be honest, I’m not sure, I will find out though.

  139. I was wondering what Venusaur you would recommend using in play? The Base set one or the Promo.
    That would be up to you, I think the base set Venusaur’s Energy Trans Power is more useful though.

  140. Pat, how exactly do you become a play tester? I live in the area.
    That’s sorta tricky…like I said you have to be on one of our many mailing lists and be randomly selected and called in for a focus/playtest group. There’s not really a way to apply, we choose playtesters randomly from a pool of interested gamers.

  141. Why did you chose to do single elimination in the Super Trainer Showdown? Wouldn’t double or Swiss rely on more skill instead of losing because of a bad draw?
    Because we’re expecting LARGE numbers of people at these and it’s difficult to keep the attention level required for several hours of Swiss-style play for many of the participants.

  142. How did you guys get that art from the Dark Raichu from a Japanese artist when it did not come out in Japan? Did ya ask him?(laugh)
    That was a special piece of art made specifically for us by that artist.

  143. If you have a Clefairy Doll or Mysterious Fossil in hand, can you mulligan? Or are you forced to play it because it counts as a basic Pokémon.
    You can mulligan because it doesn’t count as a Basic Pokémon when it’s in your hand.

  144. Why didn’t you use “Evil” like the Japanese translations?
    One, we had to be sensitive that this game is popular with younger players, and two, one syllable words (Dark) tend to flow easier than 2 syllable words (Evil).

  145. Can you make any card you want then? or do you have to get approval from Nintendo every time.
    No, we must get permission every time and it’s a difficult a lengthy approval process

  146. What’s up with the miss-printed, non-foil, Dark Vileplume? It has Fighting weakness instead of fire.
    It’s a misprint. We’ve mentioned this one many times already. Play it as it is.

  147. When is Pokémon tournament in Long Beach?
    July 22, 2000

  148. If you were a winner in the Team Rocket contest, when will WoTC be contacting the winners for info to send the prizes?
    Not sure, you should hear from them soon.

  149. Do you believe it is too late to sign up for the Pokémon League?
    Not at all, it’s still going on all over the country.

  150. Where on the web can I buy Pokémon cards on the web for a reasonable price?
    Well. www.wizards.com sells them, and will deliver in 7 to 10 days.

  151. How do I get my information (badges earned, etc) sent in so I can qualify?
    Make sure that your league gym leader is sending in the forms every week. For the tournament, just show up with your 3 or more badges.(it may get verified against our master list).

  152. What do you do if retail stores are charging 7 dollars a pack for Pokémon cards?
    Try to find a place that sells them for a more reasonable price.

  153. Should I download roms of Pokémon games?
    That is in violation of Nintendo’s copyrights. We do not make those egames but I don’t recommend getting caught doing anything like that.

  154. Can you get as many dark Gyrados as you want?
    I think they limit it to one per person as long as supplies last.

  155. Pat or Mike, where will you guys be at the SeaTac Mall stops? Maybe I can get you to tell me what Promo #11 is.
    I think Mike was mentioning that we would try to be there when the Mall tour stops there. When it get’s closer to the date, we’ll announce when and where we’ll be. I’m most often at the Game Center in Seattle.

  156. What killer deck is the best, Raindance, Haymaker, or the Mr. Mime deck?
    We all have our favorites here, mine has been Haymaker, Mike likes Raindance and we’ve been doing some experimenting with another Master Trainer’s design called Mr.Yuk

  157. How can I become a gym leader if I don’t work at Toy’s’rus or any trading card league store?
    Unfortunately, you usually have to work at one of the League stores to be a Gym Trainer.

  158. If I use Mewtwos absorb and pull a rainbow energy do I damage my self
    No you damage Mewtwo.

  159. Who did the art for dark Raichu? It is really awesome. I have it on my computer wallpaper right now!
    Yea, I dig it too. The art is by Mitsuhiro Arita

  160. Earlier I asked about the Trainer: Challenge, what I meant was the Trainer CARD Challenge in the TR set.
    If you and your opponent both have space left on your benches, then Challenge! loads your benches. If your benches are full, then it’s baically another Bill card. You can’t have too many Bill’s, can you?

  161. Can you evolve a “Dark” card from a non-team rocket basic card; also could you evolve a base 1 Charmeleon into a dark Charizard or a Dark Charmeleon into a base 1 Charizard?
    All Pokémon start as basic, so you can go from Base 1 Charmander to Dark Charmeleon. You cannot go from Base 1 Charmeleon to Dark Charizard though. Once you start evolving a ‘Dark’ Pokémon you have to keep going that way.

  162. About that previous ruling on the Mewtwo mulligan deck… If you’re playing by the rules, wouldn’t you draw your hand and resolve mulligans before you lay your prizes out? and then how could the Mewtwo’s get into the prizes so you don’t draw a basic?
    Correct. Some players jump ahead and lay prizes BEFORE the y look at their hands (which as you mentioned is incorrect ) . Sorry gang, had to take a long AD&D call.

  163. I heard that there is a card called dark Dragonite that is non-holo and it has the number of 5/82, when non-holo dark Dragonite is supposed to be #22/82, is this true about the error? If so, about how many were produce before the error was caught?
    Right, it is an error, not many leaked out to the public before we caught it. It will be a rare card indeed.

  164. Will you make a super energy retrieval? It would be a awesome card for rain dance decks!
    That would be great, don’t know of any plans though. Use Garbage Dump to help though.

  165. Any idea when the TR Checklist will be up on the main WoTC page? Of course this question will look very stupid if it already is up…
    I don’t know I’ll call the web guys and bribe them with donuts…

  166. Will the Japanese people want the dark Raichu? Is that a card that is exclusive to America?
    They might. It is exclusive to North America so far…

  167. What’s the most boring deck you’ve played?
    Mewtwo mulligan deck…boy this one is lame.

  168. Why do people think Pokémon is for little kids?
    Hmm, maybe it’s the cartoon, toys, Pokémon candy, Pokémon under roos, etc.

  169. When are the gym leader sets 1 and/or 2 EXPECTED to come out?
    Late summer for the first one and early fall for the second. I’m not going to be able to get more specific right now, sorry.

  170. Did you read about what the pope said about Pokémon? He praised it!
    We did hear of that yes.

  171. What is your e-mail address?
    custserv@wizards.com

  172. How cool is the team rocket set?
    Not quite as cool as Cool Porygon.

  173. Do you have every single American card?
    Nope. But I do have a copy of each one.

  174. Is there ever going be a Pokémon cruise for the top Pokémon TCG trainers?
    You never know.

  175. Not saying Wizards should be perfect, but EVERY Pokémon release has an error! Couldn’t you spend a little more time checking for mistakes?
    Sorry gang but NO card set released from ANY company has ever been 100% error free.

  176. Why does the Pokémon league ignore weakness and resistance?
    I shouldn’t be ignoring that.

  177. You play with a raindance deck right? What team rocket cards have u added and why? I’m a fellow raindance player
    I play with a Here comes Team Rocket and a TR Rattatta to unlock my prizes. I also play with 2 Nightly Garbage Runs to bring cards back from the discard pile so I can oak again if need be.

  178. Is Pokémon dying? People say they don’t like Pokémon but they keep looking over my shoulder when I play the game!
    It sounds like they don’t know what they’re talking about then.
    A couple of the heal energy help sometimes too (to stop Pralaysis and Confusion and Posion).

  179. Is it possible to put 4 kadabras and 4 dark kadabras in the same deck?
    Yes it is, they have different names.

  180. Why does Nightly Garbage Run say 3 basic Pokémon, evolutions, or basic energy when it should say up to a total of?
    You take back 3 cards total, you can choose form basic energy or evolutions, or basic Pokémon.

  181. How do you play Pokémon TCG on line?
    We have no plans to do that as of yet.

  182. Is there anyway that I can get a Dark Gyrados, my league area has run out?
    Try other league locations (it was while supplies last).

  183. Will the upcoming Gym/Gym2 cards that you will make, have a non-holo counterpart as well?
    Yes

  184. This is a follow-up question on question #204. The store that sells the Pokémon packs for 7 dollars is the TCL gym leader store. Can WotC do anything about this? Like, don’t ship cards to them!
    Thu Apr 27 16:51:15 2000 Master_Trainer_Mike [public msg] By law we cannot force a store to sell our product for a particular price. That is price fixing and illegal. I would recommend shopping somewhere else or get them form us online.

  185. Do you ever go to WIZARD’s in the NORTHGATE MALL?
    Yes, I was there for the Team Rocket launch last weekend.

  186. How can I become a gym leader? Who do I have to contact? What are the requirements?
    Gym Leaders are employees of the store that are running the Pokémon League. If you own a store and want to have the League, contact Merchant Relations at 1-800-821-8028.

  187. If Rainbow Energy acts as any Basic Energy Card, how many can you put in your deck?
    4 it is NOT a basic energy, only counts as one when in play.

  188. If I play in a DCI sanctioned tournament and use a misprinted Dark Vileplume, should I consider its weakness to be fighting or fire?
    If it is an English tournament, play the card as is. If it is an international tournament, play it as the correct version (fire).

  189. When are you going to have an FAQ on team rocket posted on the wizard’s website?
    I am working on one, should be up soon.

  190. Can electrode be buzzapped into 2 Rainbow energy or Potion Energy?
    Nope, only basic energy.

  191. Since you added an extra card to rocket, is it possible extra cards will be added in the future, or was that just to make up for no Fossil Mew?
    It’s possible but hard to do.

Click on each spoiler to view entire log:

Thurs. May 4, 2000 - Weekly Pokemon TCG Q&A

Pokémon Online Help
Offered every Thursday 2-5 PST in the TCG Forum of the Wizards.Community chat site!
Featuring Master_Trainer from Customer Service

Thurs. May 4, 2000

Hi gang, Mike here with Pat ready to get started. A little technical difficulty to start but here we go!

  1. Can you have multiple Dark Muks so you have 2 colorless retreat cost on your opponent per Dark Muk?
    Sure! Each one adds 2 colorless to the retreat cost for the defending player.

  2. Can you have 8 basic Pokémon because of the new Dark Pokémon?
    You can have 4 of the same name, Dark Blastoise and Blastoise have different names, so 4 of each.

  3. Ditto is active, and the opposing PKMN is Dark Arbok. Ditto has 40 damage on it. Dark Arbok does stare on Ditto. Is Ditto (now with 50 damage) knocked out because it’s PKMN Power stops working, or is it not because it’s still Dittoing Dark Arbok, a
    Correct, Ditto would revert to Ditto and 50 damage would knock him out.

  4. Dark Gyarados is active, and Dark Arbok is the opposing PKMN. Dark Gyarados has 60 damage and Dark Arbok uses Stare on it. Does Dark Gyarados still do Final Beam?
    No it would not; the Stare attack stops the defending Pokémon’s Power from working, so it would stop the Final Beam from working.

  5. Can you tell me any info on future or up coming promos and if you can will you share that info with us?
    What do you think Pat? Can we tell them anything? There will be more, yes. Beyond that? No info to share! Yet. (hee hee hee)

  6. I have heard rumors of poor organization and management at the Pokémon tour in Colorado. What steps are being taken to make sure the workers know (and enforce) the rules?
    Of course we want to make sure that the tour works best for everyone. Any difficulties that may have occurred at that location have been reported and we are working to improve it for next time.

  7. Can Clefable copy dark Charizards continuous fireball?
    Yes. You’ll have to flip coins equal to the number of fire energy cards attached to Clefairy if you copy it though.

  8. Will Dark Vileplume still be able to use its weakness to fire?
    If you’re playing in a tournament, you’ll use the weakness of the Dark Vileplume that you have in play. Having two weaknesses to choose from when building your deck could be helpful depending on what decks you’re likely to face.

  9. On the ruling on Ditto/Myst. Fossil, when Electrode is Buzzap’d it is KO’d. But when Kabuto is KO’d the opponent gets a prize. The basics (Mist. Fossil is a trainer!) Are different, so could you clarify that a little better?
    I don’t understand this question. When you buzzap and Electrode the opponent also gets a prize. When Ditto is copying a Mysterious Fossil it reverts to Ditto when it is knocked out and so the opponent gets a prize. It is a Pokémon copying a trainer card that acts like a basic Pokémon. Make sense?

  14. Also with TR Magikarp. If I have a Ditto against it, with a Gyarados in my deck, could I use Waterfall Evolution to evolve Ditto into a Gyarados?
    We will check on this but Ditto says that it cannot evolve, period. The Magikarp ruling just lets you use that attack to ignore the Aerodactyl Pokémon Power. It still has the effect of evolving.

  15. If an Alakazam uses Teleport Blast and goes on the bench, while knocking out the opponents Active Dark Gyarados, do you use Dark Gyarados’ power on Dark Alakazam or your new active Pokémon?
    Damage is done BEFORE you switch Dark Alakazam back to the bench. So you would resolve the Knock Out effects BEFORE you Bench the Dark Alakazam.

  16. Normally Ditto can’t evolve on his own (for example, he’s copying a Charmander and you wish to play a Charmeleon in your hand onto him). However, TR Magikarp’s Rapid Evolution bypasses the rules of normal Evolution rules (since it isn’t affected by Aerodactyl and can “evolve” Magickarp the same turn it was played). Therefore, could then a Ditto copying TR Magikarp use Rapid Evolution to evolve himself into a Gyarados since Rapid Evolution overrides normal rules for evolution? Similarly, what about Metronoming Rapid Evolution?
    Nope. We explained this already (though we will check R&D for you to verify). Rapid Evolution still counts as evolving as in it has the same effects as. Since you are NOT playing a card from your hand this is not the Standard Evolution step so this is why it ignores the Aerodactyl power. It still COUNTS for the purposes of Ditto’s not being able to evolve, period. No matter how the evolution is done, Ditto CANNOT evolve, period.

  20. Is Dark Dugtrio’s Pitfall Pokémon Power cumulative in any way? Or are it just one flip and 20 damage regardless of how many Dark Dugtrios you have in play? And if does involve multiple coin flips, do you stop after the retreating Pokémonfirst takes damage, or continue flipping for each Dark Dugtrio in question?

    Ok, I get what you are saying but don’t try and use logic for this sort of thing. It doesn’t matter if a card actually hits the discard pile or not. Ditto is a Pokémon that is only COPYING a trainer card that acts like a Pokémon. When Ditto is knocked out, IT DOESN’T matter what he was.

  33. Concerning the refusal to issue errata for Pokémon: I would simply like to suggest a few things. 1) Errata would be much easier for players to understand than, say, the various Ditto rulings. Yet they’re already expected to know the latter. 2) The policy against fixing the errors doesn’t seem to make sense in this case since WotC doesn’t own the game, simply translates. The translations should be accurate. 3) Errata only effects DCI sanctioned tournaments when you get right down to it. Fixing the cards won’t hurt casual players. Not fixing them hurts serious tourney going players, however. 4) There’s no way the errata list would ever be more than a page. 5) A lot of us would sure appreciate that erratum.
    Ok, first please keep in mind that no matter how much some players may wish otherwise, Pokémon has a core younger audience. You cannot have the same expectations for the sophistication of the average player as you can with Magic or other more mature games. Most younger players play the cards as read. They do not even know what erratum is? We are aware that some of the misprints can be somewhat confusing but it will be even harder with errata for the average player. Nothing is written in stone so things may change as the sophistication changes. BUT, thank you for your comments.

  43. This is on behalf of Koribouros, who typoed and doesn’t have copy/paste: Mike, Pat – we understand that the core group in Pokémon is a younger audience. But I think WotC is not giving the kids a lot of credit. As I mentioned in a letter to WotC, kids can understand better than you might think. Furthermore, sometimes people who have not been informed of current errata on cards will show up at tournaments and find out that their prized combo doesn’t work as they expected.

  51. Let’s talk about the errata a little more. It could be said that Mike and I have jobs because of the MOUNTAINS of errata on Magic cards. However, we both feel, and so does the people in charge of Pokémon organized play, that to start issuing errata for Pokémon cards would be starting on a road that we’ve already been down with Magic. Once again we will say that this COULD change in the future if need be. These mistakes do NOT seriously effect the game, if we made a mistake that did, of COURSE we would correct it. At this time, we believe that not issuing errata is the right choice for now so that everyone can compete without having to track the latest rulings on your favorite cards on the Internet.

  60. How do you use the Trainer card “Challenge” and the Rainbow Energy Card? I don’t get how to use them.
    Ok for Challenge, you ask the other player if he accepts the Challenge or not. If he says no, then you draw 2 cards and it’s done. If he says yes, you both can search through your deck and pull out basic Pokémon and put them on your bench (remember the bench can only have 5 maximum Pokémon on it). For Rainbow Energy, when you attach this energy to a Pokémon (from your hand), that Pokémon takes 10 points of damage. The Rainbow Energy now counts as all basic Energy types at the same time (grass, fire, water, psychic, lightning, and fighting).

  63. I get the impression that Pokémon isn’t treated as seriously as other games. You won’t correct the game because kids can’t figure it out. Your major tournament event in Colorado was filled with problems; my league doesn’t turn in our information (which means I may not get to go to the LA event); I went to a Wizards store and the employees had no clue what Topdeck was and no idea about any TEAM ROCKET related events for the following weekend. My question is why is this treated, as such a second rate game when the profits are so great? Is it taken less seriously because the age range is broader than other games?
    We take Pokémon very seriously here. Keep in mind that this is the largest selling game in the world and in HISTORY. We never expected the game to take off like it did and in some ways we are still playing catch up. Keep in mind that we are all human and we are doing the best we can. This internet chat for example, started because we want to communicate better with you than we have with other game sin the past. We understand that errors can be frustrating for the public, we don’t like them either. Pokémon is such a HUGE thing now that even a few errors (which can’t be avoided we all are human after all), can seemingly multiply. Many MANY more players have gotten into the TCG field due to Pokémon 's unrivaled popularity. Many resources that were set up for the smaller market with Magic and other TCG’s are now being inundated with the new Pokémon card fans. We really do want this to be a great experience for everyone involved and will continue to do our best for you all.

  127. If I have a Ditto with 3 dc energy attached as active and the defending card is a base 1 Blastoise, can I do Hydro Pump for 60 or do I need water energy?

Ok gang, time to go back and answer the phones. Sorry I couldn’t get to all your questions but you asked some good ones that we will have to research for next week. Thank you all for coming and we will see you next week. Bye!

Thurs. May 11, 2000 - Weekly Pokemon TCG Q&A

Pokémon Online Help
Offered every Thursday 2-5 PST in the TCG Forum of the Wizards.Community chat site!
Featuring Master_Trainer from Customer Service

Thurs. May 11, 2000

Hi gang! Mike and Pat (and our boss Mike) here again for another fun-filled chat! First the announcements: We have some promo cards to announce for you. Season six in the Pokémon League (which should be starting this weekend or soon thereafter) has the Computer Error promo card (#16) as the card you can earn. Season Seven has the hologram Eevee (promo #11) as the card you can earn. The promo Eevee is a unique mechanic card that has not appeared in Japan.

We also have some new rulings from R&D for you. For the Rocket Magickarp’s attack Rapid Evolution: (Search your deck for an Evolution named Gyarados or Dark Gyarados and put it on Magickarp. Shuffle your deck afterward.) This attack DOES count as evolving Magickarp so it CANNOT be used the turn that Magickarp comes into play (you cannot evolve a Pokémon the turn it comes into play). The reason that this attack CAN be used even if Aerodactyl is in play (Its Prehistoric Power prevents evolution cards from being PLAYED) is that you are not PLAYING an evolution card but pulling one from the deck and using it. PLAYING a card means taking it from your HAND and using it. Also, if Rapid Evolution is Metronomed, the Clefairy/Clefable WOULD be able to evolve into a Gyarados or Dark Gyarados if that player has one of those cards in his or her deck. R&D is also talking with the creators of Pokémon back in Japan about confusion over Ditto and copying attacks like Metronome as well and we will keep you informed of what they learn from them.

Lastly, once again we’d like to say that we do read through the various popular unofficial web sites and see and pass along your concerns. Nothing is set in stone here at Wizards and there are always ongoing discussions about Pokémon and its future. Please feel free to pass along any comments or questions you have to us here at Customer Service at custserv@wizards.com and we will always pass them along for you. Is that it? Oh yeah, Pat and I (Mike) and our boss (Mike) will be at the Mall Tour Stop at the Sea-Tac Mall this weekend as well. Feel free to stop on by and show us your deck and try and stop Boss Mike’s “fearsome” Mr. Yuk deck! There we go.

  1. If Ditto is copying a Pokémon with a PKMN Power, does Ditto copy the power as well as the moves?
    Yes.

  2. Why do some attacks state “Any other effects that would happen after applying Weakness and Resistance still happen”? What effects happen after applying weakness and resistance?
    They mean any other attack effects like Poison or Confusion or effects like Agility or Smokescreen.

  3. Last week you mentioned that the TR Grimers art was changed. What was the change and why was it changed?
    If you’re familiar with the Japanese card you will know why we changed it. That’s all I’ll say on the matter.

  4. Could I damage swap a damage counters to a Clefairy doll, since it says, “Clefairy Doll doesn’t count as a knocked out Pokémon”?
    Yes, you could. When Clefairy Doll is in play it counts as a basic Pokémon.

  5. If a ditto is copying another Pokémon (like Mr. Mime) does Ditto also copy the Pokémon Power (like Invisible Wall?)
    That’s right.

  6. I’m a local Gym Leader in New London, CT. Other stores in my area are giving away promos when they are not earned, or are stamping for seasons right up until the Earth Badge. What should I do if someone who has extra stamps comes to my location and wants more (and more promo cards) from my store?
    Well first of all if you know of any stores that are breaking the rules, please contact us and let us know so we can correct it. I would just inform these players how it is supposed to be done and that you will be doing it correctly. They should only earn and receive the promo cards from their original location.

  7. Does Dark Charizard still have too flip for all of his energies when u do continues fireball? After you already KO’d the defending Pokémon?
    Yes, D. Charizard will have to finish flipping coins even after enough damage has been done to the defending Pokémon.

  8. Will Promo # 1 ever be reshipped? The people at my local League really would like a copy of the card, and most of them never had the chance to collect it.
    Probably not, older promo cards don’t get reissued generally. I would check the secondary market or see if you can trade for them.

  9. Will the Nintendo Power June issue have a Dark Persian promo?
    You’d have to give Nintendo a call about that one, I’m not sure.

  10. Can you give us anymore info on The # 11 promo Eevee?
    There is a full write up of that card in issue #7 of TopDeck.

  11. Can you give us info on other promos to come out soon?
    We just updated you on that; we’ll post the announcements again later.

  12. If I were to send my deck idea to wizards would they publish it in there magazine? If they did then would they give me credit for making it like would they put my name at the bottom of the deck idea?
    You would need to send them into TopDeck c/o Wizards of the Coast PO Box 707 Renton, WA 98057. Sometimes they print deck ideas in the magazine.

    Only other grass energy.

    As we announced in the opening, there is an ongoing discussion about Pokémon and its future. We always pass along your concerns.

  100. I have a mono-fire deck with no rares. My problem is that they are all weak to water and I usually lose to good rain dance decks. My question is: How can I beat a Rain-Dance deck, without adding any rares? Please help me, I have a awesome deck it’s record so far is 10-2.

  115. Can I evolve a Dratini from the rocket set into a Dragonair from the first set of Pokémon?

  116. If the defending Pokémon has a status change (like poison) but and attack requires you to flip to see if the same condition is afflicted, do you still have to flip? (Eg - Weedle’s poison sting reads "flip a coin. If heads, the defending Pokémon is no?

  117. Is Growlithe base set a misprint?

  118. I am trying to make a fighting deck which would be my dream deck and could possible beat psychic, which is its weakness, but I can’t find the proper cards?

  119. Hello! I’m a beginner and I like to know how exactly the Sleep & Poison works: Sleep; flip a coin after the owner of the asleep Pokémon turn or after every turn; same for the poison; one damage after the owner turn or after every turn?
    After each player’s turn including the one in which a Pokémon was put to Sleep, you flip a coin. If heads, your Pokémon is awake and can act normally. If tails, it is still Asleep and cannot Attack or Retreat.
    For Poison, your Pokémon takes 10 damage after each turn (including the turn in which it was Poisoned). This lasts until your Pokémon is knocked out, benched, or evolved.

  120. Some of those team rocket cards look like a 5-year-old drew them… How come Wizards of the coast didn’t try to do their best?
    That’s what the original artwork was in Japan. Personally I think Picassos looks like a 5-year-old drew it.

  121. I don’t know if this question has already been asked because I just got here, but anyways, here goes. Say I have a Drowzee (from Team Rocket on my bench) with a Snorlax active. If I use Long-Distance Hypnosis and the flip is tails, will my Snorlax be put to sleep?
    Nope, unless Snorlax’s Pokémon power isn’t working for some reason (like Muk is in play), he will not be put to sleep.

  122. If an attack knocks out Dark Gyrados, but also Paralyzes Dark Gyrados on a coin flip, does Dark Gyrados’s Final Beam work?
    Yes it does as being Knocked out is immediate and attack effects don’t happen until the end of the turn, so Gyarados would be Knocked out BEFORE he was paralyzed.

  123. Are there any cards that have a SMALL CHANCE of being banned from official play like in Japan? (I.e. Comp. Search, SER, Item Finder and Team Rocket’s Sneak Attack are banned there, including some others I can’t seem remember the names of)
    There are no plans to ban any cards at this time (though this could always change).

  124. Are all league members with 3 badges invited to the Super Trainer Showdown in Long Beach?
    They are eligible to take part if they want.

  125. How many promos are out right now?
    Roughly 25 or so.

  126. Any new TCG accessories being released in the near future we should know about?
    Nothing to announce, sorry.

  127. If I used Ditto to copy Grimer and Grimer evolved to Muk will Ditto evolve too, if so if Muk uses toxic gas will my Ditto be useless?
    Yes Ditto would transform into Muk but then would revert to Ditto.

  128. What season of the Pokémon League is it now?
    Season 6 should be starting this week at most locations.

  129. If you use Gambler with no other cards in your hand, do you have to shuffle your deck?
    Yes you would still have to shuffle your deck.

  130. OK, this one is for everyone in my League that keeps bugging me about it: Do you get anything for earning all 8 badges in the League (other than a sense of pride)?
    They are still working on that one.

  131. What is Pokémon League?
    A place where people who enjoy Pokémon get together every week to play, trade, and talk. Check out our web site for league locations in your area.

  132. Is it legal to use a Japanese Mew at a tournament at which promos are not allowed?
    Dunno, English promos are usually allowed.

  133. If my Pokémon fell asleep and it wakes up next turn will it be able to attack on that turn or the next?
    You flip at the end of each player’s turn. If it wakes up after the other players turn, BEFORE yours then it would act normal on your turn.

  134. So is it true that promo 16 is coming in the Pokémon League this Saturday?
    Should be, yes.

  135. What is the card made out of other than paper? Because I see black stuff on it sometimes, or something from the inside.
    That is the layer we include to make it hard to counterfeit the cards.

  136. What rules are the good one Base 2 or the 1st rules (in the Wizards page rules appear the 1st rules)?
    The Base Set 2 rules are a bit more detailed (they came out later) but they are both basically the same.

Ok DING! Time’s up! Thank you all for coming. If you are in the area, stop by the Sea Tac Mall this weekend to play against me Mater Trainer Pat, and Boss Mike. We look forward to meeting you.
BYE!

Fri. May 12, 2000 - Team Rocket TCG Hour

TCG Hour: Team Rocket
Featuring Teeuwynn Woodruff, game designer and Carole Pucik, brand manager

Fri. May 12, 2000

WizO_Bilbo: Dastardly Team Rocket has struck again! Find out the details of their latest crazy machines and sinister attacks from designer Teeuwynn Woodruff and brand manager Carole Pucik. Starting right now at TCG Hour in Wizards Presents.

GingerTheMighty: I have heard at Pokémon League that you can’t use one of the Team Rocket Pokémon evolutions, (like Dark Wartortle, for example) with a non-Team Rocket card. Is that true, or can you evolve any Squirtle with the Dark Wartortle?

WotC_Carole: Yes, some of the evolved cards are limited to use with other Rocket cards. Basically, this is done to keep the game interesting.

Koribouros: With regards to the Squirtle question, any Squirtle will do fine for evolving into a Dark Wartortle. But once you go Dark, you have to keep them Dark.

GingerTheMighty: How do you know which cards can be used with which? Some of the cards in the Devastanio deck weren’t Team Rocket cards, so how do you know?

WotC_Carole: Each Evolved Pokémon tells you which card they evolve from on the card.

Arcanine21: Can you Energy Trans Rainbow Energy with Venasaur?

Koribouros: Once it’s in play, a Rainbow Energy card counts as all basic energy, including Grass, so yes, you can Energy Trans it.

Fromando: Can I blame you for me not getting any holograms in 6 packs of Team Rocket?

WotC_Carole: You’re just very unlucky.

HydroMew_3213: What type of deck is most affected by Team Rocket cards?

WotC_Carole: Well, we’ve found that most advanced players using Team Rocket cards can beat almost any deck.

Guest27: Does a Full Heal Energy or a Potion Energy only count as colorless? Does playing a Full Heal or Potion Energy count as your 1 energy card to be played?

Koribouros: Yes, they both only provide colorless energies. And yes, they also do count as your one energy per turn.

Fromando: When do you plan to release Gym?

WotC_Carole: Gym Heroes will be in stores the first part of August!

Guest27: Will Evee be promo 11 and released in the TCG League?

WotC_Carole: Evee will be released next season. Starts tomorrow if I’m correct.

Koribouros: I take it then the two Gym series expansions will be called Heroes and Villains? Why those names?

WotC_Carole: You’re close. Heroes and Challenge. We chose those two names because they most closely matched the Japanese storylines.

HydroMew_3213: Why was Dark Gyrados the Prerelease?

WotC_Carole: Because we wanted to sample one of the Dark Pokémon. We thought Gyrados would be a favorite. Turns out, it is!

Koribouros: Just wanted to say “thanks” for not calling the second expansion Villains. Challenge is much better!

Fromando: In Gym Heroes, will the art for Misty’s Tears be changed?

WotC_Carole: Survey Says: Most likely.

Arcanine21: When will Neo cards be released?

WotC_Carole: Neo will likely come out early 2001.

Pokefan12345: How many points is it to earn the promo Eevee?

WotC_Carole: You can earn promo cards at 250 and 500 points (Evee is cool!).

Jester9779: Why is my league so behind? We just started session 5.

WotC_Carole: Where is your league located?

Jester9779: Zainy Brainy in Orland Park, Illinois. We also receive cards late.

guest27: We just started going for promo Mew foil at Zany Brainy in NJ.

Jester9779: Holo Mew starts this weekend for me.

WotC_Carole: There could be a number of reasons. Maybe it’s a new store. . . . If I remember right, the Zany Brainy chain didn’t start the League until November, so they would naturally run behind a couple seasons. . . . Don’t worry. You won’t miss anything!

HydroMew_3213: What promo number is Dark Persian?

WotC_Carole: The Dark Persian promo card? It’s number 17.

Guest27: If you knock out the defending Pokémon on the first coin flip using Dark Charizard, do you have to continue to flip coins equal to the number of energy since the defending Pokémon is now knocked out?

Teeuwynn: Yes, you do. The attack says that you have to flip a number of coins equal to the number of Fire Energy on Dark Charizard. You still have to do this even if you knock out the defending Pokémon early.

Koribouros: Some of us were surprised that there wasn’t a promotion or product release specifically targeted to the Christmas '99 shopping season. Was this a conscious decision not to, or just the way schedules worked out?

WotC_Carole: Basically, we viewed Fossil as our holiday release. We also had a gift box. Doesn’t get much more holiday than that!

Koribouros: Boosters make great stocking stuffers you know!

Pokefan12345: Why is it that you chose promo cards to be given away at 250 and 500 points all the time?

WotC_Carole: We originally awarded cards at 500 points, then changed it when they became too difficult to earn. We are consistent with the award numbers because we feel people need to earn the cards. We’ like to maintain consistency.

Fromando: Why did you make Here Comes Team Rocket a normal holo/rare? Its only value would be as a super rare. I mean, it sucks in game play.

WotC_Carole: Holo rares are highly collectible. Let’s not forget Dark Raichu . . . the American super rare.

Teeuwynn: Fromando, it’s not a very good card, but some kids like seeing the Prize cards. You can use it creatively, though . . . like with Rattata’s Trickery Pokémon Power. Trickery lets you trade the top card of your deck with one of your Prize cards

WotC_Carole: We replaced Here Come the Rockets with Dark Raichu. You wanted two super rares?

Fromando: YES!

WotC_Carole: Sorry!

Arcanine21: On Dark Charmeleon, when it uses the “Fireball” attack, it specifically states to discard a Fire Energy card, does rainbow energy count as a fire in this case?

Teeuwynn: Good question, Arcanine21. Yes, Rainbow Energy counts as a Fire Energy (and a Water, Grass, etc.) while it’s in play. (But it doesn’t count as basic energy when it’s in your hand.)

Fromando: Isn’t Dark Riachu just a normal holo rare?

WotC_Carole: Dark Raichu is the Super Secret card. The rarity is the same as the other holos.

HydroMew_3213: What promo cards and numbers are the cards for the second movie? P.S. Isn’t Computer Error promo card come before promo Eevee?

WotC_Carole: Are you sure there are promo cards with the second movie?

Teeuwynn: I think you may just have to wait to find out Hydro!

Jester9779: When is Gym 2 coming to the states? I know this is far into the future, but how about Neo Neo2?

WotC_Carole: Gym Challenge will release in the 4th Quarter 2000. Neo will likely come out early 2001.

WizO_Durst: (Note: Designers can’t answer questions about far future products.)

Teeuwynn: How true!

Guest27: So, I can play a basic energy card AND a rainbow energy card on one turn? When does Team Rocket FAQ come out on the website?

Teeuwynn: No. You can still only attach one energy card a turn. I’m not sure when the FAQ will be up. Carole? Do you know?

WotC_Carole: The FAQ should be up in the next 10 days (once we know what all the FAQs are . . . )

Arcanine21: On Dark Magneton its “Magnetic Lines” attack states you move an Energy card from the defending Pokémon to a benched Pokémon. What if he has no benched Pokémon, can you still do just the damage?

Teeuwynn: Yes, you can – because of the “if.” If the card said you must, then you would not be able to do the attack. If you CAN move the energy, you have to.

Fromando: Can you tell me one attack the Dark Persian promo has? *Looks up with puppy dog eyes.*

WotC_Carole: You know I’m an animal lover. But it will never work.

Pokefan12345: On the survey by pojo.com, most people said they don’t want the Misty’s Tears card’s artwork to be changed.

WotC_Carole: There are many opinions about Misty’s Tears. Our decision was to make a slight alteration.

Koribouros: Actually, as I understand it, the Japanese Misty’s Tears actually DOES have her wearing a bathing suit – it’s just really hard to see. So if they changed it, they wouldn’t really be “changing” it.

Teeuwynn: It’s a very cool card – game-wise!

HydroMew_3213: I heard Cool Porygon will be re-released at the League. How? Could you re-release promo Jigglypuff?

WotC_Carole: Great Questions! Cool Porygon will be released through the League at a later date (to be determined). We have no plans to release more Jigglypuff at this time . . . but we never say never.

Dark_Kadabra: If you attach a Full Heal Energy to my active Pokémon and a Pokémon puts that Pokémon to sleep will it go to sleep?

Teeuwynn: Your Pokémon would be Asleep if the Full Heal Energy was already on the Pokémon. It’s not permanent protection from Asleep, etc. It just works like a Full Heal when you play it . . . and then it’s colorless energy.

Pokejoey: My sister and I have been in a League and we have moved. The new League has said that we have to start our books from the beginning. Is this true? We have been working on our books since August 1999.

WotC_Carole: Your new league store got it wrong. Have them call the League administration. You don’t have to start all over just because you moved.

Pokejoey: Thanks for your help.

Jester9779: On Dark Raichu if you flip tails will the attack still do 30 damage? And just for fun: what is your opinion on Digimon and the cards?

Teeuwynn: I don’t have that card with me, Jester. Do you know the exact attack text? I don’t remember the exact attack text, so I don’t think I can answer that now. Sorry, Jester! As for Digimon . . . . It’s got cute little monsters. I don’t personally think the game’s great, but that’s just my opinion.

Guest27: Will there be another TCG after all of the current 8 badges are earned? Will you also be able to get 10 additional points for a full Team Rocket set in the current books?

WotC_Carole: We’re designing the second year of the League now. There will be plenty of new badges to earn.

Guest27: Excellent and thanks for all the help tonight

Teeuwynn: You’re welcome, Guest

Pokefan12345: Will you still print new sets of Pokémon cards even if there are no more new sets coming out in Japan? (I just want to know because I love the card game, and I hope it’ll keep getting new cards and becoming more complex.)

WotC_Carole: The original game is designed in Japan. If we don’t print the Japanese cards . . . we don’t have anything to print

Teeuwynn: We can’t do original cards ourselves. We’re not allowed to in our license.

Koribouros: Thanks for taking the time to drop in and answer questions, Tee, Carole. And thanks also to the WizOs!

Teeuwynn: Thanks a lot for coming to the Team Rocket chat everyone.

Dark_Kadabra: Thanks

WotC_Carole: Nice to meet you all

WizO_Durst: Aye, kudos to Carole and Tee for their time, and kudos to everyone else for following protocols.

Pokefan12345: Dark Raichu is an original card!

Koribouros: I think they mean as in whole new sets of cards, Fan.

Teeuwynn: Dark Raichu was a special case, right Carole?

WotC_Carole: Dark Raichu was a very special case

Teeuwynn: Good catch, though, Pokefan!

WotC_Carole: You’re gonna love Evee! It’s a beauty!

WOTC_Mel: Thanks Tee, Carole. Pika! Pika! everyone!

Teeuwynn: Everyone loves Eevee!!!

Pokefan12345: Promo Eevee was released in Japan

Teeuwynn: Thanks for having us!

WizO_Durst: Thanks for stopping by everyone. The next Pokémon chat is May 18th. Check the chat schedule for times.

Teeuwynn: You’re most welcome! Bye everyone!

Thurs. May 18, 2000 - Weekly Pokemon TCG Q&A

Pokémon Online Help
Offered every Thursday 2-5 PST in the TCG Forum of the Wizards.Community chat site!
Featuring Master_Trainer from Customer Service

Thurs. May 18, 2000

Hello again friends. Mike here for the weekly Pokémon chat. Pat is at a meeting and will join us in an hour or so. But first some MAJOR rules announcements. After R&D talked with Creatures Inc. in Japan last week, some rules changes (or corrections) that we need to pass on to you. First, for Ditto. R&D has reversed their ruling on Ditto Transforming into Mysterious Fossil or Clefairy Doll. When Ditto as-one-of-these-Trainer-cards is Knocked out the attacking player does NOT get to take a prize card. Many of you initially figured this out and R&D ruled differently. Well now, they are ruling it as you thought. Since Ditto is copying the Mysterious Fossil, it copies EVERTHING from it, including the text that says when it is knocked out the other player does NOT draw Prize.

Now for Devolution Spray. Devolving a Pokémon DOES count as evolving it (again, a reversal on a previous ruling). This means that if you use Devolution Spray on one of your Pokémon you CANNOT evolve it again on that same turn. Sorry if these rule changes are confusing. It just shows again, how nothing is set in stone when it comes to Pokémon. And lastly I would like to thank the two people who have sent in Weedle cards for the Space Weedle so far.

A big thank you to Evil Bob and to Koribouros for sending me a Weedle card for the upcoming Space Weedle. Thanks guys! So if you TOO want to be a part of Space Weedle history, please send your extra Weedle cards to Master Trainer Mike c/o Wizards of the Coast PO Box 707 Renton, WA 98057. Please sign the front of the Weedle card and when we get enough we will build the Space Weedle and get pictures of it up on the web for you. If we get enough cards in time you may also see it at the Super Trainer Showdown and other events in the future as well.

Lastly, Boss Mike and I will be gone for the next few weeks to Europe to help them with their Pokémon issues. Master Trainer Pat and some guest trainers will cover the chat for the next few weeks. Behave yourselves while I’m gone, ok? Ok, so here we go!

  1. What comes first weakness or resistance when you attack?
    You calculate Weakness first, and then Resistance.

  2. What will the gym sets be called?
    Sorry but we can’t comment on cards that we have not released.

  3. If I use Charizard’s Energy Burn Pokémon Power and turn a water energy into a fire energy, can I use TR Charmander’s power to move that energy onto it?
    Sure!

  4. On Computer Error, can you draw 0 cards? Also, do you declare how many you are drawing, then draw, or can you stop before 5?
    Nope you must declare from 1 to 5 cards, and then draw that many.

  5. Is there a Dark Persian promo?
    Not yet, there will be one out through Nintendo Power, I believe in August.

  6. Anymore info on the Gym sets?
    1st set will be out in August 2nd set in October.

  7. Any more information on promo Eevee?
    Comes out Season 7 of the Pokémon League, must be are like the Foil Mew was.

  8. If you knock out a Dark Gyarados, with an attack that can paralyze, does Final Beam stop working because Dark Gyarados is paralyzed as he goes to the discard pile?
    Nope! I answered this one last week. The damage is calculated first, which immediately knocks out Dark Gyarados. Appropriate Pokémon Powers are done BEFORE attack effects are done.

  9. Who is the artist for promo Eevee?
    Kagemaru Himeno

  10. Will cool Porygon be in the league?
    We are looking into making it available through the League later on.

  11. If your Clefairy/Clefable is facing a Dark Charizard, and you Metronome Continuous Fireball, I assume that you would actually have to have Fire Energy attached in order to do a coin flip. Do you need 2 Energy (Dark Charizard requires 2, but Clefable only needs 1 to use Metronome) or can you do the attack with only 1? Do you have to discard the Fire Energy if you get heads and do damage to your opponent?
    Correct you would need fire energy for the effect of the attack (like Moltres’s Wyldfire). You could do the attack with just one fire energy though as per Metrome ignoring the Requirements of an attack. And yes, you would still have to discard energy for each heads flipped. This is NOT a requirement but an effect of the attack so Metronome does NOT ignore it.

  12. Pat what is your favorite Pokémon as a Pokémon? Why do I have a feeling? Since y’all are so weird (no offense) that you’ll probably say Psyduck or Caterpie?
    Pat is at a meeting and will be back in an hour or so. He has said many times though that he really digs Scyther and Hitmonchan.

  13. Will cool Porygon be released in the Pokémon league as number 15?
    Probably.

  14. Are French and German cards cheaper to get at wholesale because of unsold overstock?
    Not that I know of.

  15. I’m not sure if you can answer this, but if promo Eevee evolves, can you use it’s power to evolve it to a different evolution?
    Good questions, I will check R&D to verify but I would imagine that that would not work. Since Eevee would already be another Pokémon (it evolved) and the power states that you attach the pulled evolution card to Eevee that is no longer in play.

  16. If you use Gust of Wind Trainer (or Pidgey’s attack) and the opponent has no benched Pokémon, what is the result?
    Nothing.

  17. Any new changes with the Pokémon Errata decision?
    You know as much as I do.

  18. Will there be a dark Persian promo accessible through Nintendo power?
    Yup.

  19. When you flip tails with dark Raichu for the first time, do you still do the damage?
    Sure!

  20. Is it true that you can’t evolve a dark stage 2 from a dark stage one?
    That is not true, that is how it works.

  21. Can you tell us if Imakuni?s Doduo or ___s Chansey will be in Gym 2 and super rare and uncommon or do you think they will be released as promos?
    Nope, sorry I can’t.

  22. Any news on upcoming extra cards in sets?
    Sorry but we can’t comment on cards that we have not released.

  23. If you lay a DCE on Charizard, will the DCE turn into 2 fire energies or 1 fire energy?
    If you use Energy Burn, it would count as 2 Fire energy.

  24. Regarding Dark Wartortle, when a Pokémon like Kangaskahn does 80 damage to Dark Wartortle while it used Reflecting Shell attack, will Dark Wartortle do 80 damage back or only 60 since that is it’s max HP?
    It would do 80. It copies the amount of damage done, not damage taken.

  25. If our league has not received Computer Error, whom can the gym leader contact to find out more information?
    Depends on which league location. They should contact whom ever orders their supplies. For chain stores like Toys-R-Us it’s usually their DM’s. For individual stores, they would call our Merchant Relations department.

  26. With Charizard’s attack, it says discard 2 energy CARDS! So if you had 2 double colorless, and you used energy burn, you’d have to discard them both, right (both double colorlessness)?
    Key-wreckt.

  27. What is computer error?
    Season 6’s promo card (#16) that you can earn in the League.

  28. When do the seasons start?
    Season 6 should have started last weekend (roughly).

  29. My Gym leader says he has Dark Persian Promo #17 in fact he might bring it in on Monday for me to see. Do you know how he could have got it?
    Yes.

  30. IS it true that Cool Porygon will be giveaway at the TCG league soon?
    We are looking into this possibility yes.

  31. Any new info on Pokémon League 2?
    Nope, not yet, sorry.

  32. Please make sure everyone here knows that if a Mr. Mime got paralyzed, his power would still be off until his next turn BEGINS, therefor an opponents Pokémon would be able to do 30 more damage.
    That is right.

  33. What is Dark Raichu because I got one in a pack?
    That is the extra super secret card we included in Team Rocket.

  34. Do you have the picture for holo Eevee?
    Why yes I do.

  35. What about Jigglypuff I missed out on her the last time and she is what I am missing to complete the promo set?
    That was through Atlantic Records. It is a finished promotion here in the states. I hear it is still going on in the UK though.

  36. Any new info on the talks for NEO?
    Unfortunately, no.

  37. Will there be any more promo cards in the NP magazine subscription?
    That’s a good possibility.

  38. Do you guys ever tell league locations these rulings?
    We do our best to get the info out. It is also up to you as Pokémon players to inform them too. We do have a newsletter we send out every month to them.

  39. Will you be using Japanese Weedle cards on the Space Weedle?
    If they are sent to me, sure!

  40. Whats the address for Weedles?
    Master Trainer Mike c/o Wizards of the Coast PO Box 707 Renton, WA 98057. Make sure you sign your Weedles that you send so the world will know you are a part of the Space Weedle.

  41. Any chance for the nice plastic flips coins that were in the Japanese starter decks and Gym Leader decks to be released in the US? The paper coins trebly don’t cut it.
    We’ve passed that concern along. I know they are looking into all sorts of possibilities.

  42. Is there any talk of bring vending promos to the US?
    Possibly.

  43. Your active is confused, and your opponent attacks with Smokescreen. Then you try to attack. Rulebook says Smokescreen flip is done before Confusion flip. So if Smokescreen flip is tails, is Confusion flip still done?
    Yes it is.

  44. My friend tells me Team Rocket has been shipped to the UK, is that true?
    Not by us.

  45. Could you post the exact odds of getting a SPECIFIC holographic card for each set?
    Well, it’s easy. Figure how many rare holo cards are in a set and multiply that by 3 (since the odds of getting any holo are 1 in 3 in a pack). So base set had 16 holos, so the odds of getting a particular one (like Blastoise) is 1 in 48.

  46. When you use computer error is your opponent still able to attack?
    On his turn, sure.

  47. In the league, can you get more than the two holo Mews? In other words 2 of the stickers for Mew?
    Nope, 2 max per person.

  48. Is it possible to lose your League at a store if it adopts the Japanese ruling of banning certain cards?
    Dunno, they would have to talk to our League folks on that one.

  49. Is it possible to evolve Eevee into Flareon, Jolteon, and Vaporeon in a game?
    The same Eevee? I suppose so if you devolve it or scoop it up enough times.

  50. Is there a promo dark Persian in the June issue of Nintendo power?
    Nope, August.

  51. With the new Devolution Spray ruling… can I evolve something and then devolve it on the same turn (for what little good that may do)?
    Nope, Devolving COUNTS as evolving. You can only evolve a particular Pokémon once per turn. So you CANNOT use Devolution Spray on a Pokémon you evolved this turn.

  52. In TR set does a stage 2 Dark Pokémon have to evolve from a dark Pokémon or can I put it on a plain one.
    It has top evolve from a Dark Stage 1 Pokémon (unless you use Breeder of course).

  53. What will be the next American excessive cards? And for fun, what do you think of digimon and the card game?
    Dunno about next exclusives sorry. As for Digimon, I hear that silly Digimon song too many times during the show.

  54. Has WOTC planed on making any more American only cards?
    There are possibilities.

  55. Is it true that you can’t evolve a Dark stage 2 card from a regular stage 1 card?
    Right.

  56. Where can you go to find a list of all the promos?
    I am pushing for them to put one on our web site. TopDeck has lists form time to time as well.

  57. Is it possible to earn all 8 badges as of now?
    Nope, its up to Season 6 so at most you can have earned the first 6 badges.

  58. Will there be any special reward for some one who gets all 8 badges at the end of the League?
    Maybe

  59. Has WOTC officially gained the rights to neo?
    Nope, not yet.

  60. Have prizes for the Super Trainer Showdown been finalized yet? Can we expect some cool/rare promos for it and/or some Gym 1 (Heroes… Blah) boosters?
    Sorry but it is still being worked out.

  61. Wait a sec – Mr. Mime gets paralyzed, but he’d unparalyze before the attacker could attack a second time – so they couldn’t hit him while the power is off!
    Yeah! That’s right! Darn that Mike and his wrong answers! Let’s get him!

  62. About the Dark Persian being #17 and the Gym Leader bringing it, what was the answer?
    Well, we would love to hear how someone got a card that hasn’t been released yet.

  63. Wouldn’t it be cheating to include 4 comp? Errors, 4 item finders, 4 comp. Searches, and 4 gamblers in a deck? Because you could deck the other person’s deck by just doing comp. Error for 4 turns, then doing item finders to find those 4 and do it again, and then gamble all the cards back into your deck. Wouldn’t that be cheating?
    Nope, not cheating, just another way to try and win.

  64. How can I find tournaments around me?
    Check out our tournament locator on our web site.

  65. Well I know you and Da’ Boss will be in Europe this weekend, but will MT Pat be hitting the Boise Ball Tour?
    Sorry but no, he needs to hold down the Poke Fort for us while we are gone.

  66. Where can I get that news letter?
    It is only sent to League locations.

  67. Is it possible to play six types of energy in one deck and win?
    Well it is possible but I might have some swamp land in Florida to sell you too.

  68. If we have four Mews in a deck can we have four Japanese counterparts like Myuu?
    Nope. 4 of the same name only max.

  69. Would you take an Action flip Weedle, and what is a good amount of Weedles to send?
    Hmmm, action flips Weedles. Sure why not! Send whatever you’d like, all is appreciated.

  70. In the league, are Japanese cards allowed without having English translations? At a WOTC league (my first visit at this location) they allowed Pinsir & Zubat in this boy’s deck. Pinsir’s HP was different than the English version, so it was not the s?
    No. The rule is you MUST have an English translation of that specific card there to use any Japanese cards.

  71. If we never received our Movie promos from ticket stubs that were sent off who can we call to get them?
    Warner Brothers did that one. Call them at 1-800-824-9588 and leave a message at the end of their recording.

  72. Is Dark Dugtrio’s Pokémon Power, Sinkhole, cumulative or not? (I like the idea of having a chance of doing 80 damage when my opponent retreats.)"
    They are cumulative.

  73. Please tell me what R&D is. Ive heard the term before but don’t know what it means.
    R&D is Research and Development (not Raichus & Digletts if that is what you were thinking!)

  74. If I use devolution spray do I remove damage?
    Nope.

  75. How will the Promo Dark Persian be different from the regular Dark Persian?
    Sorry but we can’t comment on cards that we have not released.

  76. We had a discussion recently on “card memory.” Specifically, does Ditto “reset” itself when it retreats to the bench? For example, if he was opposite a Gengar, could Ditto use Curse while Active, retreat to the Bench somehow (thereby “resetting” himself?), then come back up again and Curse once more? I’d say no, but I figured it better to ask just in case.
    Well, Ditto turns into a new Gengar in this case. He has no memory of being one before and so you could use the Curse again.

  77. I just wanted to compliment Wizards on the STS. Despite some rather shaky reports from the initial stop, everything I’ve been hearing since then has been very complimentary. However, EVERYBODY seems to be raving about these darned hats you get for making it to the fourth round! What’s up with those? I haven’t seen them yet – are they plated in gold, or something?
    Well, thank you. They are nice hats (though I have such a big melon on my shoulders that mine barely fits). I don’t think they are made of gold though.

  78. What happened to the release of the Pokémon damage counter dice? I haven’t seen them yet.
    Last I heard, Creatures Inc. put the kibosh on them.

  79. What are promos 11 and 17?
    11 are the foil Eevee and 17 will be the upcoming Dark Persian.

  80. What is the super trainer showdown?
    A premiere event taking place in LA on July 22nd on the Queen Mary. We are having qualifying tournaments on the Mall Tour. You can also be a part of it as long as you have earned at least 3 badges through the Pokémon League.

  81. Will Pokémon have a national tournament like Magic?
    Not quite the same way no, but the Super Trainer Showdown is a premiere event. We are working on setting up one for the East Coast later this year too.

  82. In Japan, the level 7 Eevee was a Neo designed card will the US card have a different card design than normal as well?
    Sorry but I really don’t know.

  83. With computer Error card does your opponent *have to* draw 5 cards when you play it?
