  84. What address do I email to if I need my ratings and rankings changed?
    webmaster@wizards.com

  85. Is there a minimum requirement of how many basic Pokémon must be in your deck? Also, questions about Clefairy doll. What happens if your hand only includes Clefairy Doll (no basic Pokémon)? Do I have the option of playing him face down? Must I play him?
    There is no minimum but Clefairy Doll does NOT count as a basic Pokémon in your hand (it is a trainer card). If you don’t have another basic Pokémon then you MUST mulligan.

  86. Any chance for a special contest where the winner designs a Pokémon promo (within reasonable limits, of course)?
    I will pass that suggestion along.

  87. Are you SURE about the “new Gengar” thing? Because if that’s the case, there may very well be some really broken combos out there that could be done with Ditto being able to swap in and out for free (say, with Dodrio on the Bench). Theoretically, that would allow you to use any Opponent’s “once per turn” Power and infinite number of times.
    Sure as long as you could continually retreat Ditto. It does seem sort of broken doesn’t it? I will talk with R&D on this one. I guess I would be careful playing Gengar now huh?

  88. Who are Creatures, Inc (besides the company that put the kibosh on the dice)?
    They are the company that created the Pokémon card game in Japan.

  89. Does Creatures, Inc have a web site? I found Game Freak’s. And what about Media Factory?
    Not that I know of, sorry.

  90. Will there ever be a Pokémon card with a blank area for kids to draw their own picture of the character?
    No plans to do so at this time, though I will suggest something similar to that.

  91. Could there be more than one on each coast so people don’t have to travel so far?
    We’re still looking at setting those up, for the East Coast. We’ll see.

  92. Question regarding the “devolution” rule. Does this mean also when you are devolved by Mew that you can not re evolve immediately?
    Yes. Although that question is kinda moot because if you use Mew’s attack to do that you wouldn’t be able to evolve anyway. And if you devolved your opponent’s Pokémon they could still re-evolve it on their turn.

  93. Where can I send in my resume to become a master trainer or an R&D person?
    Check the 'Career Opportunities" link on the Wizards homepage.

  94. Regarding Confusion & Smokescreen (#57). Smokescreen says “If tails, that attack does nothing.” So why could the Confusion flip be necessary?
    Because that attack may result with something that would not be prevented by Smokescreen, like discarding energy cards.

  95. Since the mulligan rule says you can draw up to 2 cards on a mulligan, and you can draw 0 cards; can’t you draw 0 cards on Computer Error?
    Yea, I suppose. Why?

Guest 8 your question was so long that I just dumped it. I will pass along your concerns.

  1. Is the tour going to stop by Houston?
    Sorry, don’t know the new locations yet.

  2. When you listed the unnumbered promos you missed Poke tour Pikachu?
    Correct! I don’t even have one of those. Look! Another Pikachu promo!

  3. Is there plan for a promo Blastoise card?
    No, although I’d love to see one link the one that was released for the Japanese CD soundtrack.

  4. Can you please explain the different ways of getting to the STS in LA?
    Sure, win a qualifying event at the mall tour, be one of the top 10 DCI ranked Pokémon players in the world, or earn 3 or more badges through the Pokémon league.

  5. Do you have any new dates for us? (Like for when gym comes out?)
    Gym 1 in August, Gym 2 in October.

  6. Will there be a contest to see who can make the best trainer card?
    Not that I know of.

  7. What will be the reward for playing and winning (fingers crossed) in the STS in LA (besides of course bragging rights)? Will this tournament and qualifiers be DCI rated?
    The qualifiers are not DCI sanctioned since we wanted to be able to get the most number of people through so everyone can try. If it was sanctioned it would take a lot more time registering people and signing up people for the DCI. I don’t know if the STS will be sanctioned or not.

  8. I don’t quite understand it when you said if you were de-evolved by mew you couldn’t evolve straight away. The turn would be over; there is no way you could evolve right away anyway?
    Right! That’s what I said. Right that’s what I said in my follow up.

  9. Will there be any more Pokémon that know Metranome?
    Don’t know yet.

  10. What will happen if two person use Ditto as their active Pokémon at the same time?
    Not a darned thing.

  11. How do you get 10 points in the tcg league for having the complete team rocket set?
    Show the league leader and they will stamp your book.

  12. What I know what Blastoise’s power does but I think I am using it incorrectly, how do I use the power correctly?
    Raindance allows you to play Water Energy from your hand on any one of your Water Pokémon. One energy at a time, but as many as you want per turn.

  13. I heard that gym 1 and 2 would be released in a different format than in Japan, can you say what the difference is or don’t you know yet?
    The Gym Sets were released as 4 sets in Japan; we’re combining them into 2 sets.

  14. What is the league consensus on penalizing cheating?
    It all depends on the circumstances. If it were deliberate and continual then the League would have the right to ask someone to not come for a week in order to show them the severity of what they are doing.
    But it really does come down to the situation.

  15. Is Wizards working on new theme decks, booster packs and ideas… you know your last one was Team Rocket, do you have any new ideas other than promos coming out soon?
    Next sets are the Gym sets.

  16. Can I play an original Stage 2 card on a dark card? (Example: Machamp on Dark Machamp)?
    No, only Dark evolutions on Dark cards.

  17. Will you please get the rulebook and read what it says about parlays? I remember seeing that it didn’t say after your next turn", but something like “Until the end of your opponents next turn”
    We did read it. You are misinterpreting it. I paralyze you Pokémon on MY TURN. On YOUR TURN its paralyzed, and at the end of YOUR turn it is UNPARALYZED. Back on MY TURN, it is NOT PARALYZED, comprendez?

  18. I signed up to become a member and lost my password! It wasn’t even sent to me (pikae3@yahoo.com)
    Write to community@wizards.com about this.

  19. What happens when all seasons are over? What will happen to the Pokémon Leagues?
    There are future events being planned.

  20. If I have 2 Dark Dugtrios in play, if my opponent retreats, does that mean he takes 40 damage?
    It means he flips 2 coins, his retreating Pokémon takes 20 damage for each tails he flips.

  21. I say some cards that have an attack like Kangaskhan’s fetch or Moltres’s wildfire should be a Power that you can only do once a turn… why did you have to make them an attack?
    We translated them as they were originally made in Japan.

  22. If I have a Ditto active and my opponents Pokémon is either KOed or retreats, does Ditto revert back to itself or does it automatically change to the new Pokémon?
    Unless your Ditto is paralyzed, confused, or asleep, it would automatically transform into the new active Pokémon its facing.

  23. I have been in the tcg league since August but have not been able to access my personal web page on the wizard website. MESSAGE “DCI number invalid” My sister has gotten to hers, but there are no results posted?
    I know they are having trouble updating so many thousands of pages. If your DCI card wasn’t COMPLETELY filled out they haven’t been entering them. Also if your league location doesn’t send in the correct paperwork each week, it also doesn’t get updated.

  24. What is different about this Nintendo power Persian than the ones previously released?
    It’s different in many ways…I can’t be more specific right now.

  25. What did you mean when I asked about what Rain Dance does? I was thinking more like the lines of this… “How many energies can you play on Blastoise a turn?”
    You can use the power as often as you want before you attack on your turn. So you could attach as much water energy to water Pokémon as you have in your hand in one turn if you want.

  26. Why does team rocket have Pokémon that are good I thought team rocket could not win and why is there Pokémon weaker?
    They aren’t necessarily good, they just aren’t Dark. There are no Dark Basic Pokémon. Dark Pokémon have less hit points (in most cases) but some of them have pretty cool attacks and powers.

  27. I don’t want to get in trouble now or in the future so can you folks check my website at the address travel.to/pikachu and if it violates any copyright rules, tell me to take it down?
    You should be sure to check out the ‘contact info’ section of our website for legal info like that.

  28. Why does the Pokémon TCG have no good trainers I beat them all!
    What did they ever do to you to deserve such disrespect?

  29. If you flip tails on Sinkhole and it does 20 damage to your Pokémon, does your Pokémon still retreat?
    Sure.

  30. Can I evolve my Kadbra to Dark Kadabra?
    Nope.

    We don’t see but our moderators keep an eye on it.

  34. Is jungle and base officially out of print?

  35. TR Charmander and its Pokémon power. Can I use a benched Pokémon Charmander’s energy to the active Charmander and move another fire energy from a different Pokémon on my bench for the active Pokémon 's power in the same turn?
    Nope, TR Charmander’s power can only move 1 fire energy to ITSELF (not to another Charmander).

  36. How does it work to earn the holo mew in the tcg league? It seems that different stores have different rules
    You have to earn 250 and then 500 points. You earn points as normal in the league.

    Chansey would be returned to your hand. When you play him again he’ll have the full 120 HP.

    We don’t want to, but Nintendo owns the license so they ultimately decide.

  39. I say WOTC should change the rules to how ever many cards in a deck is 60, individual of 4 should stay, but any how can u boost it up to 70 cards? I need to add important cards in my deck and cant take any others out?
    Tough, you’ll have to cut some out of your deck.

  40. Do you know how the online store is able to sell 1st edition team rocket packs again?

  41. Is Super Energy Removal *ever* going to be banned?

  42. Can we buy by the box directly from wizards? I see the packs, but I’m looking for boxes.

  43. If I can attack (I have an active Pokémon with enough energy card) but I don’t want to attack, can I pass the turn or I must attack?

  45. How many DCEs (Double Colorless Energies) can you have in a deck?
    Just 4

  46. Plans for English Promos to be released in other places only besides America?
    Sure!

  47. What if I don’t wanna use Aerodactyle’s power huh?
    You don’t have a choice, if Aerodactyl is in play and its power is active, it’s active.

  48. If your opponents Muk is confused, and your Ditto transforms into a Muk, if it also copies Toxic Gas, does that mean ditto’s transform will be canceled and it will transform back to ditto?

    It will be different from when it was released in Japan, if that’s what you’re asking.

  54. Could you put a page on your site for released Promo Cards; I haven’t been able to find one yet (please, please, please)?

  55. How do you get 10 points for a complete set of team rocket in the tcg league (where is it recorded?

    umm 7

    26

    Sorry but it is Vileplume.

Thanks gang. See you in a few weeks! Later trainers.

Thurs. May 25, 2000 - Weekly Pokemon TCG Q&A

Pokémon Online Help
Offered every Thursday 2-5 PST in the TCG Forum of the Wizards.Community chat site!
Featuring Master_Trainer from Customer Service

Thurs. May 25, 2000

Hi Gang! Not much new to announce this week; MT Mike is in Europe on some Poke-business (the lengths we go for Pokémon!) so I’ll be getting some help from MT Galen, who created the infamous Mr. Yuk deck.

  1. You say you don’t care about errata but you know kids know lots about ditto and you think they understand a simple You play dark Vileplum with weakness to fire but what if you printed imposter professor oak but is said draw 70 cards that’s not fair game?
    I’m going to assume this question is in some way commenting on our decision to stay away from official errata. It’s not that I don’t think players can handle it. It’s just that, that is what our decision is at this point. If there are other cards that get misprinted at a later date, we’ll take a look at the issue again.

  2. If you have out Clefairy and opponent Moltres can you use wildfire and discard their whole deck?
    Not unless you can discard enough fire energy from Clefairy. You need to do so, because that ability of Moltres is an option.

  3. A couple weeks ago, you said that if Clefairy or Clefable Metronomed Rapid Evolution, that you could evolve Clefairy/Clefable into Gyrados or Dark Gyrados. What if Ditto uses Rapid Evolution? Would Ditto evolve into Gyrados/Dark Gyrados?
    No, unfortunately, Ditto actually says on it: Ditto can’t evolve.

  4. Can you get into the Super trainer Showdown by earning 3 badges because someone told me that?
    Yes, you can.

  5. If you use dark Alakazam’s teleport blast do you have a choice to switch? Remember it says: you MAY switch?
    Yes, you do.

  6. Is there any new info on the Gym Sets?
    You know that the first one is coming out sometime around August.

  7. Can I use a copy of a card instead of the card itself?
    This is usually called a proxy. This is not legal for tournament play, but you’re welcome to do this in informal play if you want.

  8. Is there anymore info on Dark Persian promo?
    Other than what I’ve heard from you guys? No, sorry.

  9. What are the promos gonna be for pkmn2k?
    Sorry but we can’t comment on cards that we have not released.

  10. If I used Swords Dance with Scyther and it got knocked out or benched on my opponents turn, if I have another one will it do 60 damage with slash?
    No, Swords Dance is referring to _that_ Scyther; if he retreats or is knocked out, no double Slash attack.

  11. Do you plan to make the special Game Boy cards in the Pokémon tcg Game Boy real?
    No plans to, no.

  12. When is holo Eevee coming out?
    Holo Eevee should be available during season #7 of the Pokémon Leagues.

  13. Which cards are best in an ALL-Team Rocket tournament?
    Hmm, I would still say that Dark Vileplume and Rocket’s Sneak Attack are two of my favorites.

  14. Is the MR Yuk deck way too weak to psychic?
    I’ll let Galen answer that one. [Galen] Which Mr. Yuk are you speaking of, the one I made, or the one Boss Mike altered? Mr. Yuk is most weak to fire…it would hold it’s own against a psychic I think.

  15. Do you have a final ruling on ditto’s “card memory”?
    You mean like when Ditto’s copying a Clefairy Doll and gets knocked out? If so, in that situation the player who knocked out the Ditto would _not_ draw a prize card.

  16. Energy that have been Burned by Charizard’s Pokémon Power are considered to be Fire Energy until the end of the turn. Once burned, do they still stay that way until the end of the turn if they are removed from Charizard (say, by TR Charmander’s Gather Fire PP)?
    Well, I believe that would be possible, but I’ll check on that one.

  17. Are the game boy cards ever going to be real cards?
    No I am afraid not.

  18. Similarly, with regard to Energy Burn, if you accidentally put Charizard to Sleep (say, as a result of a failed Long Distance Hypnosis coin flip), do the Energy Burned Energies revert to their original types, or do they still remains Fire Energy until the end of the turn?
    They would remain Fire Energy until the end of the turn.

  19. For clarification from last week: with Computer Error, is it correct that you have to state how many cards you are going to draw before doing so, and also, that you may draw 0 cards if you wish?
    I don’t think that’s a rule, but it’s certainly the polite way to play.

  20. Or, to make it even clearer for those confused with the entire Devo Beam, Devo Spray, Rapid Evolution, Breeder, etc. Stuff out there: would it be correct to say that, simply, you may change the “evolution level” (Basic, Stage 1, or Stage 2) of any particular Pokémon only ONCE per turn, regardless of the method used?
    That sounds reasonable, yes.

  21. Do you guys sell promos that can’t be gotten anymore on the net?
    Unfortunately we do not sell individual cards

  22. Just what is the line between “play it as it is” and “unplayable, let’s fix it”?
    That’s for R&D and the DCI to decide not us.

  23. Is there a second online TCG League Newsletter in the works yet?
    Yes, there is, though I don’t know when it will be sent out.

  24. Sorry that this was announced, but I completely forgot the release dates of Heroes (Gym 1) and Villains (Gym 2)?
    We are thinking that Gym one will be out around August. Gym 2 a few months after. Sorry I can’t be more specific.

  25. Why are there never any Pokémon tcg tournaments in Baltimore?
    I don’t know possibly a lack of people willing to organize a tournament?

  26. Is it true the reason of the reprinting of the Dark Persian Promo is because the first version had no HP on it?
    Sorry can’t comment on that one.

  27. But on Ditto, it says that it copies ALL text on the opposing card. So wouldn’t Ditto copy the line of text which says that you evolve it into Gyrados/Dark Gyrados?
    Ditto will still know it’s own card text though, and that says: Ditto can’t evolve.

  28. Will there be multiple Super Trainer Showdowns, or only the one in Los Angeles?
    We are hoping to have that one in LA…and perhaps later…one on the east coast…remember, this is all hypothetical.

  29. On Pokémon powers, do you need to say them every turn like an attack, or do you only say them once and they keep working until that Pokémon is unable to use it?
    You don’t absolutely need to say them, but it is proper game etiquette I think.

  30. Last week a question was asked about Ditto opposite Gengar, with Ditto repeatedly retreating, becoming active, and doing Curse multiple times on the same turn. You guys said you would check and see if that was OK. Is it?
    I just checked and they answered in the affirmative for now, but they reserve the right to change that answer later. How’s that for vague? I would go ahead and play it like that for now.

  31. How do you get a 1st edition promo card?
    Those are very difficult to find. Here’s why: The only 1st ed. promo I know about is the #1 promo Pikachu that was accidentally inserted into 1st ed. Jungle packs. So you would have had to get it out of a 1st ed. pack of Jungle.

  32. Who drew Dark Riachu? Was it a North American artist? How about the Eevee #11on ebay, who drew that?
    Both of those were done by Pocket Monster artists. I don’t happen to have my copies of those cards with me, otherwise I would tell you who did them.

  33. Will promos be available in the UK?
    I know that the promo Jigglypuff is, through the movie soundtrack. I don’t know the release schedule for any others in the UK.

  34. I have a first edition “Challenge!” card. On it, it appears that the copyright symbol is overlapping the illustrator’s name. Is this a misprint?
    Hmm, it looks close, though it’s not overlapping on mine. I would say it looks ok.

  35. Can I have four base set Charmanders and four-team rocket Charmanders in a deck?
    No, because they both have the name Charmander. You’re limited to only four of any particular card.

  36. What is to be done with the extra Jigglypuff promo #7 cards?
    What do you mean extra? Atlantic records gave those promos out (supposedly)

  37. If I attach a pluspower to a paralyzed Scyther, then use a switch, then make my Scyther the active again, will the plus power still be there?
    My question to you is why don’t you do that before you attach the plus power? Then you won’t have to worry about it?

  38. If TR Porygon converts Ditto’s weakness (say, to grass), then retreats and is replaced by a Scyther, is the Ditto still weak to grass?
    Yes.

  39. Will you provide air transport for the winners of all 9 tournaments at the STS qualifiers?
    I really don’t know what exactly will be provided for the winners of the trips.

  40. Why hasn’t WotC posted the 2nd edition of league news?
    I don’t know.

  41. What promo do you get with the soul badge?
    I believe that one is #16 Computer Error.

  42. When will Fossil and Team Rocket be out in the UK?
    I believe that Fossil should be out shortly, but I don’t know when the release date for TR is over there.

  43. Is there a Pokémon TCG league in the UK?
    You might try emailing the Wizards’ customer service at uk@wizards.com for that information

  44. Do you HAVE to have a basic Pokémon in your deck?
    Yup…otherwise you wouldn’t be able to start the game.

  45. Can you just play a card like Haunter, With out playing Gastly>?< because on the basic Haunter it doesn’t say Put Haunter on The Stage 1 Cards?
    No, you have to start with Gastly. No you cannot…the rule with that is that you cannot have more than 4 of the same kind of cards (excluding basic energy of course) with the same name, both Charmanders have the same name on the card. Therefore that would be like having 8 which is not allowed. It’s all in the name.

  46. How many promotion cards will there?
    We don’t know how many total there will be at this time.

  47. Suppose my active Pokémon is asleep. My opponent’s turn ends. I draw a card, then realize that I didn’t flip to see if I wake up. Can I still flip? Or did I forfeit the opportunity to flip because I drew a card first?
    Yes, you can still flip.

  48. Will you ever bring a huge league from Wizards Of the Coast To Green Bay Wisconsin?
    The league is already there…just check your local Toys R Us, Zany brainy, or Waldenbooks to see if they have one. If they do, sign up at one of those stores.

  49. Your opponent Mulligans and you draw 2 more cards, one of which is a basic Pokémon. Can you make that Pokémon your starting active Pokémon, or can you only start with one from the original 7 cards you were dealt?
    Since you haven’t laid down the cards yet for play…it is still technically part of your turn…so the answer is yes.

  50. How can I obtain a Prerealse Dark Gyarados can you send me one?
    You can check to see if your local league location still has those to give out. They were originally given out when TR came out.

  51. Do you have to be invited to play at any of the Super Trainer Showdowns (apart from LA) or can you just show up?
    You can just show up…but make sure you have obtained at least 3 badges.

  52. I know that in Japan, Here Comes the Rockets was really rare. Is it also rarer than other cards in America?
    No, in our set it’s no more rare than Dark Gyrados(holo).

  53. Can you evolve a base set Charizard on a Dark Charmelion?
    No you can’t…once you go to the dark evolutions, the next forward evolution must be the Dark Charizard.

  54. If I were building a deck, could I have 4 Dark _ and four-base/jungle/fossil __? I have been told both yes and no.
    Yes you could, my friend.

  55. Will Jigglypuff #7 cards be released through the league? the cards were poorly advertised and very few people knew about them.
    No.

  56. Say Ditto is copying an Abra, and I attach a pluspower to my Abra, then use Psyshock, then it becomes paralyzed, would the Ditto still be alive?
    If Ditto’s copying a Base Set Abra, he’ll be knocked out by that attack.

  57. If you attached a PlusPower to a Pokémon (for this, Scyther) and then Scoop Upped it (yes, a very dumb person), what would happen to the PlusPower?
    It goes to your discard pile.

  58. If I use Scyther’s swords dance and on my next turn I get paralyzed asleep or confuse but I full heal, will I be able to use the slash attack for 60?
    Yes.

  59. Why do the evolved rockets cards only say dark?
    They were trained by Team Rocket that’s why.

  60. The ed1 l16 Pikachu, was it randomly inserted as a common, uncommon, or rare?
    I don’t know, the person I traded for one, didn’t remember what slot it was in.

  61. If you have 2 Jungle Mankeys in play, can you use their Pokémon Powers (Peek) together, to look at the top 2 cards in your deck, or would they just let you look at the top card twice.
    You could only look at the top card twice.

  62. Referring to the Ditto on Porygon. If Ditto’s Weakness were changed to Grass, When Scyther gets bringed, Wouldn’t Ditto’s Weakness be changed into Fire?
    Nope, Ditto is still the active Pokémon and Conversion won’t end until the converted Pokémon is benched. We’ll double check on this one too, I understand that it’s kind of confusing.

  63. Can you have only 1 basic Pokémon in your deck?
    You could…but your opponents would have a field day with you unless you got a very lucky draw. Mulligans…bad…for you.

  64. If you made a Dark Raichu, Why isn’t there a Pikachu in Team rocket expansion>?
    Don’t know…it wasn’t in the original Japanese set so we didn’t print it…I think there are enough Pikachu’s in the previous sets.

  65. Can you retreat with a full bench?
    Yes, you’ll just exchange your active with a benched Pokémon.

  66. If your Mr.Mime is paralyzed then on your opponent’s turn can he knock it out with 40 damage, Or does it become unparalyzed and the Pokémon Power is back on?
    He would get knocked out because his Pokémon power is ineffective when Mr. Mime is paralyzed

  67. Is the Eevee going to be released via the Pokémon league?
    Yup, season 7.

  68. Are your coins weighted or something? They land on heads a lot more than tails?
    Not for me they don’t…gosh, I wish I had your luck?

  69. I’m planning on making a Haymaker Deck, What cards do you recommend I insert into my new deck?
    Here’s the basic Pokémon necessary for Haymaker decks: 4 Scythers, 4 Hitmochans. From there, trainers customize according to what other decks are popular in their area. I’ve used Jigglypuff/Wigglytuff before, but now I use Electabuzz and Pincer.

  70. Tournament question: I play an unsanctioned tourney every weekend, but I’d like to get ranked. Is there any way I can start a sanctioned tourney, or get a League location to start one?
    Sure, check out the DCI sanctioning section on our website for more info.

  71. Can Rocket Magikarp’s Rapid Evolution be used on the first turn it is put down, by placing 3 energy with Rain Dance?
    No, Rapid Evolution still counts as evolving, so you can’t do it the first turn you put down Magikarp.

  72. Will the Gym Leaders Set have the gym leaders picture on it in the US version?
    That is what I imagine will happen.

  73. How many English cards out so far including Promo’s?
    About 350, not including the duplicates in Base set 2

  74. Will there ever be any tours in Canada?
    Unsure of that one but I would certainly think so we haven’t forgotten about our good neighbors from the North.

  75. Will any of the Base and Jungle cards left out of Base Set 2 ever be reprinted?
    Many already have such as Porygon in the Team Rocket.

  76. Does Ditto’s HP stay the same or change to the defending Pokémon’s HP, and does resistance and weakness change?
    Weakness/resistance changes, so does the HP when Ditto becomes another Pokémon

  77. Does Ditto’s attack copy the effects like paralyzing, asleep etc?
    If the attack of the Pokémon he’s copying has those effects, so will Ditto.

  78. If you use a plus power then Prof. Oak, would the then ready to attack, would the plus Power still be there? Or, would you have to discard it if you attached it to you active, then professor Oaked, then attacked?
    If the active Pokémon that you attached Plus Power to is still your active after your Oak, it will still be in effect.

  79. If you go first, are you allowed to win the game before your opponent has a chance to have a turn?
    Yes I suppose so.

  80. In the TR Meowth, its attack says “don’t apply weakness and resistance for this attack”. Why put this text in when Meowth is a colorless Pokémon?
    It’s possible that a card that we expect to print in the future may effect the type of a Pokémon in play.

  81. In response to #137 – Mr. Mime would NOT be knocked Invisible Wall would be back on, since Mime is no longer paralyzed after its players turn!
    Yeah. You are right I think I misread the question my apologies.

  82. Does my serious Fossil still count as a basic Pokémon when in the discard pile?
    No.

  83. Can you retreat if your Pokémon is poisoned and asleep?
    You can’t retreat, but you can play switch.

  84. Will there be something after you get the earth badge and tms and the stickers and certified coach in league?
    I have been told that Wizards is working on something for people who have all the badges.

  85. Why not make an internet contest, to see who can make the best theme deck, and have the winner’s theme deck made?
    Possible, we’ll suggest something like that.

  86. What’s going to happen about Misty’s tears because some people say she is naked on that card?
    That will be interesting won’t it I seriously doubt she will look naked.

  87. My opponent plays a Challenge, and I accept. I place a Charmander on my bench. He ends turn. It is now my turn. Can I evolve Charmander into Charmeleon, or do I have to wait until my NEXT turn to evolve?
    You can evolve Charmander because he wasn’t played -that- turn.

  88. I’m trying to make a Wigglytuff deck and I need to know what Pokémon are good for backup. Can you help me?
    Anything, that allows you to get more Pokémon, on your bench.

  89. Can you evolve a dark Charmeleon into a Charizard?
    Nope.

  90. Any chance for Base Set 3?
    No.

  91. Will the fossil cards ever go out of print and/or will the foil be changed?
    Yes, but the foil will stay.

  92. When did you stop making first ed. team rocket boosters?
    3 days after we started printing it.

  93. What holographic cards are in the Team Rocket decks?
    Dark Weezing and Dark Arbok.

OK, if we didn’t get to your question, save it for next week or give us a call on the Pokémon hotline 1(800) 324-6496. We’ll check on those rulings for you by next week. So long, campers. See ya dudes next week!

scratchdesk June 26, 2017, 4:31pm 5

Thurs. June 1, 2000 - Weekly Pokemon TCG Q&A

Pokémon Online Help
Offered every Thursday 2-5 PST in the TCG Forum of the Wizards.Community chat site!
Featuring Master_Trainers from Customer Service

Thurs. June 1, 2000

Hey Trainers, it’s been a slow week as far as Poke-news is concerned. I just have some rulings from R&D for you from issues you asked about last week, so I’ll post those now and on the hour. Once again, MT Galen will be helping me out.

OK, here are all the rulings I double-checked on for you from last week.

Q: Can energy that has been changed to Fire energy with Charizard’s Energy Burn be moved by TR Charmander’s Gather Firepower?
A: Yes, energy changed in this way will be Fire energy till the end of the turn, you can use TR Charmander’s power to move this energy.

Q: If you attach a Plus Power to your active Pokémon and then retreat and then advance that Pokémon, will the Plus Power still be in effect?
A: Yes, it will.

Q: If you use TR Porygon’s Conversion 1 to change a Ditto’s(copying TR Porygon) weakness to Grass and then you retreat TR Porygon and advance a Scyther, will the converted weakness still be in effect on Ditto?
A: Yes, any effects of attacks on Ditto will remain.

Q: Can Ditto(copying a Gengar) repeatedly retreat and advance so that he can do Gengar’s Curse over and over?
A: Yes, every time Ditto advances and copies Gengar he can activate the Curse power.

On to the chat!

  1. If you didn’t win a tournament to enter the STS is there another way to get in besides the contest?
    Yes, if you have earned at least 3 Pokémon League badges you can get in.

  2. How do I get the Computer Error sticker?
    I know there’s a Computer Error promo card . . . does the sticker signify that you’ve earned it? Anyone?

  3. On Dark Golbat, when it says “Apply Weakness and Resistance”, well, at the end of the last sentence it has no space after the period, and before “Apply”. Why was that not on the misprint page?
    Is that the unlimited Dark Golbat? Because my Dark Golbat says “Don’t apply weakness and resistance.”

  4. Any chance for Base Set 3?
    There’s always a chance where Wizards is concerned but I have heard no such plans to do so.

  5. Will the holofoil on Fossil cards be changed?
    They’ll stay the same.

  6. Are the edition 1 cards on your website corrected from errors?
    Probably not…the misprints will probably be there.

  7. Are you going to make the vending sets?
    No news on that one yet, sorry.

  8. Will Fossil ever go out of print?
    Yes, eventually.

  9. Any more information on Cool Porygon in the league?
    No news on how that will be released, we just know that it will be available at some point.

  10. Any more info on the Gym Sets?
    Gym one is supposed to be released in August…that is about all we know.

  11. What will the Gym Sets be called?
    The first one will be called Gym Heroes, I don’t know about the second.

  12. If you use a plus power on an attack that does 0 damage, will it do 10 damage? Like for example, Kangaskhan’s fetch will it do 10 damage with a plus power?
    No, Plus Power will only add 10, if damage is done. Fetch doesn’t do damage.

  13. At the TCG Tour we were told that only people who qualified at the Tour could participate in the STS. However, on previous chats we were told if you had 3 or more badges you could participate. Which one is correct or are both correct?
    Both statements are correct actually. Earning 3 badges counts as qualifying.

  14. Last week it was ruled, that if Ditto is against a Pokémon that has a “once-per-turn” Pokémon Power. Say, Gengar – and Ditto rotates out to the bench and then back up, it can use that “once-per-turn” Pokémon Power a second time during the same turn (or more, if he continues to do so). If you used Gust of Wind to drop the opposing Gengar back to the opponent’s Bench, the then brought him back up again to the Active slot with another GoW, would Ditto now also be able to use that “once-per-turn” again?
    R&D has said that benching Ditto in this situation would allow you to use Curse again, so I would imagine that the inverse is true as well. If you send the opponent’s Gengar back to the bench and then move him back up when Ditto’s still active, you could do Curse again.

  15. If you have a Promo Eevee in play, and your opponent evolves up into an Aerodactly, how does that resolve? Since you can use Eevee’s Chain Reaction during your opponent’s turn if he evolves, can you use it “before” Aerodactyl’s Power goes into effect, or are you prevented from using Chain Reaction? Or, as I suspect, is it like Rapid Evolution in which Aerodactyl doesn’t enter into the equation since you’re not technically “playing” an evolution card?
    You’re not technically ‘playing’ and evolution card with Eevee’s Chain Reaction.

  16. Some attack text, such as Harden, Stiffen and Withdrawl, say that they prevent damage done on the opponent’s next turn, but do not reference, where the damage is coming from. Will these prove effective against things such as a failed coin flip from Digger, which does 10 damage to the losing Pokémon?
    So it means anything on the next turn of your opponent so yes it would prevent that damage.

  17. Last week, you said that Energy Burned Energies remain as such even if Charizard is put to Sleep that same turn (say, as the result of a failed Long Distance Hypnosis coin flip). However, looking back through some previous rulings, you said a month or two ago that if Charizard is paralyzed, etc. then the energies revert to their normal type. Which is correct?
    The energies will remain Fire energies until the end of the turn, even if Charizard is put to sleep. Certainly, some of our rulings may change as R&D corrects or reverses older rulings.

  18. Scenario: you have an Active Ditto with, say, 2 Fire, 2 Grass and 1 Water energy on him, and he is opposite a Dark Charizard. He could do Continuous Fireball and flip five times, since all energies attached to Ditto count as all types (including Fire). However, for each heads he gets, he has to discard a Fire Energy. So let’s say he gets three heads out of the five flips – does he have to discard the two Fire Energies first, and then one of the others, or can he discard the two Grass and 1 Water instead? Or do you state “which” energy card you are flipping for when you flip, and discard that specific one when and if it’s heads?
    Because Ditto’s energies count as any type when they are attached to him…you could choose which energies you discard by the amount of heads you flipped

  19. To show proof that you have 3 or more badges MT Pat told me in an e-mail to bring those badges and my DCI number. All of my family member’s DCI numbers are not in the system. One registered in Oct. 99, another in Jan. 2000 and I, on April 1st.
    I’ve been told by the person setting up the STS that trainers should bring their badges and DCI #, if you’re not in the system yet(as far as the DCI #'s are concerned) don’t worry about it.

  20. If you attach a plus power to Scyther and then retreat for Hitmonchan and do jab, will Hitmonchan do 30 instead of 20?
    Plus Power will stay attached to the Pokémon you put it on. It will not be in effect for the Hitmochan.

  21. Do you have a copy or know the formula used for computation of the best performing winners at the TCG Tour? Can this formula be posted somewhere?
    No we don’t, sorry.

  22. So if I understand your announcement correctly, Energy changed and then moved, remains changed for the rest of your turn?
    For the rest of that turn.

  23. You mentioned the ruling with Plus Power; would the same apply to other attached cards, such as Defender?
    The correct interpretation is that it is attached to the Pokémon you put it on not necessarily attached to the active slot per se. Sorry for the mistake guys I goofed.

  24. What are the movie promos?
    According to the Warner Bros. website the promos will be: Ancient Mew, Articuno, Zapdos and Moltres.

  25. Can Ditto change to any Mysterious Fossil or Clefairy doll. If so, is the ability copied?
    Ditto can copy either of those cards, but since Ditto can’t evolve, you won’t be able to use those cards to their full ability.

  26. Say, just a clarification for the record: ALL of Ditto’s abilities related to Transform are functional ONLY when he Active, including the “Rainbow” effect of attached energies, correct?
    As far as I know, yes.

  27. Concerning Rainbow Energy, the card states that when Rainbow Energy comes into play it deals 10 damage to the Pokémon it’s attached to. Does this 10 damage take place the one time it comes into play, or take place every turn?
    No you just take 10 damage when it comes from your hand and you put it on…it does no damage after words

  28. Will hard to get promos like cool Porygon & Jigglypuff be reissued at a later date?
    Cool Porygon I know will be released in some other way, but I don’t think this will be the case for Jigglypuff.

  29. Just for clarification - If I use Mew’s De-evolution beam on my turn against my opponents active Pokémon, can he re-evolve it on his turn? I don’t see why he can’t as his turn is a different turn than the turn I did de-evolution beam on.
    Yeah totally you could evolve him on your turn.

  30. If Dark Charizard is confused and tries to attack with Continuous Fireball, what is the exact procedure (assume the confusion flip is tails)?
    Flip a coin to see if the attack is successful due to confusion. If it’s tails, do 20 damage to D.Charizard.

  31. At the TCG Tour I came across some people who roll a die instead of flipping a coin for status effects. Is this legal in a DCI sanctioned event? I mean the card says to flip a coin, not roll a die. The die is OK actually just as long as it has someway of doing a 50/50 chance for heads or tails you would need to somehow designate which numbers represent heads and which ones represent tails.

  32. Is Digger’s damage considered an “attack”? (If Haunter is damaged by Digger, does Haunter’s Transparency require another flip? Will Defender protect against damage caused by Digger?)
    No.

  33. Can you tell me anything about availability of promo #11?
    Not yet only that it is going to be in the league next season (season #7).

  34. Concerning Clefable’s Metronome, can I metronome Dark Charmeleon’s Fireball attack when I have energy other than Fire on Clefable?
    No.

  35. What other ideas do you have for use for extra common cards not needed?
    Maybe decorate your car with them. Give them to charity. You see Pat is the good guy

  36. What is a good number of Gyarados’s to have in a deck?
    I would say 2 or 3 personally.

  37. My Toys 'R Us I go to in Durham, NC, just gives away the promo cards (I’ve gotten about 6 prerelease Gyarados, 3 Arcanine, 3 holo mew, and 25 non-holo Mew). Is that legal?
    Sure, but now everyone knows where you get your promos!

  38. The Pokémon DCI ratings have not been updated in over 6 weeks. When will they be updated?
    Dunno, try e-mailing the DCI@wizards.com

  39. Can you put more than 5 Pokémon on your bench by using the Challenge! card since it clearly says you can pick any amount of Pokémon?
    No because you only have five spaces on your bench.

  40. Pojo.com has a rumor that Dark Raichu had the error corrected, has it been fixed?
    Not that we know of.

  41. Can the Gym Leaders request more copies of the forms for Brock’s and Misty’s Challenge?
    I don’t see why not. Have them call our merchant services department at 1-800-821-8028.

  42. The Dark Golbat has no space after the period. It says “Dark Golbat does 10 damage to that Pokémon. Apply Weakness and Resistance.” See no space after the period, before “apply”?
    Gotcha, it must be on the unlimited version. I don’t know how they’ll rule on that one. Dang it, you gave me homework again!

  43. Why are you not allowed to tell us about the movie promos when Wizards already advertised them?
    Simple answer: we didn’t advertise them, WB did. We just weren’t told that WB made the info available that’s all.

  44. Concerning Clefable’s Metronome once again this time in relation to Hydro Pump (or similar attacks), since the initial energy is considering to cover the costs for the attack, if I have 2 Water Energies in excess of that first energy, will the Hydro P?
    Hydro pump specifies what kind of energy (water) you need to do excess damage so you would have to put extra (water) energy on Clefable in order to do more damage.

  45. What Rocket misprints have been corrected?
    I don’t know of any that have yet, though I know that the correction process has been started for a few cards.

  46. How do we get the promo 11 Eevee?
    Eevee will be available through the league during season number 7.

  47. When will we be able to get Eevee in the Pokémon league?
    Season 7

  48. If you make a first edition booster pack why don’t you make a first edition Theme Deck?
    All the Theme Decks are pre-constructed. They are geared more towards the game-player rather than the collector.

  49. Does smokescreen carry over if the person retreats or dies on that turn? For example, If fossil Magmar kills Oddish and the opponent brings up Gloom, does the opponents still have to flip?
    Smokescreen goes away, when the Pokémon affected retreats or dies or evolves so the upcoming gloom would not have to flip the smokescreen would not be in effect.

  50. Do you have to flip for an attack like fetch if the attack doesn’t do any damage?
    You mean if Kangaskhan is confused? Yes, you would.

  51. When using Raichu’s agility attack it states that if heads Raichu will not receive damage until after the opponents turn. If Raichu is poisoned and then gets heads will he take damage from poison at the end of his turn?
    Yes, Agility is referring to effects of attacks on Raichu during your opponent’s next turn.

  52. Referring to the question regarding Ditto and “once-per-turn” Powers: if Ditto can use said powers multiple times in the same turn if the opponent is Gusted out and back, is it because Ditto “resets” himself somehow when he Transforms? If so, this seems at odds with status effects, which are not lost when Ditto Transforms into a new Pokémon. Unless I’m just missing something, along the line here.
    No, Ditto doesn’t ‘reset’, but if he Transforms from Gengar to Ditto to Gengar, that second Gengar will be considered a ‘fresh’ one as far as the ‘once-per-turn’ use of Curse.

  53. If I attach a plus power to Dark Wartortle, and use Mirror shell, and the defending Pokémon does 20 damage to Dark Wartortle, does Mirror Shell do 20 or 30 damage back?
    No, the Plus Power will be removed at the end of your turn, so it won’t be in effect for the Mirror Move.
    It will do 20.

  54. If you really do plan to put Fossil out of print, about when will Fossil be out of print?
    I haven’t heard any dates on that.

  55. How does a store get to order Wizards of the Coast products to sell. My family started up a store recently and we’d like to know?
    Contact Wizards of the Coast Merchant Relations, call us and press the extension for ‘retailers’ for the phone number.

  56. Is there any new info on rules, tournament format (Elimination or Swiss)or other new details for the Super Trainer Showdown on July 22nd?
    No information about this yet, sorry. I think people are still working on what they want to do…at least I hope they are.

  57. Why did Giovanni put himself on the cover of a Pokémon card wrapper in a set called Team Rocket without revealing to the Pokémon league that he’s the team rocket leader. The Pokémon league will take away his gym. What was he thinking? Does he have a bigger ego then common sense?
    Nope, just an ego worthy of comparison to Ken Griffey Jr.'s

  58. When playing a rainbow Energy on a Pokémon, the 10 damage still occurs even if a Defender is played on that Pokémon, correct?
    Defender states that it only defends against damage done by attacks since that is not an attack the damage would be done if the Rainbow was played out of the hand on to the Pokémon in question.

  59. When playing a rainbow Energy on a Pokémon, will Mr. Mime’s Invisible Wall prevent that damage or not?
    No it would not.

  60. Will the movie promos be given to each group of people or for how many number of tickets are bought will determine the number given. It would stink it if was one per group because my little brothers will probably fight right their in line.
    We can’t say right now Haymaker but I am sure there will be some consideration to that request.

  61. When will the league web page be updated?
    Dunno.

  62. If you put defender on a Pokémon that has just been attacked by a Gastly with destiny bond will the defenders have any affect?
    The defenders won’t have any effect because Destiny bond has no value to the damage it does it simply knocks out the defending Pokémon.

  63. All my Dark Golbats say “Apply”, but it sounds like you have one that says “Don’t apply”. Please confirm for the masses. Thanks.
    Both of the ones I could find here say, “Apply weakness and resistance.”

  64. What was the reason for the 2.99-3.29-price hike?
    Costs associated with printing and producing the cards.

  65. If there are 4 Snorlax on a bench, won’t that break the bench?
    Probably, but not in the game, for the Bench is just the place where they wait to battle and not actually a real bench you might have a picnic on.

  66. To qualify for the 7/22 tournament, you need 3 badges correct? Does the league pretest badge count?
    No, only the 8 main badges count.

  67. Are we supposed to charge kids to join Pokémon League?
    That’s entirely up to the store you can choose to charge or you can choose not to.

  68. I’m a Gym Leader and I received Misty and Brock stickers and sheets, but NO instructions on using them. How do they work?
    Give us a call at Customer Service and we’ll try to get an answer for you.

  69. Why must the cards be released separately, it’s a pain the wallet for families, because kids want all the cards and parents won’t hear the end of it unless they get all the cards?
    Which cards do you speak of senior Haymaker?

  70. Nothing in my instructions said the kids can only earn Holo Mews during one season, but I heard that’s true. Is it? I still have lots of kids with stickers, and quite a few mews.
    You have authority to continue letting kids earn those if their wasn’t specific instructions prohibiting this.

  71. I’ve seen reference to “signing up for next season”. What does that mean? I thought they fill out DCI card once, get a book, then that’s it. They come when they can.
    Well, you should still keep a sign-up sheet so you only sign-up as many people as you can handle.

  72. Can you play if most of your Pokémon cards use colorless attack if I don’t have any colorless cards?
    Well colorless attacks mean that you can use any color of energy to activate that particular attack you don’t just need the double colorless energy to use those attacks.

  73. Below dark Raichu’s left foot, there is a ‘blob’ of something - is this a error or damaged card? Or are they all like that?
    I don’t know. I’d have to see the card.

  74. Is the Brock and Misty challenge coming to Canada? Our league never seemed to get it?
    I imagine that you’ll get those activities eventually.

  75. My league location temporarily shut down. Will they replace the promos they missed?
    That depends if your League organizer continued to order the League kits.

  76. My brother tried to play a deck with no Pokémon at the super trainer showdown qualifier, but the deck check lady said it was illegal. I see no where in the rules where it says its illegal and a master trainer told me on chat that it was ok too.
    If you don’t have any Pokémon in your deck the game will never start. If you want to make a deck like that, you’re welcome to, but, be prepared to get kicked out of a lot of tournaments.

  77. Will Dark Raichu be legal for international tournaments?
    I think it will depend on how fast the distribution goes for the Rocket Cards internationally.

  78. Is 0 damage still damage? My friend said that his Hitmonchan with 2 plus powers on it did 20 damage, but I said NO. What’s the ruling?
    No, 0 is not damage. Hitmochan with 2 Plus Powers on it and no energy, will do 0 damage.

  79. Why doesn’t WotC put a price on the wrapper like $3.29 in the corner so stores don’t over charge them? I’m fairly disappointed at how some stores charge $10 for a pack it’s ridiculous and why can’t the just make them $3.29?
    Because our cards are sold all over the world and to put just an American MSRP would be pretty shortsighted. We do our best to publicize the correct price of the cards and to make them available for that price on our website.

  80. Am I the only one that thinks letting anyone with 3 badges in to the STS will allow too many people in? Is there any limit?
    Don’t know that yet first they have to get to L.A. ya know?

  81. If we finally finish handing out enough Mews to fill the replenishment sheet, is it too late to send it in to get more?
    I believe so, though you’re welcome to try.

  82. Can you make a book with all these rulings from R&D so I can show my tournament director? He doesn’t believe me!
    Nope, those are only for our use at this time. Like I said earlier though, we’ll suggest a book of those rulings be printed.

  83. Can you have 3 Lv. 12 Pikachu and 2 Lv. 14 Pikachu in one deck?
    Nope, you can only have 4 Pokémon of the same name in your deck it does not matter which set they came from or if they were different promo’s.

  84. For the super trainer showdown entry my Gym Leader didn’t know what was the stamp to use and just used the green star stamp is this correct?
    I don’t know, sorry.

  85. I think this was asked a couple of weeks ago, but if an attack that knocks out Dark Gyarados also paralyzes him, does he get to use his Final Beam or not?
    No, he won’t get to because you’ll have to apply all the effects of the attack on D.Gyrados all at once. Since it will be paralyzed, it won’t be able to do Final Beam.

  86. How old do you have to be to work at a Wizards of the Coast store?
    18 I think. I dunno.

  87. Does the ruling on Plus Powers staying with retreated Pokémon also apply to other attached cards, such as Defender?
    As far as we know.

  88. In a translation by Scrye, it says that Dark Blastoise does 10 damage for each extra energy and Rocket Diglett’s Dig Under does 20. In the actual American cards, it is the other way around. Was that a mistake, or was Scrye wrong?
    Scrye and Inquest often have to submit their translations for the new sets before they see our cards, so it doesn’t surprise me that they may have been wrong or we may have changed the card’s wording.

  89. Can you tell me the truth about Base Set 2? Why did you make it?
    Well, we thought the Pokémon game would mature differently at that time. We thought that producing one set with most of the important Pokémon from Jungle and Base set 1 in it would help get the game into the hands of more consumers and lower the average price consumers were paying for cards.

  90. Are the base set cards that have a date of @1995,96,98,99 fake because they have 99 on them.
    Nope there was a legal thing that Nintendo made us take off the 99 after many cards were already printed and distributed. In fact the ones with the 99 are a little older then the ones without the 99.

Pat: OK, that’s it for this week, if we didn’t get to your questions save them for next week. I’ll be here what about you Galen?

Galen: Actually MT Mike is taking over for me but I hope to make guest cameo appearances from time to time. Thanks for letting me talk with you guys. It’s been a lot of fun for me. See you next week.

Thurs. June 8, 2000 - Cancelled due to server issues

Sorry! This chat was cancelled due to server problems.

Thanks,
Wizards.Community
