Thurs. June 22, 2000 - Weekly Pokemon TCG Q&A

Pokémon Online Help
Offered every Thursday 2-5 PST in the TCG Forum of the Wizards.Community chat site!
Featuring Master_Trainers from Customer Service

Thurs. June 22, 2000

Hello again gang. So first, the announcements.

Most of you have probably already heard that the STS format changed for the 2 youngest age groups. Here is the letter that is being sent out:

Dear Master Trainers,
Its true! Due to amazing customer feedback we have decided to add these two sets into the Pokémon card sets that can be used at this event in July. All age groups will be able to use Base Set, Base Set 2, Jungle, Fossil and Team Rocket. In addition all promo cards that have been released in English can be used as well. We feel that this will create the most exciting and interesting play experience for all the master trainers coming to the Super Trainer Showdown. Good Luck, Master Trainers, and have a great time!

Secondly I would like to thank all of the people who have sent in Weedle cards already. Thank you! We still need more to build the Space Weedle though. If you have any extra cards and want to be part of Pokémon Chat history, please mail your Weedle cards to Master Trainer Mike c/0 Customer Service Wizards of the Coast PO Box 707 Renton, WA 98057. Please sign the card with your name so the world will see how generous you are.

And lastly, the STS will be a DCI Sanctioned event meaning some of the shenanigans we’ve heard about at some of the Qualifying events will NOT be allowed. If you are unsure of what the DCI rules for Pokémon Tournaments are check them out on our web site.

  1. Any new info this week about the Persian Promo?
    Nope, should be out in Nintendo Power down the road.

  2. Can I submit an idea for an American promo?
    We appreciate your interest in our products and love to hear that our creations are inspiring others. Unfortunately, we are not currently accepting submissions for expansions based on Pokémon, nor can we accept any single-card submissions.

  3. Will Eevee Promo be gotten by doing the same thing for Holo Mew / Computer Error?
    Yup, gotta earn them points!

  4. In the Pokémon TCG League, what will happen after all the seasons’ end?
    That is still in the works (along with a possible 2nd year of the League).

  5. Can I have say 4 Blain’s Arcanine and four regular Arcanine?
    In one deck? Sure, they have different names.

  6. Is there any other way besides F.Gastly’s “Energy Conversion” to get a DCE straight back into your hand (not into the deck)?
    Hmmm, not that I know of. Does anyone else know of a way to do this, gang?

  7. So. Want to make ANY comments on the Dallas, TX STS and anything you have heard about it?
    Well, like mentioned in the opening announcements, we were sad to hear of “reported” unsportsman-like conduct. Rest assured that the STS will be a DCI sanctioned event and that sort of “ruining the game for everyone” won’t take place. To be honest, we never suspected that this sort of thing would happen. Our bad in being too trusting I guess.

  8. When my ditto uses an attack that requires discarding of a fire energy, may I discard an attached grass energy since all energy on ditto counts as any color?
    Yes you can.

  9. If Dark Wartortle were facing against Mr. Mime would mirror shell affect Mr. Mime when Dark Wartortle is KO?
    It would depend on how much damage was done to Dark Wartortle, if it was 30 or more then the Invisible Wall would still prevent it (as long as Mr. Mime’s Pokémon Power still worked).

  10. I have an Abra card that has a crescent moon with a dot in it where the rarity symbol is supposed to be its #43/102, what’s this mark mean?
    Sounds like it’s a misprint. The printing press may have been low on ink at that point.

  11. Any new promos you guys can announce (excluding the movie promos)
    Not really, besides the Eevee Foil (#11) that you can earn in Season 7 of the Pokémon League. Also the last issue of Top Deck had Mew (#8) in it as well if you missed getting it before.

  12. How many Mew’s should I put in my deck?
    That my friend, is entirely up to you (4 max of course).

  13. Is there going to be a promo in the new Pokémon soundtrack?
    Possibly, I haven’t heard yet whether this will happen or not.

  14. What shenanigans are you referring to about the qualifier? The 4-minute turn? What is the time limit for a turn?
    Can’t comment on specifics as we were not there and we are hearing about it second hand. Check out the Pokémon DCI tournament rules on our web site to learn what is and isn’t allowed.

  15. The Ancient Mew card being given out at the movie this summer, is it going to be a ‘Mew’ card or an ‘Ancient Mew’ card, meaning, could I have 4 mews and 4 ancient mews in my deck?
    It is called Ancient Mew.

  16. Does DCI plan on banning any cards after the STS?
    There are no planned bannings that we know of.

  17. Does Defender prevent damage from poison?
    Nope, it only reduces damage from Attacks, NOT attack effects like Poison.

  18. Are any of the master trainers going to play in the STS? Your self included? Can you please give the names of the master trainers that will be playing?
    Well, Master Trainer Pat and I will be there and so will Boss Mike and possibly some of the other Trainers here from WOTC. We won’t be playing in the STS but we will be there to help run the whole shebang.

  19. Are there any plans to sanction Pokémon judges?
    Not at this time.

  20. Hi I live in Saudi Arabia is there going to be something here like the Pokémon league or something?
    Wow, I have no idea. I know that Pokémon and the Leagues are slowly spreading out over the world though. I would ask your local retailer/dealer if they know.

  21. If Clefairy is against Executor and she uses metronome. Do you go by the energy requirement on Executor? I was told by a friend that because it says ‘without regard to energy requirements’ that you just flipped untill the opponent was dead? That sounds wrong.
    Right, your friend is wrong. You replace the word Exeggutor with the Clefairy when you use Metronome on the Big Eggsplosion attack. So you would flip as many coins as you have energy attached to the Clefairy.

  22. If you are playing the beginner trading card game, what size deck do you use, and how many prizes?
    The starter deck comes with 2 30 cards decks (1 for each player) and you play a game for 3 prizes.

  23. May I move a double colorless energy attached to a ditto onto my Charmander, using Gather Fire?
    Yes you could (since Energy attached to Ditto counts as any basic energy type).

  24. If Golduck uses Hyper Beam to KO a Dark Gyarados and the coin flip was head and Gyarados had two energies on it, would the attack to 20 or 40 damage?
    It would do 40.

  25. Can you have 4 basic Charizard in your deck and 4 team Rocket Charizard?
    Nope, they have the same name (Charizard); the set that they are from does not change their name. Now, Dark Charizard is a different name though, so you could have 4 of them and 4 Charizard.

  26. To clarify the “all energy on Ditto counts as energy of any color”, this is only the case when Ditto is active and it’s Pokémon power comes into play, correct?
    Correct.

  27. Is there any chance of lily pad mew coming to US?
    I have no idea.

  28. Would Dk.Wartortle’s MirrorShell stop working if the opponent benches their Pokémon first (same as Smokescreen)?
    Good question! It is worded a bit vague isn’t it? My guess is that it would end when the Defending Pokémon is benched but I will check on it.

  29. What does Dark Raichu’s attack does?
    Surprise Thunder: Flip a coin. If heads, flip another coin. If the second coin is heads, this attack does 20 to each of your opponent’s Benched Pokémon. If the second coin flip is tails, this attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent’s Benched Pokémon. (Don’t apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) DAMAGE 30. It requires 3 lightning energy attached, btw.

  30. What is a good ratio for total basic Pokémon to evolved Pokémon in a deck?
    Well, we usually recommend 4 basic to 2 Stage 1 to 1 Stage 2 Pokémon normally. Of course, you can vary it.

  31. Will Ancient Mew be tournament legal?
    Not for the STS no. Beyond that, I dunno.

  32. Do you believe they should have a limit of 60 cards in a Pokémon deck? I mean, Magic you can have infinite cards, IT IS UNFAIR!
    Why? It’s always been a part of the rules ever since the Pokémon TCG came out 5 years ago.

  33. Ok, if I play a Computer Error, and I draw 5 cards, does my opponent HAVE to draw 5 cards too, or can he/she opt to draw a different number?
    They can draw UP TO 5 cards so they get to choose the number.

  34. Will Porygon be included in season 8? Also will the league be modified due to the fact that in the new Pokémon games, their are more badges to earn than before. The new badges would be great for those who already earned the earth badge.
    If you are asking about the Cool Porygon promo I don’t know when they will be re-releasing that. Unfortunately I don’t have any real details yet on the tear of the Pokémon League either except that they are working on it.

  35. A question on the damage caused from Rainbow Energy: If Mewtwo “energy absorbs” and then Venusaur "energy transfers it, do the receiving Pokémon take damage?
    Nope, it only does the damage when you play the card from your hand.

  36. I would like to go to a gym but I don’t know where to find them do you know?
    We have a League Locator on our web site at events.wizards.com/pWherePlay/Default.asp? Arena

  37. Are you guys *ever* going to post a listing of the Team Rocket card set on your website? (I could’ve practically typed one up myself already)?
    Ya know, we keep mentioning it, I dunno why it isn’t up yet.

  38. I asked about a Machamp league promo last week and you said you’d look in to it, did you find anything?
    Nothing yet.

  39. Is it possible for a league to ban a person because the person is “too old”? (Over 12)
    Each league location runs the league as they see fit. I’ve heard of some locations having to limit (due to pace consideration) and have been using age as a way to do so. The are allowed to do this if they choose. Yes, that’s up to the League stores.

  40. Your letter about the STS rules changed starts “due to the amazing customer feedback…”, just how many people called/wrote and complained?
    Well Pat and I whined a lot!

  41. Will the cards in the gym sets made without a rarity symbol in Japanese be printed with one in English?
    I imagine so. We put rarity symbols on all non-promo cards we’ve released. We have not seen how they’re doing this yet.

  42. What’s the date of the most recent chat transcript currently available on your website?
    It looks like June 1st’s transcript is up.

  43. Is Ancient Mew’s Pokémon Power the one where no evolved Pokémon can hurt it?
    That’s going to be for League members to figure out.

  44. Might want to check RD on the Golduck ruling. It seems you would carry out the attack and all its effects then knock out the Pokémon.
    Ok, according to the order of attack: The last step is if the attack does anything else other than damage do that. Since Dark Gyarados is being Knocked out from the damage (step h) BEFORE the Remove Energy effect goes off the energy card should still be there when Dark Gyarados is Knocked out and his Pokémon Powers resolves.

  45. Mew’s Devolution Beam works on the opponents benched Pokémon too, right?
    Yea, that’s right.

  46. Would Wizards start a store where players of the TCG can buy cards for low prices?
    We do have stores that we sell our products (and other games) at. In some cases our prices are lower than what other stores are charging.

  47. If I evolve a Pokémon that is being effected by Smokescreen, does the effect go away?
    Yes.

  48. What’s the use of having 4 Charizard and 4 Dark Charizards in a deck when you can only have 4 Charmanders, which means you won’t use all of them? Isn’t it a waste of space?
    Yes, it’s probably wasted space. But if your deck is focussed on getting a Charizard into play…maybe you want it that way?

  49. What are the #'s of the new movie promos?
    Ancient Mew doesn’t have a # on it. Moltres is 21. Zapdos is 23 and Articuno is 22.

  50. All right, I’m gonna try and juice this out of you guys. The East Coast tour will happen after the Super Trainer Showdown in July no doubt, but are there any plans for another STS of sorts… or will the East Coast tour gain people entrance to Hawaii Tropical Mega Battle 2000… or is it just for fun?
    No, seriously, they’re looking at doing an “STS” type event for the East Coast there’s just nothing concrete we can tell you right now.

  51. What season should the league be on?
    I think it should be on season #7(Volcano Badge)

  52. Might want to know this: Pokémon the Movie 2000 comes out July 21st according to the official Web Site.
    Yea, thanks, I’ve marked that on my calendar…

  53. Is there going to be a super secret card in the gym1 expansions?
    No word on that yet. If there was, I wouldn’t say anyway. *Evil grin*

  54. Is their any prizes on the tournament on the Queen Mary?
    Yes, the list was given last week. I know I saw it posted on Pojo.com.

  55. When you use smoke screen does it affect all your opponents Pokémon because it says it makes the defending Pokémon flip a coin?
    Nope. It just effects the defending Pokémon.

  56. If I have a Pokémon ‘rules’ question, and cannot attend this chat session, who at wizards could I email, and how soon might I get a response?
    custserv@wizards.com, put ‘Pokémon’ in the subject line.

  57. Can I get a confirmation from either of you about base set and jungle only being allowed in the 11-14 age group?
    That has been changed. Now all sets (that have been released in English) are allowed.

  58. So your saying if my Gyarados was knocked out by a fossil Golduck, would it remove an energy card before Dark Gyarados used final beam?
    You keep asking guys, we have to check with R&D. My understanding is that it would be knocked out BEFORE the remove energy card effect and so the Dark Gyarados would do 40 instead of 20.

  59. How come some people at the Pokémon TCG League in Monrovia California let people use fake cards? I don’t mean counterfeit but home made fan cards?
    Ummm…they shouldn’t be (not for the League anyway). If this is the case, please email and tell us about it and we will look into it.

  60. Last week I asked about the Clefable Metronoming Rapid Evolution, and you said it could evolve, but Metronome says to copy the attack, and R. Evolution says put Gyarados on Magikarp, are you guys sure about this?
    Yup, R&D confirmed it. You would replace the work Magikarp with the word Clefabel (as the ruling for Metronome is, always replace self-referencing with the Clefable/Clefairy). It would work (though only if you had a Gyarados in your deck of course.

  61. Is there any other way to go to the STS on the Queen Mary besides three badges and an invitation?
    There have been some contests and the top 10 DCI ranked Pokémon players in the world get an automatic invitation as well.

  62. What will be the next set after the Gym sets?
    We are still working on that.

  63. Will gym cards have the little gym trainer heads on them?
    Yup.

  64. Is there an entrance fee on the STS tournament?
    Nope, it’s free.

  65. Why is it that every time I go to my Pokémon League in Toys R Us They never give out anything because 2 kids stole a box of Holographic Mews and a Kids Game Boy and the Soul Badges and he never wants to pass out the Holographic Eevees!
    Geez, I dunno. Send us an email explaining what is happening and we will look into it for you.

  66. Are there plans for Wizards to hold some sort of Pro-Tour?
    Nope.

  67. Can you be disqualified at the STS by having a disability (wheelchair, for example)?
    Of course not!

  68. Will tickets be required for entry to STS like the Showdown battles last year, or will it be first come, first serve? Because if it is first come first serve, that’ll be really hard for people like me coming from Texas.
    It will be first come first serve though line cutting and stuff like that WON’T be allowed.

  69. Will the tcg tour stop by New York? I live here and there are not many tournaments or events.
    There are a LOT of tournaments in New York. Check out our online tournament search engine at events.wizards.com/dcitournament/Default.asp?game=PK There will be an East Coast Mall tour and premiere event later this year.

  70. Does wizards have the ability to create all new sets?
    Not without all sorts of approval by the license holders.

  71. Will there be any independent vendor tables at the STS, like the ones at conventions?
    Good question! To be honest, I have no idea. I will try and find out.

  72. Suppose I have a TR Rattata on my bench, no cards left in my deck, and one prize left. Can I use TR Rattata’s “Trickery” Pokémon Power to switch that Prize into my deck for the win?
    Nope, sorry.

  73. Why won’t Jiggly be re-released? It was such a pain mailing things in and getting the run around on the phone at Atlantic, then waiting 3 months.
    It is available now in Europe (so it has been re-released over there).

  74. Will you tell the people working on the Eastern STS to put a stop in Durham, NC?
    I’ll pass it along.

  75. Will Ancient Mew be a double-sided holo?
    Yup!

  76. How many foreign people are invited to play in the STS? From which countries?
    Sorry but don’t have the specifics as to numbers.

  77. Will there be another Tropical Mega Battle in Hawaii? How do you qualify for it?
    There are plans for it. Specifics on it will be posted when they are ready.

  78. If you win a trip to Hawaii, what if you don’t know how to swim?
    Flap your arms real hard?

  79. How will the Stadium Cards be played?
    Sorry, but the Gym set hasn’t been released yet so no rulings can be answered on them.

  80. Does evolving a Pokémon remove smokescreen effect?
    Yes it does.

  81. What is the big deal with the order for the attacks, if you just do what the cards say, don’t you get it in the right order?
    It can get confusing if there are relevant trainer cards; Pokémon powers and attack effects all being done in one attack. You have to know which ones resolve first.

  82. Will the vending series ever be released?
    Possibly.

  83. I’m sure you knew this, but you apply all text from an attack before you decide final damage (and K-Oing the Pokémon) So first you would flip to see if an energy is discarded from Gyardos.
    WRONG! You apply the damage FIRST and then, if the attack does anything other than damage, then you do that (which would be the Energy Card removal effect for Goldduck). Take a look at the rulebook.

  84. Electabuzz does thunder punch with a plusepower and he flipped tails does it do 20 to Electabuzz?
    Nope, pluspower only adds to damage done to the defending Pokémon.

  85. What is the maximum occupancy allowed for the STS? I would imagine it couldn’t be unlimited, because of time.
    To the actual event? No limit. To the various tournaments and side events, there will probably be limits.

  86. Does Blastiose’s (Base Set) Hydro pump do 30+ or 40 +?
    40+.

  87. What is promo #17?
    That will be the Dark Persian.

  88. Will there be an AMERICAN Jiggly re-release?
    Dunno. It’s always possible.

  89. If Ancient Mew is double sided, won’t that make it illegal in tourney play without opaque slips?
    IF it ends up playable, then yes, that would be true.

  90. On the Super Trainer Showdown on the Queen Mary will all Promo Cards (English) be available in the 10 & under division?
    What do you mean available? You will be able to use them, yes.

  91. You said that the Queen Mary STS will be “first come first served”. Will those with invitations be allowed in ahead of those with 3 badges? Or must we all get in line at 6:00 a.m.?
    Guys, to be honest, not THAT many people will make long trips to this event, it will be mostly the trip winners and local players. We are planning on handling as many people that show up though.

  92. Is Pokémon TCG for 10 and up? (My friends don’t believe me, they think I’m too old)
    It is for whomever wants to play it.

  93. Why bother making non-holo versions of the holos? To make money?
    No, we had many collector/players complain that they didn’t want to play with their holo cards and wear them out but still wanted to use the cards so we made both versions of the cards for collecting and playing.

  94. Do I have to have an actual fire energy card attached to Ditto to do an attack that requires discarding of fire energy? Or would a normal energy or rainbow energy work?
    You could use any energy as all attached to Ditto (when he is active) can count as all-basic energy types.

  95. Can you use Rocket Garbage run to recover an already discarded garbage run?
    Do you mean Nightly Garbage Run? If so, then no, you can only bring back energy or Pokémon NOT Trainer cards.

  96. What are the next few promos coming out? And what does promo stand for?
    Promo means promotional. The next cards will be the Foil Eevee in the League, and the Ancient Mew and Legendary Bird card in the next Pokémon movie.

  97. I meant, is the game marked for 10 and up. I thought I saw it on the waterblast deck, but I lost my box…
    It is recommended for ages 10 and up.

  98. If I have two Rainbow energy attached to a Dark Charizard, and I flip two heads, can I discard the rainbow energy or do I have to have fire energy cards?
    You could discard the Rainbow Energy as they do count as all-basic energy types.

  99. How many rounds of Swiss, for the STS?
    It is usually 5 rounds (though this can vary due to size).

  100. When will the Gym sets be released?
    The first set will be out mid August 2nd set in October.

  101. I will be attending STS with my very young son, both of us will be playing in the main tourney - will it be organized enough that I don’t need to worry about him getting lost and confused about where he is supposed to be?
    It will be organized but it will be a very large tournament. If you feel your child might get confused you should probably stay with him until he knows where he is going.

  102. Is there any way other than F.Gastly’s “Energy Conversion” to put a DCE back into your hand (not into the deck).
    Can’t think of any off of the top of my head, Pat?

  103. I heard that the defending Pokémon has to be asleep for 2 turns in order to use base haunter’s dream eater… does the TR trainer Sleep! Change this?
    The Defending Pokémon just has to be asleep when you try and use the Dream Eater attack. It doesn’t matter how you put it Asleep.

  104. Why didn’t you call the STS the West Coast STS because there were no stops east of the Mississippi?
    Why don’t we call it the US STS since it’s only in the US?

  105. Can I use 4 Imposter Professor Oak cards in one turn?
    Yes, you could if you had the 4 of them in your hand.

  106. Are there any plans on making the deck size larger to accommodate the augmenting (nice word eh?) of new cards?
    Nope, 60 cards.

  107. Will you be giving special promo cards to the winners at STS?
    Not that I know of but they will get medals and special jackets, hats, and free product.

  108. Why are booster pack prices going up?
    We have not raised our booster prices; we still sell them online for $3.29 each. Prices for boosters have not gone up recently that we know of.

  109. How do you feel about all that junk one had to go through to get the Jiggly promo? Will it happen again with the new soundtrack?
    That was my concern with another soundtrack promo. We were not happy with our promotional partners in that instance and are working to ensure that that sort of thing doesn’t happen again.

  110. If a card has a thin HP text and no shadow from the picture, and lightened background, (most people call it “second edition”) are they fake?
    Nope, they are just from the early print runs of the cards before we darkened them, thickened the font, changed the copyright, and added the drop shadow. No, there was a slight color change between print runs.

  111. My son lost his hat that he won at the STS qualifiers - so he stole mine - can I get a replacement?
    Hmmm, I don’t know if there are any left. I would suggest emailing us at custserv@wizards.com and we can pass along your request.

  112. Can you Raindance Rainbow Energy?
    No. Because it does not count as any type in your hand.

  113. Is the TR Magikarp Rare or what? I can’t find one anywhere.
    It is an uncommon card in the Team Rocket set.

  114. Where did the idea for Pokémon come from?
    Mr. Ishihara in Japan created it.

  115. If dark Flareon use playing with fire, do I have to discard a fire energy even though I flipped a tail? Does the same rule apply on dark Charmeleon’s fireball attack?
    For Dark Flareon you only discard a Fire Energy if you flip Heads. Same for Dark Charmeleon.

  116. Last week you said you would check and see if the free trip winners got staterooms with windows or the inside windowless rooms - did you check? They turn down the beds and put chocolate on the pillows at REALLY nice hotels.
    Funny, I do NOT recall being asked that, sorry.

  117. What are Dark Muks attacks?
    Sludge Punch and the Pokémon Power Sticky Goo.

  118. In the Gym series, will there be another American exclusive card?
    Dunno.

  119. If I put defender on my active Pokémon, then I put a rainbow energy on the Pokémon, the defender prevent the damage right?
    Nope. Defender only prevents damage from attacks only.

  120. If I have a Ditto as my active Pokémon and my opponent retreats his active Pokémon does Ditto change into the new Pokémon?
    Yes it does (as long as Ditto is not Asleep, Paralyzed, or confused).

  121. Any other promos in between Persian and the movie promos?
    Just the Foil Eevee for Season 7 Pokémon League (so far).

  122. Where can I get the Persian promo?
    It has not been released yet, will be coming out in an issue of Nintendo Power.

  123. Any plans on an American exclusive set?
    Nope.

  124. Will there be an English contest to draw pictures of Pokémon and be official cards?
    Possibly.

  125. Will there be any more ‘point free’ promos like mew and Gyrados?
    Possibly.

  126. When does Season 7 start? Isn’t it this weekend?
    Not sure, should be soon though.

  127. Will gym change gameplay mechanics significantly?
    There will be some new mechanics added (like Stadium cards).

  128. What are the gym leaders’ sets called again?
    Gym Heroes and Gym Challenge.

  129. On the gym sets, will you use the art from the Japanese booster wrappers?
    Dunno, too far away to know for sure.

  130. How are you going to number gym1 and gym 2?
    Dunno again. But these sort of specific questions won’t ever be answered until a set has been released.

  131. Can you ever knock out Mr. Mime on the first hit without him being asleep, confused etc.?
    If he does not already have damage on him? Nope.

  132. I was just talking about the Mr. Mime thing; I remembered about Nidoking’s toxic whatever… it would do 20, then 20 again for the poisoning, right?
    Yup! Very good, that would work.

  133. Are the rules difference because of the gym leaders? I ask this question because the gym I play in only allow 1 trainer card per term!
    Probably. There shouldn’t be any limits like that that I’ve heard of.

Ok, thank you all for coming this week! Hopefully we will see some of you at the STS. Take care!

Thurs. June 29, 2000 - Weekly Pokemon TCG Q&A

Pokémon Online Help
Offered every Thursday 2-5 PST in the TCG Forum of the Wizards.Community chat site!
Featuring Master_Trainers from Customer Service

Thurs. June 29, 2000

Pat will be along shortly (he is at another meeting about donuts, I think).

But first the opening announcements:

Here is the TENTATIVE East Coast Mall Tour schedule. It is still being worked on and will most likely change but we wanted to give you an idea anyway:

August 26-27 Troy, MI
Sept 9-10 Towson, MD
Sept 16-17 Cincinnati, OH
Sept 23-24 Schaumburg, IL
Sept 30-Oct 1 Independence, MO
October 7-8 Alpharetta, GA
October 14-15 Braintree, MA
October 21-22 King of Prussia, PA
October 28-29 Nanuet, NY
Nov 4-5 Miami, FL

Secondly, Wizards is investigating the “alleged” incidents that took place at the Dallas STS qualifier. We cannot comment any further on this at this time.

And last, we want to clarify about the STS. It is not a DCI sanctioned event (since it is tied in so closely with the Pokémon League) but it WILL follow and be run using the DCI floor rules along with the judging system.

Okay, let’s get on to the questions.

  1. Ditto’s active with 20 damage, they put mysterious Ditto’s active with 20 damage, they put mysterious fossil as their Pokémon is Ditto KO?
    I’m assuming you mean they retreat and bring up Mysterious Fossil. Ditto transforms into Mysterious Fossil, only has 10 HP but already has 20 damage so it goes to the discard pile. It does NOT count as a Knocked out Pokémon (last ruling by R&D) as it is a copy of Mysterious Fossil, which does not count as a Knocked out Pokémon.

  2. When is gym hero set coming out?
    Mid-August.

  3. Why on third stage they say put on stage 1 Pokémon but then it shows a Pokémon for EXE Charizard it show Charmelon and it says stage to above the picture?
    Why that would be a mistake on the card. Or a misprint.

  4. Will you be able to mail in your ticket stubs for movie cards for p2k?
    Dunno, that is Warner Brothers gig. It is up to them whether that will happen or not.

  5. What exactly does curse do?
    POKÉMON POWER: Curse once during your turn (before your attack), you may move 1 damage counter from 1 of your opponent’s Pokémon to another (even if it would Knock Out the other Pokémon). This power can’t be used if Gengar is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed. It is a Pokémon Power on Gengar.

  6. Will there be a promo in the p2k soundtrack?
    Dunno.

  7. Will the legendary bird’s card given out at the WB store be jumbo?
    You would have to ask them about that one.

  8. When will the movie cards show their faces?
    When the movie starts, Ancient Mew will be given to movie patrons (while supplies last) the first week, then the 3 legendary birds after that (again while supplies last).

  9. Will there be a birthday Pikachu?
    Not that we’ve announce yet.

  10. Will there be a tropical mega battle?
    Yup, In August in Hawaii.

  11. How many people will win trips to the tropical mega battle?
    No info on the Tropical Mega Battle is available yet, sorry.

  12. Will Cool Porygon be released in the next season for Pokémon League?
    It will be out at some point, not announced when yet.

  13. Will the Pokémon league stop after season 8?
    There are plans for future League events and possible continuance, no specific info available yet.

  14. What will promo Dark Persians number?
    17

  15. Has Wizards gotten the rights to print Neo and/or Neo 2?
    Not that we can announce yet, no.

  16. How much damage is done to each Pokémon if Rapidash uses Agility(Heads) followed by opponent Dk. Wartortle’s Mirror Shell followed by Rapidash’s Agility(Tails)? Is it 0, 30, or 60? Take your time and think about this one carefully please. THANKS.
    We already have been thinking about this one and you will have to wait until we get an answer from R&D. My guess is that it would be 60 as Agility would NOT prevent Mirror Shell (it doesn’t refer to Rapidash). Then if Rapidash did 30 to Dark Wartortle the Mirror Shell would attack back for 30 (the word ATTACK is in the Mirror Shell description) and since Rapidash is weak to water it would be doubled to 60. However! That is my opinion and we will talk with R&D for the final official ruling.

  17. Have the Europeans been informed that we (Americans) will be using Rocket and Fossil cards? What will happen when they don’t know what a card does and has trouble reading English?
    They are aware and they will be taught about the new cards before they get here.

  18. I have a Team Rocket Grimer card. It says for poison gas, “Flip a coin. If heads the Defending Pokémon is now asleep.” Is this a mistake?
    Yup, we admitted that one months ago. It is a misprint.

  19. What are the promo legendary birds attacks are?
    Can’t say until the cards are released, sorry.

  20. Are the Legendary birds cards from the movie going to be only English cards like Dark Raichu?
    Dunno.

  21. Why is there no STS qualifying tournaments in the East Coast?
    Because the STS is a West Coast event (though anyone can come). As mentioned in the opening announcements there will be an East Coast Mall tour and East Coast premiere event later this year.

  22. When does the STS begin, end, and how long does it last?
    July 22nd, scheduled 10am-6pm on the Queen Mary in Long Beach, CA.

  23. Why do you make non-holo and holo versions of the same card? Is it to just get our money?
    Because we had many player/collectors complain that they never wanted to play with their holos and wear them out but still wanted to use those cards in game play. Now you can save you r holos and play with the non-holo version. Since the upcoming Gym sets are much bigger though the cards will NOT come in both holo and non-holo versions (or the set would be far too big to collect).

  24. What is the prize for winning STS in your age group?
    The overall winner will get a gold medal, event jacket and hat, and lots of Pokémon cards.

  25. Where do I send a letter to persuade you guys into having a STS over here at the East Coast?
    Relax, it’s already covered.

  26. In the STS, will the prizes taken in each match determine the score of the tournament or just the outcome of a match?
    Read up on the DCI Pokémon floor rules, they will cover the specifics. Other details to follow.

  27. What does the DCI plan to do about the combo of Imposter Oak’s Revenge, Rocket’s Sneak Attack, and Team Rocket’s Trap? Or can’t you discuss that?
    No combo is unstoppable. I’m sure you clever Pokémon Masters out there can beat it.

  28. Is promo Mewtwo allowed at Mall Tourney Minneapolis 7/1?
    Which one? All of them should be.

  29. Why don’t you put a rare AND a holo in every pack like Media Factory does?
    The packs would cost more, the holos would be much more common and therefore less collectible and since we want to promote game play, you don’t use many holos in a deck so why do you need so many?

  30. When are they going to get caught up with the “personal web pages” on the WOTC page?
    We have hundreds of thousands of reports coming in, it is now the major convention season, AD&D 3rd edition is out soon, as is X-Men, and we just released WCW and MLB2000. Unfortunately we are a bit overworked. They are going as fast as they can.

  31. What gym leaders will be in the first set “Heroes”? Will it be the same as in Japanese sets?
    They will be mostly the same, can’t talk about specifics.

  32. A trivial question yes, but what kind of boosters is the STS’s going to have as prizes?
    My understanding is that it will be a combo of different Pokémon sets.

  33. Is there a “promo card” due out in July?
    The Foil Eevee has just started to be available through the Pokémon League. The Movie promo cards will be out in July with the film release and I think Nintendo Power should be releasing their Dark Persian promo fairly soon.

  34. If Muk stops a Snorlax’s Pokémon power and poisons it, and Snorlax defeats it with Body Slam, is it still poisoned? (The power stops if confused, paralyzed, or asleep. Not poison.)
    Good question!!! Thick Skin states that Snorlax can’t BECOME asleep, confused, paralyzed, or poisoned. In this case he already is poisoned and I don’t think that the reactivation of the Thick Skin will remove the existing Poison.

  35. Will there be some sort of prize for the kids that have all the badges from WOTC?
    Maybe, still in the works.

  36. Do you feel Wigglytuff, is too powerful of a Pokémon? With the ability to do 60 damage resistance to Psychic and only two retreat, it can be absolutely devastating?
    Personally? Hmmm, he is fairly strong but not unstoppable.

  37. Since the league is almost over for the Pokémon tcg, are there any plans for a new one?
    It is being worked on.

  38. Will promo cards be given out at sneak preview screenings of Pokémon 200?
    You would have to check with the individual theaters, it would be up to them and Warner Brothers.

  39. Can you evolve a Dark Alakazam from a Kadabra?
    Nope.

  40. If Alakazam uses Damage Swap on a Pokémon with Defender, is the transferred damage prevented?
    Nope, Defender only prevents damage from attacks, not from Pokémon Powers. Besides you do realize that you can’t use Damage Swap on the other player’s Pokémon, right?

  41. What’s the difference between Dark Pokémon and regular ones?
    Dark Pokémon are the Pokémon that have been raised by Team Rocket. Which means they are sneaky, conniving, and drink milk directly from the carton. They have different powers and attacks and usually have lower hp than the non-dark versions.

  42. Can you attach double colorless energy then another energy since it is not a basic energy card?
    Nope, you can only attach 1 energy card per turn (whether basic or not).

  43. Were the misprints from the Team Rocket set done on purpose?
    Nope.

  44. Why don’t you make a Pokémon encyclopedia like you have done for MTG?
    We own Magic, we only license Pokémon from Nintendo and Creatures. We do not get to decide what products get made.

  45. Hello I wanted to know how many cards are in the gym heroes set?
    Somewhere around 132 or so?

  46. Any hints about next year’s Pokémon League?
    Only that they are working on it.

  47. I’m 35, and I want to start a gym how can I make it official?
    The official Pokémon League is a program run through participating retail locations only. If you have a storefront then contact our Merchant Relations department and they can help you set it up.

  48. If I have 4 electric energy on an active Zapdos and another Zapdos on the bench with one energy, can I use thunderbolt and discard the energy off the benched Zapdos?
    No, it means discard the energy off of the Zapdos that is doing the attack.

  49. I heard there was a Japanese Fossil Mew (or it’s just a rumor) Why isn’t Mew in the American Fossil? (I’ve read the Q and A for Fossil and I just want more than "because it is a special Pokémon!)
    Japan even felt that Mew should NOT have been in Fossil and they asked us to pull it. We then agreed to release it to as large an audience as possible (and it was FREE!!!).

  50. What are the ways to qualify for the super trainer showdown?
    Win an invitation at one of the qualifying tournaments, win an invitation in Europe, the top 10 DCI ranked Pokémon players get an automatic invitation, or earn 3 or more badges through the Pokémon League.

  51. At recent tournament: Clefable Metronomed Dark Wartortle’s MIRROR SHELL. On opponents next turn, Dark Wartortle evolved into Dark Blastoise, and it was ruled that Clefable’s metronome of MIRROR SHELL would have no effect on players next turn. What are R&D’s current ruling on that?
    I will have to check, it is unclear as to whom the attack SPECIFICALLY references. While it does mention the defending Pokémon it is only as a target of a possible future attack not as whom the effect specifically targets.

  52. Will a Pokémon that is retreated and activated the turn after Dark Jolteon’s lightening flash still have to suffer the coin flip? I would say yes, and as a precedent: jungle Eevee’s tail wag says “benching either Pokémon cancels the effect” yet Dark J?
    The Lightning Flash attacks effect references the Defending Pokémon. If that Pokémon is benched, evolved, or Devolved on the Defending player’s turn, then the effect is ended.

  53. Okay, Ditto vs. D. Charizard. Ditto has a DCE and uses repeated fireball. It doesn’t have an Fire energy cards, so can it not use it or something?
    Remember when Ditto is the active Pokémon, energy attached to Ditto can count as any basic energy type so he could use it.

  54. Is promos allowed in the STS tournament?
    Yup.

  55. Okay, Mew vs Venomoth or something, Mew uses Devolution Beam on Venomoth, can he evolve back into Venomoth next turn?
    On the next turn? Sure.

  56. How do I contact Master_Trainer_Mike?
    You can contact any of us here by writing to custserv@wizards.com and put it to the attention of whomever in the subject line.

  57. How come some cards are rarer than others? I want a good answer please!
    It is a collectible trading card game.

  58. Will the super trainer showdown be DCI sanctioned and count towards our records?
    No, it is not DCI sanctioned but it WILL be ran using the DCI floor rules and judging system.

  59. Why do you put 15 cards in a pack of magic cards but only 11 cards in Pokémon when they cost the same price?
    Pokémon cards cost more to make (the foils especially). Also we own Magic and so don’t have to pay licensing fees whereas we have to pay licensing fees to Nintendo for Pokémon.

  60. You said no combo is unstoppable. However, with heads flipped, the IOR-RSA-TRT combo used first-turn leaves the opponent with one card (the draw) in their hand. This doesn’t leave much in the way of countering the combos. Why not just ban IOR?
    Pokémon is supposed to be a game for fun, NOT hardcore competition (yeah I know we’ve been over this before). At this time (AND IT COULD CHANGE!) there are no plans on banning any cards. Besides 3 card combos don’t happen that often.

  61. Will WoTC having a Pokémon presence in Origins and GenCon?
    There will be a small presence for Pokémon at both events. Master Trainer Pat will be at Origins, I will be at Gen Con. Come find us!

  62. Why are there 2 Gym Leader sets? Ones not enough?
    If it was only 1 set it would be HUGE.

  63. Why aren’t Japanese proxies allowed at STS? (Like say, if I use Japanese Full Heal or something, or Japanese Scyther)?
    You can use Japanese cards as LONG as you have an English copy of the card with you for translation purposes, it is a card that has been already released in the states, and lastly you must use opaque card sleeves since the Japanese cards have different backs on them.

  64. Why doesn’t the Machamp in the Base 2 starter set have the Base 2 symbol?
    Good question, I have yet to get a good answer on that one.

  65. Will there be promo cards given out to winners of the STS?
    There might be a promo card given out to all participants.

  66. Can a rainbow energy be used as colorless, dark, and steal energy?
    No, it can only be used as basic energy types.

  67. Will the movie promo cards and ancient mew be legal at the STS?
    Nope, they will not be fully available in time.

  68. What do you plan to do about people who have 3 badges, but couldn’t make their local STS qualifier and can’t afford to pay for the trip themselves?
    This is just a tournament much like any other one that takes place across the country. Do they pay your way there? If you have earned 3 badges and plan on going to the STS please bring your badge book along as verification.

  69. What do you mean Promotion Dark Persian? I have a regular Persian! I’m confused!
    There is a promo Dark Persian due out in Nintendo Power soon, (#17).

  70. What’s the address to send Weedles for the Space Weedle project?
    Ahhh, thanks for the reminder!! Please send your extra Weedles to Master Trainer Mike c/o Customer Service Wizards of the Coast PO Box 707 Renton, WA 98057 Please remember to sign your name on the cards so we can see who you are!!

  71. Can you use goop gas attack when Dark Vileplume is in play?
    Only if Dark Vileplume’s Pokémon power isn’t active.

  72. Are you thinking of coming out with a Base Set 3, where the Neo is combined with the existing cards. For Example: Pikachu will not be a basic Pokémon?
    No plans to do so right now. My feeling is that we probably won’t. We’ll have to wait and see.

  73. What will Wizards do with “Misty’s Tears?”
    Probably alter the artwork slightly.

  74. Can I receive points at Pokémon League for completing Team Rocket?
    Yes, though I don’t think there’s a place to check that one off. Just have your Gym Leader write it in.

  75. When you use Pokémon Trader, do you shuffle a Pokémon card into your deck or do you discard one?
    You shuffle it back into your deck.

  76. Can promo Eevee’s Pokémon Power be used on the same turn that Eevee comes into play?
    No, but you would be able to use it on the turn following that. In other words, if your opponent tries to evolve a Pokémon the turn after you brought Eevee into play, you could use Eevee’s power then.

  77. Can Dark Charmeleon evolve into Charizard, or does it have to evolve into Dark Charizard?
    Once you start down the dark path, forever will it dominate your destiny. (So, no, you cannot.)

  78. Is it possible for a Fossil Magnemite to use 2 Defenders to stay alive?
    You mean Magneton, right? Yes, you could save him with 2 Defenders

  79. When Charizard uses Energy Burn would it count as 2 Fire Energies on a Double Colorless Energy?
    Yes.

  80. Why isn’t there errata for D. Vileplume and other badly printed Rocket cards? You do that for Magic!
    We’ve decided not to at this time. We didn’t feel that the misprints were game-affecting enough to errata.

  81. Why does Dark Flareon’s playing with Fire say “only use this attack if there are any fire energy attached to Dark Flareon”?
    This type of wording is used on Dark Charmeleon as well and it’s designed to force Ditto players to actually have a Fire Energy on their Ditto to copy that attack.

  82. Can you guys put a promo list on the Pokémon TCG website?
    We’re not responsible for that ourselves, but we’ll mention it to the web team again.

  83. There were 94 cards in the Japanese gym1 and will be 132 in English, does this mean WotC is making new cards? Or just taking cards from gym2?
    Gym: Heroes is basically a combination of Gym 1 & 2 from Japan.

  84. Will ancient Mew be “deck usable”?
    I don’t know, though I would think it would just cause confusion as to the translation and stuff.

  85. Will Wizards ever release an entire set of cards that are different from a Japanese set?
    The chance of that is fairly slim, but anything’s possible.

  86. What if you put a Double Colorless energy on Ditto. What kind of energy does it produce?
    Two energy of any type.

  87. Has there been any other sets confirmed to be made by Wizards beyond Gym Heroes and Villains?
    Nothing that we’ve heard about here.

  88. If you have a Clefable and your opponent is a Ditto, and you have only one energy attached to it, can you use Metronome to use Minimize?
    Yes, you can. Sorry 'bout that one…that question just about caused a brain hemorrhage.

  89. What if you sent the receipt in from the 1st movie sound track, but didn’t get a Jigglypuff card?
    Hope that Atlantic records someday sends you a Jigglypuff. (sigh!)

  90. Will the master trainer showdown be held aboard a boat, or is the Queen Mary a place?
    The Queen Mary, as I understand it, is a decommissioned luxury liner that is now used for conventions and stuff.

  91. Has it been determined whether WotC will have Preconstructed Gym Leader decks?
    Yes, we will, though I still don’t know how close to the original Japanese Pre-con decks these will be.

  92. I am sure that DCE cannot be used to count for any specific energy like 2 water energy. Is this true?
    Well, not entirely, when a DCE is used on certain Pokémon it can sometimes count for 2 Fire energies, for instance.

  93. Are there going to be Pokémon TCG Promotions at the all-star Baseball game?
    No, Mike and I have not heard anything about that.

  94. Will you ever have the birthday Pikachu or flying Pikachu?
    I think it’s a possibility, but we really don’t have any details about it.

  95. Is there an exact date for the league to begin over here in the UK? I know it’s in the August, but when exactly?
    We don’t know the exact date, have you contacted our office in the UK?

  96. How do I get badges in the Pokémon TCG league?
    You go to the Leagues and earn points by playing Pokémon, trading cards, completing sets and other activities.

  97. Will Ancient Mew be double holofoil?
    Let me see, yes, it’s holo on the back and the front.

  98. What does the suprise thunder of Dark Raichu?
    Surprise Thunder: Flip a coin. If heads, flip another coin. If the second coin is heads, this attack does 20 to each of your opponent’s Benched Pokémon. If the second coin flip is tails, this attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent’s Benched Pokémon. (Don’t apply Weakness and Resistance for this attack)

  99. Would you say that an energy removal deck is good against a Haymaker or not?
    Energy removal decks are not very successful against the new school Haymakers. The ones that use the movie promo Mewtwo.

  100. What is the advantage of a 4 basic energy type deck?
    There’s no advantage on it’s own, but if you use a wide variety of Pokémon with the 4-color energy supply, you will often have a good Pokémon for several different situations.

  101. How old is the oldest person you know that plays the Pokémon TCG?
    A grandma called me on the Game Support line the other day that was 73…and yes, she knew how to play!

  102. Is there rule for Pokémon that allows the opponent to shuffle each others deck before starting the game. because people I play with stack their deck and they don’t allow me to even cut their deck.
    I don’t know if there is a specific rule on that (I’ll check for next week) but I would assume that they would at least have to shuffle it in front of you or cut their deck.

  103. Are the only basic energy cards the following: Fire, Water, Psychic, Fighting, Grass, and Electric?
    Correct.

  104. Pardon me, but if Pokémon is supposed to be just for fun and not for hard competition then why do you guys have leagues?
    Leagues serve other purposes too. Like providing a place for people to gather and play and helping people learn how to play the game.

  105. Could I use base set energy burn on a double colorless than use Team Rockets Charmander gather fire to move to it than evolve it to dark Charizard with Pokémon breeder and then could I use its fire ball attack and would I only flip once for it?
    Nope, Gather Fire will only be able to move one Fire energy and the DCE counts as 2 after you Energy Burn it.

  106. If you attach plus power to your active Pokémon and retreat it is it discarded?
    No but it only lasts until the end of the turn.

  107. I have heard allot about the League, and is it true that the games are timed? If so, how long do you get to play one game?
    That would be up to the individual location. I’ve not heard of league games being timed.

  108. If my Pokémon use Agility and get heads then on my opponents tern he benches his Pokémon does that end and if that Pokémon was knock would agility be still their for the next Pokémon that he sends up.
    Since the Agility Attack references Rapidash, only benching or evolving him ends the effect.
    Also since it only refers to Rapidash it would still be effect if the other player benched.

  109. Is Tentacool and Alakazam a good damage removing strategy via Pokémon powers moving 20 damage to Tentacool then removing him from play then playing him again then repeating it until all damage is gone?
    Yup, saw someone use that at the Seattle Mall Tour. Good idea.

  110. What do I do when I use an Energy Retrieval, do I discard the card do I trade to the discard pile or put in my deck?
    You trade it to your discard pile (essentially discarding it) to pull 2 basic energy from the discard pile to your hand.

  111. Has Wizards stopped producing those Dark Raichus?
    Nope, still in print (since Rocket is).

  112. Can you lay a energy that’s basic and another that isn’t on the same turn?
    Nope.

  113. What exactly is info on the misprint Dark Dragonite?
    It’s on our web site at www.wizards.com/Pokémon/rocketerrors.asp

  114. How many of the Misprint Dark Dragonites were made?
    Don’t have exact numbers but not a lot.

  115. Are there any plans for a STS Qualifier Tournament in the Omaha, NE, area?
    Not that I am aware of (though schedules are still in the works).

  116. I’m not from Canada, but people I know from there want to know, will there be a Canadian Mall Tour?
    It all depends on whether there are any malls in Canada that want to run it.

  117. If NP Persia is #17, who are 18? 19?
    They have not been announced yet.

  118. Can you use the Trainer Pokémon Breeder to evolve a Basic Pokémon into a Dark Stage 2 Pokémon?
    Sure.

  119. This is just a comment, last week you said Gym cards may have text different than the Japanese versions to limit abuse. Please don’t. If there is a combo too powerful, restrict the cards. I have a feeling some cards would be messed up if text is change?
    We usually only make minor changes at most.

  120. Can you use the attack Call for Family just to shuffle your deck?
    If you have one of the Pokémon in you deck you must put it on the bench. If you don’t (even if you know you don’t), you could still use the attack, look and not find the card, and then shuffle your deck.

  121. If you have a Kangaskhan in play and want to retreat it (retreat cost of 3) and the only energy you have on it is 2 double colorless energy cards, what happens?
    You would have to remove both DCE’s.

  122. Why doesn’t Wizards hold the STS in Seattle? It would be easier for you and me guys!
    We like to travel. Also LA is a larger local market.

  123. Can you use cards that let you search for Pokémon (like Pokeball) to get a Dark Pokémon?
    Sure.

  124. My opponent’s active Pokémon is Vulpix, on his turn he attaches Clefairy Doll to Vulpix and says Clefairy Doll will “shield” Vulpix (take all damage) from my next attack. Is this correct?
    Not at all. You cannot attach Clefairy Doll to any Pokémon.

  125. Are adults allowed to join the Pokémon TCG League?
    Generally, yes.

  126. What time does the STS start?
    Start time of 10 am on July 22nd.

  127. Is there an upper age limit for Pokémon Tournaments?
    It depends, the STS has 3 ages groups, 10 and under, 11-14, and 15 and up.

  128. Since there’s players coming from all across the US, and even from Europe as well, wouldn’t the STS be the perfect time for DCI sanctioning? And it’s not going to be? is that for sure?
    The STS is very closely tied in with the Pokémon League, which is NOT a DCI sanctioned event. Since many of the players coming have not ever taken part in an actual sanctioned event it was deemed that it would be too intrusive to do so. However, we will be following the DCI floor rules and judge system to help maintain a fair and fun tournament for all.

  129. Dark Charmeleons attack states that the attack may only be used if any fire energy is attached. Does this mean that Rainbow energy doesn’t work?
    No, Rainbow energy can count as fire energy.

  130. Were you 2 (Mike, Pat) at each of the STSQ’s? One of the ‘Red shirts’?
    Nope, we only made it to the Seattle Sea-Tac Mall Tour and were gunslingers. We were not involved the in Pre-Q’s.

  131. If you have two different basic Pokémon on your bench, can you evolve them both on the same turn (assuming it’s not their first turn on your bench)?
    Sure.

  132. If Dark Charizard is confused, and it’s tails and does 20 to itself, it doesn’t discard any energy right?
    Correct.

  133. Anytime during a battle, is you, or your opponent allowed to shuffle your deck?
    NO!

  134. I am a gym leader at Toys R Us how can we get information on having a league tournament.
    If you are looking to run a sanctioned event, we have the submission process on our web site.

  135. I got a base 2 booster with no rare. I know Wizards does not guarantee a rare in every pack, So I was wondering, is this common?
    Not particularly. If you are unhappy, mail the booster and the cards to the address on the package (attention: Product replacement) explained what happened, and once we receive it we will send you out a replacement.

  136. Here is an idea! After the Space Weedle, make an Experience Pikachu Project. Hey, why not just make a mini Pokémon Seattle Center?
    Hmmm, I like your way of thinking.

  137. Can you move 40 damage to Mr. Mime with Damage Swap and will it be prevented?
    Mr. Mime’s Invisible Wall only protects against attack damage, not damage moved there from a Pokémon Power.

  138. Earlier I asked about the fire energy only on Dark Charmeleon. If Rainbow Energy works, then what is the card referring too?
    It is worded that way so the other player could NOT Metronome that attack without fire energy (or a rainbow energy) being attached to the Clefable/Clefairy.

  139. Let’s say I have a promo Eevee and I go second. On my opponents second turn he evolves a Pokémon can I evolve Eevee?
    Sure.

Ok gang, gotta go! It was fun as usual to talk with you all! See you next week!

Thurs. July 6, 2000 - Weekly Pokemon TCG Q&A

Pokémon Online Help
Offered every Thursday 3-5 PST in the TCG Forum of the Wizards.Community chat site!
Featuring Master_Trainers from Customer Service

Thurs. July 6, 2000

Hey gang! Welcome to the new 3-5 PST Pokémon chat!
Master Trainer Pat is out so you’ll just have to put up with me alone!
First though, the announcements.

Fresh from R & D are the announcements:

First, How does Agility and Dark Wartortle Mirror Shell interacts? Agility does NOT prevent Mirror Shell from happening, as it does NOT refer to the Defending Pokémon when this attack is done.

Secondly, someone asked if there is a shuffling rule for Pokémon. Normally you follow the DCI rules, which allow you to shuffle or cut your opponent’s deck.

Thirdly, a definition that may help with future rulings. Any card that provides Energy is considered an Energy card of the type it provides. So if you were to Energy Burn a DCE, it counts as a Fire Energy card that provides 2 fire Energy until the end of the turn. So it could be gathered by Team Rocket Charmander but would only provide 1 coin flip for the Continuous Fireball attack on Dark Charizard. As for the Eevee Chain Reaction questions, R & D is still researching into the “Counts as Evolving” rule. So hopefully we will have answers on it in the future. We have heard all about the concern for some upcoming Pokémon cards such as Team Rocket Trap, Chaos Gym, and Team Rocket Zapdos. Rest assured that we are aware of your concerns and are looking into them. Lastly I wanted to thank all of you who have contributed to the Space Weedle project so far. I have received 115 Weedles so far and more are coming in every day. I also wanted to thank Tyais for helping get the word out for the Space Weedle. Many of the cards coming in have the Pokegym on them in support of his site. If you want to contribute and be a part of Pokémon history, please send your extra Weedle cards to Master Trainer Mike c/0 Customer Service Wizards of the Coast PO Box 707 Renton, WA 98057. Be sure to sign your name on the cards so all can see how you took part in this fun project. Now, on with the questions

  1. Will there be a second Pokémon league after this one ends?
    Yup yup! No details available yet though (sorry).

  2. What is going to be the next Pokémon League Promo card?
    Dunno! Eevee right now, nothing to announce (yet).

  3. What other events will happen at the STS instead of the tourney?
    Well, there will be a King of the Hill tournament, gun slinging against WOTC’s best Pokémon Masters, a place to get your picture in front of a Giant Pokémon card (I’m hoping for Weedle), and other side events as well.

  4. For Venomoth when it uses its “Shift,” how do you know what its Weakness is? Or do you count that?
    Its weakness remains the same, which is to Fire.

    That would be the Gym: Heroes set coming out in August.

Thurs. July 13, 2000 - Weekly Pokemon TCG Q&A

Pokémon Online Help
Offered every Thursday 3-5 PST in the TCG Forum of the Wizards.Community chat site!
Featuring Master_Trainers from Customer Service

Thurs. July 13, 2000

Hey gang! You don’t mind if we start a couple of minutes early do you?
Here are the announcements.

First, an R&D ruling. Team Rocket’s Magickarp and Promo Eeevee’s Chain Reaction can be used the turn those Pokémon come into play. Since they pull an evolution card from your deck instead of playing an evolution card from your hand they are NOT limited to the normal rule of evolution and thusly will also NOT be stopped by Aerodactyl’s Prehistoric Power either.

Here is the latest POSSIBLE East Coast Mall Tour information. Please keep in mind that it is STILL being worked on and thus not finalized.

August 26-27 Troy, MI
Sept 9-10 Townson, MD
Sept 16-17 Cinncinnati, OH
Sept 23-24 Schaumburg, IL
Sept 30-Oct 1 Independence, MO
Oct 7-8 Alpharetta, GA
Oct 14-15 Braintree, MA
Oct 21-22 King of Prussia, PA
Oct 28-29 Nanuet, NY
Nov 4-5 Miami, FL

Some rules information on the main tournament at the upcoming STS. It is a Swiss style tournament. You will earn 3 points for a win (meaning take all 6 prizes, deck him out, or knock out his last Pokémon), 2 points for a draw (anything NOT a win or loss), and 1 point for a loss. When time is called, the player that is playing gets to finish his turn and then the other player gets one last turn. Players will be allowed to use dice instead of coins if they so choose.

If you are late to your match your opponent gets to take one of his prize cards, if you are more than 5 minutes late, the gets 2 prize cards, and you forfeit if you are 10 or more minutes late to your match. Matches will still be 20 minutes long and there will be 15 minutes between matches to finish up, learn your next match pairing and get settled for the next match.

Lastly, the judges will all be trained and ready to help keep this a fun event for all, unsportsmanlike conduct and stalling will be dealt with accordingly (from a warning to a lost prize card to a game loss to a DQ). Please keep in mind that these rules may vary somewhat at the match but these are basically as it will be.

And finally, I want to thank all of the folks who have sent in their Weedles to be a part of the Space Weedle (Thank you to Tyais for helping to get the word out on the Pokegym as well). I’ve received over 250 so far and if we keep getting more then we may have to build more than one Space Weedle as well. If you want to be a part of the Space Weedle project, please sign the front of your extra Weedle cards and mail them to Master Trainer Mike c/o Customer Service Wizards of the Coast PO Box 707 Renton, WA 98057.

Ok, I’ll give you a minute to digest all of that. Master Trainer Pat is away at Origins this week so its just me once again.

  2. When a confused Pokémon flips tails for an attack, is it considered the defending Pokémon? More specifically, do PlusPower and Defender affect the damage done?
