Thurs. July 13, 2000 - Weekly Pokemon TCG Q&A

Pokémon Online Help
Offered every Thursday 3-5 PST in the TCG Forum of the Wizards.Community chat site!
Featuring Master_Trainers from Customer Service

Thurs. July 13, 2000

Here’s today’s announcements: First, the scoring for the STS is as posted on our website, _not_ as MT Mike told you last week. Rest assured he has fewer donuts today as a result.

Sorry 'bout that, slight 'bit o trouble with the mic today.

Second, there has been a slight change to the rules regarding when time is called at the end of a round. When time is called, the current active player will finish his or her turn and that will end the round. Previously, it was written that there would be a chance for the inactive player to have one more turn as well.

Finally, as many of you already know MT Mike, myself and a very dedicated group of friends (who put up with our hair-brained ideas) worked until the wee(dle) hours of the morning to complete the Space Weedle Project.

So, I imagine you’re loaded with question pertaining to the STS and promo cards we haven’t released yet. So let’s go.

  1. Will the Gym Heroes Prerelease Tournament Promo be available at all Pokémon league locations?
    It will not. The list of Pre-Release locations is on our website.

  2. Will all three-age categories be playing at the same time at the STS? Will the Legendary Birds promo cards be legal to play at the STS?
    Yes, to the first. No, on the second. Because the Legendary Birds should _not_ have been released yet officially, by this weekend.

  3. If your opponent has no benched Pokémon and you use Pigeot’s Hurricane attack; will you win immediately due to the empty bench rule?
    Yes, you can.

  4. If an opponent’s Dark Wartortle used Mirror Shell, and I attach a PlusPower to my active Pokémon, does the PlusPower damage get reflected back to me too or just the normal attack damage?
    Mirror Shell will reflect the total amount of damage done to Wartortle due to the attack. I’m going to hold off for a few minutes on the evolution on the first turn questions; we’re trying to pin down an answer from R&D at the moment.

  5. Will there be an East STS in NJ?
    That’s still up in the air, I have some tentative dates, but I really don’t want to say anything yet.

  6. As R & D believes now, is it POSSIBLE to EVOLVE on the FIRST turn? For example, you ruled that a Pokémon Revived would be allowing the turn it comes into play. Does this mean that if I discard my Squirtle in my hand (from Computer Search), Revive the Squirtle, and play Pokémon Breeder (ALL on my first turn), I would be able to evolve the Revived Squirtle to Blastoise? Please clarify.
    It is not possible to evolve on the first turn.

  7. You ruled that Team Rocket’s Magikarp can be used the turn those Pokémon come into play. Does that mean that if I had played TR Magikarp down on the first turn of the game, I could evolve him (I know that this is not possible, i.e., I cannot get 3 [W] Energy on Magikarp but if we ignore this limitation)? Would it be possible since Rapid Evolution ignores the normal evolution rule?
    Yes, if you could get three water energy on TR Magikarp

  8. When Mirror Shell’s recoil refers to the “defending Pokémon”, does that mean the opponent currently in the active slot or does it mean the one that was defending at the time the Mirror Shell was invoked?
    The ‘defending’ Pokémon that means the one that is defending at that time.

  9. Do you have any info on the UK league?
    No info that you cannot get from Wizards UK.

  10. Is there a DIFFERENCE between the normal evolution rule and how one’s Pokémon must be in play for at least one turn before evolving?
    Scyre, you’re going to have to be more clear with your question. I don’t understand where you’re going
    With this.

  11. Im asking this question for a friend: any info about the Pokémon league in Isreal?
    Sorry, I really don’t know anything about the Pokémon League in Israel.

  12. If you go to Pokémon the movie 2000 tomorrow and don’t get any cards can you get them in any way?
    You’ll want to get them at the theater because they’ll only give them out while supplies last.

  13. If they don’t give you one, ask for one.
    Can you tell us if the Sedra promo mentioned last week is a prerelease?

So NO Pokémon can evolve, at all, by ANY means, on the first turn OR the turn they come into play?
Not quite. I’ll let MT Mike post something about it, as I’m sure you’re all curious to hear how R&D ruled.

Here is the latest ruling from R&D on the whole evolution question.

First, Ditto CANNOT evolve whether he is a copy of TR Magickarp or promo Eevee as it states on Ditto he cannot evolve and so that takes precedence. Second, Clefairy/Clefable COULD evolve if you Metronomed an attack tat in effect evolves a Pokémon like TR Magickarp’s Rapid Evolution. This is of course, assuming that you have a Gyarados in your deck. Third, the whole Revive a Pokémon and then evolve it in one turn has been ruled NOT possible.

Basically REGARDLESS of how a Pokémon is brought into play; it CANNOT be evolved normally on that turn (meaning you play an evolution card from your hand). You COULD Revive a TR Magickarp, Rain Dance 3 water energy on it, switch it up as the Active Pokémon and then use its Rapid Evolution attack to pull a Gyarados from the deck and place it on the Magickarp. This is allowed as you are NOT normally evolving the Pokémon but using an attack to do so.

Lastly, it is possible for you to have a Pokémon evolve BEFORE your 2nd turn but NOT on your first turn. An example: your opponent plays first, on your turn you play or already have promo Eevee out. On his second turn he evolves a Pokémon, you could now use promo Eevee’s Chain Reaction to pull out an evolution card and put it on Eevee. This is BEFORE your second turn but AFTER your first turn.

OK, I know you’ll have tons of questions for us about this, but please try to read through MT Mike’s post before questioning us on it.

  1. If an attack that Knocks Out Dark Gyarados also Paralyzes him, does he get to use his Final Beam or not? I’ve gotten conflicting in past chats. Dary Gyarados SHOULD be able to do Final Beam because Pokémon Powers are applied BEFORE attack effects such as paralysis right?
    Final Beam will go off before Paralysis is applied.

  2. Who is the winner for Week 10 of the Win A Trip to the STS?
    You’d have to find out from the website, sorry.

  3. When energy that has been transformed by a Pokémon or Pokémon Power, such as Ditto or Energy Burn, is transferred to another Pokémon, when does it revert to its original type?
    That depends how it was changed. For instance, Energy Burns changes energy to Fire energy until the end of the turn.

  4. What are the promos #18 and #19 gonna be?
    They have not told us yet, so it must be good.

Also, we confirmed some plans to have a follow-up season to the Pokémon League after season 8 is finished.

This Final season will be called ‘Victory Road’ and it will give trainers who got a late start at earning their badges a chance to earn the ones that they missed. We’ve also found out that during “Victory Road” trainers will have a chance to earn a Cool Porygon. Earning one will not be a walk in the park however, as it will take quite a few points to get. Furthermore, as I’m sure you’re all wondering, the Cool Porygon that you can earn during Victory Road is _exactly_the same as the one that was included with the Nintendo 64 bundle packs.

  1. How is the Misty’s Seadra obtained? Does it take the slip from the movie promo? Or can it be Gotten though the league/.
    The Misty’s Seadra can be obtained by doing a League activity that involves translating the Ancient Mew that you will be able to get at the movie.

  2. Will the ancient Mew card be playable? All advertisements I have seen say yes.
    Yes, it is playable, though you _must_ use opaque backed card sleeves if you use it in your deck. That’s so that you can’t tell what card you’re drawing due to Ancient Mew’s distinctive back.

  3. Will Chaos Gym be in Gym Heroes?
    Yes…don’t even think about it though…grin.

  4. When figuring weak/resist for DkWartortle’s Mirror Shell recoil, does this mean to use the weak/resist of the attacking Pokémon or from the Dk.Wartortle? Scenario: after a MirrorShell, MP Mewtwo does 40 damage to D.W.; does Mewtwo get 40 or 80 damage?
    Use the weakness/resistance from the Pokémon that is being attacked. In your scenario MP Mewtwo would take 40 damage from a water Pokémon.

  5. Aside from our decks, will we need to bring our own damage counters, coins, and stuff like that to the STS or will any of that stuff be provided?
    Trainers should always be prepared. Bring along whatever you need to play.

  6. Someone posted a whole list of Gym Heroes cards on Poke Gym message boards. Is that list real?
    I can’t say because I haven’t checked it really closely.

  7. Any new bannings/restrictions
    Nope.

  8. Is Sabrina’s Slowpoke gonna be in Gym: Heroes?
    I’m not going to continue commenting on what is or isn’t in Gym: Heroes. There should be a special in an upcoming issue of Top Deck.

  9. Could you please explain the 4 Japanese Gym sets? (How they were obtained, what cards etc.)
    I’ve heard how they were released but I really don’t want to over it, because it was very different from the way we think of releasing card sets. By that I mean that there was not one date when the whole set was released. It was done a little at a time through PCD’s and boosters and the whole Gym series itself was spread out among several sets and release dates.

  10. Do you know anything else about the prerelease tournament?
    Only that it will be limited to 36 people per location, you’ll start with a PCD and 2 boosters (which you can use to change you PCD if you want) and that it will not be happening at all League locations.

  11. What is the season 8 promo?
    MT Mike is on the case; we’ll have an answer for you soon.

  12. When a Pokémon power says once during your turn, does it mean you could only use it once or you could use it once every turn?
    Well, ‘once during your turn’ would seem to me to mean only during ‘your’ turn.

  13. If you use Dark Jolteon’s Lightning Flash, and your opponent’s active Pokémon faints, or they switch it, will they still have to flip a coin to see if the attack works?
    No, benching or evolving the defending Pokémon will end the effect.

  14. What is the promo card you get for completing the ad in the movie promo pack?
    If you mean the one printed on the cards, I believe that will be Misty’s Seadra, but I’ll let Mike give you the answer when he shows up in a few minutes. He’s off trying to track down the defacto answer.

  15. Can basic energy attached to Ditto be treated as non-basic energy?
    Nope, that’d be nice though, huh?

  16. Is Ancient Mew able to use in the Pokémon League?
    Yes, in fact, at the Leagues there will be some activities to translate the actual text of Ancient Mew.

  17. If I have a Ditto as my active, and the opponent has a paralyzed ditto as his, what is the Ditto? The ditto would transform and the power would be disabled, but when he demorphed, he can change back.
    Why would your unparalyzed Ditto not copy your opponent’s?
    Ditto will not copy effects of attacks on your opponents active Pokémon.

More news for you and a correction.

When you go to the movie starting July 21st you will get an Ancient Mew card (while supplies last). This will also come with an ad card that sends you to your local Pokémon League to get the special Ancient Mew play mat which also helps you learn the translation of Ancient Mew. You do NOT earn any extra promo cards with this. The Ancient Mew is your promo card.

Starting July 28th, they will be giving away the 3 legendary birds promo cards at the theater (again while supplies last). There will be an ad card that comes with them that sends you to your local Pokémon League. If you complete that ad card you can get a Misty’s Seadrea promo card from the league. You will also be able to earn a Mistys’ Seadra during Season 8 of the Pokémon League by completing one of the League activities. Season 8 of the Pokémon League (starting August 5th in most locations) will also give you the opportunity to earn promo # 18, the Team Rocket’s Meowth promo card. You can get a point grid sticker put into your book and you can earn up to copies of this card, 1 at 250 points, and 1 at 500 points (just like the promo Eevee was done this season).

Also, more new for the league. After Season 8 ends, the Victory Road Season starts. For those of you who won’t have earned all 8 badges yet, you would continue to work on them. If you have earned all 8 of your badges then you get a special Victory Road Point book. You will keep track of your wins and your Gym Leader will verify losses against other League members (trainers) in this book and each match. For a win, you earn a number of points equal to the opponent’s number of badges. For a loss, you would SUBTRACT 1 point. When a Trainer accumulates 20 points in your Victory Road booklet you will receive 1 #20 Promo Psyduck card. When you win 5 games IN A ROW in your booklet, you will receive 1 Cool Porygon promo card (promo #15). Trainers can continue to fill their booklet and/or receive a new one upon completion of the first one for the remainder of the Victory Road season.

We are also working out the details for the second year of the league as well. So be rest assured, it will continue.

  1. Is ancient mew a playable card if you know what it says?
    Yes, but like I said before, you’ll have to use opaque backed card sleeves.

  2. Does ancient mew have a #?
    No, it doesn’t. You can tell it’s a new one though due to the copyright date.

  3. What will the special promo card you get from the puzzle in the legendary birds be?
    That one will lead you to getting Misty’s Seadra. Misty’s Seadra may also be earned in the regular way.

  4. How do you get the three birds jumbo card?
    I believe that’s something that Warner Bros. is doing. I suggest checking their website or asking at one of their stores.

  5. When will Cool Porygon be re-released at the league?
    During ‘Victory Road’ the final season after season #8

  6. Is there a limit to the number of participants in the main event at the STS for each age category? If not, how will you handle a large number of competitors?
    We have a limit as to how many people we can have on the Queen Mary. We will handle as many competitors as we get.

  7. Will ancient mew be legal at the STS?
    Yes, it will. Though if any of you know what the translation is, I don’t really know why you would choose to use it.

  8. What’s gonna be on the Gym Heroes booster packs?
    They’re cool looking’ (almost as cool as Team Rocket, IMHO). The booster’s basically have the Heroes on the front and they’re kind of Rainbow colored. Like a rainbow was hit be a Mack truck.

  9. Can tell us any info on the Gym theme decks?
    I can tell you that the PCD’s will be geared around a specific Hero, similar to the Japanese Gym decks.

  10. Is there going to be another league promo like Eevee before the pre-release Mistys Seadra?
    That one and the TR Meowth.

  11. Will Ancient Mew be playable because the translation I got at pojo.com says it’s not a real card?
    The Ancient Mew is playable.

  12. Can I evolve a dark stage 1 from either basic like dark Charmelelon from base Charmander?
    Yes.

  13. Do you have an official release date for Gym Heroes? Will theme decks be available at the same time? Could we receive 1st Edition boosters at the Prerelease Tournament?
    August 14th. Yes, on the Theme Decks, but no on the 1st ed boosters.

  14. How will ancient mew be packaged? Will it be in a program like the Japanese one?
    Ancient Mew will come packaged just like the movie promos from the last movie.

  15. Do you know about the release date for the Gym Challenge set yet?
    No, I can’t be more specific than October.

  16. On Dodrio’s Pokémon Power, Do I have to pay 1 less for each Dodrio in play?
    Retreat Aid is cumulative, so 2 Dodrio’s on your bench will let you pay 2 less to retreat.

  17. Does rapid evolution get canceled by Aerodactyl?
    No.

  18. If I use rapid evolve. With the tr. Magikarp can I use Icebeam on the same turn with Gyarados?
    No, Rapid Evolution is an attack. That would be your attack for that turn.

  19. If you use Dark Jolteon’s Lightning Flash and the opponent’s active Pokémon faints, or they switch Pokémon, will they still have to flip a coin to see if their new Pokémon can attack?
    Nope.

  20. Does the Promo Eevee, using its Pokémon Power evolve during your opponent’s turn, if your opponent is the one who evolves, or do you wait until your turn?
    Yes, on your opponent’s turn (if they evolve something.)

  21. Will there be 2 versions of Ancient Mew like there was in Japan?
    No, not that I know of.

The URL for this petition is pokegym.thedojo.com/ubb/Forum11/HTML/001585.html Thanks
    Your plug has been posted. Whether that will increase the chances of you getting an East Coast stop or not, I don’t know.

  23. What are you planing to do with Imakuni’s Dodou and Chansey?
    Sorry, no plans yet.

If I can recall correctly, DCI rules state that if WotC in English has PRODUCED a Pokémon card are only allowed to be in decks. The Bilingual Exeggutor was produced by Media Factory. So it WOULDN’T be allowed in tournament decks then, right? You’ve given different answers in the past so please give a right one today.
    If it wasn’t produced by Wizards, it would not be legal. I have not seen one with my own eyes, so I can’t tell you for sure who produced it.

  25. Last week, MTM ruled that if you REVIVED a Pokémon (maybe a Pokémon that was discarded to pay the cost of Computer Search), you could evolve the turn that you play it. Does this INCLUDE the FIRST TURN? In other words, by Reviving a Pokémon, can I evolve it on the turn it is played, INCLUDING the 1st turn?
    MT Mike has recanted that in his earlier statements.

  26. When will the Ancient Mew play mat and the Misty’d Deadra card be released?
    Starting July 21st League locations should start getting those.

  27. Second turn, I revive a Pokémon; can I immediately evolve it? Is this official yet?
    No.

  28. How come they’re aren’t any new transcripts on your site?
    They take awhile to get posted.

  29. Is Wizards still planning to put out those damage dice?
    No, we won’t be making those at this time.

  30. Okay, say I have a Venomoth in play and a Hitmonchan, and I shift into Fighting, and then Hitmonchan is knocked out, if I were to put another Venomoth into play, could I shift it to fighting because of the first Venomoth?
    Yes, you can.

  31. Does Swords Dance go away if Scyther is benched?
    Yes,

  32. Will there be continued activitys at the league after the 8th badge?
    Yes, the final season will be called Victory Road.

    No.

  35. Is the Ancient Mew that your giving away printed backwards cause its backwards on the commercial and is it holofoil all over like Ancient Mew?
    No, but it is holo on the front and foily on the back.

That will bring us to a close for this week, I hope we got to the important questions for the STS and any other issues that needed resolving. We’ll see you next week, unless of course you’ll be at the STS. In which case, we’ll see you on Saturday. Bye.

Thurs. July 27, 2000 - Weekly Pokemon TCG Q&A

Pokémon Online Help
Offered every Thursday 3-5 PST in the TCG Forum of the Wizards.Community chat site!
Featuring Master_Trainer from Customer Service

Jul 27,2000

Hello everybody! MT Mike gets to be ‘Sir Not Appearing in this Film’ this week because he left for a sports card show in Anaheim, Ca yesterday. So MT Galen’s going to pitch in and help out with the questions today.

A big congratulations goes out to West Coast STS Champions: Joseph Viray(10 and under), Jack Savage (11-14) and Andrew Marshall(15 and up). I also wanted to thank everyone who showed up and made this event such a success, especially those of you who were there that made a point to stop and say hello to MT Mike, Da Boss Mike or myself.

MT Mike and myself were very disappointed that the Space Weedle did not make it off the plane with us in LA. The airlines did return it to us undamaged on Monday morning when we got back to Seattle. Hopefully, we will be able to bring it along to another event later this year.

  1. Has Wizards got the rights to print Neo?
    Not yet…still waiting on that.

  2. Any scoop on the 15-trainer stipulation?
    That’s just a self-imposed restriction we’ve been testing here in our offices. We’re just seeing what we can come up with inside that limit that will be a tough deck to beat.

  3. What is an opaque card sleeve?
    An opaque card sleeve is one that has a backing you cannot see through…common opaque are red and/or black

  4. Is Imposter Oaks Revenge banned from the league?
    Nope

  5. Will there be a secret card in Gym Heroes?
    We don’t know…don’t think so

  6. What is promo #19?
    I don’t think we can announce that one yet, sorry.

  7. What are promos between 17 and 21?
    17: Dark Persian, I think, 18: TR Meowth, 19? , 20: Misty’s Seadra?

  8. Regarding Gym Heroes Tournament on Aug.5. As of 7-26 WotC Santa Monica, Ca. is on the list but knows nothing, WotC Montclair, Ca. is NOT on the list & says they are doing it but have no info and Hall of Fame Sports in Redlands, Ca. is on the list but
    Have the stores call our merchant services department by calling our customer service line

  9. Will gym heroes prerelease tournaments be at league stores nationwide, or just at stores in certain parts of the country?
    The Gym Heroes Prerelease will be help and a game or hobby store near you.

  10. So, after reading R&D’s ruling from last week, the only way a Pokémon can evolve on the first turn is through either Eevee’s Chain Reaction of TR Magikarp’s Rapid Evolution? Otherwise, the normal “Pokémon must be in play for at least one turn” is still in effect?
    Yes, essentially, though I don’t know a single way you could do TR Magikarp’s Rapid Evolution on the first turn.

  11. What did you think of the reaction of 1 guy at the STS who ripped a guy’s hat made of Pokémon cards?
    Different strokes for different folks I guess…we don’t condone that kind of behavior to be sure.

  12. If a Promo Eevee is against a Ditto, can the Ditto us the power just to look through his/her deck without evolving?
    Nope. Ditto can’t evolve, so can’t even do that.

    None yet…we are still firming up dates

  14. Is there anyway, or will there be any way, to get the Nintendo Power promos in the UK?
    I don’t know, I imagine I you could get Nintendo Power there that you could.

  15. Will you be at the East Coast STS?
    We will be there.

  16. If Movie Promo Mewtwo attacks with Energy Absorption, and one of the cards attached from the discard pile is Rainbow Energy, that energy does not do any damage to Mewtwo (since the card was not played from the hand) but can still be consider Psychic energy? You’ve given different answers in different chats in the past and I’ll like a correct ruling on this one.
    Yes, no damage from doing that and the energy can count as whatever type (basic type) you want.

  17. Is the promo Misty’s Seadra the same as the Misty’s Seadra that will be appearing in Gym Heroes?
    Yes…it will just say “prerelease” on the card. That would make us believe that there will not be a promo number for Misty’s Seadra.

    Dunno, that was the decision from Creatures though.

    With Gym 1 there will be approximately 600 cards or so give or take.

  20. Last week you made a reversal on whether Dk Gyarados’ Final Beam power works or not if the attack that knocks him out also paralyzes him. Thanks from TEAM COMPENDIUM.
    We really do try to be consistent with this stuff, but sometimes… Yes, Final Beam works in this situation.

  21. Are it true Gym Heroes will be released on August 7th; if so is it at only Wizards retailers as in Wizard stores themselves and Gamekeeper?

  22. If Clefable Metronomes MagiKarp’s Rapid Evolution, would it be legal to evolve it into Gyrados? My guess is no.

    Yeah we are trying to implement restrictions that might make the game more balanced…that is one of the suggestions. We don’t make the rules, but I do believe that something should be done to broaden the types of decks that are competitive.

    Because they shouldn’t be getting those until July 28th.

  25. Are there plan for a promo Lugia card?
    Not at this time I’m afraid.

  26. Is Chaos Gym in Gym heroes?
    I sure don’t see it…but I haven’ t had a chance to check through all the cards yet.

  27. Will the Vending Promos be printed in the future?
    No word on that yet…but probably.

  28. Can using it as a reference card and then using a proxy card in your deck) plays the jumbo card with the 3 legendary birds?

    Dunno.

    Sure.

  32. Just to let anyone know I’m Akira from the Pokégym , we debated the other day about the power of the new gym cards, Hallu/Chaos Gym and Team Rocket’s Trap, and a few things were brought up, #1 - Is there any idea of restricting the number of trainers in a deck to prevent broken combos? #2 Is there ANY hint of banning certain cards? #3 Have you guys at WoTC played around with Team Rocket’s Trap or Chaos gym and actually seen how broken they are? I mean there is a lot of feedback in Japan on these cards as well as us on the Internet in the online leagues on these cards and their overall cheapness
    Certainly this combo is one that started MT Mike and I thinking about such solutions, but R&D has the final say and they are still looking at all options. Like I mentioned earlier, the 15 Trainer limit is something we’ve been trying here, just to see what deck archetypes would come out as being really competitive in that environment.

    Earning points just like you would in the other league

    You do not battle the Gym Leaders typically you are battling the other players in the league to earn points

    Gust of wind is not considered retreating…you couldn’t use pitfall for that

We will definitely take this into account when planning for the East Coast STS and other similar events.

    It should be sold for the same price as any other booster box

    No

  45. For the ancient Mew card can we play it if we put a regular card behind it in a plastic thing so it hides the foil?
    That’s questionable…it would be heavier than the regular cards so in a way that would be like having a marked card which is illegal by DCI standards.

  46. Will the boosters at the RELEASE Gym tournament be editions 1?
    Probably not.

  47. If D. Gyrados got knocked out by D. Golbats power, would it still do final beam?
    No, because Final Beam will only trigger if D. Gyarados is knocked out by an attack.

    That is up to the stores disgression, most stores will have a fee.

  49. How many Stall Decks are around?
    Thousands I bet.

  1. Do you have any new info on Gym Challenge?

    Isn’t it playable in Japan?

    None that we know of yet.

    132 cards.

    Brock’s Zubat is a common. BUT>>>there is a rare Brock’s Zubat, too.

    Let’s hope so.

  10. Has a list of cards in Gym Heroes been released?

    I love poison Pokémon like Dark Muk, and Nidoking Poison rules and much praise unto the “Mysterious Mr. Yuk” deck…

  21. My question was cut off. When should stores have info by regarding the Gym Heroes Tournament?

    Ideally you would be able to work towards your badges at either store.

  25. Where will the East Coast STS be held?
    We’re finalizing plans now, nothing to announce yet. The East Coast qualifiers kick off the weekend of August 26th in Detroit.

  26. What was with STS? Other than the judges, few employees could help on Pokémon questions (or pokey-man as they called it.)
    Keep in mind that many of the people who helped us out with the STS do not deal with Pokémon rules questions on a daily basis like we do here. Just as there are certified judges at a Magic tournament, some people are qualified to make those rulings and some are not. Would you ask someone working registration at a Magic tournament about your latest Pandemonium/Opalescence combo?

  27. What card will I get when I watch the Pokémon Movie 2000 tomorrow?
    Hopefully one of the legendary bird cards.

  28. If I use a Pokémon trade or energy search and there are no energy or Pokémon in my deck, then do I have to show my deck to my opponent?

    Unknown…we hope to though

    Probably as the dark energies haven’t been officially translated yet we will just have to wait and see for sure

  32. How much does it cost to get into the gym hereos tournament?
    It depends on the store you go to.

84.Why don’t you update the FAQ with the Ditto/Rapid Evolution/Chain Reaction rulings?
We’ll ask the web team to. What you need to understand is that we’re not responsible for posting new rulings to the website every week, we do our best to get the message to the departments responsible.

  1. What happens if Mew uses Psywave and the opponent doesn’t have energy on the Pokémon?
    It wouldn’t do any damage.

  2. Will exclusive cards be available only in gym decks like in Japan?
    Not quite.

87.You said promo #20 is Misty’s Seadra, but the other Pre-releases didn’t have a promo #, did u just make a typo?
That was my mistake

  1. Why was the change made form the pattern of the holofoils used on the cards? Why are the holo patterns different from Base 2 on than Base through Fossil?

  2. Will there be another Super Trainer Showdown Tour soon? Me and my friend didn’t get to go to the last one since they tournament locations were scattered too far from us.
    Yes, the qualifiers will kick off August 26th in Detroit

  3. Does Porygon’s Conversion 2 work if I use a pluspower?
    Plus power only deals more damage if damage can be done…plus power attached to an attack that does no damage would be useless it wouldn’t do any damage.

  4. Can we use one of the Legendary Bird Cards for playing?
    Yes but not the extra large ‘three-birds’ cards.

  5. Will the ‘Pokémon The Fist Movie’ CD Promo Jigglypuff be available through the League any time soon, or is there no way this card can ever be earned again?
    We don’t know don’t think so no plans at this time.

  6. How come space Weedle and you guys weren’t at the super trainer showdown?

MT Mike and myself were very disappointed that the Space Weedle did not make it off the plane with us in LA. The airlines did return it to us undamaged on Monday morning when we got back to Seattle. Hopefully, we will be able to bring it along to another event later this year.

  7. What other ideas are you guys currently jostling to make the metagame more balanced?
    Another idea that has been proposed is making a ‘minimum’ of basic Pokémon necessary for each deck. What are your feelings on that? I don’t think that that would open up as many new strategies as the other, trainer’ limit idea.

  8. How much HP does Ancient Mew have?
    You’re going to have to work at figuring that out yourself. I can tell you that Ancient Mew’s attack costs 2 Psychic energy.

  9. Will Gym 2 be legal at the East STS?

Thurs. Aug 3, 2000 - Weekly Pokemon TCG Q&A

Pokémon Online Help
Offered every Thursday 3-5 PST in the TCG Forum of the Wizards.Community chat site!
Featuring Master_Trainers Mike and Pat from Customer Service

Hey Pokémon hardcores! Not much new to announce this week, but MT Mike will be joining me shortly to help answer your? I don’t remember telling you about this so.

There will be a foil-stamped Misty’s Psyduck card with issue #10 of Top Deck magazine. That’s the only new promo to announce so I’ll dig into the questions for this week.

Gym Heroes is missing many cards from the original Gym 1. Do you have any plans to use the missing cards in Gym: Challenge?
Yea, the way it worked out is that the cards from the original sets will be spread out among the two sets

  1. How many of different rarity are in each pack (ex.4 commons 3 uncommons etc.)
    Usually it will be 7 3 1 though one of the commons is energy?

  2. Are you considering errata on the misprinted Team Rocket cards?
    Not that I know of.

  3. When a card’s attack “does damage to itself”, is this damage considered to be an ATTACK against the Defending Pokémon? Let’s say you had an Electabuzz versus a TR Porygon and TR Porygon switched Electabuzz’s Weakness to Lightning. You Thunder punched with Electabuzz and flipped tails. Would Electabuzz receive 10 or 20 damage? Furthermore, would Defender prevent this damage? (Defender prevents damage from attacks).
    Well, assuming it was an attack that did damage to itself then defender would help with that damage.

  4. Have you gained the rights to print the Neo series?
    No word yet. We’re hoping to hear something soon.

  5. Can you use Ancient Mew without an opaque black sleeve?
    Absolutely not.

  6. If an attack Knocks Outs and Paralyzes Gyarados at the same time, would he be able to do Final Beam. The rule book, page 21: “f) … Do any damage first, then do any other effects, and finally, Knock Out…”. However page 22 indicates that you do g) Powers before I) status effects (thus coming to a “yes” conclusion last week). According to page 21, the attack will paralyze Gyarados, disable Final Beam, and then Knock Out Gyarados without him able to do Final Beam. Does “g) relevant Pokémon powers” on page 22 is referring to powers that modify the damage done, not Pokémon Powers which trigger when a Pokémon is Knocked Out?
    The answer has already been ruled on. Dark Gyarados would get off its final beam, as it would take damage and be knocked out BEFORE the attack effect (paralysis) goes into effect. This has been ruled on before and this is the official answer.

  7. Are the boosters at the pre release tournament 1st edition or unlimited
    I’m guessing they’ll be unlimited

  8. What is promo #19?
    We don’t know yet.

  9. How many of different rarity are in each pack (ex. 4 commons 3 uncommons etc.)
    7 common, 3 uncommon, 1 rare one common will be energy

  10. What is the latest status on the 15-trainer rule?
    Still testing

  11. When will league locations get Misty’s Seadra prerelease for legendary bird’s ad?
    I would guess they’ll be getting those within a couple weeks.

  12. Where is the 1st edition symbol on gym hero’s packs and where is the 1st edition symbol on gym hero’s box?
    On the pack it’s in the lower left. I can’t check a box at the moment though

  13. Will there be an East STS Qualifier in NJ?
    I’m not sure all the dates have been finalized yet, though I would imagine there would be one within driving distance of NJ

News from the latest Pokémon meeting (just got back). We are looking into sanctioning the East Coast Mall Tour qualifiers and the East Coast STS. So playing in them will effect your DCI rating if this goes through.

Many people have asked how do you get invited to the Tropical Mega Battle. Simple, the top 12 ranked players between the ages of 10-14 will receive an invitation. This event is happening specifically to interface with Japanese players that are being sent over with Creatures Inc. It is a smaller event and thus will not have qualifiers for it.

There have been lots of questions about any rules changes in the game (like Trainer limits, minimum Pokémon numbers, etc.). Rest assured we are looking into several possible changes for sanctioned tournament structure to help maintain game balance and encourage variety for the game. It will take plenty of time and testing on our part before any such possible changes will most likely occur.

Lastly, one last thank you for all the people who sent in Weedle cards for the Space Weedle. While I was very sorry that it got lost and never made it to the STS, it was returned days later. There are some new pictures of it (and Pat and I) up on my web site at home.earthlink.net/~seawolven/ . We plan on unveiling it to the public now at the East Coast STS instead (and we will ship it so that the airlines can’t lose it again)!

  121. Do you know exactly where the east super trainer showdown will be?
    We have a good idea; we just can’t announce it yet.

  122. If the Tropical Mega Battle for 2000 is next month, then what is going to happen to the folks who win the East Coast STS?
    Ummm, they are really cool?

  123. Does every League location have a Prerelease Tournament?
    No.

  124. Is their any difference between the new energy cards in Gym Heroes and the ones from Base set?
    The Gym energy has a gym expansion symbol on it.

  125. Will Gym Heros and Gym Challenge be allowed at the East Coast STS?
    Most likely yes.

  126. How do I get the promo Arcanine?
    You could have earned that card in season 6 I think, in the league.

  127. Who would get invited to the tropical Mega battle?
    Top 12 rated dci players ages 11-14.

  128. When will the Seadra prerelease card be available?
    Should be out now (some stores will be getting theirs today).

  129. Will you be able to buy packs of Gym Heroes at the pre release tournament?
    Nope.

  130. Will the “Chaos Gym” Gym/Stadium card ever be printed?
    Yes, but it’s not in Heroes…

  131. Is the Gym: Heroes Prerelease tournaments supposed to be played by DCI rules? And are participants allowed to play more than 1 deck during the tournament?
    It should be but it is not sanctioned. You should only play with 1 deck.

  132. I read an “unofficial” Gym Heroes list on PokeGym, and Brock’s Ninetales was missing. Is it likely to be in Challenge instead?
    Maybe.

  133. How many foils are in Heroes?

  135. MTM… how do you feel the West STS went?
    I enjoyed it. More people came than some expected (not me though). We learned lots of things to improve for the next one and I got the chance to meet many of you cool people!

  136. I would have been in the prerelease tournament but he said. Just get there early because the first people there get in, is this how its supposed to run and will some of the prizes be like 10 booster packs of gym or what?
    Normally they should preregister for this event. Prizes are up to them.

  137. If not all league location have a prerelease tournament, why do I call the Wizards help and they say all league location have a Prerelease tournament?
    They were wrong, sorry.

Ok gang, time to go! Pat will be here next week and I will be at Gen Con.
Please be nice to him and I hope I get to meet up with more of you.
Take care!

Thurs. Aug 17, 2000 - Weekly Pokemon TCG Q&A

Pokémon Online Help
Offered every Thursday 3-5 PST in the TCG Forum of the Wizards.Community chat site!
Featuring Master_Trainers Mike and Pat from Customer Service

Hi gang! Back from Gen Con Master Mike and Master Pat are in da house!
But FIRST, a few announcements. There will be an East Coast Mall stop in Miami on Oct 28-29.

It is missing from our web site and it is at the Galleria in Ft. Lauderdale. Also, we are working out the plans for the Gym Challenge Release event and we are looking to add more locations possibly. Lastly, I just wanted to say thank you to all of the people that are still sending in Weedle cards and those of you I had the chance to meet at Gen Con.

  1. At the East Coast STS will the 3 Badge entrance be available still and what is the estimated date for it?
    Sorry but we don’t have any official dates/times/info on the East Coast STS yet. As you know we don’t leak it until it is ready.

  2. Is the east cost STS being held in the meadow lands in NJ?
    Yup.

  3. If you evolve Erika’s Oddish Lv. 12 into Erika’s Gloom and it has a DCE attached, does the DCE stay as Grass energy or revert to being DCE?
    It would revert to a DCE.

  4. If you have an active Ditto, and they have a Lv. 10 Lt. Surge’s Rattata, the Ditto does Focus Energy. Next turn the opponent retreats the Rattata and puts out a Lv. 12 (Base Set) Pikachu. Does the Dittos’ Gnaw attack do 10 or 20 damage?
    It would do 20, yes.

  5. Have you got the Neo rights yet?
    Sorry, nothing to announce yet…

  6. How does the Pokémon Power - Hay Fever effect trainers, more to the point Stadium trainer cards, already in play?
    Once D. Vileplume is in play, no more stadium cards (trainers) can be played. It will not remove the ones in play.

  7. Can we get some official; formally announced rulings posted on Wizard’s site, or better yet, the rulebook? The chat transcripts are a mess, with many questions repeated over and over with different answers. Rulings like on the Metronome are confusion?
    We are working on gathering the info. There is a rules compendium web site put out by some fans tat we are looking to link to for you.

  8. If Ditto transforms into Blastoise can it use Raindance with non-water energy?
    No you can’t. Only water energy from your hand can be rain danced.

  9. The Pokémon league that I go to ran out of TMs, is there a way I can get them?
    They should contact us for replacements.

  10. What kind of Psyduck is promo 18?
    Don’t have info yet sorry.

  11. Where and when is the STS?
    It will be in New Jersey don’t have a date yet.

  12. Which is better base set Squirtle or team rocket Squirtle?
    That would be the Weedle Squirtle!

  13. What was your first Gym Heroes rare?
    Erika’s Clefable.

  14. Is Base Set 3 real?
    Not yet, no.

  15. Any new info on Promos (Pokémon League, etc.)?
    Nothing really new to announce.

  16. Why is Misty’s Psyduck weak to Grass?
    Because she raised it better?

17.For Team Rocket’s Meowth, do you count Meowth and the active Pokémon in play? So Team Rocket’s Meowth does up to 120HP?
Yes, he could.

  1. My friend has a Blastoise card that is missing the word “stage” in the reminder text, how rare is this card, and how did it come to be?
    I don’t know, though it doesn’t sound like a common misprint

  2. Why did you make Misty’s Goldeen rare instead of Seaking?
    Because Misty’s Goldeen was only available in the Japanese PCD’s

  3. Any new info on a Pokémon Movie 2000 Promo Mail in offer like in the Pokémon the First Movie mail in offer?
    Actually I’m not certain whether WB is doing anything like that…you would have to contact them.

  4. If I attach a PlusPower to my Electabuzz, use Thunderpunch and flip tails, does the attack do 40 to the opponent and 20 to me? What about if it’s damage to bench Pokémon?
    Plus Power any does 10 additional to the Defending Pokémon

22.When you use Misty, Starmie swift, do you still have to flip for sand attack?
Nope. Staryu has the Swift attack BTW.

  1. Can you use recall to evolve Gyarados to Dark Gyarados? Then if you use Devo spray which one do you take off?
    I’m assuming you mean use Recall to then take advantage of Rapid Evolution and re-evolve Magikarp. No, you wouldn’t be able to place a Stage 1 on a Stage 1.

  2. What are the chances of T2 and T15 being passed?
    No chance of getting an answer on that right now, sorry.

  3. When and where will the STS be? Someone said the Meadowlands. NJ. What time will it be held at?
    New Jersey, November…no other info yet.

  4. Any info on the Tropical Mega Battle?
    Sure, its August 26-27th. The Tropical Mega Battle is a showcase event for a small number of children +/- 50 to play in sealed and constructed deck tournaments. The tournaments will only use cards from Base Set and Jungle. Media Factory of Japan will produce the event. Children from Japan, United States, Canada, Latin America and Asia will be invited to participate. 42 Players representing 9 countries will attend this event. The top 12 ranking of the DCI age 11-14 category in the US were invited.

  5. Clefable’s Metronome does the defending Pokémon’s attack for one colorless energy. How does this apply for attacks that change with more energy attached? For example, Blastoise’s Hydro Pump does 40 with 3 energy, 50 with 4 and 60 with 5+. Does Clef
    Clefable will do the base damage unless Clefable also has extra water energy attached.

  6. Does Misty’s Staryu’s Swift hit through Scrunch? Transparency? How about Barrier?
    It hits through ALL Pokémon powers or attack effects or weakness or resistance.

  7. Will Cool Porygon be available in the league soon, and how can I get it?
    Yes, you’ll have to have all 8 badges, and then you have win 5 games in a row.

  8. On Blaine’s Quiz #1, when it refers to “either way, return the card to your hand”, is it talking about the Pokémon or the Blaine’s Quiz itself?
    The Pokémon, not Blaine’s Quiz #1

  9. If I use Pokémon trade or Energy Sear and there aren’t any Pokémon or Energy in my deck, do I have to show my deck to my opponent? If there isn’t any in my deck, do I get to put the Pokémon Trader or Energy Search back in my hand either?
    You don’t have to show your deck and you don’t put the trainer back in your hand.

  10. Can players mark the energies in their deck by turning them all upside-down? (kids at my league do)?
    No, all cards should be facing the same way.

  11. Will Gym Heroes cards be allowed at STS qualifying tourneys?
    Yup.

  12. I have 5 Pokémon on my bench, one of which is a Chansey with 110 HP. I put down Narrow Gym; can I return the damaged Chansey to my hand and dump all of the damage counters?
    Sure, you could do that. That will function like a free Scoop Up!

  13. Do you guys know any misprints in Gym Heroes?
    Nope, not yet.

  14. I have some bs1 cards with square corners, haw did this happen, and how rare are they, are they set wide or just the holos?
    I have some of those; they are fairly rare I guess.

  15. Any info on League Season 2?
    Do you mean year 2? Starts in January.

  16. If a card say to shuffle your deck after doing something like putting cards back in your deck but you do did not put any cards in your deck do you still shuffle? Like playing gambler with no cards in your hand?
    Yes, you would?

  17. I hear talk of an error Cool Porygon, is this true if so what is the error?
    I have not heard about any errors on Cool Porygon…

  18. Can you play Blaine’s Last Resort if you have another Blaine’s Last Resort in your Hand? Cause Since it says you can’t use it if you have no cards in your hand other than “Blaine’s Last Resort” and the one in your hand simply bypasses it. If not, Why do you have to state to show your hand when you don’t have any cards in your hand when you play it?
    Yes you can play Blaine’s Last Resort if you have another in your hand.

  19. Will Gym Heroes Cards be allowed at the East Coast STS qualifying tourneys?
    Yes.

  20. Any new info on new Promo Sets, like the 5 Holo Evolution Link Campaign set or the CoroCoro Comic Magazine Promos?
    Nope.

  21. Is Ancient Mew a Mew or Ancient Mew card? IE 4 Mews and 4 Ancient Mews in a deck?
    They have different names so they are different cards.

  22. Let’s say a Zubat attacks a poisoned Pokémon that isn’t weak to Grass. Will it get to remove 10 or 20 damage?
    It would remove 10 damage

  23. This is probably an incredibly silly question, but I can’t find the answer to it anywhere. If an opponent knocks out one of my Pokémon, and they forget to draw a prize, are they entitled to it if they remember later?
    Technically yes. It is the responsibility of BOTH players to make sure everything is done correctly. If you spot it and he forgets you can BOTH get a warning in a tournament if you don’t catch it?

  24. Let’s say a Charizard uses Energy Burn. Then Goop Gas attack is played. Will the energy revert to regular, or will it stay fire, because of the fact that Energy Burn states you use it “once per turn?”
    Yes, it would stop working…Lesson is don’t use Energy Burn before playing Goop Gas

  25. Will there be a White Diamond Chansey in Gym Challenge?
    We don’t do white diamond cards.

  26. Will the rarity symbol on some Gym 2 Cards be changed? For example, Imakuni’s Doduo is a white star (Super Rare). Will it become a Black Star? Also, ____'s Chansey. It’s White Diamond. Will it become Black Diamond?
    We don’t do white diamond cards.

  27. Can you use Promo Eevee’s (30HP) PP when your opponent evolves?
    Yes.

  28. If your opponent uses Tickling Machine, and flips heads, you set your hand aside for 1 turn. If you draw a Prof. Oak and play it, do you have to discard your set-aside hand? Or do you still get to pick the hand up after your turn is over?
    That will be an R&D question, we’ll get back to you on this one.

  29. I went to my local Pokémon card store over a week ago and the had Gym Heroes unlimited packs for 3.99 and 1st edition packs for 7.99. My question is are they allowed to sell the 1st editions for more than 3.49?
    Yes, they are, though I would suggest going someplace else to buy your cards for a better price.

  30. There’s a new Gym card called “Charity” and I’m confused as to how it’s supposed to work. If I attach it, does it reduce all damage done to me down to only 10, or does it only allow me to use my attack for less damage than is stated on the card?
    You attach Charity to your Pokémon; you then return it to your hand at the end of your turn (unless your Pokémon is knocked out). If it is attached, you can lower the amount of damage your active Pokémon (the one with the Charity card) as much as you want. So you could have your Chansey Double Edge and effect a Mr. Mime (by reducing the attack amount to 20).

  31. Why do the American Gym Theme Deck contents are different from the Japanese Theme decks?
    The Japanese Gym sets came out really haphazardly; we release our sets differently.

  32. Why did you change the Damage Counters from cool stone ones to cardboard cutouts?
    Cheaper production costs and many people didn’t understand what to do with the stones (especially with different colors).

  33. Can you evolve Rockets Magickarp using rapid evolution even if Aerodactyl is in play?
    Aerodactyl says: No other Evolution cards can be played. So it wouldn’t stop Rapid Evolution

  34. On my Mistys Poliwag it has an attack of Tail Rap, is it supposed to say Tail Wrap, a misprint?
    Bo, it’s correct, Rap as in to hit something.

  35. Does Ancient Mew have a promo number? And what exactly is #20?
    No it doesn’t, #20 is promo Psyduck

  36. Any new info on Gym 2 Theme Decks?
    Nope, not yet.

  37. How many cards will there be in challenge?

  39. Ok, these Gym Heroes and Gym Leaders expansions are confusing, are all the gym cards in Gym Heroes or only all of the 4 main trainers and some of the rest?
    The Gym Heroes and Gym Challenge sets will have all of the cards that came out in Japan in the 2 Gym Leaders sets as well as the exclusive cards that only came out in their hard to find pcds as well. If you think our Gym sets were confusing, the Japanese sets were a collector’s nightmare.

  40. If a Scyther attacks with Sword Dance, then is knocked out, and you bring up a second Fully Charged Scyther, will it deal 60 or 30? I ask this because of the phrasing of the Sword Dance Attack. It says Scyther on the attack, so does it mean the Scyther that was knocked out or All Scythers?
    It does 30. It means the Scyther that was k.o.'d

  41. Will Scythers swords dance can be used in the next turn even if it went to the bench before attacking?
    Nope, effect ends when Scyther’s benched.

  42. When using Sabrina’s ESP, and re-flipping the coins, can you choose which set of coin flips you wish to use? (The first or the second)
    You take the second results.

  43. Why were the six basic energy cards included in gym heroes?
    Because the other sets will be discontinued soon enough and we still need energy available to the public.

  44. Will people who have just joined the league and not had the chance to earn all their badges be able to get a Cool Porygon promo when it is released?
    You can only attempt to earn one if you have earned all 8 badges.

  45. Will there ever be a super trainer showdown in the mid east or mid west?
    No plans for one at this time.

  46. Couldn’t you have placed the East Coast STS in a more convenient location, like say southern California? Serious question though, do you foresee problems with getting people to attend because of school and not having the ability to miss school?
    It is on the weekend. We haven’t had any troubles with other tournaments before.

  47. When does Victory Road start?
    After season 8. Depends on where you League is at in the schedule.

  48. When or will Gym: Challenge be incorporated into the East Coast STS
    Gym Challenge is out in October, the STS is in November, so yes.

  49. Forgive me if this has gone threw once but my computer went down and I just got back on. Any way here it goes. Will Cool Porygon league promo be just like the N64 promo one, including #?
    Yes.

  50. I have a question regarding Venomoths pokepower Shift. It says once during your turn you may change the type of Venomoth to the type of any other Pokémon in play other than colorless. I was wondering how that works exactly.
    You simply say Venomoth is now a water Pokémon (or your choice). This would effect the other players weakness and if you named it water, you could Raindance water energy onto it.

  51. Are all the gym leader sets in the English packs are just a few?
    The Gym sets have been split into two parts, you’ll find the Heroes intermixed

  52. Why did Wizards make so many easy to get “common” Japanese gym cards rares in America? (I know that they were only available through the gym decks, but so was a Machamp, and he didn’t end up being that much either)
    Guys, you simply cannot compare the Japanese market (much smaller) with the huge US market.
    Yes there are a lot of Machamps out there, there are not a lot of Misty’s Goldeen’s.

  53. Are there any leagues in east MO?
    We do have a lit of all league locations on our web site in the Pokémon area, check it out.

  54. Could you please list promos 17 and up?
    Promos: 17: Dark Persian, 18:TR Meowth, 19:?, 20: Psyduck, 21:Moltres, 22: Articuno, 23: Zapdos

  55. What languages are you planning to produce Pokémon TCG in and when are their approximate release dates?
    It is already out in 12 different languages.

  56. Can I use Blaine’s Last resort if I the only cards in my hand are Blaine’s Last Resorts? It says use only if Blaine’s Last resort is the only card in your Hand.
    Yes.

  57. How do you go about play testing various Tournament formats? Is it all done in-house, or does Wizards sponsor Tournaments where specific rules are tested?
    In house mostly.

  58. Say Gyarados uses Rapid Evo ala Recall. He evolves Gyarados into Gyarados. Which would be the highest evolution card? Both are stage 1s.
    You can’t put a Stage 1 on a Stage 1, sorry.

  59. Would Misty’s Stayu’s (the one that does damage regardless of weak/resist/powers/effects of attack) do damage to a Raichu Rapidsah Seadra Fearow Blaine’s Ponyta that got a heads on agility? Cause agility says prevent all effects of attacks, and the game text of the Staryu’s attack IS an effect. I know this question is a stretch?
    Yes it would still do damage; it ignores the effect from the Agility as stated on the card.

  60. Blaine’s Moltres does its attack. It knocks out Dark Gyarados who gets a heads on final beam. The Moltres gets a tails on its attack. If final beam did enough damage to KO Moltres would Moltres fry or fly into the deck safely?
    We will ask that one to R&D, not sure.

  61. When you start a game and you put your first Pokémon down, do you also put a bench down too right away?
    You can if you want.

  62. Who at Wizards can we contact to find out how the play testing of some of the Propositions are going or do they plan on releasing some kind press release for the DCI sanctioned tournaments?
    We will announce things when we are ready, that’s all, sorry.

  63. Can I just flip a coin with Misty’s duel instead of playing rock paper scissors since r,p,s is an easy target for cheaters?
    It’s up to the person playing Misty’s Duel.

  64. If I have a Clefable out against a Chansey and I use Meteronome and then I use double-edge will I do 80 damage to myself?
    Yes.

  65. Now, I know you’re shying away from Restrictions, but, what do you think will happen to the game. Is it better or worse because of it?
    Because of what? We are testing some possible tournament formats at this time.

  66. Instead of having STS on the East Coast and West Coast why didn’t you all have State Tourneys and then all the 50 winners have a Grand Master Tourney.
    We’ll take that into consideration for next year.

  67. How do you get invited if you’re in Canada for the Tropical Mega Battle?
    The 2 Canadian children have already been invited.

  68. Does swift do 20 damage even if the opponent has a defender attached?
    Misty’s Staryu doesn’t say that it ignores trainers. So I would say yes, but we’ll check on that too.

  69. I don’t attend the league that much because it is at an inconvenient time, is there a way to earn league points on my own time?
    Unfortunately not, though you can earn some league points at the Mall Tours.

  70. Will WOTC ever make a set of it’s own, with All-American cards?
    Who knows?

  71. Can you use Blaines last resort if you have two Blaines last resorts in your hand?
    Yes you can.

  72. On Ditto’s transformation it says that it is the same, as the defending Pokémon but it can’t evolve. Does that mean that if someone has a Charmeleon out and you have Ditto? Ditto acts like Charmeleon and if that person evolves it to Charizard does Ditto.
    You cannot evolve Ditto; if your opponent evolves his Charmeleon, then Ditto becomes Charizard.

  73. Will Gym Challenge be legal at the East Coast STS?
    Yes.

  74. For Blaine’s Quiz #1 can the opponent look at any face up cards around them to figure out the length of a Pokémon? Can he/she look at an open binder near bye? I have a feeling the answer is yes/no
    You could look at other Pokémon that are in play but not at a binder. Come on.

  75. Will there be a limit on how many Cool Porygons you can get during the Victory Road Season?
    Not that I know of but they won’t be easy to earn.

  76. Can I please get some DCI tournaments in Seattle! the home of American Pokémon. I’ve tried sanctioning them myself but.
    Have you talked with store to hold a sanctioned event?

  77. If you had a Sabrina’s Alakazam and used Recall trainer to do Sabrina’s Abras Energy Loop, would you have to take an energy from the Alakazam because Sabrina’s Abra’s attack is talking about Abra, not Alakazam?
    I would think so, but, once again we’ll check with R&D to make sure that’s what their ruling will be.

  78. Would you know why there were no 1st edition Gym Heroes cards in stores on the 14th? Is it because Wizards decided to release it early in their own stores?
    We sent out the 1st edition cards to all locations as normal, it is possible that some locations got them later due to the vagaries of shipping and handling.

  79. So far, we’ve heard about Banning/Restricting, Trainer Limits, Pokémon Limits, and a restriction on the number of times you can use a Trainer per one turn. Are there any other ideas Wizards is testing that you can share?
    Sorry Zorak, nothing we can share right now.

  80. On the league activity where we find out all of Ancient Mews stats, how come it doesn’t mention him having a weakness, despite it being on the card?
    That was a misprint on our part, it was supposed to be on the mat.

  81. If my opponent puts down his prizes, then draws his hand, can I force him to reshuffle and deal in the correct order?
    I don’t know if you could _force_ someone to do that. I guess it would depend on the tournament. The correct order is hand first.

  82. Does smokescreen still in affect if you kill, retreat, or evolve the Pokémon?
    Which Pokémon do you mean? It references the defending Pokémon so only benching or evolving that one will end the effect.

  83. Do you guys have a binder full of all the cards that u refer to when being asked?
    No, we have a database that MT Mike improved that we use to look up cards.

  84. Sorry I have to rewrite a question from earlier, Will a Super Energy Removal remove a Double Colorless energy and another energy?
    Yes it could.

  85. Since you said you don’t do White Star cards that means if you make neo you won’t have Dark Pokémon have White Stars?
    Correct.

  86. Why don’t you make ENGLISH cards with different rarity symbols? Ex: Here Comes Team R. (white star), etc.
    We just don’t do it; those chase cards are hard to collect. Super Rares tend to tick the public off.

108.Can you Scoop Up a Stadium card?
No.

  1. If your opponent uses Tickling Machine and you draw a card do you have to put that down too?
    No.

  2. Why are all the STS in the East Coast and West Coast, cant there be one in the mids?
    This is the first year of trying it out; we may do more locations in the future.

  3. Why did you change the Japanese Contents of the Gym 1 Set to include Gym 2 Cards (Not that I’m complaining about it?
    Like I said earlier, our Gym Sets are a combination of all the Gym sets and PCD’s that came out in Japan.

112.If you use TR Magicarp’s rapid evolution can you still attack with Garydos or Dark Garydos?
No, one attack per turn.

  1. How was Gym Leaders #1 Japanese a collectors Nightmare?
    What I meant by this is that there were lots of cards you could only get in PCD’s, extra rare cards, and the sets were spread out over several months.

  2. Butterfree’s Mega Drain Attack. Remove counters equal to half damage. If damage is 20, remove 10 counters? R&D says play card as written, right?
    No.

  3. How will I be able to obtain the promo Psyduck #20 when it comes out?
    Promo Psyduck is a League promo so you will be able to earn it in the Victory Road season if you have earned all 8 badges.

  4. Will energy be in Gym Challenge?
    Yes.

  5. Do you have any plans for a tcg tourney tour? People are telling me you guys are.
    Not specifically but the Mall Tour contains a sanctioned Qualifying tournament in it.

  6. Will the league promo Cool Porygon still be in a plastic wrapper, or is that the way to tell the difference between the 2?
    I honestly don’t know, but it is the same card.

  7. Can you play an Energy Flow and choose to put no energy cards back in your hand? In other words, could you just discard the Energy Flow?
    Sure, it says you may so you can chose not to.

  8. When you add a lightning energy to Promo No.4 Pikachu can you use recharge, even though you already added a lightning energy?
    Yes you can.

  9. Does Swift get through Tail wag? It says they can’t attack but that is an effect.
    Good one! Dunno, we will ask R&D again (this always happens right after a new sets release).

  10. Could you use Swift when you’re asleep?
    Nope.

  11. Could Gyrados with recall do flail for 90 damage?
    Once again we will have to check, so all questions about Recall please wait until we can talk with R&D. another good question, right on.

  12. Can you use Item finder to get a card back you discarded? (Example: I get 1 basic and have 7 cards on my opening turn, I item finder for an RSA, discarding one & getting it back, then do the same thing again, allowing me to use Blaine’s Last Resort to try to get another basic)
    D’oh! We both agree that you shouldn’t be able to do this, but we’ll check because the wording is so weird

  13. If Ditto is poisoned and the Pokémon evolves, is Ditto still poisoned?
    Yes, he is.

  14. At the store I play at, if the game has already begun and you forgot to draw your prizes you automatically lose, is that correct?

  15. Where on line can I get a card list for Gym Heroes?

  16. Will there ever be some Pokémon event in Oregon?
    Well there have been sanctioned Pokémon tournaments, check our web site.

  17. Are there any tournaments in Texas any time soon? How could I find out?
    You can check the tournament locator on our website.

  18. How will you be able to record how many games you won, in a row?
    You will record your games in the Victory Road book.

  19. What is the minimum amount of Pokémon a deck must have?
    No minimum.

  20. Does the East STS Tour need staff? I participated at three West STS Tours stops (Seattle, Phoenix, Houston) as well as the STS at Long Beach. If yes, how would I apply?
    You would need to work for Wizards or DSL, the company that handles these events.

  21. What is the Pokémon Play-It CD-ROM?
    A CD that helped teach you the game that came out in the starter decks.

  22. What does PCD and DCI both stands for?
    Pre constructed decks / duelists convocation international.

  23. Can you use a Potion on a Pokémon that has no damage counters, I mean can you just discard it?
    Yes.

  24. Can you use a Super Potion if a Pokémon has no energy cards attached to it?
    Sure though you must still discard 1 energy.

  25. When is the release date for Gym Heroes II?
    October

  26. Do you have to discard Clefairy Doll even though it doesn’t count as a knocked out Pokémon? Aren’t the rules for a knocked out Pokémon is taking a prize and discarding the Pokémon?

Thurs. Aug 24, 2000 - Weekly Pokemon TCG Q&A

Pokémon Online Help
Offered every Thursday 3-5 PST in the TCG Forum of the Wizards.Community chat site!
Featuring Master_Trainers Mike and Pat from Customer Service

Master Trainer Pat: Hi Gang! We’ve done some homework for you guys with respect to hunting down some answers for last week. MT Mike Do you have those ready?

Master Trainer Mike: Hi gang. Let’s start with some rules answers to last week’s questions.

First Misty’s Staryu’s SWIFT attack. The SWIFT attack ignores all Pokémon Powers, Weaknesses, Resistances, or ANY other effects that attempt to alter the amount of damage done by this attack. SWIFT does NOT prevent anything that prevents the attack from actually occurring however like Smokescreen or Transparency. So SWIFT will ignore a Defender that is attached to the Defending Pokémon, as it is an affect that is attempting to alter the amount of damage done by the attack.

Second, the RECALL Trainer cards. This has the same sort of effect as Metronome or Ditto in that any self-referencing in the attack is changed to the active Pokémon’s name instead. Meaning if you used RECALL to use the Energy Loop attack on Sabrina’s Abra when it is evolved to Sabrina’s Kadabra (or Sabrina’s Alakazam), you would replace the topmost evolution step’s name into the attack. In other words you would still have to return a psychic energy card attached to it in order to the Energy Loop attack. The easiest way to think of it is that the RECALL Trainer gives the Active Pokémon the attack of your choice from one of its previous evolutions, with all of its positive and negative effects affecting your active Pokémon. So if you used RECALL on Gyarados to use Magickarp’s Flail attack, it is possible for that attack to do up to 90 damage.

Rocket’s Scyther’s Shadow Images attack is NOT cumulative.

Clarification on the whole Knock Out/triggered effects steps in Pokémon as well. When a Pokémon receives sufficient damage to be knocked out it is INSTANTLY knocked out (before anything else is done). HOWEVER, Prize cards are NOT drawn AND replacement Pokémon is NOT moved up until ALL triggered effects are resolved. Meaning that if Blaine’s Moltres does its attack and Knocks out Dark Gyarados, the Dark Gyarados would get its chance with its Final Beam attack effect BEFORE the Moltres can return to your hand (if you flipped tails). Blaine’s Moltres states that it would be returned to your hand AFTER DOING DAMAGE. This means AFTER all triggered effects are resolved (in this case the Dark Gyarados’s Final Beam). So after everything has resolved THEN prizes are drawn and replacement Benched Pokémon are moved up (with the player whose turn is next choosing first).

Lastly as some of you may have heard, we will be making appearances at some of the East Coast Mall Tour stops. Dark Master Trainer Mike (our boss) will be at the Baltimore and Miami stops, Master Trainer Pat will appear at the Chicago location, and I (Master Trainer Mike) will be at the Boston stop. So stop by and say hello, and bring your best decks to show us what you can do!
