Thurs. Aug 25, 2000 - Gym Heroes TCG Hour

TCG Hour: Pokémon: Gym Heroes
Featuring Robert Gutschera

Fri., Aug. 25, 2000

WizO_Bilbo: Evenin’ folks and welcome to TCG Hour with our special guest, Robert Gutschera! From Cerulean City to Pewter City and beyond, you can find powerful Pokémon trainers called Gym Leaders. These are some of the best trainers around, and the Gym Heroes™ set lets you check out some of the gyms as well as the Gym Leaders’ personal Pokémon and training methods. Robert Gutschera from Wizards R&D gives you the scoop.

WizO_Bilbo: Robert, do you have any comments to open up the chat with?

WotC_Robert: I don’t have anything special to say . . . I’m happy to dive right in!

guest22: Are these the same cards that are in the Japanese set?

WotC_Robert: That’s a good (and surprisingly complicated!) question. Let me try to explain . . . . The cards are all the same cards as they appeared in Japan, but the way we are releasing them is different. They had a release of two decks; then two more decks; then boosters; then two more decks; then boosters again. There was a lot of time between these different releases, and it was very hard for fans to keep track of what came from where. We decided to simplify it so that there would be two releases: Gym Heroes and Gym Challenge. We also wanted people to be able to collect all the cards from the boosters. So if you want to buy a theme deck, that’s great, but if you just want to buy boosters you can do that too. In the Japanese releases, some cards were only available in theme decks. I hope that all made sense!

guest22: That’s very interesting. Thanks!

Scrye_Fung: Ancient Mew is the nickname for a card just like the movie promo Mewtwo is a nickname for a card. Why is this card considered different from Mew and you’re allowed to have four of each (Ancient Mew and Mew) in a deck? After all, there are only 3 symbols on top of the Ancient Mew card, which should indicate the word Mew. Also, now that Ancient Mew is banned from tournament play, why is it still being allowed at the DCI-sanctioned East Coast STS?

WotC_Robert: Ancient Mew was never meant to be a tournament playable card . . . it was just meant to be for fun. We don’t want to have cards in play that people can’t read! And of course it has a different back. Remember we want to keep the environment fun and casual . . . don’t just think about the big tournaments with the top-level players (who of course are heavily represented in places like this chatroom!) In more casual environments, it’s important that people can read the cards, play them as written, play without sleeves if they want, and so on. Also, as far as I know, they don’t allow it in Japan, and we want to keep the same cards legal or not legal in the two places

guest17: I participated in the Gym Heroes Prerelease tourney. I was charged an entry fee of $5 and had to pay extra for booster packs. They also allowed Japanese cards . . why did this happen?

WotC_Robert: I’m sorry to hear it didn’t work out for you . . . it’s hard for me to respond to the specifics since I don’t know what that tourney organizer was doing, or what he had promised beforehand, and so on. But I would say the best thing to do is to write Wizards Customer Service in an email giving the particulars, and if the tourney organizer is playing fast and loose they can try to whip him into shape!

King_Blastoise: Why did Wizards take some of the cards out of the original Gym set and throw in some Blaine and Sabrina cards? Why didn’t Wizards just keep Gym like the original one was set up?

WotC_Robert: Good question. I’m the one responsible for all that (I picked the Heroes and Challenge sets out of the Japanese cards). The main reason was that we thought it was important to represent all the colors. We didn’t want some kid whose favorite color was Psychic to find that there were no cards at all for him in Heroes. We didn’t particularly want to make our set different just for the sake of it being different, though. Within the bounds of having all the colors, we tried to have the emphasis on Heroes be on the first four Gym Leaders and the emphasis in Challenge be on the second four. Remember, not everyone (especially younger kids) knows exactly what the Japanese release structure was. We wanted something that would make sense to someone just buying Heroes straight up without advance information about the Japanese sets. Sorry if it didn’t match what you wanted . . . I’m hoping that having all the different colors will appeal to lots of the people buying Heroes!

guest22: Why is the trainer called Misty (which is a foil) rarer than most of the Pokémon?

WotC_Robert: She shouldn’t be . . . I know it seems that some of the foils are rarer than others, but really they are all about the same! It might seem like one or another is rarer, but that’s mostly randomness having to do with time and place. There can be very slight differences . . . for example, if most foils go on the sheet four times, but there are still a few extra slots on the sheet, we put a few foils on five times rather than waste paper. But none of the foils are deliberately put on many times less often. We try to make them all as equally close in rarity as we can. Really. I’ve done a lot of the layouts (I did all the early ones, although I didn’t do the Heroes ones).

Scrye_Fung: Well . . . because the queue is so long now . . . this will probably be my last chance to talk before the end so I’ll make some general comments and then my question at the end . . . I’d like to thank you for coming out. Wizards has made a continued effort to reach out the public. That I thank you for. Now my question . . . you actually forgot to mention last time you took my question . . . will Ancient Mew, because it’s now banned, be allowed at the East Coast STS and on a lighter note, how long does it take for Wizards R&D to get rulings from Creatures? Does it vary on the complexity of the question?

WotC_Robert: I can’t give an official answer on Ancient Mew, but I’ll pass the question along to the tourney people (R&D advises them, but we don’t directly determine ourselves how they run the tournaments). I will try to make sure the Customer Service people have the answer when they go on chat! My guess would be that it wouldn’t be allowed, but that’s NOT official. Rulings from Creatures . . . it varies quite a bit. Typically what happens is that we save up our questions, and then the next time we see them (maybe to talk about an upcoming set, maybe at a big tournament or other event) we ask the questions then. Most of the questions never see the light of day . . . we ask lots of questions when we are writing the English versions of the cards, so that we can clear up as much as possible in terms of how the cards work *before* we actually print them . . . that way the English wordings can be clearer (at least that’s the goal!). Of course, if something really important comes up, we can try to hasten the process, but that’s how it usually works. The complexity of the question is usually less important than when we are scheduled to see them . . . it’s so far from here to Japan (and they are very good at giving us lots of time we do get together) that we usually have big meetings with lots of questions rather than lots of short questions. Meeting face to face turns out to be pretty important in communicating these things.

Reubot: Why won’t Imakuni’s Doduo be in Gym Challenge?

WotC_Robert: Hmm . . . I don’t want to comment about specifically what will and what won’t be in Gym Challenge . . . I will say generally, though, that we often wrestle with what to do with the “weird” cards. Imakuni of course being an example. We worry that for the people who don’t follow the Japanese cards (like the younger kids) it just won’t make any sense, but then we realize some people want us to do all the cards, no matter how goofy. So it’s a judgement call. I don’t think that card is tournament legal, though, so it shouldn’t affect the tournament scene . . . it is very funny, though. I personally like the card, but specifically which cards we put into sets isn’t my decision anymore!

Zapdos_6669: Sorry if this was asked earlier, but if I successfully use Tickle Machine against my opponent, and then on his turn he draws an Oak and plays it, must he discard his face-down cards? Also, what cards will make up the extra slots to fill the 132 cards in Gym Challenge(there weren’t 264 cards in the Japanese Gym sets).

WotC_Robert: For rules stuff, remember this isn’t official . . . but the rules people did come and ask me yesterday what I thought about that very question . . . . My feeling was that you don’t have to discard the facedown cards, because they aren’t in your hand (Tickle Machine says to put them back in your hand later, so they must not be there now). So that was the advice I gave. But it’s not official until the rules team says so! (Let’s hope they follow my advice, I say! As to the extra cards, there aren’t any extra slots, really. Remember the Japanese sets are six decks plus two sets of boosters, and there are cards in each of the decks that aren’t in the boosters. So the full Japanese Gym set is much larger than it would seem from just the count in the two booster sets they did make. Heroes and Challenge are the same size (to within a couple of cards) and the total cards in Heroes plus Challenge equals the total of all the cards in the Japanese sets, more or less.

guest17: What Gym card do you think will change the game the most?

WotC_Robert: Hmm . . . an interesting question. I actually asked the Creatures people about this, and they pointed me to a card I might not have thought of . . . namely, Misty’s Tears, which just might be the card to push the Blastoise deck into the top . . . hmm but that’s in Challenge, so let’s not talk about that. For Heroes, cards I think are interesting are Erika’s Dratini (as a hoser against Haymaker decks . . . although it’s not clear if it’s strong enough to do the trick by itself) and Misty’s Poliwag can be a pretty good stall card. At a more casual level, the No Removal Gym might make a lot of people who are constantly being Energy drained happy. By the way, Misty’s Tears was originally scheduled for Heroes, but it wound up in Challenge instead . . . . I won’t say any more about that . . . you guys will have to puzzle it out.

guest21: With Challenge due out mid-October, can we look forward to Neo in our Christmas stockings?

WotC_Robert: Sorry . . . can’t talk about release schedules . . . the Pokémon Brand team would kill me!

King_Blastoise: Okay, I don’t know if you answered this yet but they have a Blaine’s Charizard and an Erika’s Venusaur but not a Misty’s Blastoise. Why is this?

WotC_Robert: The sad answer is I don’t know exactly . . . I never asked the Creatures people this question. But my guess would be that Blastoise isn’t a very “Misty-like” Pokémon, so they tried to pick Pokémon like Staryu that are more directly associated with Misty. Erika and Blaine aren’t as well known from the show as Misty, so what Pokémon they have is more open. That’s just a guess though.

guest22: Why do the same Pokémon have different designs and attacks? (for example, Misty’s Tentacool)

WotC_Robert: The basic answer is that there are only 150 Pokémon, so if people still want new Pokémon cards, some Pokémon need to be repeated. Normally, of course, Pokémon with the same name but different powers (which you can think of as different levels of the same Pokémon, if you like) only appear in different sets. I’m not exactly sure why they decided to change that in Gym . . . my guess is that they wanted to have lots of cards that went well with a given Gym Leader. For example, Misty is very strongly associated with Staryu, so rather than doing lots of totally different Pokémon as “Misty’s Pokémon” (and have some of them not seem very “Misty-like”), they decided to do different versions of Staryu. Also, keep in mind that it would be really hard for the colors like Psychic and Lightning where there are very few Pokémon!

WotC_Robert: Thank you all for coming! It was good to talk with all of you!

WizO_Bilbo: Thanks Robert! And thanks for coming everyone. Be sure to check out upcoming chats on the schedule: www.wizards.com/chat/calendar.asp.

Thurs. Aug 31, 2000 - Weekly Pokemon TCG Q&A

Pokémon Online Help
Offered every Thursday 3-5 PST in the TCG Forum of the Wizards.Community chat site!
Featuring Master_Trainers Mike and Pat from Customer Service

Master Trainer Mike: Hi gang! Master Trainer Pat is out today so it’s just me (so understand if it goes a bit slower). DMT Mike and I were in Hawaii for the Tropical Mega Battle this last weekend and I wanted to share some information about it with you.

The first day, the players were formed into 8 groups that went around to the 8 cities and played as teams for point totals. Some cities had trivia contests, another had name that Pokémon from its flavor text, one city had the players digging for Monster Balls with points in them on the beach of Waikiki. DMT Mike and I played in the Vermilion City Gym where we used Lightning/Colorless Pokémon and took on all Challengers. I ended up with the best record at 5 wins, 2 losses, while DTM Mike went 4 and 3. In the open play tournaments (still only allowed to use Base or Jungle Pokémon cards), everyone I saw played Haymakers with at least 25 Trainer Cards except for 1 Raindance Deck.

The second day final tournament was a constructed one where each player was given 90 cards from Basic and Jungle and had 1 hour to build a 40-card deck to play with. They were given as much basic energy as they wanted as well. Here is the list of what they were given:

Grass 1 Caterpie, 3 Weedle, 2 Kakuna, 1 Beedrill, 3 Nidoran , 1 Nidorino, 1 Koffing, 1 Oddish, 1 Paras, Fire 3 Charmander, 1 Charmeleon, 1 Charizard, 1 Growlithe, 3 Ponyta, 2 Rapidash

Water 3 Squirtle, 1 Wartortle, 2 Poliwag, 2 Seel, 2 Dewgong Lightning 3 Pikachu, 1 Raichu, 2 Magnemite, 2 Voltorb, 1 Electrode, 1 Jolteon Psychic 3 Abra, 2 Kadabra, 2 Drowzee, 1 Jynx, 1 Mr. Mime

Fighting 3 Diglett, 2 Dugtrio, 1 Onix, 3 Mankey 2 Primeape, 1 Rhyhorn colorless 1 Rattata, 1 Doduo, 1 Meowth, 2 Eevee 1 DCE trainers 1 oak, 1 bill, 1 trader, 1 energy removal, 1 energy retrieval, 2 switch, 1 computer search, 1 pokedex, 1 pluspower, 1 defender, 2 gusts of wind, 1 super potion, 2 potion, 1 full heal, 1 pokeball

When we watched the tournament every energy type was pretty evenly chosen except for grass (only 5 players chose to use Grass in their decks). The overall winner of the Tropical Mega Battle was Jason Klaczynski of Chicago. He played well and won it all on a successful coin flip for his Quick Attack with his Eevee. His opponent only had 1 Pokémon out (no bench) and needed 40 HP to be knocked out. Jason played his 1 Pluspower and went for it all and got the coin flip he needed.

Now for some other news. Next years Pokémon League starts in January and will have 8 seasons in it like this year’s. Players that earn their badges quickly will have more extra activities they can do (no more TM’s though) and can even slowly work on points for the following season.

The official date and location for the upcoming East Coast STS is November 18th at the Meadowlands Exposition Center in Secaucus, NJ.

Lastly look for some of your favorite Master Trainers at the following East Coast Mall Tour stops. Dark Master Trainer Mike (my boss) will be at the Baltimore and the Miami stops. Master Trainer Pat will be at the Chicago Mall stop and I will be at the one in Boston. Please stop by, say hi, and challenge us. (Phew) that was a lot of typing.

Thurs. Sep 7, 2000 - Weekly Pokemon TCG Q&A

Pokémon Online Help
Offered every Thursday 3-5 PST in the TCG Forum of the Wizards.Community chat site!
Featuring Master_Trainers Mike and Pat from Customer Service

Sept. 7, 2000

Master Trainer Pat: Hello everybody, I’m back from a relaxing weekend of live music. Sorry I missed out last week. Once again MT Mike will be joining us shortly, he’s finishing up some announcements for today.

  1. Can you use a gambler if you get that in you’re first hand when you have no basic Pokémon cards?
    Master Trainer Pat: If you mean start without a basic in play, then no. You must have at least one basic Pokémon in your opening hand.

  2. My Pokémon league has already started victory road, but they don’t have the cards or new badge books yet. When will they get them?
    Master Trainer Pat: I would imagine that they’d be getting those soon. I don’t send them out so I’m not certain on a date exactly.

  3. Can we please ask questions about Gym2?
    Master Trainer Pat: Sorry, no. We’ve told you more than we should already. Meaning me leaking info about what cards are in there. Though I figure if you’re savvy enough to know what cards are in the Gym sets you’ll figure out what is in Challenge.

  4. Did you meet Imakuni at TMB?
    Master Trainer Pat: I wasn’t able to go; though DMT Mike and MT Mike did get to meet and play Imakuni.

  5. Any new, news on promos, Neo, or Prop15?
    Master Trainer Pat: Nothing new on that front but I think MT Mike has some tidbits for you. Mike?

Master Trainer Mike: Hi gang, let’s start with the announcements. First, as some of you may have heard, the East Coast STS Main Tournament’s Constructed Format rules will be announced on Oct 9th. We do not know what these rules will be, if they will even be different from the West Coast STS rules at all, so please do not ask about them, as we will not have any info on it until Oct 9th. At that point, they will be posted on our web site and you will be able to call Customer Service and get the full explanation of it.

Secondly, after talking with R&D I want to pass along some ruling changes and clarifications. If you have a promo Eeevee in play and you or the opponent evolve Grimer into Muk, then the promo Eevee’s Chain Reaction Pokémon power would be triggered by the evolution of Muk and would still occur even though Muk’s Toxic Gas states to ignore all other Pokémon Powers. Of course, any evolutions done after this case would NOT trigger the Chain Reaction due to the Toxic Gas Pokémon power.

If you use Porygon’s Conversion attack on a Ditto, the effect takes place. If the Ditto transforms into another Pokémon, the Conversion effect is still on it. This is because the use of a Pokémon Power does NOT end an attack effect. If the Ditto were to Transform into a Pokémon that did NOT have a Weakness then it would still not have a Weakness as the Conversion effect states: If the Defending Pokémon has a Weakness, you may change it to a type of your choice other than Colorless. This does mean that if that Ditto were to later Transform to a Pokémon that DID have a Weakness, the Conversion effect would still be on the Ditto and would effect the resultant Weakness. Conversion, as all attack effects would be removed if Ditto was Benched or left play.

Some clarification on how attack results is calculated. Follow the chart in the rulebook under How Do You Figure Out the Damage. Ignore the rules in what order do you do Your Attack (specifically f). When your Pokémon attacks go through the normal steps through h, IF enough damage is put onto the opposing Pokémon to knock it out then that Pokémon is considered Knocked Out. DO NOT ACTUALLY REMOVE THE CARD; TAKE A PRIZE CARD, OR MOVE UP A REPLACEMENT UNTIL ALL ATTACK EFFECTS ARE DONE. What this means is that if the placing of the damage on the Pokémon TRIGGERS a return attack (like Dark Gyarados’s Final Beam or Rocket Hitmonchan’s Crosscounter attack) then you jump back up into the order and resolve this NEW attack BEFORE you do step i) Now that damage has been done, if the attack does anything else besides damage, do all of that. This explains how an attack that paralyzes does NOT prevent Dark Gyarados’s Final Beam effect if the Dark Gyarados is knocked out. Only AFTER all damage and attack effects are resolved do you actually remove the Knocked out Pokémon, draw a prize card, and replace it. Keep in mind though, that as soon as a Pokémon takes damage equal to its current HP it is considered Knocked Out regardless of what other attack effects occur after damage.

Lastly, what you have heard is true about the promo Jigglypuff #7. It is being earned on the East Coast Mall Tour. Our apologies for telling you otherwise. We only learned of this ourselves recently.

Master Trainer Mike ; Phew! I know lots of stuff to read. Back to the questions (I beat Imakuni by the way).

    Master Trainer Pat: Yes, we did find out that the video for Pokémon 2k will have a promo in it, but we don’t know what they’re planning yet. The Jiggly will be given out at the East Coast mall Tour as MT Mike mentioned.

    Master Trainer Pat: We don’t know of one yet.

There is no clarification on the Sabrina’s ESP card that says anything about reapplying status effects, etc. For example, if you used Sabrina’s Venomoth’s Healing Powder, would you count all 6 coin flips as healing or just the second three? Also, if you were to use an attack from a Sabrina’s Pokémon such as Sabrina’s Gengar, would you flip all four coins and if two are heads out of all of those four flips, would you shuffle your opponents Pokémon back into their deck? Even further, if you were to use Sabrina’s Venonat’s attack that makes your opponent’s def. Pokémon lose an energy, if you flipped heads originally, then flipped again for Sabrina’s ESP and got 2 heads, would you discard 2 of your opponents energy, or would you only count the reflip?
    Master Trainer Mike: Easy. IF you choose to reflip the coins, you take all of the new results instead of the old. You must make this choice to either keep the original effects OR reflip for new ones. They do NOT carry over.

    Master Trainer Mike: As long as the other player has not done anything yet (drawn his card, etc) then you can rewind and reflip. Otherwsie, if the other player allows you to make the forgotten flip and nothing has happened yet based on your state it can be done. Otherwise, you lose the flip. Call a judge in if it is important.
    Master Trainer Pat: It is both players’ responsibilities to remember this stuff.

Thurs. Sep 14, 2000 - Weekly Pokemon TCG Q&A

Pokémon Online Help
Offered every Thursday 3-5 PST in the TCG Forum of the Wizards.Community chat site!
Featuring Master_Trainers Mike and Pat from Customer Service

Thurs, Sept. 14, 2000

Master Trainer Pat: Hi everybody! Hope you all had a good weekend. D. MT Mike said he had a blast at the Baltimore Mall Tour event. It sound like he had a chance to meet some of you. Big thanks goes out to Kori for the neat personal poke-cards he made for all of us.

Master Trainer Mike: Yes, thank you Kori for the card and the book “Wheedle on the Needle”! It’s great!

Let’s start with the announcements. Unfortunately there is not a discount program set up for hotels for the East Coast STS. Turns out there are several events going on in the area that weekend and the 5 closest are already booked up. If you plan on going, I would recommend booking early. Speaking of the East Coast STS, the Mall Tour stops so far have been hitting capacity for the qualifying tournaments. If you plan on going to one, make sure to get there early. There is good prize support as well with the winner getting a game boy, the ETCG cartridge, a box of boosters, and a jacket, a T-shirt, along with his invitation to the STS. If you do not win an invitation in a qualifying event, then as long as you have earned at least 5 badges through the league you can enter. Capacity has been doubled from the West Coast STS but it is still limited. We are working on a pre-registration program for the main tournament that will start 3 weeks before the STS. If you plan on participating in the main tournament and have not won an invitation, then watch our web site and the chat for details. Also keep in mind that the construction rules for the main tournament will be announced on Oct 9th on both our web site and you will be able to call us here at customer service for details as well. Make sure to find out what it will be before you go to the event!

We have also been receiving lots of email and calls about the various tournament formats that are being tested and considered. The 15-trainer limit is probably the one that you have heard the most about. There seems to be lots of confusion about this and the other formats being testes so I wanted to give a brief explanation. As we have said before, the Pokémon TCG was never intended to be a truly competitive game. It was made to be socially competitive (meaning friendly fun). The tournaments that are held in Japan are few and infrequent with an emphasis on fun for all.

Here in North America we play our games a bit differently. Its all about winning in our tournament scene and so we tend to play harder, quicker, and much more cutthroat than the game was designed to be played. With that in mind, it has become obvious that out of the 500+ cards that have been released so far, roughly 20-30 of them are ever used in the must-win tournament scene. This is a sign of a broken game. There have been many discussions about the dominating Archetypes in Pokémon, mainly being Wiggly decks, Haymaker variants, the new Trapper deck, with some other deck types being occasionally played (Raindance, Stall, Sponge, etc.). In the West Coast STS (the first main competitive event we have held) almost 90% of the decks play were almost identical. This is clearly a sign of an out of balance tournament environment.

Since we do not own the card game, banning and restrictions are not really an allowable option. Nor is changing the rules of the game (like only allowing 2 trainers played per turn). That leaves us with constructed tournament formats to try out. We have been play testing various formats here in the offices and also reading all of the results that you have sent in to us. Whatever format we come up with (if any) might NOT be a final answer in an ever changing and growing competitive environment. Keep in mind that we are looking at the overall longevity of the game and the competitive scene, which is remarkably different than the Japanese market, which the game was originally designed for. Sort of fitting a square peg in a round hole. The reasoning behind these proposals is to promote diversity in the competitive environment, and to help players try other sorts of decks that have even a slight chance of competing with these decks.

Trainer profusion, BBP’s, the relative slow speed of evolution decks, the rapid spreading of any new deck tech through the internet and popular fan sites are all issues we are aware of and are discussing with Creatures for our different market than that of Japan. We are also talking with them about becoming more involved in the creation and play testing of Pokémon and possibly even helping to design additional cards (like Dark Raichu) that may help to bring balance to a “fun” game that we in North America play so hard with.

Please feel free to keep sending in your opinions and thoughts on the future of Pokémon, we do read them, and listen on the phone. Understand though, that no matter how strongly you may feel about a particular aspect, there will be lots of others who feel the exact opposite. Such is the spark that a democracy gives us. I hope you have all heard about the Pikachu Promotional set that is being sold at the Australian Olympics. We have info about it on our web site. Check it out! Don’t worry though, the unreleased cards in that set will be coming out in North America (and the rest of the world) in your local language through various promotions like the Pokémon League and movie releases.

Also, we are having our first in-house Pokémon tournament tonight! MT Pat, Dark Master Trainer Mike, and I will compete with Mike Elliot from R&D, Kiernan Chase from the DCI, and lots of other tough WOTC Pokémon Trainers. It is a 15-trainer limit tournament and we will give you a report of how we did and what deck types were used next week.

Lastly, I want to recommend that you check out the Team Compendium web site at pokegym.thedojo.com/compendium/. They do a great job of collecting our wisdom (and screw ups from the chat) and put it into an easy form for you to research at. Check them out! Now, to the questions.

Thurs. Sep 21, 2000 - Weekly Pokemon TCG Q&A

Pokémon Online Help
Offered every Thursday 3-5 PST in the TCG Forum of the Wizards.Community chat site!
Featuring Master_Trainers Mike and Pat from Customer Service

Thurs. Sept. 20, 2000

Master Trainer Pat: Hi everybody! We told you we would have some results for you this week from our in-house Pokémon tournament (15 trainer limit in effect) I think MT Mike will have those for you momentarily.

Master Trainer Mike: Hi gang, experiencing some technical troubles here.

Master Trainer Pat: In the meantime I’ll dive into some of these questions…

Master Trainer Mike: As some of you may have heard, we held an internal tournament using a 15-trainer limit.

Master Trainer Mike: One of the things we learned is that Ditto was the winningest card, meaning of the decks it was in, they won the most games. Of course, Jiggly/Wiggly ended up in half the decks and did ok.
There are full results of this posted on the Pokegym web site at pokegym.thedojo.com/. Check it out. I wanted to share with you the 3 decks that tied for first though. Here you go.

Kevin’s Deck 3-1-1-0 12 points total
2 Erika’s Dratini 3 Ditto 4 Jigglypuff 4 Wigglytuff 2 Chansey 4 Scyther 4 Mewtwo, promo #3 4 Professor Oak 3 Computer Search 2 Gust of Wind 2 Scoop Up 2 Misty’s Wrath 1 NGR 1 Item Finder 4 Full Heal Energy 4 DCE 14 Psychic Energy

Kieran’s Deck 4-0-0-1 12 points total
4 Jigglypuff 4 Wigglytuff 4 Ditto 4 Scyther 4 Mewtwo, promo #3
3 Energy Removal 3 Professor Oak 3 Rocket’s Trap 4 Computer Search 2 Item Finder 4 Rainbow Energy 4 DCE 17 Psychic Energy

And lastly our own Da Bosses deck. Dark Master Trainer Mike’s “Evaporate or Whiskey a go go” deck 4-0-0-1
2 Articuno, promo 4 Blaine’s Charmander 3 Eevee, promo 3 Dark Vaporeon 4 Dratini 3 Dragonair 2 Gust of Wind 2 Computer Search 4 Energy Removal 3 Super Energy Removal 3 Professor oak 1 Narrow Gym 2 Full Heal Energy 4 DCE 7 Fire Energy 13 Water Energy

(Phew), check out the Pokegym for more details and analysis. Of course we have done more testing since then as well.

  1. I just wanted to say what a good job you guys do with this chat. It always cheers me. I have made many friends here. Thanks and keep up the great work.
    Master Trainer Pat: Thanks, Arti, I don’t think too many people realize how much time and effort we put into this so that the game of Pokémon remains interesting for everyone and so that it doesn’t just become a footnote in the history of TCG’s.

  2. If Psyduck uses Headache (“opponent can’t play any trainer cards next turn”), and then opponent uses Erika’s Victreebell’s “Fragrance Trap” power to put Psyduck onto the bench, does the status effect end and the opponent can then use trainer cards?
    Master Trainer Pat: No, the status effect doesn’t end. It is on your opponent.

  3. Will Challenge be delayed?
    Master Trainer Mike: Not that we know of.

  4. If you draw your last card and have no cards left in your deck, can you play Mr. Fuji and put cards back in to keep yourself from decking out?
    Master Trainer Pat: Yes.

  5. Would Base Mewtwo’s “Barrier” attack prevent the effect portion of attacks such as Ninetales’ “Lure” (switch), Pidgeot’s “Hurricane” (back into hand), or Dragonair’s “Hyper Beam” (discard an energy card) from happening to Mewtwo?
    Master Trainer Mike: Yes they would, it prevents ALL effects from an attack.

  6. OK. This is a different question. I’m new to Pokémon and have been learning lots here lately. I was wondering what the leagues did about different ages. Since I’m an adult, I think it would be unfair to put me against a young child. How is this d
    Master Trainer Pat: This is handled differently by separate stores. They decide whether to split the participants into different groups or let them play together. We encourage adults or older kids to take leadership type roles at the leagues if possible.

  7. What does a rainbow NRG do is it just like 1 DCE?
    Master Trainer Mike: When you attach a rainbow energy from your hand to a Pokémon, that Pokémon takes 10 damage. A Rainbow energy can count as any type of basic energy.

  8. When you have a Dark Charizard or a Dark Vileplume does it have 2 evolve from a Dark Charmelion or a dark gloom or just any?
    Master Trainer Pat: Must evolve from dark Pokémon.
    Master Trainer Mike: Unless you use Breeder from a Basic.

  9. When will we see DMTM in the chats?
    Master Trainer Mike: His hands are full of Maple bars. He can’t type well with them.
    Master Trainer Pat: He’s not using my keyboard.
    Master Trainer Mike: Yeah, he gets them all sticky.

  10. Time for Mr_Mystery’s Weekly What If? Tonight’s What If: A person plays Blaine’s Quiz #1, and he is about to flip the card over when a Tornado comes over and scoops up all the cards. What do we do?
    Master Trainer Mike: There’s no place like home.
    Master Trainer Pat: Click your shoes together three times.

  11. In the announcements about your in-house tournament, you said “Kieran’s Deck 4-0-0-1 12 points total”? What does each number mean? I can understand Win-Loss-Tie, but what’s the fourth number?
    Master Trainer Mike: Sorry about that. The first number is the number of 3 point wins (as in full wins within the time limit). The second number is an out of time win, meaning you have taken more prizes when time runs out, that is worth 2 points. The third number is the number of draws (both players have the same number of prizes left) when time runs out, worth 1 point. And the last number is the number of losses, worth 0 points each.

  12. Can you use a combo of Damage Swap and Team Rocket’s Snorlax to kill all your opponent’s Pokémon while it’s asleep?
    Master Trainer Pat: Damage Swap isn’t damage. It’s simply moving counters. Sorry.

    Master Trainer Mike: Nope.
    But as DMTM says, 2001 will be a great year for Pokémon. (hint hint).

  14. Any new info on the Vending Drawing Contests?
    Master Trainer Pat: No, that article was very premature. We have nothing to announce yet.

  15. Scenario: Ditto opposite MP Mewtwo. MP Mewtwo attacks w/ Psyburn. Ditto is knocked out because its weakness is to Psychic. This is correct?
    Master Trainer Mike: Correct.

  16. Can you use Narrow Gym in play put a 5th Pokémon in play and take out one?
    Master Trainer Pat: Nope.

    Master Trainer Mike: Nope, nothing new, all info is on our web site.
    How’s Neo coming along? If it is released, will the set have a different name? I think everybody is familiar with Neo and you should keep it that way. We’ll suggest that Arti. I want to call it Weedlerama.

  22. Do Dark Pokémon evolve from Dark Pokémon and Gym Hero’s Pokémon evolve into or from Gym Hero’s Pokémon? Someone at my league says They can, and to quote “But Spearow is Spearow!”

  27. If a bench Pokémon has some damage and a Defender on it, would Sabrina’s Gengar’s “Pain Amplifier” work on it or would Defender block it? The attack’s text says to “put a damage counter on”; is that considered “doing damage”? LifeDown is coming soon!

  41. On Misty’s Psyduck, why does it has a weakness over Grass type? Is that an error?

  42. Any new news on the new league (New badges, new books, new promos, etc.)
    Master Trainer Mike: Nothing to report yet.

  43. About the Psyduck question. Is Headache affecting the player playing Psyduck or the opponent? The attack does make reference to the opponent, but in addition Psyduck is the one with the headache, right? Do does it affect both players?
    Master Trainer Pat: It affects the opponent.

  44. Any new news on Base3?
    Master Trainer Mike: Nothing to announce but maybe it will help us balance the game a bit.

  45. When will the Pokémon league locations get refills in promos, badges, dci cards, and badge books?
    Master Trainer Pat: This really isn’t something we can answer.

  46. No matter what attack is done; you’re always going to be placing damage counters on the Defending Pokémon. Can you explain further please?
    Master Trainer Mike: If an attack states it does damage, then that is damage. If it states placing damage counters then it is counters for the purposes of Brock’s Rhydon, Weakness, etc. So attacks that place damage counters (Like Sabrina’s Goldduck in Challenge) are NOT affected by Weakness, Defender, etc.). Just like moving counters with Damage Swap or Curse isn’t affected either.
    Master Trainer Pat: For instance, Rocket’s Mewtwo’s Juxtapose attack states: Flip a coin, if heads switch the number of damage counters on R. Mewtwo with those of the defending Pokémon. This is not damage.

  47. What would happen if you did Seadra’s agility but the opposition had a dark Wortortle and did mirrorshell what would happen?
    Master Trainer Mike: Nothing. Agility might prevent damage form an attack on your opponent’s turn. The Mirrorshell strikes back on your turn and so is not affected by the Agility.

  48. I live in the Central Time Zone, and I want to attend the Knowledge Competition. When will it start in my time zone, and how long will it last?

    Master Trainer Mike: We gave away perhaps 20-30 of the cards, that is NOT enough to affect the secondary market. Thurs. Sep 28, 2000 - Weekly Pokemon TCG Q&A

Pokémon Online Help
Offered every Thursday 3-5 PST in the TCG Forum of the Wizards.Community chat site!
Featuring Master_Trainers Mike and Pat from Customer Service

Sept. 28, 2000

Master Trainer Mike: Hi gang. Not much new to tell you of (yet). I did dig up some more details about the upcoming Birthday Pikachu web promotion though. The Wizard’s web site is going to be completely redesigned and up on Dec 1st.

Starting that day you will be able to try and answer some Pokémon trivia contests, once you get the correct answers you will need to print it out and mail it in. The first of a set number we receive with the correct answers will get a holo Happy Birthday Pikachu mailed to them. The number released (initially) will be limited so be sure to hop on the first day if possible.

Remember we will be announcing the East Coast STS Main Tournament Deck format starting Oct 9th. It will be on our web site and you will also be able to call customer service at 1-800-324-6496 for details. We will also be taking pre-registrations for the main event starting later in October. Seating will be limited so we recommend you pre-register if you plan on competing.

MT Pat had a great time meeting many of you at the Chicago Mall Tour stop. I will be going to the stop near Boston in Braintree on Oct 7th and Dark Mater Mike will be at the Florida stop as well. Hopefully we will also get to meet and talk with many of you at the East Coast STS as well.

Master Trainer Mike: So Pat, how was it?
Master Trainer Pat: Hi everybody! I’m back from the Chicago Mall Tour event, which was a blast. Thanks for everyone who stopped by the league area to say hi or challenge me to a duel. It was cool to finally be able to place a face to each of your online names. Here’s a question that was asked by Jason at the Mall Tour this weekend. I think it deserves posting… If player A has a promo Eevee in play with 2 damage counters on it, and player B evolves Zubat into Dark Golbat on their turn, can promo Eevee use it’s Chain Reaction Pokémon Power before Dark Golbat’s Pokémon Power puts another damage counter on promo Eevee? The answer is yes. Promo Eevee gets to evolve before Dark Golbat’s power applies it’s damage.

Master Trainer Mike: Better ask more questions or I’m gonna have to sing

  1. I know I asked this the other week but I didn’t see the answer so again: if you launch an American vending set will I be able to participate even though I live in England? Or not?
    Master Trainer Pat: We have no concrete plans on the vending set yet, sorry

  2. Last week you said (Q44) that you can’t “Damage Swap” to Clefairy Doll because it would KO that card. However, in previous rulings (May 11 Q4 & Aug 3 Q55) you said that you can because Clefairy Doll doesn’t count as a KO’d Pokémon. Which is correct?
    Master Trainer Mike: We will check into it, its unclear since it would take the Cledfairy Doll out of the game but it does NOT count as a Knocked Out Pokémon. We will check with R&D. Sorry!

  3. Is Sabrina’s Abra in the October Nintendo Power?

  31. Are you familiar with sudden death? If both players win/lose at the same time, then you play a game with one prize. Is it possible for sudden death to ever happen though? Say I had a Chansey with 80 HP left and used double edge on a Charmander. I would still when, because I knocked out the Charmander before I did 80 to my self, right? So could sudden death ever happen?
    Master Trainer Mike: Wrong! You do not remove Knocked out Pokémon or draw Prize cards until the entire attack sequence is done. So in this case, you would do enough to Knock out the Charmander then do the rest of the attack and Knock your Chansey out, and then both of you would actually remove them and draw your final prize cards. A draw would ensue.

Thurs. Oct 5, 2000 - Weekly Pokemon TCG Q&A

Pokémon Online Help
Offered every Thursday 3-5 PST in the TCG Forum of the Wizards.Community chat site!
Featuring Master_Trainers Mike and Pat from Customer Service

Oct 5,2000

Master Trainer Pat: Hi everybody! It’s been a busy week here for us at the Wizards Gym. MT Mike will be joining us momentarily, so I’ll begin with the announcements…

It seems like we may still be having some tech. difficulties, but we’ll see what we can do…

MT Mike and I were able to get a sneak peek at some of the Gym: Challenge cards and we’re sad to report that our good luck with no misprints in Gym: Heroes did not carry over to Gym: Challenge.
Specifically, there are two misprints, which make the cards either unplayable or very weak.

The two cards in question are Blaine’s Charizard and Rocket’s Minefield Gym. Blaine’s Charizard has a Fighting energy symbol on it instead of a Fire symbol and Rocket’s Minefield Gym is missing the number 2 right before damage counters’. On the bright side, the set as a whole has several possible tournament worthy cards, some Pokémon with new attacks or Pokémon Powers that do things we have not seen before.

OK, so now on to some questions, of which I’m sure you’ll have many.

  1. Will gym challenge be available this Saturday at the Pokémon league for sure?
    Master Trainer Pat: I don’t know if it will be available for sure at your location, the Wizards stores and Premier stores should have them though.

  2. Will there be a Gym Challenge prerelease tournament? If so, when and will there be entry fees?
    Master Trainer Pat: None, for Gym Challenge

  3. When is Gym: Challenge being released? The Wizards site has said the 7th, 10th, and 16th.
    Master Trainer Pat: Premier stores and Wizards stores should have them on the 7th, mass-market retailers should get them by the 16th.
    Master Trainer Mike: Sorry but there are no plans for a Gym Challenge prerelease event.

  4. Two weeks ago you said that you can’t “Damage Swap” to Clefairy Doll because it would KO that card. However, in previous rulings (May 11 Q4 & Aug 3 Q55) you said that you can because Clefairy Doll doesn’t count as a KO’d Pokémon. Which is correct?
    Master Trainer Mike: The correct answer is that you CANNOT Damage Swap onto a Clefairy Doll or Mysterious Fossil for that matter, period.

  5. From last week: It’s down to one prize each, your turn with 10HP left, and you’re poisoned. You attack and KO your opponent to draw your last prize. But you take poison damage and would be KO’d now too. Do you win or does it go to Sudden Death?
    Master Trainer Mike:] you win, you must complete the rest of the combat sequence, but then if you win BEFORE the end of the turn, you win, period. Poison doesn’t happen until after the end of your turn.

  6. If you have a Pokémon, which would take 10 recoil damage for each energy of a particular type (say, lightning), would it receive the recoil damage for any attached Rainbow Energy? And how much would it take for a Buzzap’d Electrode?
    Master Trainer Mike: Rainbow energy yes, the buzzaped electrode depends on what type of energy you chose when you buzzap’ed it.

  7. If Misty’s Tentacool uses Crystal Beam on a Pokémon, can an Electrode be Buzzap’d onto that Pokémon?
    Master Trainer Mike: Yes it could, the Crystal Beam ONLY prevents the attaching of energy from your hand (your free normal attachment).
    Master Trainer Pat: We’ll be asking Creature’s specifically about what Crystal Beam will prevent when we next meet.

  8. If “Here Comes Team Rocket” turns all prizes face-up, then if you use TR Rattata’s “Trickery” does the new prize card go face-up or facedown? (My guess is face-up).
    Master Trainer Mike: Face up as you are switching the cards.

  9. Is there any info on neo…? Vending machine promos…or the evil monkey that lives in my closet?
    Master Trainer Pat: The Monkey’s tired of rooming with your skeletons
    Master Trainer Mike: no, but the monkey is getting hungry. FEED HIM FOR GADS SAKE!

  10. Let’s say a confuse Pokémon tries to retreat. I pay the retreat cost but the Pokémon fails to retreat. If I use say a full heal energy can I then pay the retreat again and retreat Pokémon like normal.
    Master Trainer Pat: No, Confusion states you may only try once during that turn.

Master Trainer Pat: Why is there a fighting energy symbol on the Roaring Flames attack on Blaine’s Charizard? That is a misprint, it should have been a fire energy symbol and the card should be played as if it was a fire symbol. This attack is confusing, how does it work? Simple. You discard all fire energy cards AND all cards that provide 2 fire energy as well (like a fire chosen Buzzap’d Electrode). This attack does 20 damage plus 20 damage more for each fire energy discarded this way. So a discarded Buzzap’d Electrode (that was chosen to provide 2 fire energy) would add 40 damage to this attack.

Thurs. Oct 12, 2000 - Weekly Pokemon TCG Q&A

Pokémon Online Help
Offered every Thursday 3-5 PST in the TCG Forum of the Wizards.Community chat site!
Featuring Master_Trainers Dark MT Mike and Pat from Customer Service

Oct 12,2000

Master Trainer Pat: Hi everybody! Has everyone started tweaking your favorite decks for the new deck construction guidelines for the East Coast STS? We’ve been playing like mad around here…mostly new deck types built with Gym Challenge cards. I’ll go ahead and post the deck construction guidelines now for any of you who may have missed it.

New Deck Construction Rules: 60 cards total per deck, Unlimited number of basic Energy cards per deck, No more than 3 of any single Trainer card, Basic Pokémon card, Stage 1 card, Stage 2 card, or non-basic Energy card per deck, and no more than 15 Trainer cards per deck.

Additionally, the Ancient Mew promotional card and any card exclusive to the Pikachu World Collection* are not allowed in the East Coast Super Trainer Showdown. Here’s the URL for that:Wizards of the Coast

We also have a guest MT with us today…Dark MT Mike. Please save all Maple Bar/Donut debates for the last two hours of the chat.

  1. Last week, you said you could energy flow a Buzzaped Electrode back into your hand (Q29). Now, if you have it back in your hand, could you evolve a Voltorb back into that Electrode? Or would it forever stay energy?
    Master Trainer Pat: If you have the Electrode back in your hand you can then use it as a Stage 1 Pokémon again. It doesn’t stay energy.

  2. Over at Pokeschool, we are debating a loophole in the 3-card rule for the STS. Rules State no more than 3 of any “single” card can be used. But, could I use 3 Charmander base, and 1 Charmander TR? Or can you only have 3 cards with the same name?
    Dark Master Trainer Mike: It would be the same as the original 4-card rule. Only with 3 cards.

  3. You have a Lv. 10 S Gastly w/6 Psy Energy Cards attached, giving it 100HP (PP Gaseous Form). It has 90 Damage. Will Energy Flow allow you to remove all the 6 Psy Energies before it is KO’d, or will it be KO’d when you remove the first one?
    Master Trainer Pat: You can remove all 6 at the same time with energy flow. ‘All 6’

Therefore, since you’re technically not evolving, Ditto can say become a Blastoise without the ability to Rain Dance water Energy right? What happens when I Knock Out Brock’s Ninetales and Blastoise is still on Ditto?
    Dark Master Trainer Mike: Ditto would be Blastoise as long as Blastoise was out. Ditto would become Ditto If you knocked out the Ninetales.

  5. Koga’s Beedrill. Would Scooping it up and playing it again would reactivate the ability to do Hyper Needle, right?
    Master Trainer Pat: You could do Hyper Needle again after re-evolving to Beedrill, correct.

  6. Ditto is Dittoing Sabrina’s Alakazam. Would I be able to play Sabrina (the trainer) on my Ditto?
    Master Trainer Pat: Yes.

    Dark Master Trainer Mike: That depends on the tournament organizer.

  45. What would be the order of attack if Dark Alakazam attacks Erika’s Vileplume with Teleport Blast? Would Pollen Defense effect the NEW Active Pokémon?
    Master Trainer Pat: No, it affects D Alakazam right before D Alakazam bounces to the bench. Thus curing itself from the Confusion right away.

  46. When will the first Neo card come out? Or won’t it?
    Dark Master Trainer Mike: It is already out. In Japan that is!

  47. If Chaos gym is in play, and I play Tickling Machine. I flip tails, my opponent decides to use Tickling machine and he flips tails. Whose turn is it now?
    Master Trainer Pat: It’s still your turn. If a trainer that states ‘your turn is over after using this’ is used by an opponent when Chaos Gym is in play, your opponent ignores that, since it’s not their turn anyway.

  48. If Misty’s Tentacruel uses Flee to switch with a benched Pokémon, would that other Pokémon receive effects of the attack (i.e. paralyze, poison)?
    Dark Master Trainer Mike: No it would not.

  49. If a Sabrina’s Kadabra attacks with Life Down on a Rocket’s Scyther after it used Shadow Images last turn, would the amount of damage counter put on Scyther depend on the 2nd coin flip or both coin flips?
    Master Trainer Pat: Life Drain is not damage so that wouldn’t be stopped by Shadow Images

  50. What are the new Pokémon cards called that just came out?
    Dark Master Trainer Mike: Gym Challenge or I like to call them Sabrina’s Maple Bar collection.

  51. Can I use my un-errated (sp?)? Rocket’s Minefield Gym for Casual play? (Die Chansey Die!)
    Master Trainer Pat: Imakuni has decreed from Japan that all English Rocket’s Minefield Gym cards should now say ‘…2 damage counters…’

  52. I have a Flames Of Rage deck that needs 4 of a certain card and so now it gets punished cause of archetypes help
    Master Trainer Pat: Everyone has to build decks under the same rules for the STS. Use your imagination and skill to come up with a fix or a new deck. Nobody is being punished here.

  53. My Dark Vileplume has a weakness to Fighting, not Fire. Do I play the card as if this were not an error?
    Dark Master Trainer Mike: Play it as printed.

  54. What is the best Pokémon card available?
    Dark Master Trainer Mike: Are you talking to me! Then it’s GENGAR!
    Master Trainer Pat: Best in what? Professor Oak probably is used in the most decks.

  55. When will you guy have permission give any neo info?
    Dark Master Trainer Mike: Neo? What’s that?

  56. When will the 9-card Pikachu set be brought here?
    Master Trainer Pat: The 9 card set "Pikachu World Collection’ will not be released here that we know of. However the cards in that set will be produced in English and distributed in different ways. Check out the Pokémon section of our website for more info on how they’ll be released.

  57. How can I get cards with the new Pokémon on it? New Pokémon
    Dark Master Trainer Mike: The only ones are Japanese at this time.

  58. What info can you tell us about Pokémon in 2001?
    Dark Master Trainer Mike: It’s going to be a good year for Pokémon in 2001!
    Master Trainer Pat: You set yourself up on that one…

  59. Venomoth shifts to Psychic using Shift. Now can Sabrina’s Alakazam use Venom Powder now that it is a Psychic Type through it’s Pokémon Power?
    Master Trainer Pat: Yes that’ll work.

  60. What’s the next set?
    Master Trainer Pat: I’m not sure.

  61. Koga says that, if a Pokémon w/ Koga in its name damages a defending Pokémon, “that Pokémon is now poisoned.” Which one: the Koga one or the defending one?
    Dark Master Trainer Mike: The defending one.

  62. Will there be any new promos for the rest of the year?
    Master Trainer Pat: The only one I know of is Brock’s Vulpix from TopDeck it’s not a numbered promo though.

  63. If a creature does not cause to tap to attack can it attack if it is tapped?
    Dark Master Trainer Mike: There’s no place like home! There’s no place like home!

  64. What are the details on the East STS tournament itself, like how many players, how many rounds, how long will it go?
    Master Trainer Pat: I’ll try to round up some details for you by next week on that.

  65. If there was a prerelease card for Challenge, what would it probably be?
    Dark Master Trainer Mike: Imakuni’s Dorito.

  66. Are there plans on league promos after Cool Porygon and ____"s Pikachu?
    Dark Master Trainer Mike: Yes. Yes there are.

  67. Why do you change card pictures? It says, I believe, on the back of card packages, “10 and up”
    Master Trainer Pat: We change lots of things due to cultural differences between Japan and the US.

  68. If you make neo, can you make Steel Energy for a prerelease?
    Dark Master Trainer Mike: What is this Neo thing?

  69. Will Prop15 take effect for the Pokémon League?
    Dark Master Trainer Mike: No.

  70. Have the Pokémon Trivia prizes been sent yet?
    Master Trainer Pat: No, they’re sitting here on my desk. I just got the winners’ addresses and stuff so I’ll be sending them out tomorrow.

  71. Do you know why Wizards doesn’t make the Japanese super rare cards super rare in the U.S.?
    Master Trainer Pat: We just have chosen not to follow the same pattern that they did in Japan. That’s all.

  72. Where can I submit my prop 15/3 results?
    Dark Master Trainer Mike: custserv@wizards.com

  73. What tournament format will the STS use? Swiss, Double elimination, single elimination, other?
    Master Trainer Pat: It will most likely use a Swiss format.

  74. Also, just how many people is this event going to hold? According to several reports people were turned away at the West STS
    Dark Master Trainer Mike: About 6000 total and 1500 for the tournament!

  75. Is Birthday Pikachu legal in Tournaments?
    Master Trainer Pat: No.

  76. So I can go to any Pokémon place and compete there, and how do I get points?
    Dark Master Trainer Mike: You must go to a league store. Play, trade, teaches.

  77. What do you think the most powerful card will be in the 15T environment?
    Master Trainer Pat: That’s tough. Professor Oak is still going to be one of my top picks. I don’t know as far as Pokémon. The regulars will be up there like Wiggly, Scyther and Movie Mewtwo.
    Dark Master Trainer Mike: Prof. Oak. Not Weedle as previously thought.

  78. Do you personally prefer playing with the prop 15/3 rules or with out them?
    Master Trainer Pat: Honestly, I’ve been having some fun putting together decks again. Which is cool. However, so far that limit to 3 of a certain card has kinda cramped my style. It sure made me revise my decks though.

  79. Will there be plans for a Lugia card?
    Dark Master Trainer Mike: No plans.

  80. Can Electrode (Base) be used to make 1 Fire and 1 plant energy?
    Dark Master Trainer Mike: If that plant is Grass.

  81. If I’m ditto and I’m copying Arcanine and do flame-thrower can I discard any card or do I have to discard only a fire energy?
    Dark Master Trainer Mike: First of all if you’re actually Ditto I’m calling in a bunch of scientists. Otherwise the answer is any card.
    Master Trainer Pat: I’ll add: any energy card attached to Ditto.

  82. RE Question 29 Regarding the evolution of Team Rocket’s Meowth: I don’t think it can evolve because I’ve heard that Team Rocket’s Meowth can only evolve into Team Rocket’s Persian, which hasn’t been printed yet. Are you sure?
    Master Trainer Pat: You’re right, I thought the question mentioned ‘Rocket’s Meowth’ as in the Meowth from the Team Rocket set…too many Meowths

  83. I am about to move to another country. Would I still get DCI points there?
    Dark Master Trainer Mike: Yes. Unless that country is on another planet.

  84. You can evolve TR Meowth into Persian? Persian says “evolves from Meowth” and you guys said you can’t evolve Dk. Kadabra into Alakazam because it says Kadabra, not Dk. are you sure about TR Meowth? Please get r/d.
    Master Trainer Pat: You’re right, see my last answer. I thought the question was about Meowth from Team Rocket set.

  85. Any new developments on next year’s STS?
    Dark Master Trainer Mike: No. Yes I will be developing a Maple Bar set.

  86. Will Rocket’s Scyther be able to evolve into scizor? (In Neo 2) Will Tyrogue be able to evolve into Rocket’s Hitmonchan? (Also in Neo 2)
    Master Trainer Pat: I don’t know, wouldn’t you have to follow the regular rules for evolution? If it’s Rocket’s Scyther, that would have to evolve to Rocket’s ______. Whatever the name of that evolution would be. I really don’t know many of the Japanese Neo cards.

  87. Erika’s Vileplume vs. Dark Machoke. Machoke uses knock back to send Vileplume to the bench. Would the flip occur for Pollen Stench?
    Master Trainer Pat: You mean Pollen Defense? The answer is the same, any other effects of attacks by the active happen after you apply Poke Powers from the defending Pokemon. Check the rules (version 3, pg.22, step g and I)

  88. Have you played any of the new GameBoy games?
    Dark Master Trainer Mike: Wish I had the time. No I have not.
    Master Trainer Pat: I was able to try out Pokémon Gold at the Chicago Mall Tour very cool.

  89. Are there any plans to ban cards?
    Dark Master Trainer Mike: No plans.

  90. How many Sabrina’s Abra promo cards were made?
    Dark Master Trainer Mike: If I tell you I would have to “Knock you out”

  91. When is neo going to come out?
    Master Trainer Pat: At least 2 Neo sets have already come out in Japan.

  92. If you have a 60 card deck with no Basic Pokémon in it, would it lose by delay of game or something if the opponent chose not to draw 2 cards every time? ( curtsey of Flying_Dragonair =)
    Dark Master Trainer Mike: The game would never start.

  93. Have you guy’s thought about doing a ProTour like Magic. I’m pretty sure they have something like it in Japan. (I know, you’re not associated with them?
    Dark Master Trainer Mike: We have thought about it.

  94. Any news about Neo being translated.
    Master Trainer Pat: No news, sorry.

  95. UHHHMMMMM is it true that there is going to be a 15/3 rule for STS?
    Dark Master Trainer Mike: Yes it’s all-true!

  96. Regarding the response to Question 33, you said that Pollen Defense would take effect before the Pokémon swapped. Should a heads be flipped and Dark Alakazam move to the bench, would Confusion then be canceled?
    Master Trainer Pat: Exactly. I think you’re getting it now.

  97. Will gym 2 be allowed at STS?
    Master Trainer Pat: Yes.

  98. What WOTC representative will be at the King of Prussia stop?
    Dark Master Trainer Mike: None of the MT’s but there will be some corporate people as well as the great DSL guys.

  99. Will there be a Team Rocket’s Persian?
    Dark Master Trainer Mike: Don’t know

  100. My wife (!) asks: Is there something missing from Blaine’s Charmander “Fire Tail Slap” text? Why does it say “Use this attack only if there are any Fire Energy cards attached to Bl’s Char?” Inquiring minds want to know?
    Master Trainer Pat: No, nothing missing that we can see. Time to wrap it up for this week gang. If we didn’t get to your question, write it down and call or ask it next week.

Dark Master Trainer Mike: It was fun. Keep eating those Maple Bars.

Master Trainer Pat: See you later.

Thurs. Oct 19, 2000 - Weekly Pokemon TCG Q&A

Pokémon Online Help
Offered every Thursday 3-5 PST in the TCG Forum of the Wizards. Community chat site!
Featuring Master_Trainers Mike and Pat from Customer Service

Oct 19,2000

Master Trainer Mike: Hi gang, MT Pat is having some technical difficulties. He has the opening announcements so he is rebooting. Anyway, glad to be back, Vermont was beautiful. Saw a few Weedles in the wild but let them go. I also upgraded my PC to Win 2000 so I’ll blame all errors on that today, ok?

  1. I know there is a WOTC trading newsgroup at tank.wizards.com, but is there an all Pokémon trading newsgroup?
    Master Trainer Mike: Not one that we hold. I would check out the Pokegym, the Pojo, or the Pokeschool. I imagine they might know of one or more.

  2. When do the DCI rating for NC get updated?
    Master Trainer Mike: That is not something we know much about. I know that they have been running a bit behind. Last I heard it is supposed to be every 2-4 weeks.

  3. Do you plan on holding an event in the Pittsburgh PA area ever? I know lots of people who wish one would be held here.
    Master Trainer Mike: I know that several tournaments take place in that area. Check out our tournament locator on our web site.

Master Trainer Pat: Hi gang! Sorry 'bout the delay. I will go ahead and correct something that slipped by us last week and that is that when you use Electrode’s Buzzap Pokémon Power you can only choose one type of energy for that Buzzap’d Electrode to provide.

  1. When a Chaos Gym is in play, and you flip tails when trying to play a Trainer, does your opponent use the Trainer immediately (assuming they can fulfill the requirements to use it) or do they have to wait until their turn?
    Master Trainer Mike: Yup he must use it immediately or not at all.

  2. If a Chaos Gym is in play, can your opponent choose to use your Plus Powers and Defenders if you flip tails?
    Master Trainer Mike: Yup.

  3. You use Misty’s Psyduck ESP attack against a Ditto. You flip 3 heads so you get to copy an attack. Since Ditto is Misty’s Psyduck, can you copy the ESP attack and flip 3 coins again?
    Master Trainer Mike: Sure but that would be silly.

  4. Did you catch any Weedles in Vermont, MTM?
    Master Trainer Mike: Nope couldn’t catch them.

  5. Clarification regarding Lt. Surge’s Secret Plan: The card says, “Flip the card if it ever uses an attack or Pokémon power”. Does this mean if you place a Stage 1 or 2 face down, you could flip it, use its Attacks or Powers and then discard it because it is not a Basic?
    Master Trainer Pat: No, if you flipped it and it wasn’t a basic, you would discard it. You wouldn’t be able to use attacks or Pokemon Powers on that Pokemon.

  6. Ditto is opposite Rapidash. Ditto does Agility and flips heads. Then the opponent plays Goop Gas Attack. Can the opponent do damage to Ditto on this turn?
    Master Trainer Mike: Nope, the Agility effect is still residing on him.

  7. What was that Easter egg in Play It! V2 CD? Something about fire?
    Master Trainer Pat: I have not checked it on version 2 yet, but on the original you could type ‘fire’ at the title screen and open up 2 other decks.

  8. Clarification on Brock’s Protection: The card does not specifically say how long it stays in play. Is it discarded after your opponent’s next turn, or does it stay attached to the Pokémon?
    Master Trainer Mike: It stays on that Pokémon while that Pokémon is in play.

  9. If Ditto copies a Koga’s Beedrill and uses Hyper Needle, can Ditto use the attack again if it gets benched and then becomes active again?
    Master Trainer Pat: Nope

  10. Here is a quote from the Wizards website regarding year 2 of Pokémon League - ". . . it is going to be more exciting than ever. New trainers. New badges. New cities. New game mechanics. New promo cards to earn. "Can/will you elaborate on what those “New” things might be?
    Master Trainer Mike: Not yet, sorry.

  11. If you use Tickling Machine and flip a heads then play an Imposter Professor Oak, does your opponent shuffle the face down cards into his deck or does he just draw 7 cards?
    Master Trainer Pat: He just draws 7 cards.

  12. I have a Blains Charizard that has a fighting energy symbol on it, is this an error and when will it be corrected?
    Master Trainer Mike: It is an error, play it as a fire symbol instead, it won’t be corrected, and just play it the way it was supposed to be.

  13. If my opponent successfully play a Tickle Machine, and there is a Chaos Gym in play, if he plays an Oak and flips tails and I choose to use it, do I have to discard the face down cards and draw 7 cards or just draw 7 cards?
    Master Trainer Pat: No, those face down cards stay where they are.

  14. If Ditto is copying a Sabrina’s Kadabra, can you play a Sabrina’s ESP on Ditto? And if you gust up a different non-Sabrina Pokémon, can you use the attached ESP when you attack?
    Master Trainer Mike: Yes you could but we will verify that answer with R&D.

  15. With Chaos Gym, if I try to play a “turn-ending” card (like Computer Error or Tickling Machine) but flip tails, if my opponent chooses to go ahead and use the card is my turn then immediately over even though it was not I who used the card?
    Master Trainer Pat: No, your opponent would just ignore that part of the card and you could continue your turn after your opponent uses the trainer.

  16. When will the corrected versions of the TR errors be released?
    Master Trainer Mike: Never

  17. What are your plans for the next big Pokémon event? Perhaps another STS?
    Master Trainer Mike: Nothing announced yet, possibly more smaller STS type events in a year.

  18. So has DMTM been punished for his mistakes on the Electrode Buzzap question he answer wrong last week?
    Master Trainer Pat: Everyone makes mistakes Scrye_Fung, even you. . . we’ve seen your posts

  19. If Sabrina’s Kadabra does Life Drain against an undamaged Mr. Mime, how many damage counters are placed on Mr. Mime?
    Master Trainer Mike: 3 damage counters, the Invisible Wall does not prevent the placement of damage counters, only damage.

  20. With Chaos Gym, if I try to play Goop Gas Attack but flip tails, if my opponent chooses to use the card does the Goop stay active for my turn + their turn + my turn once again, or just until the end of my current turn? (card text says "opp’s NEXT turn
    Master Trainer Pat: Since your opponent is playing Goop Gas it would last until the end of your next turn

  21. Can Koga’s Kakuna use its Pokémon Power to evolve on the same turn it comes into play.
    Master Trainer Mike: Yup.

  22. With Chaos Gym, what happens if I try to play a Plus Power or Defender and flip tails? And if they can use it, how long would it stay attached?
    Master Trainer Mike: They last until the end of the player’s turn who played it. So if you tried to use it on your turn and flipped tails and I decided to use it instead. It would last until the end of my turn.

  23. When will the world Pikachu cards be released in the us and how can I get em?
    Master Trainer Pat: Most of the English versions of those cards will be released as League promos next year some time.

  24. Since “Life Drain doesn’t do damage, it just places damage counters,” does this mean that Life Drain will place damage counters equal to 110 on Chansey, even if Chansey has successfully done Scrunch? Master Trainer Mike: Correct!

  25. Is base Mewtwo’s “Barrier” like a “Smokescreen” (the attack fails), or does Barrier only prevent damage and effects done to Mewtwo? (Would “Fetch”, “Messenger”, “Scavenge”, “Stretch Kick”, etc. , still work despite the Barrier? )
    Master Trainer Pat: Barrier is unlike Smokescreen in that Barrier will prevent effects _to_ Mewtwo, but other effects will still happen. So Fetch would work against Barrier.

  26. If my opponent plays Challenge and I put some Pokémon onto the bench, can I evolve those Pokémon when my turn comes around or do I have to wait a full turn after that?
    Master Trainer Mike: Yes you can.

  27. If I use Charizard’s Energy Burn to make some cards into Fire energy, do they stay Fire if I use Energy Flow to bring them back into my hand? The Energy Burn power says “until the end of the turn”.
    Master Trainer Pat: They remain Fire only while they’re in play.

  28. Any promo news? Also what issue is the Brock’s Vulpix in?
    Master Trainer Pat: I think that should be in issue 13.

  29. Why wasn’t the Industry Edge chat w/ R&D on Gym: Challenge advertised better? I mean, I only found about it 2 hours before the actual chat!
    Master Trainer Mike: Probably a last minute addition.

  30. Can I use Devolution Spray (trainer) on a Pokémon that I evolved on that same turn? For example, I evolve to Muk to turn off Dark Vileplume’s “Hay Fever”, play all the trainer cards I want, and finally use DevoSpray on the Muk at the end.
    Master Trainer Mike: Yes you could do that.

  31. A BuzzZapped Electrode on a Rocket’s Zapdos, how does this play when Zapdos does his Electroburn Attack. . . as far as the damage done to Zapdos?
    Master Trainer Pat: In this case Rocket’s Zapdos states ‘Lightning energy cards’ so the Buzzap’d Electrode would only count as one Lightning card.

  32. If I flip tails while trying to use Rocket’s Secret Experiment, does that mean I can’t play any more trainers for the rest of this turn *and* the entirety of my next turn too? Or is it just until the end of my current turn?
    Master Trainer Mike: You would have to wait until the end of your next turn. . What a yucky card.
    Brock’s Protection (trainer) says to “attach it to one of your Pokémon with Brock in its name”, but it doesn’t say when to discard the card. Does it last for the remainder of the game?
    Master Trainer Mike: As long as that Pokémon remains in play it does.

  33. If I have one Sabrina’s Alakazam active and another on my bench, can I use Psylink to use the benched one’s Mega Burn attack on the turn after I used the active one’s Mega Burn attack?
    Master Trainer Pat: No, you would not be able to use Mega Burn during your next turn even if you used the Psylink Power

  34. Dark Weezing’s “Mass Explosion” attack does 20 damage times the number of Koffings, Weezings, and Dark Weezings in play. Does this include Koga’s Koffing & Koga’s Weezing too or not?
    Master Trainer Pat: Nada.

  35. Will the Space Weedle be at the East Coast STS?
    Master Trainer Mike: Yup!
    Master Trainer Pat: Uh-huh!

  36. Some are interpreting rule 215 of the Pokémon DCI Floor Rules to mean that if the 1st player mulligan, then 2nd player may draw 2 addition cards even if no basic Pokémon were drawn in the 2nd player’s initial 7 card draw. Is this correct?
    Master Trainer Mike: Yeash, technically you could do that but if you still don’t end up with a basic then you get caught cheating and you lose the match, period! Not a smart move to do.
    Master Trainer Pat: Not a good thing to be caught doing. . .

  37. Now that Gym Challenge is out, would Dark Weezing’s Mass Explosion include Koga’s Koffings and Weezings in calculating damage?
    Master Trainer Pat: Nope

  38. Last week in Q114, DMTM said that a Buzzap’d Electrode could provide 1 Fire and 1 Plant (as long as that plant is Grass) energy. Are you allowed to split the energy types like that (one of each) or did he just run out of donuts or something?
    Master Trainer Mike: He gave the answer we were given by R&D months ago. They corrected it today. So no you could not do that but DMTM gave you what he was told to say.

  39. If there is a Chaos Gym in play, and you try play a Rocket’s Secret Experiment and get tails, and your opponent choose to use it and get tails, can he still play trainer cards during his turn?
    Master Trainer Mike: Nope.

  40. If some use Sabrina’s Kadabra’s First attack ( I can’t remember its name) with a power plus does knock out the defending in one hit. Do you apply weakness, resistance and Pokémon Power for the attack.
    Master Trainer Pat: No, because that attack isn’t doing damage.

  41. The Rocket’s Minefield Gym card is kind of vague. It says, flip a coin, if heads put damage counters on the Pokémon, but it doesn’t say how many?
    Master Trainer Mike: That is an error. It is supposed to say 2 damage counters. Play it as if it said 2.

  42. Now you have had a good time to check out the “gym challenge” cards what do u like best? . . . and why?
    Master Trainer Mike: Blaine’s Charizard! Woohoo!
    Master Trainer Pat: Rocket’s Zapdos and Rocket’s Mewtwo are no brainers. . . they’re so tuff.
    Master Trainer Mike: The Koga’s Weedle of course! and Koga’s Kakuna and Beedrill. Chaos Gym!!
    Master Trainer Pat: Some other I like are Max Revive and Master Ball, for obvious reasons.
    Master Trainer Mike: Koga’s Pidgey with Messenger, free Pokémon trader effect!

  43. Sorry to bug you about this, but any idea as to how long it will take for the trivia prize to reach me? (I live in the UK. . . )
    Master Trainer Pat: We just sent those out, I’m not sure how long it will take to get to you.

Can I use Erika’s Clefairy lv16 Lunar Power to evolve my Pokémon on my first turn, and can this attack be use to evolve a Pokémon with Aerodactyl in play.
Master Trainer Pat: No you couldn’t use that on your first turn, but it would get around Aerodactyl

  1. Do you know any DCI tournaments in West Virginia? It’s not even on your site!
    Master Trainer Mike: You are right it isn’t. I’ll mention that to the DCI. Check local stores.

  2. If Ditto is opposite a Brock’s Ninetales, which has used Shapeshift to turn into Clefable, is Ditto a Clefable or a Brock’s Ninetales?
    Master Trainer Pat: It is a Brock’s Ninetales.

  3. If Brock’s Ninetales has used Shapeshift to turn into Clefable, and the opponent plays Goop Gas Attack, is Clefable discarded or does Brock’s Ninetales turn back into Clefable after the Goop Gas wears off?
    Master Trainer Pat: Check the last line on the Shapeshift text. The Clefable would get discarded.

  4. I am Confused. Chaos Gym. I thought Trainers that Stay in play such as Plus Power & Defender, could not be used by your opponent?
    Master Trainer Pat: Sorry for confusing you, that was our mistake in not checking the card text first. Any Trainer that needs to be put in play may not be used by your opponent.
    Master Trainer Mike: Oops, must still have Vermont on my mind. The card is worded a bit unclearly and we read it wrong, you are right.

  5. About question 8, doesn’t Chaos Gym say “Your opponent cannot use the trainer if it says to attach it to a Pokémon”?
    Master Trainer Mike: Right, we were wrong.

  6. If my opponent use Pokémon Breeder and flip tales with Chaos Gym in play. Can I use that Pokémon Breeder on one of my Pokémon to evolve it if I have the nessary basic and stage2 Pokémon?
    Master Trainer Mike: Yup you can.
    Master Trainer Pat: Yes, sir

  7. If your opponent sends out another Koga Beedrill for question 16 would you be able to use the attack?
    Master Trainer Mike: Yeah.

  8. If Brock’s Ninetales is poisoned, and then uses Shapeshift and attaches an evolution card, is Brock’s Ninetales still poisoned?
    Master Trainer Pat: Correct.

  9. Is Rocket’s Minefield Gym going to be corrected?
    Master Trainer Mike: Print wise no, play it as if it said 2 damage counters.

  10. Are there any more errors in the challenge set?
    Master Trainer Pat: Not that we’re aware of.

  11. Is the Team Rockets Victrebel non-holo have an error about weakness (fighting)
    Master Trainer Mike: Umm no, its the Dark Vileplume.

  12. If I play a Rocket Zapdos and attach three rainbow to it and one lets say potion energy, do the three rainbow do 10 damage each to Zapdos when I use Elctroburn? (Not sure if attack name is right)
    Master Trainer Pat: While Rainbow energy is in play it counts as every type, so yes it would do 10 damage.

  13. I think that if you play a Defender or PlusPower with chaos gym in play the card should just be discarded since those cards must be put “in to play” and Chaos Gym says. What is your estimate on the number of questions that will be re-answered next time =Þ
    Master Trainer Mike: (sigh) you guy’s browbeat us so. Thousands of times.

  14. What do I do after I get all the league badges, TMs, tones of cards, and done all the challenges? Are you going to have more badges, like maybe from the orange/johto league?
    Master Trainer Mike: New league with all new stuff to take up all your time start Jan 6th next year.

  15. Will Prop 15-3C become DCI Tourney Format?
    Master Trainer Pat: We don’t know.

  16. As stated in the answer to #38, I believe you could not devolve a poke you evolved the same turn because the Dev Spray says treats it just as if you had evolved it, and you can’t “evolve” a Pokémon more than once per turn, or am I mistaken somewhere?
    Master Trainer Mike: It means that it would count as evolving meaning you could not then evolve a Pokémon you Devolved that turn. It is NOT Evolving so you can play it after Evolving. It just counts as it for the sake of figuring other rules. Confusing I know.

  17. If I attach a PlusPower to Brock’s Golbat and so Spiral Dive, would the plus power do 10 extra damage to the defending Pokémon, making it 20 to the defending, and 10 to the opponent’s bench?
    Master Trainer Pat: Correct Magmar2k!

  18. Is Team Rocket Grimers poison gas supposed to say puts opponent to sleep or is that an err
    Master Trainer Mike: Play it as written.

  19. Chaos Gym is in play. I play a Plus Power. I flip a tails. Can my opponent use it on their next turn? If not, why? Are there other cards that can’t be used?
