Thurs. Oct 26, 2000 - Weekly Pokemon TCG Q&A

Pokémon Online Help
Offered every Thursday 3-5 PST in the TCG Forum of the Wizards.Community chat site!
Featuring Master_Trainer from Customer Service

Oct 26,2000

Master Trainer Mike: Howdy gang!

Master Trainer Pat: How’s everyone doing?

Master Trainer Mike: Hi friends, MT Mike and Pat here again with your MINTY FRESH announcements!

First, as some of you may have heard, we will be releasing a Neo based TCG expansion within the next few months. We have no release dates, composition, or any other information for you at this time though.

Second, I can tell you about a new upcoming promo card. Pikachu promo #27 (which is from the Japanese Vending card set) will be coming out with the Pokémon 2000 DVD and video release. This card was last released in Italian in the Sydney World Pikachu Collection.

Third, make sure to stop by the Florida Mall Tour stop this weekend to challenge Dark Master Trainer Mike and his Evaporate deck. He’ll be glad to try and give you game.

And last, Wizards of the Coast Game Support will start taking phone reservations for the East Coast STS’s main tournament. If you have not earned an invitation through a qualifying event, you can still participate if you have earned 5 or more League badges. If you are 17 or under in age, you must have a parent call to make a reservation for you (due to legal issues of gathering information from minors). Slots will fill up fast so be sure to call to hold your self-a spot!

  1. If Clefable is opposite Brock’s Ninetales with Wigglytuff attached, can Clefable Metronome “Do the Wave” or only “Will-o’-the-Wisp”?
    Master Trainer Pat: Clefable can do both.

  2. Can the Giovanni trainer card still be used if Aerodactyl is in play?
    Master Trainer Mike: While you could play the card, it would not do you any good. Aerodactyl would still prevent the evolutions form occurring (i.e. playing cards from your hand).

  3. A Buzzaped Electrode is put into the discard pile (say after Charizard was KO’d). Would the Buzzaped Electrode revert back to being Electrode or stay as an Energy card in the discard pile?
    Master Trainer Pat: It would revert back to Electrode.

  4. I got my Trivia prize and I wanted to say thanks for the bonus promos!
    Master Trainer Pat: You’re welcome.
    Master Trainer Mike: Welcome!

  5. If Brock’s Ninetales has a non-Brock evolution card attached, can Brock’s Protection be attached (and prevent energy removal)?
    Master Trainer Mike: NOPE!

  6. If I have two Sabrina’s Alakazam’s out, and if I used MegaBurn last turn, can I retreat the active one, bring out the second one, and use the second one’s MegaBurn?
    Master Trainer Pat: You won’t be able to use an attack named Mega Burn during your next turn.
    Master Trainer Mike: No way Jose!

  7. If I use Poliwhirl’s Amnesia against an active Sabrina’s Alakazam with “Psylink” Pokémon power, can I choose to prevent S’s Alakazam from using one of the benched Psy Pokémon’s attacks or does it have to Amnesia the MegaBurn attack?
    Master Trainer Mike: Yes you could do that as Psylink says it always has copies of those attacks.

  8. Suppose Koga’s Beedrill is paralyzed. You play a Devolution Spray, discard the Koga’s Beedrill, which makes Koga’s Kakuna active. Can you use Koga’s Kakuna’s Pokémon Power to evolve back into Koga’s Beedrill on that same turn?
    Master Trainer Pat: Yes, Koga’s Kakuna’s Pokémon Power breaks the evolution rules as it is.

  9. If I have a Ditto out against a Heroes Sabrina’s Abra and I have a fire energy on Ditto and I use Energy Loop, do I put the energy back in my hand? (The fire is still a fire card, but counts as psychic energy?)
    Master Trainer Pat: You would have to, because S. Abra’s attack requires it.

  10. If you have a defender attached to the Defending, and you do Life Drain and it works, do you have 30 damage left instead of 10?
    Master Trainer Pat: No, because Life Drain moves damage counters and Defender doesn’t stop that.

  11. Any new promos you can tell us about?
    Master Trainer Mike: Mentioned the Vending card Pikachu coming in the Pokémon 2000 movie in the announcements.

  12. If Ditto is opposite Brock’s Ninetales with Wigglytuff attached, can Ditto Metronome “Do the Wave” or only “Will-o’-the-Wisp”? Master Trainer Pat: Yes.

  13. If a Clefable uses metronome and it copies TR Zapdos’ electroburn does it take any damage if it has 0 lightning energies on it?
    Master Trainer Pat: Right-o

  14. If Brock’s Ninetales has Brock’s Protection attached, and then a non-Brock evolution card is attached, is energy removal still prevented? Master Trainer Pat: Yes, as long as you do this in the order you mentioned.

  15. Do the Lightning energy cards required for TR Zapdos’s attack count toward the self-damage? I haven’t read the card yet.
    Master Trainer Mike: Yes they do.

  16. When will WotC actually begin taking reservations for the East Coast STS? And what is the telephone number?
    Master Trainer Pat: Next Monday. 1(800) 324-6496

  17. What is the purpose of the card charity?
    Master Trainer Mike: Well, you can reduce damage to 20 or less so you can hit a pesky Mr. Mime, that’s about it.

  18. If you evolve is the smokescreen effect removed?
    Master Trainer Mike: Yup!

  19. On Blanies Charzard when you discard fire energy does it count for two fire energies?

  20. Are you saying that if Ditto or Clefable is opposite a Brock’s Ninetales with an evolution attached, then Ditto or Clefable can do the attacks of either Brock’s Ninetales or the evolution?
    Master Trainer Mike: No they could only use the attacks of the attached card on the Brock’s Ninetails.

  21. What’s the next card set that are coming out with?
    Master Trainer Mike: A Neo set, no more info yet though.

  24. East STS seems to be shaping up nicely. Assuming you will be there, will you and MT Mike, MT Pat, and Dark MT Mike be open for gunslinging? As well, when can we expect an all out Maple Bar Mud Pit, Pokémon Deathmatch between the MTs and Dark MT on PPV?
    Master Trainer Mike: Well, I for one have no desire to mud wrestle with DMT Mike or Pat. (Though there is nothing wrong with that). As for gunslinging, it will depend on how busy we end up, hope we have time to play some games with you guys though.

  25. I have a Sabrina’s Alakazam (3 dmg counters) active and a benched Rocket’s Mewtwo, (6 dmg counters), and my opponent has an active Blaine’s Growlithe (2 dmg counters). I decide to use Juxtapose(there is one psy. on S. Alakazam), utilizing Psylink. The flip is heads. Does the B’s Growlithe switch damage counters with the Alakazam, or with the Mewtwo?
    Master Trainer Mike: With the Sabrina’s Alakazam.

  28. When are you going to have another sts after the East Coast one?
    Master Trainer Mike: Nothing to announce yet, still in planning stages.

  29. My Brock’s Ninetails evolves into Muk. What the heck happens now?
    Master Trainer Pat: First of all, B. Ninetales doesn’t evolve into Muk. Then discard the Muk and B. Ninetales returns to normal. Muk-B-Gone

  34. In past weeks you stated that Ditto opposite Brock’s 9tales with an evo would be just Brock’s 9tales, and that Ditto could attach its own evo card. Today you say Ditto could use the attacks of the card attached to Brock’s 9tales . Clarify.
    Master Trainer Mike: I don’t recall ever saying that! It says on Brock’s Ninetails, TREAT it as that Pokémon (i.e. the attached card). Ditto would copy that Pokémon (though if it was discarded, then of course Ditto would become Brock’s Ninetails.)
    Master Trainer Pat: Because of the wording on B.9tales, the Ditto would still have the Shapeshift P-mon Power
    Master Trainer Mike: These are headache cards and we will definitely vote them off the island if we could!

  35. When is the East Coast tournament coming to south Florida?
    Master Trainer Mike: It will be in its only stop in Florida this weekend. Check our website for details.

  36. Do you know what the next Nintendo Power promo card is going to be or what month is going to be?

  37. How many English promos are there right now?

  40. Mike, will there be a Weedle on the T-Shirts given at the East Coast STS? Master Trainer Mike: Hmmm, great idea! But they only let me out of the box at chat time anymore. Not sure they’ll listen.

  41. What are the prizes given out at the STS and what’s the lowest rank you’d have to be to get something…the top 3 get stuff or what?

  42. Any Chance we might be see Neo at the STS? Like a Display
    Master Trainer Pat: Probably no chance whatsoever, probably.

  43. If rocket’s minefield is out, and I bring out a Pokémon, and the coin is tails and it gets knocked out does my opponent draw a prize? (Even though it’s on the bench)?

  44. Ditto against Brock’s Ninetales that has a Blastoise attached to it: Ditto would be transformed into B’s Ninetales, not the Blastoise, correct?

So, since Shapeshift says to Treat the Bibetails as the attached card, Ditto would copy the attached Pokémon card, period.

  45. Any plan for Southern Islands promos?
    Master Trainer Pat: None yet.

  46. What do you mean? The card says “put damage counters on the defending Pokémon”.
    Master Trainer Mike: Are you talking about the defender question? Defender, Pluspower, etc affect combat damage, NOT damage counters.

47 For Nidoqueen’s Boyfriend Attack, would a Giovanni’s Nidoking on the bench add 20 to the Damage?

  1. You say that Ditto opposite Brock’s 9tales with an evolution would be like the evolution. Since the evolution on Brock’s 9tales cannot use its Pokémon Power, can Ditto use the Pokémon Power?

    Master Trainer Mike: Sorry but we don’t know, they would have to talk with their District Managers on that one.

  32. I heard of the “W” stamp Dark Charmeleon. Where can I find one?

  33. Do you think the Pokémon campaign will lose popularity in the void between League years and between expansion sets? If not, what counter-measures has WOTC taken?
    Master Trainer Mike: Any hot property will lose some steam over time. We will continue to support it and encourage game play.

  34. How fast is Wizards making set compare to Japanese?
    Master Trainer Mike: We are playing catch-up.

  35. Mike, have you though of a record? I would seriously think about it. : Evil plan: Mike makes record, and by contract can’t sing at chat:
    Master Trainer Mike: Well, I’ll just say some music is being looked into.

  36. When we are catch up to Japanese, will Wizards release set the same time as Japanese?
    Master Trainer Mike: That is our eventual plan.

  37. Do you have any errata for Year 2–as it differs from Year 1?
    Master Trainer Mike: Not yet, sorry.

  38. Is the CD in the new boxed set the same as the trainer CD, or can you modify the cards?
    Master Trainer Mike: It is version 2, which includes sound effects for all the Pokémon, better training, and a deck builder and collection software

  39. Have you guys decide about the 15 trainer cards or play two trainers cards a turn?
    Master Trainer Mike: For the STS main tournament, no more than 15 trainers in your deck, and no more than 3 copies of any non-basic energy card. But ONLY for that tournament.

  40. How many badges in the year two?
    Master Trainer Mike: 8

  41. When does Year 2 of the Pokémon League start and will Toys R Us have it?
    Master Trainer Mike: Jan 6th and yes, they should.

  42. Do you have your OWN Pokémon card collection? If so, do you already have all the neo cards?
    Master Trainer Mike: I have about half so far.
    Master Trainer Pat: Yes, but I only have a few Japanese NEO cards.

  43. How many points to earn a badge in the year two?
    Master Trainer Mike: Should be the same I think (500).

  44. This has probably been answered a million times already, but how many cards does the Space Weedle contain?
    Master Trainer Pat: I don’t know but we received almost 1000 cards.

  45. What is your best deck and what is the name?
    Master Trainer Mike: I liked the Blaines Charizard deck I played in Braintree and the Koga’s Thread the Weedle deck.
    Master Trainer Pat: Right now I’m running a Blaine’s deck called Krusty Pup.
    Master Trainer Mike: My best deck is still under construction and I will name it George.

  46. What’s your favorite Neo Pokémon?
    Master Trainer Mike: Too early to tell but Feraligatr is pretty darn cool.
    Master Trainer Pat: I have seen that promo Scyther evolution. That’s very cool.

  47. Was the Dark Raichu an American developed card that was added to the Japanese Neo 2 set, or a Japanese card that was allowed to be used as a promo?
    Master Trainer Pat: Dark Raichu was an American developed card.

  48. Are you tired of people asking questions about Neo?
    Master Trainer Mike: Figure we will be soon enough.

  49. Is there going to be a Central STS?
    Master Trainer Mike: No plans yet.

  50. How many seats are in this STS again?
    Master Trainer Mike: The main event can handle up to 1600.

Master Trainer Mike: Ok, so no new questions so we are outta here. Have to go write for Top Deck anyway.
Master Trainer Pat: By gang, we’ll see ya next week.
Master Trainer Mike: see ya!

Thurs. Nov 2, 2000 - Weekly Pokemon TCG Q&A

Pokémon Online Help
Offered every Thursday 3-5 PST in the TCG Forum of the Wizards.Community chat site!
Featuring Master_Trainers Mike and Pat from Customer Service

Nov 2, 2000

Master Trainer Pat: Hey Poke-fiends and friends! We have some interesting announcements for you this week about some new cards on the way and some ruling clarifications from last week. Realize that many Bothans died in order to get us this information.

All right! Here’s the deal with Ditto and Brock’s Ninetails: When Ditto is opposite B. Ninetails and B. Ninetails has a Pokémon attached to it (that it has Shape shifted into) Ditto _only_ copies the B. Ninetails, _not_ the Pokémon that it has Shape shifted into. If Ditto uses the Shape shift Pokemon Power to attach a Pokémon to it, and then Ditto’s Pokemon Power is turned off some how, the card that is attached to Ditto stays right where it is and doesn’t have any further affect on the game unless that Ditto manages to copy B. Ninetails again. Also regarding Ditto (no surprise there!): If Ditto is copying a Brock’s card and Brock’s Protection is attached to Ditto during this time, the Brock’s Protection card will not go away if Ditto becomes a copy of a non-Brock Pokemon. Whew! That’s it for now… Mike do you have anything?

Master Trainer Mike: Some NEO info! Info on the first upcoming Pokémon Neo expansion. It will be called Neo: Genesis. It will contain over 60 all new Pokémon, including the Baby Pokémon. 2 new energy types (along with some Pokémon) called Darkness and Metal. It will be out within the next few months (no specific dates yet).

  1. What is the next “W” promo?
    Master Trainer Mike: Foil stamped Brock’s Vulpix with issue 13.

  2. When is Pokémon neo coming out?
    Master Trainer Mike: No release dates for Neo Genesis yet.

  3. Neo: Genesis Great name MTM. Where did WotC get it?
    Master Trainer Mike: Kierin is a true Phil Collins fan, he runs around singing from the Tarzan soundtrack.

  4. At the ECSTS what format will the playing field be (not decks. Swiss type?)? How long will it be and when would it start?
    Master Trainer Pat: Swiss. Check the Pokémon page on our site for more info.

  5. Last week, you said that if Brock’s Ninetales uses Shape shift to attach a Muk, Muk’s Toxic Gas power would shut down Shape shift and cause Muk to be discarded (“Muk-B-Gone”). But Shape shift ignores powers, so the Toxic Gas shouldn’t work, correct?
    Master Trainer Pat: Correct. Also, see my announcements from this week for more on Ditto/B. Ninetails.

  6. If Ditto is up against a non-Shape shifted B’s Ninetales, can it use the Pokemon Power to search for an evo card to attach to Ditto (since it’s not truly evolving, I think you can). And when Ditto transforms into something else the evo is discarded, ya?
    Master Trainer Pat: You can’t use the Shape shift power to search. When Ditto copies something else the card that is attached stays right where it is.

  7. How come we do not get a fossil mew? Do we have it another form? Is it promo #8? -
    Master Trainer Mike: Promo #8 and #9 were the Mew cards.

  8. Any word from R&D yet on whether you can play a Sabrina’s ESP on a Ditto copying a Sabrina’s Kadabra? And if you gust up a different non-Sabrina Pokémon, could you still use the attached ESP when you attack?

    Master Trainer Pat: We do not advocate Pokémon playing to resolve domestic disputes but. Yes Ditto becomes just plain old Ditto for a turn. Sorry, 'bout the couch man.

  15. When is WOTC starting the online contest for the Happy Birthday Pikachu?
    Master Trainer Pat: We’ve been told Dec. 1st on our website.

  16. Thus far, the announcements about 15-3 for the ECSTS have all been on the Internet. Will those people who qualified but aren’t on the web find out about 15-3 before they arrive?

  33. Will neo contain Energy cards?

  38. Is there anyway I can get Pokémon Flute, Clefairy Doll, or Revive? Cuz they’re not in BS2 or Jungle.

45.If Ditto copies a Brock’s Ninetales shape shifted to Dark Arbok, then uses the PP disabling attack on Ninetales, does shape shift go off, making Ninetales and ditto both Ninetales, or does nothing happen because Arbok has no Pokémon power to disable

Thurs. Nov 9, 2000 - Weekly Pokemon TCG Q&A

Pokémon Online Help
Offered every Thursday 3-5 PST in the TCG Forum of the Wizards.Community chat site!
Featuring Master_Trainers Mike and Pat from Customer Service

Nov 9,2000

Master Trainer Pat: Hello everyone, not much new to announce this week I’m afraid. MT Mike and I are busy getting ready for the East Coast STS next week. That means building new 15/3 decks and packing up the Space Weedle. So let’s get started shall we?

Master Trainer Pat: Yes.

Master Trainer Mike: BTW, check out the latest issue of Top Deck to see a picture of the Space Weedle and see the first puzzle MT Pat and I made.

  1. Any NEO info?
    Master Trainer Pat: Not really, we’ve told you it is on the way, but we don’t have a concrete date yet.
    Master Trainer Mike: I can’t wait to play a Flaafy deck!

  2. Just to clarify Rocket’s Mewtwo - Juxtapose Attack. Since that attack switches Damage Counters, I assume it isn’t affected by Plus Power, Defender, Weakness, Resistance or Pokémon Powers that prevent or reduce Damage from Attacks?
    Master Trainer Pat: Correct.

  3. If Lt. Surge’s Secret Plan is used to put a trainer card face down on the bench, does the card have to be flipped over when Scoop Up is used on it? In other words, does Scoop Up trigger the “Need to Know” clause, since it only returns the Basic Pokémon to your hand?
    Master Trainer Mike: Yes it would, you would have to flip over the Trainer and then the Scoop Up wouldn’t be playable.

  4. Last week’s announcements said that if Ditto vs. Brock’s Ninetales attaches an evo card, “when Ditto copies something else the card that is attached stays right where it is.” Can Ditto still use the attacks on the card or is it just “dead weight”?
    Master Trainer Pat: The card becomes ‘dead weight’ until or if Ditto is able to copy B. Ninetails again.

  5. Last week you were going to check on what happens to a Shapeshifted Brock’s Ninetales if the opponent uses Devolution Beam on it. Any word from the Bothans yet?
    Master Trainer Pat: The devo. Beam would only affect an evolved Pokémon. Since that card that is attached to B. Ninetails is not considered ‘evolved’ to. The devo beam would just affect B. Ninetails or the evolved Pokémon of your choice.

  6. Last week, you stated: “If Ditto uses the Shapeshift Pokémon Power to attach a Pokémon to it, and then Ditto’s Pokémon Power is turned off somehow, the card that is attached to Ditto stays right where it is and doesn’t have any further affect on the game unless that Ditto manages to copy Brock’s Ninetales again.” Would I correct in analogizing it as the card attached to Ditto would be like a Pokémon card with no net effect on Ditto’s abilities?
    Master Trainer Mike: I wouldn’t use that specific analogy (you may be introducing new terminology and that is scary) but your concept is correct.

  7. Is there an official date set for the release of NEO Genesis?
    Master Trainer Mike: Nope.

  8. Can you tell us anything about how Weakness and Resistance will be displayed in Neo: Genesis?
    Master Trainer Mike: Nope.

  9. On Brock’s Nintales. First turn. I attach a Blastoise. Next turn I attach a Charizard (without discarding Blastoise). Is this move legal since Brock’s Ninetales doesn’t explicitly state that I need to remove the Charizard before I attach the Blastoise? Furthermore, if this is legal, Blastoise will remain attached to Brock’s Ninetales but would considered to be a null card because Ninetales can’t use of any of Blastoise’s attacks because Brock’s Ninetales becomes a copy of the latest Pokémon attached to itself.
    Master Trainer Mike: Brock’s Ninetails is a lousy card. Do any of you actually PLAY it? Or are these just mental exercise questions?
    Master Trainer Pat: Yes, you can do what you’re asking, but the end result is the same.

  10. If Brock’s Protection is attached to a Brock’s Pokémon, which attacks Koga’s Muk, could Muk’s Pokémon Power “Energy Drain” still remove an energy (since the energy removal is not caused by the opponent’s attack or by Trainer cards)?
    Master Trainer Pat: Brock’s Protection won’t protect your Pokémon in this case.

  11. I’m a little confused… why does Sabrina’s Kadabra’s Life Drain allow you to place damage counters if it doesn’t do damage?
    Master Trainer Mike: Damage counters represent HP loss, not the same as actual damage done. Think of magic, you could place a -1/-1 counter, which would kill a 1/1 creature OR do 1 point of damage.

  12. Any news on southern islands or vending English?
    Master Trainer Pat: Nothing new yet.

  13. Is Brock’s Ninetails becoming as bad as Ditto?
    Master Trainer Mike: Only when combined with Ditto!

  14. So when Mew’s Devo Beam hits the Brock’s Ninetales, does the evolution card get discarded, or does it go back into your hand along with the Brock’s Ninetales?
    Master Trainer Pat: The card attached stays right where it is and has no further affect unless you re-evolve back to B. Ninetails.

  15. You said that you can have 2 cards attached to Brock’s Ninetales, and that Brock’s Ninetales would be a copy of the last cards attached? If that last card is then discarded, does Brock’s Ninetales become a copy of the other attached card again?
    Master Trainer Pat: Yes, it would.

  16. Would Sabrina’s Kadabra’s Life Drain knock out a Pokémon if it is in a combo with a pluspower?
    Master Trainer Mike: Nope, Pluspower only activates if DAMAGE is done to the defending Pokémon, NOT placing damage counters.

  17. When Koga’s Ditto uses it’s Expand attack successfully, and then retreats to the bench with something like 6 Damage counters it will be knocked out. What I want to know is: does your opponent draw a prize for this, or doesn’t it count as a KO?
    Master Trainer Pat: Yes, they would.

  18. Where will you be at the ECSTS?
    Master Trainer Mike: Pat and Dark Mike and I will be judges again like the West Coast event. Also will be around for playing in our free time too.

  19. Will the Birthday Pikachu card be legalized for tournaments unlike its disqualification in Japan?
    Master Trainer Pat: Nope.

  20. Therefore, the attached but useless cards would return to your deck if you played Mr. Fuji?
    Master Trainer Pat: Correct.

  21. Don’t you think that Chansey is much better as an attacker than as a “staler”?
    Master Trainer Mike: No.
    Will some Pokémon cards be banned from future tournaments?
    Master Trainer Mike: Nope.

  22. If you used Electrode’s Buzzap, could you name ANY energy type, including things like “Cheese Energy”?
    Master Trainer Pat: There’s no such thing as ‘Cheese’ energy. So nope.

  23. Can you do a STS in the Midwest?
    Master Trainer Pat: We’ll see.

  24. Is prop 15/3C being tried out at STS to see if it is good for tournaments or is it not changing?
    Master Trainer Mike: It was primarily made to see the results of trainer limits in competitive play AND to poke you guys into trying new things.

  25. All of these TCG events are in America. Are any events going to occur in the United Kingdom any time soon?
    Master Trainer Mike: They are looking into plans for possible premiere events next year.

  26. Is there any REAL use if Lt. Surge’s Secret Plans can’t be used in the combos Snorlax presented earlier.
    Master Trainer Mike: Use it to bluff but not even that very well.

  27. Would Electrode’s Buzzap work for Steel or Dark Energy types?
    Master Trainer Pat: We believe so, though we can’t give you the official rulings on it yet.

  28. Can Electrode Buzzap to 2 DCE since it does not specify Basic Energy, or maybe Full Heal and Potion and metal and dark with neo?
    Master Trainer Mike: You can choose Darkness or Metal as the type just like you could choose colorless BUT the extra abilities of Darkness and Metal and Full Heal energy CARDS do NOT come with those choices.

  29. And when does the TCG League start in the United Kingdom?
    Master Trainer Pat: Try getting in touch with WotC UK about that one, uk@wizards.com

  30. Mike, how many rounds will the MAIN event be?
    Master Trainer Mike: Depends on how many players partake, probably 7-9 rounds before the finals.

  31. So until Neo: Genesis comes out, it’s illegal to name “Metal” and “Darkness” as energy types for Buzzap?
    Master Trainer Pat: Right.

  32. What hotel will you MTs be staying at?
    Master Trainer Mike: Secaucus Courtyard Marriot.

  33. Why is some 1st edition sign on gym card blurred?
    Master Trainer Pat: Probably just production mistakes.

  34. If the 15/3 format goes well at the ECSTS, do you think we could see it used in other events?
    Master Trainer Pat: We really don’t know yet Magmar2k. We’ll see how thing shake out.

  35. If your opponent Knocks Out the card that was in play as a result of Lt. Surge’s Secret Plan, and it was revealed as a non-Basic Pokémon card, would your opponent take a prize?
    Master Trainer Pat: No.

  36. When the baby versions of Magmar and Electabuzz come out will you have to evole them from the baby? even though it doesn’t say so on the presant cards?
    Master Trainer Mike: You will not have to do that.

  37. If a card is placed face down on your bench due to Lt. Surge’s Secret Plan, and later your active Pokémon is Erika’s Clefable and you attack with Fairy Power and flip heads, can you return that face down card to your hand without exposing it?
    Master Trainer Mike: You have to flip it over when you attack to show what you are doing.
    Master Trainer Pat: You would have to reveal it, that’s what it says on the card.

  38. Why aren’t ______'s Chansey and Imakuni’s Doduo in Gym Challenge?
    Master Trainer Mike: Those are regional promo-like cards. We are not allowed to make Imakuni cards here and ____'s Chansey was just not chosen.

  39. Another thing, are you required to deny all knowledge of the existence of Neo 2 and later sets?
    Master Trainer Mike: No we are not, just don’t have any specifics on them for us yet.
    Master Trainer Pat: Just to let you know…we really have no idea how we’re going to release those here in the States. Honest.

  40. The Gym Challenge Sabrina’s Gastly LV.10, if you add energy you get +10, do you have to take a way HP if you take away energy?
    Master Trainer Pat: Yes, you do.

  41. Who at WotC makes the layouts for the English cards and could they come to the chat along with all you MT’s? (please)
    Master Trainer Mike: Various people in production and R&D do that, not anyone person in particular. They are usually very busy too.
    Master Trainer Pat: You think they’d want to jump in the pit with all you wolves? That’s what we get paid for.

  42. If you use Energy Flow. can you take back non-basic energy cards or the upcoming Darkness and Metal energies?
    Master Trainer Mike: Yes you could.

  43. Can a deck have no trainer?
    Master Trainer Pat: Can a trainer have not deck? (you don’t have to have any trainers in your deck)

  44. Who translates Japanese cards into English for WOTC?
    Master Trainer Mike: We have a translation department and then the licensors still must approve the translations.

  45. What is your favorite type of element to play with?
    Master Trainer Mike: I like to try them all, though to be honest I rarely ever play fighting (Haymaker and Hitmonchan burned me out with that).
    Master Trainer Pat: Probably, Grass or Fire…how about both.

  46. Is there any specific way Wizards chooses cards for Promos?
    Master Trainer Pat: Not really, though if the card wasn’t part of a complete set or it came out in a really small set, it’s a good bet that we’ll use it as a promo.

  47. If you have Ditto out and use Giovanni’s Magikarp’s attack Ancestral Memory, if you retreat next turn and send Ditto back out, could you use it again?
    Master Trainer Mike: No you could not. The Ditto would still remember having been the G’s Magikarp and using that attack once already. It would have to leave play and then re-enter for that to be forgotten.

  48. When Neo comes out, will Rainbow Energy count as Darkness and Metal energy?
    Master Trainer Pat: For the purposes of paying the cost of an attack, yes. Though the additional effects will not be provided.

  49. Will I be allowed to use all my Japanese Neo Cards when they are released in America?
    Master Trainer Pat: Regular rules apply for tournaments, but yeah you should be able to. Do you have a large collection already?

  50. Darkness and Metal will be basic energy types, and yet not basic energy cards? Is that what you’re saying?
    Master Trainer Mike: Yup. They are types of energy (like colorless or grass and fire are) but their energy cards are non-basic cards with extra abilities like Full Heal or Potion energies.

  51. Who do you contact to get the rights of Japanese cards? What is the company name?
    Master Trainer Mike: Various companies own the license. Media Factory, Gamefreak, Creatures, Nintendo, etc.

  52. Is the World Pikachu set an indication that we will see more Promo sets coming out in the future? Maybe Southern Islands and the 9 card Neo Promos?
    Master Trainer Mike: No it does not indicate anything like that.

  53. How likely will there be an STS or equivalent on the West Coast in 2001?
    Master Trainer Mike: No idea gang, still in planning stages.

  54. If you have Ditto and your opponent has Lt. Surges Rattata Lv. 7, and you use Focus Energy, if your opponent retreats for another Lv. 7 Surges Rattata, does Focus Energy stay in effect?
    Master Trainer Pat: Yes.

  55. Where can you find a birthday or a surfing Pikachu?
    Master Trainer Pat: The B-day has only been released in the Pikachu World Collection so far.

  56. Mike will you be taking CHALANGES at the ECSTS?
    Master Trainer Mike: If there is time, yes. They have us all pretty booked up though.

  57. How do I get the “W” stamp Dark Charmeleon?
    Master Trainer Pat: The W stamped D. Charmeleon is another Australia only card we dig those Aussies!

  58. I have heard rumors circulating throughout the underground about a master trainer called “Z”. I heard he is supposed to be one of the world’s greatest masters and will be at the East coast STS. Is that true?
    Master Trainer Mike: He works here at Wizards and if this is him then he is FIRED!!!

  59. If you use Focus Energy, and your opponent retreats for a Pokémon besides Surge’s Rattata that has an attack called Quick Attack, will that attack do more damage?
    Master Trainer Mike: Yup! Works for Ditto/Swords Dance as well.

  60. I think WOTC should have a Pokémon Fan Club like NCL does for Pokémon cards.
    Master Trainer Pat: Unfortunately, we tried to do that early on and were refused. We may try again sometime, I’m not sure.

  61. I have a question about Sabrina’s Golduck. Will Haunter’s transparency prevent damage shift? Can Chancy or Clefable prevent damage moved?
    Master Trainer Mike: Anything that “prevents” all effects from an attack would stop Damage Shift. But something that only prevents damage would not.

  62. If Charizard uses PP Energy Burn, then on my turn I play Goop Gas Attack, are Charizard’s attached energies still Fire or are they reverted back to what they were originally?
    Master Trainer Pat: Charizard’s Energy Burn only lasts until the end of the turn in which they were Energy Burned.

  63. So if haunter successfully stops damage shift, does all the damage to be moved disappear?
    Master Trainer Pat: No, the attack would do nothing, meaning you would not move the damage counters

  64. Chansey’s Scrunch prevents damage from all attacks, powers(such as Dark Golbat’s power), and trainers(such as Digger) if successful, correct?
    Master Trainer Pat: Well, anything that would do _damage?

  65. Was the error on Blaine’s Charizard fixed.
    Master Trainer Pat: Nope.

  66. Will you ever have a contest where the winner gets to make their own card?
    Master Trainer Pat: It’s been talked about although there aren’t any firm plans at this time.

  67. Which of the 8 gym leaders’ trainer cards do you think is the best?
    Master Trainer Mike: I like what Koga’s does the best.

  68. Who is the head honcho at WotC?
    Master Trainer Mike: Vince Calouri, the president of WOTC.

  69. What was your e-mail again?
    Master Trainer Pat: custserv@wizards.com if you want it to get to one of us just put Attn: MT in the subject line.

  70. Will you ever have Pokémon Cards as the prizes in boxes of cereal?
    Master Trainer Pat: I don’t think so.

  71. Who made the Blaine’s Magmar/Misty puzzle?
    Master Trainer Mike: That was an earlier author/editor who is so busy with other projects that we are helping out.

  72. Using Recall, will Energy Loop return the Psychic Energy to your hand with Sabrina’s Kadabra?
    Master Trainer Pat: If you have the correct Abra underneath S. Kadabra.

  73. Does it cost anything to have a DCI tournament?
    Master Trainer Mike: nope

  74. I read in a Topdeck that major supermarkets will have the TCG league. Has it happened yet?
    Master Trainer Mike: Don’t think so.

  75. How do you join DCI, my gym leader didn’t let me?
    Master Trainer Mike: What? If you join the league, you get a DCI membership card free, if they are out of them, have them call their supplier.

Master Trainer Pat: Well, let’s wrap it up for this week Mike.
Master Trainer Mike: Ok gang, its gotten a bit silly (Pat’s fault not mine!!) and no new questions so it is time to call it a day.

Master Trainer Pat: Thanks for coming and putting up with our general nuttiness today.

Master Trainer Mike: So, be here same poketime, same pokechannel next week for more adventures of Master Trainer Pat: Lata.

Nov 9th is the last archived entry.

scratchdesk June 26, 2017, 4:33pm 11

Additional FAQ sections that mostly seem composed of single questions from the above chat sessions.

Click on each spoiler to view entire log:

Pokémon Gameplay FAQ - Circa 2000

Pokémon Gameplay FAQ

RULINGS

  1. Metronome rules from the latest R & D meeting this week:
    Whenever Metronome is used to copy and attack that “refers to itself” like Chansey’s Double Edge, does 80 to defending Pokémon AND does 80 damage to Chansey, you would replace the self reference with Clefable or Clefairy. So the attack would read "does 80 damage to defending Pokémon and 80 damage to itself (Clefable or Clefairy).

  2. If an attack does refer to other Pokémon, like Bellsprout’s Call for Family attack:
    Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon named Bellsprout and put it onto your Bench, you would NOT replace the reference with Clefable or Clefairy. So if you used Metronome to copy this attack, you could only search your deck for Bellsprout’s.

  3. Also, when you use a trainer card, first you pay the cost (if any), then you resolve the effect of the trainer card, then you discard that trainer card. So you could NOT use Item Finder to bring itself back from the discard pile (you would discard 2 other cards from your hand, then pull a trainer card from your discard pile to your hand, THEN you would discard the Item Finder).

  4. If a card gives off energy of any type then that card COUNTS as an energy card of that type. This means a buzzaped Electrode that was chosen to give 2-grass energy COUNTS as a Grass Energy Card and can use Venusaur’s Pokémon Power Transfer Energy.

  5. Energy attached to Ditto COUNTS as all-basic energy types at once. So any energy type attached to Ditto could ALSO use Venusaur’s Transfer Energy.

  6. If you have a DCE or a buzzaped Electrode attached to Ditto, then those particular cards would still count as all basic energy types at once but that particular card would give you 2 energy of any type. This means you could use a DCE or the buzzaped Electrode to give you one of two different basic energy types (like 1 grass and 1 psychic). This also means if Ditto is copying, say, a Charmander, you could discard ANY type of energy card from Ditto to pay the Discard COST for the Ember attack.

  7. Clarification on the whole Moltres Wildfire/Confusion thing. When flipping for confusion, you must pay all Attack Costs BEFORE you flip for confusion. This means anything that is written as “IN ORDER TO DO THIS ATTACK,” such as Charizard’s Fire Spin. (Discard 2 Fire Energy card attached to Charizard IN ORDER TO use this attack.) However, anything that does not state IN ORDER TO gets done AFTER the Confusion flip, this means for Moltres’s Wildfire you do NOT discard cards for the effect of the attack until AFTER you see if the attack even occurs.

  8. More clarification for Ditto: His Pokémon Power is continuous–NOT invoked. You do NOT decide what energy attached to him counts as; it simply counts as all basic energy types. When a Pokémon hits the discard pile it reverts back to its normal type BEFORE you count it as a knocked out Pokémon or not. This explains why Mysterious Fossil and Clefairy Doll do NOT count as Knocked Out Pokémon as they revert to Trainer Cards when they hit the Discard Pile. So if you’re Ditto was Transformed into a copy of one of these. It would STILL count as a Knocked Out Pokémon as it would revert back to Ditto when it hits the pile.

  9. Clarification on Team Rocket (since it will be out soon). You can have 4 Charizards AND 4 Dark Charizards in the same deck as they have different names. The rule is that you can only 4 of a particular named card. This also means you could have 4 Porygon AND 4 Cool Porygon in the same deck for the same reason.

  10. Also, Dark Pokémon evolve from Basic Pokémon. There are no Dark Basic Pokémon. Only Dark Stage 1 and Stage 2 Pokémon. Once you evolve a basic Pokémon into a Dark Stage 1 Pokémon, it CANNOT evolve into a non-Dark Stage 2 Pokémon, only a Dark Stage 2. “Once you walk down the Dark Path, forever will it dominate your destiny” - Yoda the non-Pokémon.

  11. A ruling on Metronome and Dark Charmeleon (available in Top Deck #6). Metronome states that it copies that attack except for Energy costs and anything else required IN ORDER TO use that attack. The important part of this text is the IN ORDER TO part. This means that Metronome ignores anything listed in an attacks requirements but ONLY if it has the words IN ORDER TO in its text (such as Charizard’s Fire Spin). If the words IN ORDER TO are NOT part of the text then Metronome does NOT ignore it. So, in the case of Dark Charmeleon’s Fireball text: Use this attack only if there any fire energy cards attached to Dark Charmeleon, Metronome does NOT ignore this condition. This attack was specifically worded this way so that Metronome couldn’t copy it without the Clefable/Clefairy actually having fire energy on it. There will be other cards in the future that will use this same sort of wording to make it hard for Metronome to copy it.

  12. Just so you know, we DO read many of the unofficial Pokémon Online Helpweb sites and their forum cuz we care! We really do! <Was that a bit much? >. Anyhow, we’ve seen that there has been a debate about the Devolution Trainer card. Here’s the official answer; you CAN evolve a Pokémon that you devolved that turn. Playing the Devolution Trainer card has the same effect as evolving as far as removing attack effects but it does NOT count as evolving a Pokémon. So you could devolve a Pokémon, then evolve it that turn, then even Devolve it again! But then you would NOT be able to evolve it again that turn (you only evolve a particular Pokémon once per turn).

  13. Dark Charizard’s Continuous Fireball attack- A Buzzap’ed Electrode that was chosen as fire energy would count as ONE Fire Energy card (and would only give you one flip of the coin).

  14. Dark Dugtrio’s Sinkhole Pokémon Power is assuming a SUCCESSFUL Retreating of the Defending Pokémon. So if that Pokémon were confused, that player would pay the retreat cost, then flip to see if it is successful from the confusion. If it were, THEN that Pokémon would take the 20 damage from the Sinkhole Power.

  15. The Rocket MagicKarp attack Rapid Evolution does NOT count as evolving the Pokémon (just has the same effects thereof). What this means is that if you can RainDance 3 water energy onto it the turn you play the MagicKarp you CAN play this attack and pull out a Gyarados or Dark Gyarados and place it on the Magickarp, THE SAME TURN YOU PLAYED IT. Also Aerodacty; s Pokémon Power would NOT stop this attack from working.

  16. The Dark Rapidash attack Flame Pillar’s extra effect (where you may discard 1 fire energy to do an extra effect) works like the Moltres Wildfire cost as far as Confusion is concerned. You would flip for Confusion BEFORE you discard the fire energy for the extra effect. (Phew)…Lastly my boss Mike and I met some great players and people that work for the Pojo at the Team Rocket Release this last weekend. It was a fun event and you managed to chase away that dastardly Team Rocket.

  17. For the Rocket Magickarp’s attack Rapid Evolution: (Search your deck for an Evolution named Gyarados or Dark Gyarados and put it on Magickarp. Shuffle your deck afterward.) This attack DOES count as evolving Magickarp so it CANNOT be used the turn that Magickarp comes into play (you cannot evolve a Pokémon the turn it comes into play). The reason that this attack CAN be used even if Aerodactyl is in play (Its Prehistoric Power prevents evolution cards from being PLAYED) is that you are not PLAYING an evolution card but pulling one from the deck and using it. PLAYING a card means taking it from your HAND and using it. Also, if Rapid Evolution is Metronomed, the Clefairy/Clefable WOULD be able to evolve into a Gyarados or Dark Gyarados if that player has one of those cards in his or her deck. R&D is also talking with the creators of Pokémon back in Japan about confusion over Ditto and copying attacks like Metronome as well and we will keep you informed of what they learn from them.

  18. After R&D talked with Creatures Inc. in Japan last week, some rules changes (or corrections) that we need to pass on to you. First, for Ditto. R&D has reversed their ruling on Ditto Transforming into Mysterious Fossil or Clefairy Doll. When Ditto as-one-of-these-Trainer-cards is Knocked out the attacking player does NOT get to take a prize card. Many of you initially figured this out and R&D ruled differently. Well now, they are ruling it as you thought. Since Ditto is copying the Mysterious Fossil, it copies EVERTHING from it, including the text that says when it is knocked out the other player does NOT draw Prize.

  19. Now for Devolution Spray. Devolving a Pokémon DOES count as evolving it (again, a reversal on a previous ruling). This means that if you use Devolution Spray on one of your Pokémon you CANNOT evolve it again on that same turn. Sorry if these rule changes are confusing. It just shows again, how nothing is set in stone when it comes to Pokémon. And lastly I would like to thank the two people who have sent in Weedle cards for the Space Weedle so far.

  20. Can energy that has been changed to Fire energy with Charizard’s Energy Burn be moved by TR Charmander’s Gather Firepower?
    Yes, energy changed in this way will be Fire energy till the end of the turn, you can use TR Charmander’s power to move this energy.

  21. If you attach a Plus Power to your active Pokémon and then retreat and then advance that Pokémon, will the Plus Power still be in effect?
    Yes, it will.

  22. If you use TR Porygon’s Conversion 1 to change a Ditto’s(copying TR Porygon) weakness to Grass and then you retreat TR Porygon and advance a Scyther, will the converted weakness still be in effect on Ditto?
    Yes, any effects of attacks on Ditto will remain.

  23. Can Ditto(copying a Gengar) repeatedly retreat and advance so that he can do Gengar’s Curse over and over?
    Yes, every time Ditto advances and copies Gengar he can activate the Curse power.

  24. I was able to look at a translated copy of the Neo rulebook from Japan and it specifically mentions a rule regarding Ditto’s Transform power. It states: If Ditto transforms to the _same_ Pokémon more than once per turn, he is considered to be the _same_ Pokémon. Thus, he would be unable to do Pokémon Powers that can only be used once per turn more than once.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

  1. Are these official answers can they be used in a game, to settle disputes.
    Yes.

  2. What can we do if we don’t agree with your rulings? Is there anyway we can contact WOTC and tell them they are wrong?
    You can email cust serv and we will pass it along BUT R&D have the final say and usually aren’t swayed (even when we offer donuts).

  3. Regarding Moltres: If the opponent does agility does it affect wild fire?
    If Rapidash has the Agility attack, yes, the Agility attack from Rapidash would stop the Wildfire from Moltres (it stops ALL effects from attacks).

  4. Ok, if I have a ditto in play, and the other person has a Clefairy or Clefable, can we do anything (that does damage)?
    It’s a stalemate until someone retreats basically. You could still do the Sing or Minimize attacks though.

  5. If one-player defeats the other Pokémon with Ditto, does Ditto immediately turn back into Ditto?
    No, Ditto turns into a copy of whichever Pokémon it is opposite. It would turn into a copy of whatever Pokémon the other player moved up. (Unless it is asleep, paralyzed, or confused).

  6. Special power, can 3-5 energy cards be attached from your hand when used?
    Yes it could (assuming you have them in your hand), and Blastoise isn’t Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

  7. When electrode uses buzzap, does he count as 2 energy by itself? Or does electrode count as one and Voltorb count as one? This is because of energy removal…
    Electrode counts as 1 energy card that provides 2 energy of the chosen type.

  8. Regarding Porygon’s Conversion 1: How long does the effect last? If Porygon gets knocked out…does the effect wear off? If the defending Pokémon retreats…does it wear off? Or both?
    Conversion effects are removed (as all effects are) when the “converted” Pokémon goes to a Bench. Even if Porygon is retreated or removed, the defending Pokémon is still affected.

  9. My question is also about Porygon’s Conversion attack, if Porygon uses its conversion attack to change the defender’s type to what its strong against what would happen when its attacked by that type? Would they each cancel each other out, would it double damage then take away 30,would it take away 30 then double?
    Weakness is calculated first (damage would be doubled), then Resistance is calculated (you would subtract 30 from the damage total).

  10. Moves that have a Pokémon’s own name in the attack, like Scyther’s swords dance, does it mean ALL Scyther you have in play at the moment? Or does it only affect the Scyther that used it?
    Those particular attacks only affect the Pokémon that used it, Not all Pokémon of the same name, sorry.

  11. Scenario: I have a Fully powered Scyther Active…I have one on the bench…during my turn…I swords dance. During my opponents next turn (who has a F. Magmar) he smokescreens… If I retreat my active Scyther, bring up my unpowered one, switch him back for the powered one…do I hit for 60 w/o having to flip. Or does swords dance get cancelled too?
    When a Pokémon is benched, ALL effects from attacks are cancelled. In this case the Swords Dance effect is cancelled.

  12. According to my earlier question: the wildfire does not directly affect any Pokémon correct? It affects the deck… So things like Agility wouldn’t really make a difference…would they?
    Ok, after a consultation, the answer is that the Rapidash Agility attack would still stop it. Pokémon always attack the other active Pokémon, regardless of where the effect ends up.

  13. Regarding Mysterious Fossil: During a League session I delayed 7 cards at the start…I had no Basics and a Myst. Fossil. The Gym Leaders told me I had to play the Mys. Fossil as a basic while I argued that it should have been a mulligan. Who was right…and is there any limit to the number of times you can mulligan or draw from an opponent’s mulligan?
    You are correct, if you have Myst Fossil (or Clefairy Doll) and ANOTHER basic Pokémon, you can start. They do not count as Basic Pokémon when they are in your hand (they are trainer cards), so if you only had them and no other basic’s, then you would have to Mulligan. As for the Mulligan rule, you keep doing it until each player has a basic Pokémon in his or her starting hand.

  14. Say you have a Charizard as your active Pokémon. You put double colorless energy cards on it. If you use Energy Burn does the DCE turn into 2-fire energy?
    It turns into a card that gives two-fire energy.

  15. Base Set Charizard Pokémon Powers allows you to turn any energy card into fire, so if I attach two double colorless and I use his Fire Spin, which says discard two energy cards. Do I discard both double colorless or only one (it doesn’t say two energy, it says two energy cards)?
    Charizard states you have to discard 2 (fire) energy CARDS. So in this case you would have to discard both DCE cards.

  16. Regarding Evee’s Tail Wag Attack: Would it affect Scythers Sword Dance? (I would assume not since SD affects Scyther and not Evee).
    Tail Wag blocks ALL attacks. Sword’s Dance is an attack. All attacks by Pokémon are “targeting” the defending Pokémon whether they actually affect them or not. Evee’s Tail Wag prevents the defending Pokémon from attacking. However, benching either Pokémon ends this effect.

  17. How do Metronome attacks like Meditate, Water Gun, Hydro Pump work? Do you copy the base damage or do the effect too?
    Metronome copies the base damage, you would need additional energy on Clefairy/Clefable to do additional damage with those copied attacks.

  18. When Mew uses Devolution Beam on one of your opponents Pokémon, do they have to wait a turn before evolving that Pokémon?
    Yes, as long as the base Pokémon has been in play one turn your opponent can revolve his Pokémon.

  19. Do you have to attack if you have enough energy cards attached to your Pokémon?
    No, you always have the choice whether to attack on your turn or not.

  20. Are you allowed to have as many DCE as you want in a deck like normal energy or only four like any other card?
    Only 4 max, it is NOT a basic energy card (the only type you can have more than 4 of in your deck).

  21. Clefairy Doll here . . . Situation: Hitmonchan vs. Mime. Hitmo has 2 plus powers attached. He jabs mime for 20. Is this considered a KO, or do plus powers add 20 to the attack itself (for 40) and so fail due to Mime’s wall?
    Trainer card effects are added before Pokémon powers are figured, so the attack would do 40 total, which Mr. Mime’s Power would negate.

  22. Does Fearow’s Agility attack block Kangaskahn’s fetch?
    Actually it does not, Fearow’s agility says stops damage done to Fearow, and the Fetch just draws a card. This is the new ruling from R&D.

  23. Can the switch card be used to retreat a paralyzed, confused, or sleeping Pokémon?
    Yes, it can, the Trainer (you) plays NOT the Pokémon, a Trainer Card NOT the Pokémon, so it being Paralyzed, etc. does not stop a Trainer Card’s effects (generally).

  24. Can you Raindance onto a Shifted Venamoth?
    Yes you could do that.

  25. If I use Charizard’s Energy Burn on some Grass energy could I still use Venusaur’s Energy Trans on them, and if Charizard is confused, paralyzed or asleep and he had some energy burned cards on him would they still be burned or would they change back?
    Ok, 1st if the energy is changed to Fire energy then Venosaur can no longer Energy Trans them (they are no longer grass). If Charizard is paralyzed, etc. then the energy reverts (it also only changes to fire for that turn only).

  26. The potion card says to remove “2 damage counters”, some people play with 10 and 30 point damage counters. SO: Can a regular potion take off two 30point damage counters or just 20 damage total? And can you place energy on a mysterious fossil?
    Ok, whenever a card or effect or attack mentions damage counters, it is always assuming a counter to be equal to 10 points of damage.

  27. Snorlax’s Pokémon power says that it cant be paralyzed, poisoned, confused, or put to sleep, so why does it say that the power stops working if its paralyzed, confused or put to sleep?
    Well, say Muk was in play, all Pokémon Powers stop working. Snorlax gets confused, then Muk leaves play, and his power can’t turn back on until he is no longer confused.

  28. What happens if the opponent benches the Pokémon after the fossil Magmar uses smokescreen?
    Since that attack references the opponent’s Pokémon, if he benches it, the effect is removed.

  29. If you have a defender on a Chansey, and you use double edge, is 20 of the damage to Chansey prevented?
    Yes, it would be. Defender will protect your Pokémon from attacks form your opponent AND from your own attacks while it is in play.

  30. Can I lay a double colorless energy and another energy down on the same turn?
    No, you can only attach 1 energy card per turn.

  31. Does Magmar’s smokescreen still works if I switch Pokémon?
    Yes, it would. It references the opponent’s active Pokémon. If he benches THAT, the effect ends.

  32. If you have used Scythers swords dance and your opponent uses a gust of wind on your next turn you retreat the active Pokémon and put Scyther back out does it do 30 or 60
    If you retreat Scyther, of course, Swords Dance is canceled. So if he Gust of Winded, same thing.

  33. If one of your Pokémon was poisoned, and a few turns later it is KO’d by the poison, does your opponent take a prize card although the poison KO’d the Pokémon and not your opponents Pokémon? And what if you’re own Pokémon knocks itself out?
    Yes, he would still draw a prize card. Whenever a Pokémon in knocked out, the other player gets prize cards even if you knock out your own.

  34. If my opponent has an active Ditto and I switch my Pokémon, is ditto my new Pokémon, or Ditto with 50hp?
    Ditto always turns into a copy of whatever Pokémon he is facing when he is the active Pokémon (and not paralyzed, confused, or asleep).

  35. How long does Porygon’s conversion attack (changing weakness) last?
    It lasts until the Pokémon it was used on is benched.

  36. Is Porygon’s Conversion 1/2 canceled if Porygon or your opponents Pokémon is knocked out or benched?
    If the opponent’s Pokémon is benched, the Conversion effect ends, it doesn’t matter if Porygon is.

  37. Would Magmar’s Smokescreen stop Kangaskhan’s Fetch?
    Yes, it would since Fetch is an attack.

  38. If my Clefairy does metronome and I do Chansey’s double edge attack…does Clefairy do 80 damage to itself
    Yes, it does.

  39. Why doesn’t the Energy Search card tell you to show the card to your opponent?
    All moves in the Pokémon game, are public knowledge. You do not hide what you are doing.

  40. If a super energy removal is used on a Dragonair with two double colorless energies, do you remove one, or both?
    Your opponent can remove up to 2 energy CARDS, so he could take off both DCEs.

  41. Can fossil Gastly use his energy conversion to retrieve double colorless?
    Sure, he can retrieve 2 energy CARDS, either or both could be DCE’s.

  42. Does Mew do 10 times the energy card on the defending Pokémon or 10 damage for each energy card on the defending Pokémon?
    Does 10 damage times the number of Energy cards attached to the Defending Pokémon.

  43. If you use an attack that puts your opponents Pokémon to sleep (like haunter’s nightmare), and the defending Pokémon was already asleep before you attacked, Do you still have to flip a coin after the attack to see if it wakes up?
    Yes, they get to flip at the end of each player’s turn.

  44. If Mr. Mime is played against a Mewtwo with 20 damage on it, and uses Meditate, does it do ten, doubled, plus 20, or 10 plus 20, doubled?
    You calculate the base damage first, then double it for weakness, so 60 points damage total.

  45. Can you evolve a Pokémon right after Mew devolves it or do you have to wait a turn?"
    If you devolve your own, you just did an attack and your turn is over. If you devolved the opponent’s Pokémon, he can evolve it on his turn.

  46. If a mysterious fossil is the only “basic” card you have at the start of a game, does it count as a basic or do you have to shuffle and try again?
    You have to reshuffle, it counts as a Trainer card when it is in your hand.

  47. Does Charizard’s energy burn change an energy forever…or until the end of the turn?
    The energy changed using Charizard’s energy burn only stays fire energy until the end of the turn.

  48. Can I use Tentacool’s cowardice as many times as I want?
    No, once you scoop Tentacool back into your hand, you could put him on the bench again, but you can’t use the power the turn Tentacool comes into play.

  49. Can you use energy transfer after Charizard has energy burned a grass energy?
    No, since that energy was changed into fire energy (until the end of the turn), Venasaur can’t energy transfers it.

  50. Ditto is out against (F) Magmar. Magmar uses smokescreen. Then the trainer with ditto uses gust of wind and puts a different Pokémon out does Ditto still have to flip to attack?
    Yes, it does. The Smokescreen attack only references the defending Pokémon (in this case Ditto). Benching Magmar does NOT remove this effect (though benching the Ditto would).

  51. I was playing a game at the Pokémon TCG League and the kid used a Ditto. He transformed into my Electabuzz. I eventually did 60 damage to it so the Ditto had 50 damage. I than retreated and sent in a Hitmonlee, shouldn’t it have been KO’d. I though
    You’re right it should have, Ditto would have turned into the Hitmonlee (which only has 60 HP), since you had already done 60 to it, and Ditto would have been knocked out.

  52. If I have Zubat up and retreat him, can I bring him back as active or do I have to bring up another benched Pokémon?
    When you retreat a Pokémon, you are swapping it with another on the bench. So in this case, Zubat goes to the bench, and you bring up a different Pokémon from your bench.

  53. Is it legal to have a deck with absolutely no Pokémon so that you mulligan and the opponent will draw cards till he looses?
    It is legal but the opponent has the choice of drawing 2 extra cards, he does not have to. So what would be the point? The game would never start.

  54. Does Machamp do damage if he is hit by a stretch kick?
    Yes, his Pokémon power Strikes Back would damage the other Pokémon even if Machamp is hit when he is on the bench.

  55. If a Ditto goes against a Blastiose, can Ditto use Raindance on any type of energy?
    No, Raindance says you must take water energy from your hand and place it on one of you water Pokémon.

  56. Do you have to add energy to a Pokémon and attack with your active Pokémon if you have energies in your hand?
    No, you don’t have to.

  57. At the Pokémon League, my opponent used a Ditto and I used Electabuzz, after a few turns his Ditto had 60 damage. I retreated and sent Hitmonlee with 60 HP. I was told Ditto’s power is automatic and it specifically says it transforms into the "Defender
    Right, so when Ditto transforms into Hitmonlee, he will be knocked out.

  58. If I use jab with Hitmonchan on Scyther and I attach a pluspower does it do 10?
    No, because Plus Power will only do the extra damage if the original attack does damage (after applying weakness and resistance).

  59. So you don’t have to draw two cards if your opponent doesn’t draw a basic Pokémon?
    No, you MAY draw two cards; you do not have to.

  60. Can you be paralyzed and confused at the same time, poisoned and paralyzed, or poisoned and asleep at the same time?
    You can poisoned and any other effect (asleep, confusion, or paralysis) but not a combo of asleep, confusion, or paralysis. If your Pokémon gets one of those 3 effects, the new effect replaces the old one.

  61. If you have 2 Dodrio’s on the bench, do 2 lower your active’s retreat?
    Yes, it is.

  62. If I was to have, say two or three Gust of Winds and my opponent had many Ditto’s on the bench with 40 damage each, could I knock out as many as possible using the Gusts, or would my turn be over?
    You could do that yes (as long as your opponent lets you).

  63. Since Ditto has weakness, can it ever “choose” not to copy the other card?
    Nope, if it is the active Pokémon and it is not asleep, confused, or paralyzed, the Transform power happens automatically.

  64. If there is a Clefable and a ditto active, and the Clefable has one energy can he metronome, and do the Ditto’s minimize attack, which is really his own, without having the two energy required?
    Yes, he could, since he would be Metronoming the Clefabled Ditto’s Minimize attack.

  65. Can Pokémon powers be used al the time?
    Each power tells you specifically when or how often it can be used.

  66. If you use Electrode’s Pokémon Power, does your opponent get a Prize?
    Yes, he does.

  67. V.3 rulebook states you lose at the END OF TURN if you don’t have an in-play Pokémon, but I always thought you lose IMMEDIATELY. Can I Scoop Up my last in-play? (This is a toughie)
    The rulebook is incorrect; you lose immediately if you do not have an active Pokémon.

  68. What would happen if you used plus power on Raticates HyperFang?
    Super Fang does damage equal to half the remaining HP that the defender has then the Plus Power does 10 more.

  69. When using Scoop Up, can you put all into hand or only basic?
    Only basic.

  70. Do I have to discard defender, if resistance cancels out the damage done by the defending, or does it stay until some damage is done?
    You have to discard Defender at the end of your opponent’s next turn.

  71. Does Muk’s Power ignore ALL in play or just your opponent’s Power?
    All Powers except for Toxic Gases. This includes your own.

  72. We have a set of BS2 but there is no Machamp. Why wasn’t this identified as a missing card in TopDeck?
    The Machamp is still available in the Starter Set, but it’s not a Base Set 2 card.

  73. During a game of TCG, what do you do if you draw an extra basic if your bench is full?
    Keep it in your hand for later.

  74. May I discard a basic energy card as the cost of Energy Retrieval, only to retrieve it as one of the 2 energy cards?
    Yes.

  75. Alakazam’s power states “you may move 1 damage counter from 1 of your to another”. Does to another mean you may move one of your counters over to your opponents?
    No, you have to move the damage counter to another one of your

  76. May I retrieve the same Item Finder card that I just played as the Trainer card to retrieve? (Just so that I can dump some other cards from my hand)
    Since you’re playing the card Item Finder it won’t be in your discard pile to pull back.

  77. Can I play a power plus then a gambler and play a power plus I got from the gambler?
    Yes, you can.

  78. Who do you think has the best Power? I personally think its Blastoise
    I like Raindance myself, but there are so many other good Powers…

  79. When you play a Bill where does your opponents active go?
    Bill doesn’t affect your opponent’s active.

  80. Is there a limit to the amount of cards in your hand?
    No.

  81. Is Blastoise’s skin color sky blue, or baby blue? I’ve heard conflicting reports on this, and I have checked numerous pictures of him, but they are all different colors. Can you clarify this for me, I wish you would be more accurate
    I would just say ‘blue’, but if you want to specific, I think it’s sky blue.

  82. Just to be clear: I may retrieve energy that I discard with Energy Retrieval as part of Energy Retrieval, but I may not retrieve Item Finder that I discard as part of Item Finder?
    You didn’t discard Item Finder, you played it.

  83. My opponent attacks my active, which causes 20 damage and poisons it. Her turn is over. Do I then have to put 10 more damage on it because it is still poisoned?
    Yes.

  84. Does Magma’s smokescreen work if I bench one of my and take another one out?
    If Magmar is benched, then yes. If the defending is benched then, no.

  85. How many energies can I attach to an Eggecuter for big explosion. Up to and including 58?
    Sure, if you want.

  86. Can I use Fossil Dragonite’s Pokémon Power “Step In” while my active Pokémon is Asleep/Confused/Paralyzed or Poisoned?
    Yup.

  87. What happens if a Jigglypuff lullaby’s a Muk and on your turn you retreat for a Ditto while the Muk is asleep. Will Ditto be able to use his power and/or will Muk be able to use his?
    You would be able to use Toxic Gasses no matter what, but when Muk wakes up Ditto is Ditto again.

  88. WHAT HAPPENS IF A MUK IS ASLEEP, AND I SWITCH ON MY next turn for a Ditto while Muk is still asleep?
    Then Ditto can come forward but when Muk wakes up it cancels dittos Poke Power.

  89. Can I use Promo Mewtwo’s Energy Absorption on a Mewtwo on the bench? —It doesn’t specifically say the ACTIVE Mewtwo?
    Unless it says you can target a benched you have to deal with the active one.

  90. Can a Buzzap’d Electrode mimic non-basic Energy (such as heal), and if so, does it provide the special abilities of that energy?
    He can only copy an energy type (the six basic forms), not and energy card.

  91. Check the official FAQ about Ditto copying a confused/sleeping Muk… Ditto is always Ditto … never Muk
    You are right Ditto never actually becomes Muk, but he takes on the hit points and attacks of said and when Muk wakes up Ditto reverts to his normal stats.

  92. If a Muk faces another Muk does Muk B’s power cancel out Muk A’s power so powers are once again activated?
    Muk’s Toxic Gases says it cancels all Powers except Toxic Gas, so both would work

  93. If you use Electrodes Buzzap, does your opponent pick up a prize?
    Yes.

  94. I don’t know why I’d ever want to do this but can I Raindance onto a shifted Venomoth
    Sure you could.

  95. Can I attack a plus power when cursing damage from the bench to active ?
    Yup.

  96. Can I have 4 Chairzard and 4 “Darl” Charizard in the same deck?
    You can have 4 of each uniquely named cards, since these cards have different names, you can have 4 of each.

  97. Can you attach more than one plus power/defender on a on one turn?
    Yes.

  98. Would Pidgeot’s hurricane work if my opponent didn’t have any bench?
    Yes.

  99. Can you clarify #135 a bit? If you attach a Plus Power, and use Curse to move a counter to the Active, it doesn’t do the extra damage does it, since it’s a power and not an attack.
    That’s correct.

  100. If my Lickitung confused the defending then I paralyze him would confused go away?
    Yes.

  101. What is good against a Chansey Clefable deck?
    Fighting decks are very effective against these two.

  102. If Porygon changes Chanceys weakness to psychic, Chanseys knocks out Porygon, and I bring out a Mew, and do Psywave, how do you configure the damage?
    Multiply the amount of energy cards attached to Chansey by 10 and then double the total.

  103. Does Rapidash’s Agility Stop Kangashkhan’s fetch?
    No. Agility only stops effects that target Rapidash.

  104. Do you apply weakness or resistance first?
    Weakness and then resistance.

  105. How much damage would metronome do when the damage of the attack copied is dependent on the amount of energy discarded (ex: Blanes Charizard’s fire breath
    Ok. Here we go: the Metronome attack copies the attack and negates the cost (a.k.a. the energy cost of the attack). It also negates any payments to complete the attack like Charazards fire spin where it says you have to discard energy in order to do this attack. However on cards like Blastoise and any other card that has and added attack bonus for extra energy or attached cards you have to follow those rules as normal. Example if Clafable copied Hydro pump he would do 40 points of damage unless he had extra water energy on him, the same holds true for discarding for extra effects.

  106. When using metronome who’s weakness and resistance is applied, Clefairy or the color of the copied attack?
    Clefairy.

  107. What exactly is the difference between “metronome” and Ditto’s “transform”?
    Metronome only copies the attack, Transform copies all attacks and the hit points. Also one is an attack the other a Power.

  108. If I just have 2 Double colorless on Charizard can I do “Fire Spin”?
    Yes.

  109. If Magmar’s smokescreen knocks out its opponent, does the new Active have to flip to see if its attack is effective?
    No, it only effects the defending the attack was done against.

  110. Let’s say I have 2 Double Colorless Energy attached to a Charizard and I use its Energy Burn power followed by Fire Spin. Do I discard both energy cards and just 1?
    Just one. Whoops, my bad. I guess you would have to discard both energies on Charazard, even I get this mixed up some time.

  111. Ok, if I was using Articuno and I did blizzard and flipped tails and it killed one of my benched (my opponent got his/her last prize), but at the same time I killed there last … what would happen?
    You would win and he would get a useless card.
    But I thought you won when you got your last prize…
    You would go into final death in that situation.

  112. Can I use curse 4 times if u have 4 Gengars out?
    Ya, why?

  113. Does your opponent take a prize if Ditto that was copying a Clefairy Doll (that normally doesn’t yield a prize) is K-O’d?
    No prize for you.

  114. If my Active is paralyzed, can I use switch and get him on my bench?
    You betcha.

  115. In the 3rd ed. rulebook, it says if both players take each other’s last prize at the same time, then it is sudden death – unless one player also cannot replace their vacated spot with a poke from the bench – and thus it goes into sudden death. Is this correct?
    You are correct sir.

  116. Can you put a Defender on Mysterious Fossil; likewise can you use Revive on a discarded mysterious fossil?
    While the Fossil is in play it acts as a Basic so the Defender would work, however revive says that it can bring back a Basic card, which the Fossil is not.

  117. If I draw my last card. It is an electric energy so I use Riachu’s gigashock and it kills all of my opponents. Who wins?
    You do, because you won’t actually lose for being out of cards, until the beginning of your next turn.

  118. Pop quiz: There’s one in the Fossil set that is resistant to its own type. What is it?
    Aerodactyl. Is that right?

  119. Can a Ditto against a Venusaur use Energy Trans on any type of energy?
    Not really, since you can make energy attached to Ditto be any type you could use a copied Venusar’s Energy Trans to move THAT energy to any Pokémon, but energy on OTHER Pokémon would still have to be grass energy to use this power.

  120. If you where Smokescreen-ed by a Fossil Magmar and retreated, would you still have to flip to attack?
    No, benching your Pokémon would end the Smokescreen effect on you.

  121. Would you be so kind to explain to use what exactly Ditto copies with his Pokémon Power, Transform?
    It just copies whatever is written on the opponent’s Active Pokémon card.

  122. The trainer card “Energy Search” says nothing about showing the card to your opponent once you have found it in your deck. Shouldn’t you have to show it as part of “good-gamesmanship?”
    The other player must be able to see what energy card you pull out of your deck. This is done to verify that they in fact pulled an energy card. If the card just said to pull out any card, then they would NOT have to show it.

  123. I played against trainers who “hid” attached energy cards on benched Pokémon under the Pokémon card. Is this legal? (I don’t think it is). How you advise the player it’s not okay since the issue is not directly addressed in the rule? Thank you.
    That is not legal. Any card that is in play must be visible. This is a standard card game rule and is done so you can make sure each other is playing correctly.

  124. Hello, We get the hardest rules questions in our league; this is some Debatable question. I want to verify that Magmar’s Smokescreen wears off when the defending Pokémon (the one who got smoked) retreats and When Scyther does Sword Dance and gets gusted out and can’t do its 60 anymore next turn. Just want to verify it. Thanks.
    You are correct. Whenever an effect of an attack references a particular Pokémon and it is benched, that effects ends. So even Scyther’s Sword Dance effect ends.

  125. When Clefable metronomes Big Eggplosion how much damage does it do…And what is needed?
    You would flip a coin for each energy card attached to CLEFABLE (not Exxegcutor). For each heads that comes up it would do 20 damage.

  126. Can you Rain Dance on a ditto as long you have the water energy _in your hand_ but not any other energy such as a fighting energy?
    Correct, Ditto’s effect of changing energy types does NOT effect cards in your hand, only attached to Ditto.

  127. What is the penalty for drawing 2 cards instead of 1 at the beginning of your turn? Is it disqualification?
    Hmmm, I’d recommend a charley horse. Seriously though, it would depend on whether it was a sanctioned tournament or not and whether it was intentional. You would probably get a warning the first time it happened. It would depend on the level of the tournament?

  128. I know this one’s a bit odd, but how do you score damage if Porygon’s Conversion1 attack changes an opponent’s weakness to the same color as its resistance? Do you double first and then apply resistance or do you apply resistance 1st and then double?
    Your first choice is correct, do weakness first, then resistance.

  129. Is there a difference between “trading” your cards Such As Energy Retrieval and “discarding” your cards such as an Item Finder? Say that I only have one energy in my discard pile, and I use Energy Retrieval using Energy to trade, You only are able to retrieve the energy in your discard pile, not the card you traded. Right? Cause it would make sense about “trading”
    Yes, that’s right.

  130. Do you have to draw 2 cards when you’re opponent mulligan?
    No, you don’t. You MAY draw two extra cards.

  131. If Zapdos has more than four electric energy on it, do we discard all energy cards for the attack?
    Yes.

  132. The version 3 rulebook indicates that “Your opponent can then choose to draw up to 2 extra cards,” if you do not have a basic Pokémon. So you could draw just 1 card if you want?
    Yup.

  133. If Ditto copies a Venusaur and ditto has 4-fire energy on it can it use energy Trans and make the fire energy into plant energy because it’s copying a grass Pokémon?
    Yup it could transfer the fire (now grass due to Ditto’s change ability) to another Pokémon, it could NOT transfer non-grass energy from another Pokémon.

  134. Can I use Mewtwo’s absorption attack on one of my benched Mewtwos?
    No, it is referring to itself. So it can only attach 2 3n3rgy from the discard pile to itself.

  135. One of the Clefable’s attack copy the opponent’s attack, what do we have to follow? (If Clefable is copying Charmander’s Ember attack, do we discard one fire energy for Clefable to use the attack?) What I read on the text makes me think that Clefable
    No, Metronome says you do not have to anything else that is required in order to use the attack (like discarding).

  136. If you metronome Haunter’s “Dream Eater” does the defending Pokémon have to be asleep or not?
    Yes, it does.

  137. Say a Pokémon card had a colorless resistance, would that work against all types or just colorless?
    There is no such thing as colorless resistance.

  138. If I use Clefables metronome copying Lapras’ water gun attack (Lapras having 3 water on him)…how much would the attack do?
    The base damage is 10; it would do 10 more for each additional energy on CLEFABLE not on Lapras.

  139. How would it go if it Metronomed Sword dance? Would next turn it will deal twice as much according to the Japanese Text? Or would it state in the US Text.
    You would have to Metronome the Sword Dance the first turn and the Metronome the Slash the next and it would be doubled for your Clefable.

  140. Wouldn’t there have to be extra water energy on Clefable to do extra damage with water gun?
    Correct.

  141. But on Lapras’ water gun it says does 10 additional damage on LAPRAS…so wouldn’t Metronome do 30 instead of 10?
    Nope, read what I first stated, when you Metronome a Pokémon 's attack that references itself (as Lapras’s water gun does, you replace the self-reference with Clefable). So Water Gun will do 10 plus 10 more for each extra water energy on Clefable.

  142. If the only card I have in my hand is Prof. Oak can I use it to draw 7 more cards?
    Yes, you can discard a hand of zero cards.

  143. When you use energy removal on a Pokémon with a DCE and other energy on it do you get to decide which energy card to remove or does your opponent?
    The person playing the Energy Removal card gets to choose.

  144. Can I use promo Mewtwo’s energy absorption onto a benched Mewtwo?
    Nope, you can only use energy absorption on itself, not on other Mewtwo’s.

  145. If your using a Geodude and you keep flipping heads beyond the point where your opponents Pokémon is Ko’d do you have to continue until you get tails, or can you just stop?
    You could just stop.

  146. Are any Pokémon resistant to grass?
    We aren’t aware of any.

  147. If Ditto copies Scythers swords dance attack, and on my opponents turn, he benches Scyther and brings up his other Scyther, on my turn, would swords dance be active?
    Yes, it would still be active, there is no mid point where Ditto would have reverted to himself in this case, he stayed a Scyther and the Swords Dance was referencing himself.
