  148. Let’s say Clefable Metronomes Scyther’s Sword Dance, then Scyther retreated for a. Machop. Next turn, would Clefable’s Metronoming of a Machop’s Low Kick deal 20 or 40 damage?
    No.

  149. In your judgement, how many basic Pokémon should be in a deck?
    I would say about 16.

  150. If someone made up a set of like say 68 new cards and sent them to you (with what all the cards say exactly), would they be considered?
    Sorry, we don’t design the Pokémon cards here. You’d have to send them to the makers of the Pokémon card game in Japan.

  151. If a Ditto copy Swords Dance which says his SLASH does 60, could it copy Charmeleon’s for 60?
    No, the Swords Dance refers to Scyther’ s Slash.

  152. Can I evolve Squirtle into Blastoise with Pokebreeder when Aerodactyl is in play?
    No, check out Pokémon Breeder. It says you can only use it when you could evolve that Pokémon anyway.

  153. Who would win in a fight Ekans or Koffing?
    There’s a lot that could change the outcome in that match-up.

  154. Would Plus Power be doubled if the defending Pokémon had a weakness? Or added after the attacks damage is doubled?
    No, the effects of Plus Power are applied after Weakness ands Resistance.

  155. Since I am relatively new to this, what would you consider the most powerful card in the game?
    Well, that is really an opinion question, many jump at Charizard but I personally prefer Kanghaskan. Professor Oak is what many of my compadsres are yelling at me to tell you.

  156. When Clefable metronomes Moltres’ wildfire, what are the rules? Is it true you can burn the opponent’s whole deck automatically?
    No, that’s true. When you Metronome Wildfire, its effect would discard 1 card from the other guys deck for every fire energy you discarded from CLEFABLE in this case.

  157. What Basic Pokémon you most often use in your game (the first turn)(your own recommendation)
    Past suggest Hitmonchan and Scyther. Any Pokémon that only needs 1energy for an attack could be used on your first turn to attack.

  158. Does Persian’s pounce attack’s -10 accumulate such that it can ward off any attacks, even from Charazard?
    No, they don’t accumulate.

  159. Drowzee’s pound attack requires a colorless energy, even though it’s psychic, if I attach a grass energy, does the resistance to psychic still apply?
    Yes, it does.

  160. Is there a combination of energy types that you would recommend in a deck?
    Well, that’s up to you, the grass/psychic combo is pretty tough though.

  161. What’s the ruling of the Dark Pokemon?
    What do you mean? You can have alternate named Pokémon in your deck with plain ones, so you could have 4 Weedles and 4 Dark Weedles in the same deck.

  162. Why does Rhydon have Weakness to Grass?
    Probably for game balance purposes. And the fact that he is afraid of the mighty WEEDLE!

  163. Does a Buzzap’d Electrode providing Green Energy count as a Green (not Basic) Energy card since it counts as an Energy Card?
    Well technically, it just counts as an energy card that provides (in this case) 2 green energy.

  164. Are energy on Ditto counted as whatever type needed for anything, or just for purposes of meeting attack requirements? For example, can any energy on Ditto be used to discard cards with Moltres’ Wildfire, or beef up a Water Gun?
    You can treat energy attached to Ditto as any type for whatever reasons as long as Ditto isn’t asleep, confused, or paralyzed.

  165. Does a full heal trainer remove all damage also, it is not mentioned on the card? If not, how can the Pokémon have gotten fully healed?
    No, it heals effects for attacks like asleep, confusion, paralysis, or poisoned.

  166. Say Ditto has had its weakness changed by Porygon. Porygon retreats for another Pokémon, which Ditto now copies. Does Ditto retain the changed weakness as a result of Porygon’s attack, or does it now switch to the new Pokémon being copied?
    It would have the weakness of the Pokémon it copied. If it changed back to Ditto (and wasn’t benched or scooped up) then it would have the Poygon changed weakness.

  167. Can Clefairy dolls evolve into Clefable?
    No they can’t.

  168. How many energies do u think should be in a deck?
    Depends on the style of your deck. How many energy types you are playing with, trainer cards, etc. Anywhere from 24-34 is a good start (though 30 are a good starting value).

  169. So a Buzzap’d Electrode providing Green Energy couldn’t be Energy Trans’d by Venusaur because the card is not explicitly named ``Green Energy’’ even though its considered an Energy Card?
    Correct.

  170. Do Clefairy dolls and mysterious fossil count when counting bench numbers for Wigglytuffs “do the wave”?
    Yes they would, they count as basic Pokémon when in play.

  171. Regarding Ditto and Smokescreen: Ditto is smoke screened by Magmar, who then retreats for, say, a Weedle. Would Ditto still have to flip, or does the act of “dittoing” a new Pokémon remove the effect?
    Since Ditto is still active (not benched or evolved) the Smokecsreen would still effect him, regardless of him transforming.

  172. In start game, I have only 1 basic Pokémon but I don’t like that. Can I mulligan like Magic the Gathering?
    Not in the official rules (or in league or tournament play), no. In a friendly game, that would be up to you and your opponent.

  173. Is Chansey good? It does 80 HP to itself.
    Well that is an opinion question. 120 HP for a basic Pokémon is a lot, and since it is colorless you can use any type of energy to pay for its attacks. It would have to have some sort of drawback or it would be too powerful otherwise.

  174. Does plus power trainer add damage to a failed attack when confused?
    No, Pluspower reads that if the attack does damage to the DEFENDING Pokémon then pluspower adds 10 to the final amount. A confused attack against itself is not against the defending Pokémon.

  175. Okay, so let me get this straight – Magmar’s “effect of an attack” is not cancelled by Ditto assuming a new Identity, but Porygon’s “effect of an attack” Conversion is. Is it because Porygon’s is actually changing an actual element of a card, but Smokescreen is not? (Trying to figure out the difference so I can extrapolate similar situations in the future if need be).
    Ok, that’s somewhat true but keep in mind that Ditto’s Transform has it change into a complete copy of the other active Pokémon. In your example, Ditto would have been a copy of Porygon, so it actually wouldn’t have changed Ditto’s weakness anyway, just Ditto as Porygon’s weakness.

  176. Porygon use conversion 1 change Pidgey weakness and he retreats or evolves, Pidgey still change or not?
    If you mean Pidgey evolves or retreats then the effect is gone. If you mean Porygon retreating, as long as Pidgey was still the active Pokémon, the effect would still be there.

  177. Active = Scyther. I also have a Scyther on the bench. Opponent uses Weedle to poison my Scyther. My turn. Can I retreat active Scyther and bring up benched Scyther, then retreat and bring up the original Scyther, thus removing the poison?
    Yes you could.

  178. If you have a double colorless on a Pokémon, and its retreat cost is 1 energy what would u do?
    You would have to discard the double colorless energy if that’s the only energy you had available and you wanted to retreat that Pokémon.

  179. Can I remove 2 energy in different Pokémon with super energy removal?
    No, both energies must be removed from the same Pokémon.

  180. What moves do Arodactel know?
    He has the Wing Attack for 30 damage and a new Pokémon Power.

  181. How long does Mew’s attack devolution last? I don’t think it would make sense to use it only to have your opponent turn around and evolve it again.
    That’s what it is.

  182. When I use a computer search do I have to show the card a searched for to my opponent?
    No.

  183. If someone puts ditto out at the beginning of a game and starts second, will Ditto use transform on its opponent’s turn?
    Yes.

  184. Does Venomoth’s shift power affect its weakness/resistance?
    It stays the same, course if you changed him to Fire and he was confused and hit himself, Then no it doesn’t

  185. Hi, I have a question, If I have a fossil Hunter in my bench and its attack there, does the transparency work in the bench too?
    Sure it would.

  186. If Ditto is poisoned and his opponent evolves, does Ditto get to remove the poison just as if it had evolved itself?
    Nope.

  187. If the player and/or opponent’s active Pokémon is asleep confused, or paralyzed does SWITCH and/or GUST of WIND still work?
    Yes it does, playing Trainer cards is what the trainer is doing, NOT the Pokémon (though it effects the Pokémon).

  188. Does Ditto lose effects if I switch a Pokémon(ex. poison)
    If you aren’t switching Ditto, then no.

  189. I heard that in order for Chansy or Clefairy to Metronome Moltres’s Wildfire you need to discard the energy off of Clefairy/fable still, even through Metronome says not to discard energy. Why?
    Ahhh, metronome says you do not have to discard energy that is REQUIRED to do in attack, the EFFECT of the Wildfire requires you to discard energy, not the attack.

  190. Does Chansey take poison damage if scrunch works?
    Yes, Scrunch says it only prevents damage, all other effects of attacks still happen.

  191. Can I start a game using a Clefairy Doll or a mysterious fossil as my basic Pokémon?
    Yes but only if you have another basic Pokémon (not one of them in your starting hand). They count as trainer cards in your hand and you must have 1 basic in your hand to start.

  192. If I have two Dodrio on my bench, does that mean I can use it’s Pokemon power and deduct the retreat cost by two instead of one?
    Yes, you could.

  193. If an Areodactyl is in play, can another one be “evolved” from a mysterious fossil?
    No, as long as that first Aerodactyl isn’t paralyzed, asleep, or confused, then no Pokémon can evolve.

  194. What would be a good deck building idea with water cards?
    Hmm, there are many variants on the Rain Dance deck, check out the Pojo or Pokegym for good fan deck ideas.

  195. Do you know a good type of Pokémon to correspond with water in a deck?
    Hmm, Blastoise, Lapras, Articuno, some others like Seel/Dewgong or Magickarp/Gyrados.

  196. When your opponent has Moltres and you use metronome for wildfire how would you go about that
    Well, you only need to pay 1 colorless to Metronome the Wildfire but it won’t do anything unless you pay the normal EFFEECT cost of discarding an energy card for each card you want the opponent to discard.

  197. If I have a fossil Haunter on the bench and a Magnaton uses self-destruct and I flip a head dose that make the self-destruct fail
    No, it would just prevent any damage from happening to Haunter.

  198. If I have 2 in play Fossil Haunters (one active and one benched) and my opponent uses a Magneton’s self Destruct would I flip twice for Transparency (once for my active haunter and another for my benched)?
    Yes you could flip for each one to see if damage to that particular Haunter is prevented.

  199. If my opponent had 3 cards left in his deck and I used wildfire to discard the three cards and on his/her next turn do I win.
    Yup, you would, if someone cannot draw a card at the start of their turn like they are supposed to, they lose.

  200. Does poison work like this Smog (heads)-20 damage, End of your turn-10 poison damage, End of opponents turn-10 poison damage and so on.
    Correct.

  201. Charizard has 2 dice on it. I do fire spin. I discard both DCE right?
    Fire Spin requires that 2 Energy “cards” be discarded as a cost. One Double Colorless Energy card only counts as 1 card toward this cost (another Energy “card”).

  202. I have a Lickitung out and my opponent a Ditto…ditto has 6 damage on it…I do confuse ray successfully. Will Ditto go back to Ditto?
    Yes it would and then it would be knocked out (ditto has 50 hp).

  203. If I’m playing against someone and they do other things before drawing their card and remember to do it after they give an energy or attack, are they still aloud to draw a card or are they not aloud?
    Technically drawing a card is the first thing you do, period. They broke the rules and “could” be warned if in a tournament.

  204. Moltres’ Wildfire says you MAY discard, as opposed to all other similar Fire attacks, which REQUIRE you to discard. In other words, it sounds like discarding with Wildfire is not a REQUIREMENT to use the attack, but an effect OF the attack. If that is so, could you do the Wildfire attack without discarding any cards (which, understandably, would have no effect)?
    Yes you could.

  205. Is MP Mewtwo the same as B Mewtwo or can u have 4 of both in your deck?
    They are the same in that they have the same name, only 4 Mewtwo’s max in a deck.

  206. When using super potion, is it correct that I must remove the energy card from the same Pokémon that I am removing damage counters?
    Yes, that is correct

  207. When using Lapras’ water gun, what is the most damage I can do? The card says I can add 20 damage, which means (adding 20 to 10) I can do 30 damage. Is this correct?
    Correct. 30 max for Lapras’s Watergun.

  208. If Moltres is Confused, do you discard any cards for Wildfire’s effect BEFORE the coin flip to attack under Confusion (in the ‘satisfy any requirements in order to use this attack’ step) or AFTER the coin flip (in the ‘do any additional effects of the attack’ step)?
    You must discard the energy when you do the attack BEFORE you flip for confusion.

  209. If Ditto is copying Arcanine, and wishes to do the Flamethrower attack, can Ditto discard ANY color energy to satisfy the ‘discard one Fire Energy’ requirement of the attack, or must he discard only ACTUAL Fire energy attached to him?
    You could discard any energy in this case (Ditto’s transform power allows energy attached to Ditto to be any type).

  210. Similarly, if Ditto is copying Moltres, and wishes to do the Wildfire attack, can Ditto discard any number of ANY color energy to create the deck-depletion effect, or must he discard only ACTUAL Fire energy attached to him? Or does he need to discard any on him at all?
    He needs to discard energy for the effect of the attack BUT it can be energy of any type.

  211. Since Ditto allows Energy attached to Ditto to be of any type, can you use Venusaur’s Energy Trans power to Trans a Buzzap’d Electrode attached to Ditto so that it is now attached to another Pokémon by treating it as Green Energy?
    Yes you could.

  212. When Ditto goes from copying a particular Pokémon to copying another (when the Defending Pokémon retreats, for example) do either status effects (such as poison or sleep) or attack-based effects (such as Magmar’s Smokescreen or Porygon’s Conversion) disappear as a result?
    No they don’t.

  213. In Clefairy’s Metronome is used on Molter’s wildfire does he have to discard.
    Yes you do if you want the attack to have any effect. Metronome says to ignore effects or discards that are needed IN ORDER TO DO THE ATTACK, such as discarding 2 fire energy to use Charizard’s Fire Spin, Moltres’s Wildfire says you MAY discard any number of fire energy for increasing the effect of the attack, NOT to do it.

  214. Ditto says “you may treat any Energy attached to Ditto as Energy of any type.” Does that mean that if Ditto is copying Venusaur, he could Energy Trans, say, a DCE from himself to a Grass Pokémon? Or does it mean the Energy can be treated as needed ONLY for the purposes of satisfying requirements to use an attack? Ditto says “you may treat any Energy attached to Ditto as Energy of any type.” Does that mean that if Ditto is copying Venusaur, he could Energy Trans, say, a DCE from himself to a Grass Pokémon? Or does it mean the Energy can be treated ONLY for the purposes of satisfying attack REQUIREMENTS?
    It doesn’t state that the energy can only be treated for purposes of satisfying attack requirements so don’t assume that.

  215. Since you can only attach one basic energy card per turn, can you attach (1 of your 4) double white energy too because it’s not a basic energy card?
    The Rules State you can attach one energy card per turn, it does NOT state basic energy, so the DCE would count as your one energy card per turn, yes.

  216. The WB Movie Promo Mewtwo has Energy Absorption as one of its attacks do you have to attach the 2 Energy cards to the active Mewtwo or can it be a Mewtwo on your bench?
    For Energy Absorption, the 2 energy cards can only be attached to THIS Mewtwo, not to another one.

  217. Does poison still affect a Pokémon if it is asleep?
    Yes it does.

  218. If a Pokémon is confused, once u discard the energies to heal it, but fail, are the energies still discarded?
    Do you mean removing the energy to use a super potion? If so, confusion does NOT effect this.

  219. If Charizard Firespins a Grass Energy Card attached to him so that it is now a Grass Energy Card providing Fire Energy, can Venusaur’s Energy Trans Power still move it to another Pokémon, since it still is technically a “Grass Energy Card”?
    Charizard using Energy Burn turns attached energy into FIRE energy until the end of the turn. Grass energy effected by this would NOT count as grass energy until after the turn, and it turns back.

  220. If you use energy on your turn does that mean when it comes time to attack you can not buzzap Electrode due to the one energy rule?
    No that is not true, Buzzaping electrode changes electrode into an energy card, this does NOT count as attaching (taking an energy card from your hand) an energy to a Pokémon.

  221. Regarding the Charizard fire spin question - so, since Pokémon powers are always affective, the grass energy on Charizard will always be fire energy, therefore not allowing Venasaur to energy trans it, right?
    Correct, if you used Charizard’s Energy Burn and turned grass energy into fire energy (until the end of the turn) it could NOT be Energy Transferred since it is no longer grass energy.

  222. So, since you can Energy Trans energy off of Ditto if he wants to use it as Grass Energy, could you theoretically Energy Trans a Fire Energy Card from a Ditto using it as Grass Energy onto an Arcanine, at which point it now reverts to it’s original Fire Energy?
    Yes you could (geez you are making me think a lot today!).

  223. Can Defender prevent the 20 damage during your turn (like failed attack when confused) and also prevent 20 damage during opponent’s attack, for a total of 40 damage prevented?
    Yes it could.

  224. Would Defender prevent damage caused by Machamp’s Strike Back Pokémon Power? If it doesn’t, is it because that damage is a secondary effect, and not the direct result of an Attack?
    It would not. Defender protects against damage done by attacks not by Pokémon Powers like Machamp’s Strike Back.

  225. If I recall correctly (?), neither Clefairy Doll nor Devolution Spray made it into Base Set 2. If so, can you tell me why these cards have been taken out of print?
    Because we wanted more Pokémon made into Base Set 2, some trainer cards didn’t make it. Those two were not as popular so they didn’t make the cut.

  226. Can you Metronome an attack that does not do any damage (such as Kangaskhan’s Fetch attack)?
    You could Metronome any attack, regardless of whether it does damage or not.

  227. If Clefable can use Metronome, does it have to discard while it metronomes attacks that need to discard, such as Charizard’s Fire Spin?
    If the discarding is required like for Fire Spin you do NOT, if it is optional like Moltres’s Wildfire, then you DO.

  228. If your opponent uses Kangaskhan’s Fetch attack, would you be able to use Pidgeotto’s Mirror Move to mimic it on your next turn? I imagine you would not be able to since the attack doesn’t really ``effect’’ Pidgeotto, though I could be wrong.
    Nothing happened to Pidgeotto so nothing would happen if Pidgeotto tried to use Mirror Move.

  229. If Clefable Metronomes Charizard’s Fire Spin, but Clefable has only one energy attached, Clefable can’t use that attack, right?
    Wrong, Clefable can use Metronome.

  230. If an active Pokémon had a retreat cost of 1 energy, and u used Dodrio’s Pokémon power: retreat aid, would that mean it retreats for free?
    Yes it would. Having multiple Dodrios is cumulative.

  231. Then in the same understanding as Dodrio, would powers that do a similar effect be cumulative?
    Dodrio’s is the only one that comes to mind right now that works this way, do you have another example?

  232. If Scyther does Swords Dance, and on the next turn goes briefly to the bench (to end poison) and becomes active the same turn, can Scyther Slash for 60, or does benching end the Swords Dance effect.
    Yeah, that’s a slight bummer, but you can’t have everything.

  233. Can I place Mysterious Fossil on my bench? Can I attach defender on it?
    Yes.

  234. If Syther uses swords dance then I use gust of wind?
    If Scyther hits the bench (if you gusted it) then it loses the Swords Dance effect.

  235. Is ditto’s Pokémon power always in effect?
    Yes, when he is an active Pokémon and not confused, paralyzed, or asleep.

  236. Can you use Alakazams Pokémon power more than once during 1 turn? If so, wouldn’t it be easy to win?
    Yes you could and no not really. Since you move the damage to other Pokémon you control, eventually all of your Pokémon will be full of damage.

  237. What happens if a Ditto goes against an M fossil, can the Ditto be thrown away do you get a prize if you kill it
    A Ditto that Transforms into a Fossil or a Clefairy Doll retains the text, so no prize will be given when it’s knocked out.

  238. What Pokémon’s Pokémon power must be announced to be used?
    Many of them, read each power, they are all different.

  239. If fossil Zapdos has 70 damage and he uses his attack against a full bench, flips a coin and its tails, is he immediately knocked out or can he still finish his attack?
    Damage isn’t given to Pokémon until the attack is finished being calculated (in this case, coins being flipped).

  240. Can Alakazam’s power work on itself?
    Yes it could.

  241. So Zapdos can finish his attack and can receive more damage than necessary?
    Yes, you calculate out the damage an attack does and then check effects like Trainer cards, weakness, and resistance BEFORE you actually apply the damage.

  242. A mysterious fossil and a Clefairy doll don’t count as basic Pokémon in my opening hand unless I have another basic Pokémon right
    Correct, they are Trainer cards when in your hand.

  243. Is there a great way to stop from decking yourself if you are just about to run out of cards?
    Well, if you had Lass and other trainer cards in your hand that would get a few more cards into your deck but.

  244. When I use Energy Removal, do I get to choose which?
    Yes you do.

  245. How does Charizard’s Pokémon power work?
    Energy Burn As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may turn all Energy attached to Charizard into Energy for the rest of the turn. This power can’t be used if Charizard is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

  246. If I have super potion and no energy attached to a Pokémon can I use it?
    No you couldn’t.

  247. How does devolution beam WORK?(MEW)
    You pick a Pokémon (yours or your opponent’s) and return the highest stage of evolution that was out on that Pokémon back to the owner’s hand. This would remove poison, paralysis, asleep, confusion, or any effects of attacks (like smokescreen) from that Pokémon. Damage would stay, of course.

  248. Do you think that using Haunter (fossil) to repeatedly put your opponent to sleep so you can build your bench is being cheesy?
    Hey, if it works for you then use it. Your opponent should have some switch cards in his deck to combat that sort of thing.

  249. FOR Electrode’s attack - chain lightning, DOES ALL COLORLESS TYPE POKÉMON COUNT AS THE SAME TYPE?
    They are all colorless BUT chain lightning does NOT have its secondary effect if the defending Pokémon is colorless.

  250. Why do u like rain dance? It only works on water types. So why?
    A deck made up of only water energy and water Pokémon with Blastoises can get Pokémon like Blastoise, Lapras, and Articuno full of water energy fast (through it Professor Oak, Item Search, etc). This makes for a VERY fast deck.

  251. I asked the question about the Pokémon Powers. Do you mean that even though that it is “always on” I have to announce it? And If I don’t announce it, does the power not work, or what?
    No, read each power, if always on, you don’t have to announce it. If it says you MAY use it, then you must announce it.

  252. FOR Kangaskhan’s Comet Punch, IF I FILP FOUR TAILS, DOES THAT MEAN THE ATTACK DOES NOTHING?
    Correct.

  253. I like Ditto is he/she a good Pokémon to use?
    Sure though he can be a bit complicated to play.

  254. Can I try and retreat after failed attempts because of confusion…as long as I pay the retreat cost?
    Nope, as stated in the rulebooks, if you fail retreating (due to confusion) you cannot try and retreat that Pokémon again that turn.

  255. Buzzap reads: “…choose a type of Energy. Electrode is now an Energy card…that provides 2 Energy of that type.” However, if you have chosen Grass, you still can’t Energy Trans Electrode. Ditto reads: “…you may treat any Energy attached to Ditto as Energy of any type.” As it says Energy, and not Energy cards, I would think that Ditto changes the type of Energy an Energy card provides. However, you can Energy Trans an Electrode that’s on Ditto by treating it as Grass Energy. If the type of Energy provided by an Energy card doesn’t determine its type, how is this possible? Does Ditto change the Energy type of the card as well as the type of Energy provided, or does changing the Energy provided change the Energy card type, or what? Or is Electrode just an aberration that basically counts as a Colorless type Energy card providing 2 Colored Energy because the text can be taken to mean that Electrode is explicitly “typing” itself to have no Energy type (as a card)?
    Ok, long question and we needed to check on it. Yes, you could NOT energy trans a buzzaped electrode even if grass was selected because it is NOT a grass energy card, but an energy card that provides 2 (in this case grass) energy. Ditto says you may treat any Energy attached to Ditto as Energy of any type, so if this buzzaped Electrode was on Ditto, then you COULD change it to Grass Energy for that turn (that provides 2 grass energy) and then you COULD energy trans it…

  256. Does Magmar’s smokescreen stops anything from fetch to energy absorption to firespin?
    Yes it does.

  257. Can I remove any energy card with energy removal…like Buzzaped electrode?
    Yes you could. Double Colorless energy (and a Buzzaped Electrode) are Energy cards and therefore may be discarded with Energy Removal.

  258. Does agility stop fetch, stretch kick, and wildfire?
    No, the Agility only stops effects of attacks DONE to Rapidash.

  259. On the trainer computer search, do you have to show the card you choose from your deck?
    No you don’t, since it only mentions getting a card. If it stated a specific type (like trainer or Pokémon) then you would have to show it to verify the correct choice.

  260. If I attach a defender to Arcanine and do takedown…would it reduce the damage down to 10?
    Yes, Arcanine would only do 10 to itself from the Takedown attack in this case.

  261. When out of basics, do you get to draw a card for your turn?
    Not sure what you mean. You always draw a card at the start of your turn, if you are out of cards and can’t do this draw, you lose.

  262. If I attach a defender to Electabuzz and do thunder punch, flipping tails…I take 10 damage…and my opponent does 20 damage next turn, would the damage be reduced any?
    Why would you take 10 damage? Thunder punch does 10 damage to your opponent. If his attack to you did 20, Defender would reduce it to zero.

  263. Can I use Energy Retrieval or Attacks (like Energy Absorption) to retrieve my Buzzapped Electrode (the card never says when it stops being an energy card)?
    No you couldn’t. When a card hits the discard pile it always reverts to its basic form (like a Mysterious Fossil would be a Trainer Card, not a basic Pokémon).

  264. What is the official ruling for smokescreen attack I need to know because I judge tourneys and don’t know what to call?
    If the opponent tries to do ANY attack next turn (whether it does damage to Magmar or it’s something like Fetch: Draw a Card), they must flip a coin. If it comes up tails, that attack does. If that player benches or evolves the Pokémon affected by the Smokescreen though, the effect ends (since it is referencing the Defending Pokémon).

  265. If my Chansey uses Double-Edge on a Haunter and flips heads for Transparency would I do 80 damage to my Chansey and none to him?
    Yes, a successful use of Transparency only prevents the effects of attacks on to Haunter, not to the attacking Pokémon itself.

  266. If Spearow is on the bench and takes 30 damage from promo Mewtwo’s Telekinesis attack, and then you make Spearow active, can you do Mirror Move for 30? Or does Mirror Move only apply to damage taken while active?
    Mirror Move would only apply to damage taken while Spearow was active.

  267. Can Item Finder be used to find itself? (With MP Mewtwo as active, play Item Finder to discard 2 energy, then get the Item Finder back?)
    Nope, the order for training cards is, pay the cost, do the effect, THEN discard that Trainer Card.

  268. On previous rulings: This one may have been cleared up in a Chat for which I don’t have a transcript. But it was said that when Charizard Energy Burns, says, all the Grass Energy attached to him into Fire Energy, that if he were to then become Confused, etc., then the Energy would revert back to Grass. How does that make sense when all the Power does is change Energy from its original type to Fire, and makes no reference to this being a “maintained” power (in fact, it clearly states the effect remains on the Energy “until end of turn”). Whether or not the Power is functioning doesn’t seem like it would have any bearing on previous uses of said Power (any more than evolving Grimer into Fossil Muk will retroactively remove the damage done by Machamp Strikes Back last turn).
    Umm, who said the energy would revert? If it were already changed, it would stay that way until the end of the turn. BTW, isn’t Pokémon supposed to be a fun and simple game? (Getting ready to duck flames).

  269. How many water energies can you put down in one turn using “rain dance”?
    As many as you have in your hand (then play your Professor Oak and get more and do it again!).

  270. On previous rulings: It was said that if Moltres is Confused, you must discard any Fire Energy attached to Moltres you wish to use to activate Wildfire before you flip for Confusion during your attack. However, this discarding of Fire Energy isn’t a requirement for you to use the attack (step c in attack precedence), only an optional step for it to actually do anything. It also isn’t an effect (step d). So how come it doesn’t count as “do whatever the attack says” (step f), which comes after Confusion (step e). Is this because it (the Energy discard) counts as a “choice” (step b), even though it doesn’t specifically say “choose”? Usage of the word “may” seems to imply making a choice, and as such may be the cause for confusion over this Confusing question.
    There is no TIMING in Pokémon. You are trying WAY too hard to make a simple game had. The attack states, You may discard any number of Energy cards attached to Moltres, when you use this attack. You use the attack (i.e. perform it) BEFORE confusion is rolled for. As simple as that.

  271. If a Ditto copied a sleeping Muk, Ditto would copy Toxic Gas, then disable it’s own power, becoming Ditto, then Muk, then Ditto, then Muk. What would eventually happen?
    I quote from the Fossil FAQ: Q: What happens if Ditto copies a Confused Muk (so that when Ditto copies Muk’s Pokémon Power: Toxic Gas, it turns off its own Pokémon Power: Whoops! The end result is that Ditto is Ditto.

  272. If a Haunter’s Transparency blocked a Chansey’s double-edge, would Chansey still deal itself 80?
    Yes, the effects of Transparency only prevents effects of an attack done to Haunter (Fossil)

  273. Although it may seem pointless, can you play Bill with no cards in your deck, or Professor Oak? Could you play Computer Search with no cards in your deck? Can you use Super Energy Removal and choose to discard 0 energies of your opponent’s?
    Yes, it seems pointless, but you can.

  274. If my opponent switches Pokémon is smokescreen still in effect?
    Did you do the Smokescreen to your opponent? Then no, the Smokescreen effect will end.

  275. If you us promo Pikachu’s Recharge and have no lightning energy in your deck, do you just not do anything, or show your opponent your cards in your deck and do anything? Would you be allowed to look through your deck but not attach a lightning energy?
    You would just look though you deck and not attach a lightning energy. If you use the attack and you have a lightning energy, you have to attach it to Pikachu.

  276. If a Ditto was copying a Charmander, and Ditto used ember, the energy it must discard must be a FIRE ENERGY CARD, correct?
    Remember you may treat any energy attached to Ditto as energy of any type when Ditto’s Transform Power is in effect.

  277. Say I attach a defender to Electabuzz, I use thunderpunch and I take 10 damage because of tails…and defender stops that. Then my opponent deals 20 damage to me…would defender block any of the damage my opponent did?
    To your Pokémon you mean? The Defender will reduce damage done by attacks to that Pokémon by 20. Since these are separate attacks, 20 would reduce both.

  278. On question #97: Sorry, Pat, I wanted to make Mike get this one, but. Mike said there’s no “timing” in Pokémon, yet in Rulebook V.3 it specifically states in what order you do your attack. If the discard for Moltres’ Wildfire isn’t considered a choice (step b), then it would seem to fall under step f (do whatever the attack says), which is after the Confusion flip (step e). So, is discard part of step b? Any help? Please?
    OK, hold off on the coffee man…just kidding’. You’re reading steps where there are none. You either attack with you’re confused Moltres or you do not. Any choices that must be made for the attack (like discarding energy cards for Wildfire) must be made when you choose to attack. Does that help you out?

  279. If Venomoth used Shift, would the type it changed to be removed if it retreated? What if a Devolution Spray was played on it?
    Retreating would not remove the effects of Shift, though a Devolution Spray would because Venomoth is no longer Venomoth.

  280. Some players hide their energy directly beneath their Pokémon, so you can’t see what energy they have. Is this legal?
    Nope, all cards in play need to be visible.

  281. If you have a Pokémon with 10 HP left that is poisoned, and your opponent have no cards in your deck with one prize left, then you end your turn, is it Sudden Death or do you lose? (You have a Pokémon on your bench.) Why?
    At the end of the turn your Pokémon takes the 10 points damage from Poison. It’s knocked out; he takes his last prize and wins.

  282. In your opponent has no basic Pokémon, do you have to put your active and benched Pokémon down before drawing your card? Can you bench more Pokémon and/or change your active after you draw your extra cards? Also, since you can draw UP to 2 extra cards, do you have to decide how many you draw, then draw, or can you draw one, then decide whether or not you want to draw your 2nd?
    You can draw your two cards before you place your Pokémon. You do have to announce in advance how many you will draw BEFORE you draw them.

  283. When a Ditto use’s A Farfetch’d’s Leek Slap, can it be used again with Ditto, or no? (I guess no.)
    It could not, Ditto is an exact copy of Farfetch’d and has his same limitations as well. Now, if you benched Ditto and then brought him back up then you could use it again as he is in effect, a new Farfetch’d.

  284. Can you retrieve the basic energy card you discarded to play energy retrieval with energy retrieval? (My guess. yes)
    No you can’t. Its says to TRADE 1 card from your hand for up to 2 basic energy from your discard pile. That means you exchange the one card from your hand for those cards from your pile.

  285. I play a fossil against a ditto with damage do I get a prize?
    Sure, Ditto would turn into the Fossil and then get knocked out.

  286. If a Clefairy Metronome’s a Scyther’s Sword Dance, and next turn uses Slash, will it do 30 or 60? What if Scyther retreated and came back out after you Swords Danced? What if, on your turn, you retreated Clefable, and brought it back out?
    On your first question, yes it would do 60. On your second question, if Clefable is benched it would lose the Swords Dance effect.

  287. What would be the best Pokémon to put in lightning deck?
    One of our guys says the base set Electabuzz, best basic electric Pokémon.

  288. I had a question about Clefairy/fable’s metronome attack. If you copied Sword Dance one round and then Slash the next is it 30 or 60 damage?

  290. If ditto is poisoned and my opponent evolves…will ditto no longer be poisoned since he “evolved”?
    He would still be poisoned. Ditto did not evolve; he transforms into a copy of the evolved Pokémon.

  291. About question number 133 though, about Ditto being able to discard any energy when copying Charmander’s ember. Ditto copies energy, not energy cards. Charmander’s Ember attacks clearly says “Discard one Fire Energy Card attached to Charmander in order to use this attack.” Ditto cannot use Rain Dance when copying Blastoise unless what it attaches is a WATER ENERGY CARD. So could we review the question?
    Energy Requirements include discarding, so any color energy may be used for discards. Also, Blastoise’s Rain Dance is referring to cards in your hand, so of COURSE Ditto’s energy change ability does not work with that.

  292. What is the best combo in your opinion? In TCG that is.
    Alakazam and Slowbro, or Blastoise and water energy, Weedle and anything, of course.

  293. If you have 1 card in your hand and it is a computer search can you use it?
    No you can’t.

  294. Can you use Pokémon trader if you have no Pokémon in your hand?
    No, it says to TRADE, meaning you must have another card (you should know that Ash).

  295. Can you use Maintenance if it is the only card in your hand?
    Nope.

  296. If Clefariy/Fable’s Metronome is used to copy Porygon’s conversion 2 and changes its own resistance… Does this effect still apply when benched and/or de-evolved?
    Nope.

  297. Does Venomoth’s Shift last until you start your next turn, or until you change it?
    Until you change it (or it is benched or devolved).

  298. Can I use energy retrieval if it is the only card in my hand?
    Nope.

  299. Can I use Super Energy Removal if none of my Pokémon have energy cards attached to them?
    Nope.

  300. Where can you take the water energy cards from for Blastoise’s rain dance?
    From your hand.

  301. How do you use Poliwhirl’s doubleslap?
    You flip 2 coins, for each heads that comes up, the attack does 30 damage, so no heads = no damage, 1 heads = 30 damage, 2 heads = 60 damage.

  302. HERE. This one CAN happen, your opponent’s Pokémon is asleep and poisoned, your Pokémon is poisoned. You end your turn. After you end your turn, what happens first, then second, then last?
    They are simultaneous effects.

  303. Master, you said I couldn’t retrieve the same energy I discarded to play Energy Retrieval with it, because it says TRADE. Now with Pokémon Trader, couldn’t you just take your Pokémon that you were going to put in? I read somewhere else you COULD retrieve the discarded energy. And are you sure Ditto VS Charmander, Ditto wouldn’t have to discard a fire energy when using Ember, since it says Energy CARD, not energy?
    Nope. Trading means swapping a card from your hand for the card the Trainer card is asking you for. You are getting confused with Item Finder where you CAN bring back a card discarded for the cost of a Trainer.

  304. My opponent has a Chancey and successfully used Scrunch. Can I use 2 Gust of Winds and send Chancey backs and do damage?
    Yes you could.

  305. So everyone’s asking about the ditto/fossil thing, if ditto changes into a myst. Fossil and gets KO’d do you get a prize? (Because it is now fossil.)
    As far as we know (and we will check with R&D later) he is a copy and would count BUT we will verify this one for you. Check back next week.

  306. I still don’t understand why DITTO can discard any energy with Charmander’s Ember attack. Can you explain the differences between this and Energy Trans and Rain Dance?
    What don’t you understand? Ditto can count energy on it as any type (i.e. Fire energy can count as Grass Energy) and be Energy Trans’ed. Rain Dance says take WATER energy from your HAND, Ditto has no effect on your hand!

  307. If Seadra used agility and flipped heads on the coin flip, could Fearow use agility the next turn?
    Yes he could though the 20 damage would be prevented.

  308. Does Venomoth’s weakness stay Fire even when he uses shift?
    Yes it does.

  309. Earlier you said if a Venomoth is benched the type it Shifted to stay, now you say it disappears! What happens to Venomoth’s Shifted type when it is benched?
    I made a mistake with the Fetched reference, my apologies. If it is devolved it would lose it but not if it is benched.

  310. So you said the effects from conversion 2 DO NOT remain on a Porygon or a Ditto or a Metronomed Clefairy/fable when benched, even though it doesn’t say anywhere on Proygon’s card the effects go away when benched.
    The rule is ALL attack’s effects are ended if a Pokémon is benched or evolved/devolved.

  311. Can a Pokémon with the water gun attack chose to do less damage (Bastoise do 40 with 5 energy’s on him/her)?
    Nope, though for the life of me, why would you want to?

  312. IF ATTACK MR MIME 30 OR MORE DAMAGE DOSE IT DO 0 OR 20 DAMAGE?
    If an attack for 30 or more hits Mr. Mime, it does zero.

  313. If a Pokémon is put to sleep, then, during the owners turn he flips the coin and it wakes up, can it attack?
    He doesn’t flip during his turn, he flips after a turn ends, so he could flip after the other player’s turn ends and then if he wakes up, he could attack normally, yes.

  314. Can you stop your own Aerodactyls Poké Power to evolve your own Pokés?
    No, it’s always on. Unless Aero is paralyzed, confused, or asleep.

  315. When playing an Arcanine with Defender attached. It will reduce Takedown to only 10 damage. Will it also reduce your opponent’s next attack by 20 also?
    Yup.

  316. Again referring to the “Step In” power of Dragonite. If I want to retreat a Pokémon with a high-energy retreat cost (*** or ****) - I’ll use Dragonite to “Step In” and then retreat Dragonite for only one *. I feel this was valid, but my opponent didn’t?
    That is a valid move.

  317. Referring to Pidgeot and the Hurricane Attack. My opponent used a Pokémon Breeder to evolve a basic Pokémon direct to the 2nd stage evolution (leaving the Breeder card between the two on his bench). Later, he moved the 2nd stage evolved Pokémon to act?
    Sorry but the full question didn’t come through BUT you do NOT leave the Breeder on the bench, it goes to the discard pile.

  318. If Clefairy or Clefable copies Moltres’ Wildfare, does she still have to discard fire cards to use it?
    Yup! The discarding is NOT a cost of the attack but affects the result of the attack.

  319. On Magmar’s smokescreen if my opponent switches Pokémon would smokescreen be gone?
    Yes it would (since it is referring to that particular defending Pokémon).

  320. So you do get a prize for knocking out a ditto with a fossil?
    Yes you do.

  321. Is a Pokémon benched if I pay the retreat cost…slide it down to my bench…and slide up the same Pokémon, would that rid it of poison?
    You can’t do that. Retreating means you SWAP the active Pokémon with a Benched one.

  322. Can you use energy removal on Electrodes buzzap?
    Yes you could.

  323. My ditto has 6 damage counters on it and my opponent has an Electabuzz I just knocked out, since he has no active after I knocked out Electabuzz and he has like Likitung on his bench in-between would Ditto be KO’d?
    There is no in-between step gang. When Lickitung moves up Ditto copies it.

  324. If I use 4 different types of Mewtwo’s in a deck can I use more than 4?
    Nope, you can only have 4 max copies of a same named car, regardless of what version it is.

  325. Why did WotC give Mew Devolution beam if the other trainer can just re-evolve next turn?
    You could use it on one of your own Pokémon in order to use earlier evolution abilities if you needed them.

  326. If I have 2 Dodrios on my bench and have an active Electabuzz, can I retreat him for free?
    SURE!

  327. How long does poisoning last?
    Until the Pokémon is benched, evolved, or knocked out.

  328. Why are there no Pokémon that are resistant to fire, water, or grass damage?
    Cuz fire hurts, water makes you all squinchy, and grass tickles your nose.

  329. If an attack says something like 20 damage, and flip a coin. If heads this attack does an additional 20 damage. Is that extra 20 damage added to the base damage or is it added after applying weakness and resistance?
    It’s added to the base damage BEFORE Weakness or Resistance is figured.

  330. If I KO my opponents last Pokémon but they still have Clefairy Dolls or Mysterious Fossil on the bench, do I automatically win or do I have to KO them first?
    You win if you take you or last Prize Card, otherwise the game continues.

  331. If I use Porygon to change an opponent’s weakness to the same thing as its resistance, which do I count first when attacking?
    You calculate Weakness first.

  332. Can you use 4 Vileplume and 4 of the “dark” team rocket Vileplume in the same deck?
    Yup.

  333. If Ditto copies a 100HP Pokémon, gets 50HP Damage, the opponent then retreats the 100HP monster and replaces it with a 30HP Pokémon. Does Ditto die when the 30HP Pokémon goes active?
    Yup.

  334. If you have 4 Charizards and 4 evil Charizards could you play all of them?
    Sure.

  335. Since Double Colorless energy doesn’t count as a basic energy, you can only use 4 of them in a deck, right?
    Correct.

  336. Will there be a Pokémon tour this summer, similar to last years or this year’s current Pokémon Stadium 2000?
    Yup, watch for details on the web site.

  337. If Mr. Mime is confused and try’s to attack it fails dose Mr. Mime kill it self?
    Yes it would.

  338. In regards to ditto, if I have a Venusaur in play, I can energy trans a “grass” energy off of it onto another Pokémon right? But afterwards I can’t move it if it’s not grass energy?
    Right!

  339. When Mew uses it’s Devolution Beam attack on an opponent’s Pokémon, when can that Pokémon re-evlove?
    On that player’s next turn.

  340. In Regards to Ditto, If ditto does sword dance, then Scyther retreated. Then it gets gusted in; does it slash for 60?
    No, since Ditto would have changed into whatever Scyther had swapped with. When it turned back into Scyther, it is a NEW copy and loses the old attack effects.

  341. My brother says only 1 Aerodactyl could be in play at a time…couldn’t as many as 8 (4 on each side) be in play with a Muk somewhere?
    Sure.

  342. Alot of people tell me that when they use Buzzap on Electrode, I don’t get a prize. DO I get a prize or not?
    You don’t get to take a prize when your opponent uses the ‘Buzzap’ power of Electrode. You do draw a prize if your opponent uses the Buzzap power of Electrode.

  343. Can you change a double colorless energy card to any type you wish For example change it to two fire energies.
    No, double colorless provides just what it says: two colorless energy.

  344. How does Blastoise’s Pokémon Power work? Is it just one extra water energy per turn to one Pokémon, or as many water energies from your hand as you want on one Pokémon per turn? Or is it something else all together?
    As many water energy as you want from your hand per turn.

  345. In regards to the Buzzap, it says to “KO Electrode…” on the text. It states in the rulebook that if a Pokémon is KO, they get a prize. And since the Electrode’s power is to knock it out. They should get a prize. Am I right?
    Yes.

  346. Can you change double colorless to any type of energy card?
    Only double colorless.

  347. Since Double Colorless Energy is not counted as a basic energy card . . . can you put down more than one double colorless as well as one energy card per turn?
    No, it will count as your energy placement for that turn.

  348. If I have a Ditto with a dce on it and I also have a Venusaur can I energy trans the dce?
    Yes. Because of Ditto’s power, the DCE can be any type of energy. So you can Energy Trans it.

  349. In regards to an earlier question. Why wouldn’t Aerodactyl’s Pokémon power stop other Fossils from evolving into Aerodactyls?
    I don’t know where you got that idea. Aerodactyl would stop other M.Fossils from evolving into Aerodactyls.

  350. How does the convention 1 of Porygon work? Does retreating take away the affect?
    Yes it does. Or evolving the affected Pokémon also removes the conversion effect.

  351. What are foil mew’s attacks?
    The same as the non-foil Mew.

  352. If you use Smokescreen then retreat the Pokémon that is Smoke screened or if Magmar Retreats is it still in effect?
    Smokescreen references the defending Pokémon, so if you bench that Pokémon the effect ends. If you bench Magmar then Smokescreen is in effect.

  353. Does Defender prevent damage done by a failed attack due to Confusion?
    Yes, but it’s important to note that your wording is slightly incorrect. If an attack fails due to the effects of Confusion than that Pokémon attacks itself with that attack.

  354. If your using a Pokémon that has a resistance to the opponent’s Pokémon would you flip 4 coins to see if you do damage?
    No you wouldn’t

  355. Clefairy vs. Blastoise. Clefairy metronomes Blastoise what determines the amount of damage? The amount of water on Blastoise or Clefairy? Or neither?
    The amount of extra water energy on Clefairy.

  356. If it’s a Hitmonchan with 2 PP’s on it does Invisible Power absorb it? Or does it KO Mr. Mime?
    Invisible Wall will absorb it because you calculate the effects of trainer cards before applying Pokémon Powers from the defending Pokémon.

  357. If you flip HEADS for a agility attack may your opponent use a attack like Hitmonlee’s Stretch Kick or Kangakhan’s Fetch that turn?
    If you’re talking about Rapidash, Agility will prevent any attacks or effects of attacks DONE to Rapidash. So effects to other Pokémon will still happen.

  358. Well, here’s another one. When playing, my opponent placed DCE and then Grass Energy on Scyther for one turn, then attacked with Slash. When I called him on it, he stated that DCE wasn’t a basic energy and could play 2 like that. Which of us is right?
    You are right, the DCE counts as your energy placement for that turn.

  359. Can you put 4 fossil Dragonites and 4 movie promos in your deck?
    You can only have 4 of any particular named card. Since both cards have the name Dragonite, then no, you can’t have 4 of each.

  360. If Kadabra is confused will a failed attack do 20 or 40 damage to him because of weakness?
    A failed attack in this case will do 40 to Kadabra.

  361. Do I have to flip 4 coins to do damage to Mr. Mime?
    No, unless you’re using a Pokémon that you need to flip 4 coins for.

  362. How would the damage on Clefairy count towards hydro pump if it doesn’t read the attack’s costs?
    You would have to count the extra energy on Clefairy above the necessary cost to use Metronome, in order to calculate the final damage done by copying Hydro Pump.

  363. If Ditto is copying a Pokémon whose attacks are dependent on the number of Fire (or Psychic, or Grass, etc.) Energy Cards attached, and Ditto’s attached energies are considered to be all basic energies at once (per last week’s chat), can one choose to limit how many of the energies are considered of a particular type, so as to get a limited effect, or it is treated that all are of that energy type for purposes of that attack? As an example, Ditto’ing Water Gun attacks and other similar effects. I realize this question is a little obtuse, but only because I can’t ask about Ditto’ing TR Zapdos yet, which this question was actually in reference to?
    No, you can’t limit the amount that you choose to use as a specific type. All energy on Ditto counts as all types, all the time.

  364. I’d like to clear this up, if Ditto uses Sword’s Dance, but Scyther retreats next turn, is SD still there? I don’t see why not because effects should only go away when you retreat a Pokémon and you are not retreating Ditto.
    Yes, the effect is still there, but unless the new Pokémon that Ditto copies has a Slash attack, then Ditto will not be able to take advantage of the SD effect.

  365. The TR Dark Charmeleon included in the latest issue of TopDeck has an attack – Fireball – which requires at least one energy card attached to be a Fire Energy Card in order to use it. In last week’s chat, you gave us some of the rulings from R&D on energy, specifically “If a card gives off energy of any type then that card COUNTS as an energy card of that type.” and used the example that a grass-buzzap’d Electrode counts as such and could be moved by Energy Trans. Does this mean then that an appropriate Rainbow Energy or Buzzap’d Electrode is sufficient for powering Dark Charmelon’s attack? And if not, why?
    Uh-huh. Aren’t you glad you typed all that?

  366. 2 weeks ago I had Ditto questions, about Ditto using Charmander’s ember. What was the final ruling on whether or not Ditto has to use FIRE ENERGY CARDS for Charmander’s Ember or Moltres’ Wildfire?
    Any energy on Ditto counts as any energy type, so you could use any energy card attached to Ditto as Fire energy cards.

  367. How does the ruling saying that ditto’s energy can be moved around, say a fire energy, with Venusaur? Especially since Ditto’s power doesn’t change energy types, just how it applies damage.
    Energy on Ditto counts as all energy types.

  368. How many times do you flip to see if a Pokémon wakes up?
    Once at the end of each player’s turn until the Pokémon wakes up.

  369. When Team Rocket comes out, will you be able to use 4 dark Charizards and 4 normal Charizards in your deck?
    Yes, because they have different names.

  370. MT< Guest14 here seems to think that a DCE is a Trainer card that acts as an energy, as opposed to an energy card in it’s own right. Could you clarify that it is not a Trainer Card for him/her? Sure, the Double Colorless Energy (DCE from now on) counts as an energy card just not a ‘basic’ energy card.

  371. Can you have 4 dark Muk and 4 Fossil Muk in a deck?
    Yes, and before everyone asks if this is true for their favorite Pokémon and it’s “Dark” equivalent, let me say that this is true for any Pokémon with different names.

  372. So to Clarify, Clefable with any 3 energy could do the “extra” damage in a hydro pump? They would not have to be water energy?
    Nope! You could use any kind of energy to pay for the metronome attack, THEN energy PAST that would have to be water energy to do the extra Water Pump damage.

  373. After Scyther uses swords dance and is sent back to the bench by GOW etc. If I send him back out will the swords affect still be on?
    Nope, the Swords Dance effect is ended when Scyther is benched.

  374. Can you have 4 Regular Pokémon Like Blastoise and 4 Dark Pokémon like Dark Blastoise in the Same Deck?
    Yes you can since they have different names.

  375. What is Fire type Pokémon 's best type to be with in a deck?
    That would depend on what the player’s in your area are using.

  376. Do you think, after tonight, there should be a rulebook made on Ditto and his attacks? Or is he a simple Pokémon whose attacks are easy to figure out?
    Nope, to be honest Metronome and Ditto cause us confusion as well. We do our best to try and explain them though.

  377. How does using a Clefable/Clefairy’s Metronome on Moltres’ Wildfire work? Because Clefable says to ignore card discarding.
    NO. Metronome says to ignore COSTS required to do the attack. The discarding is an effect that affects the amount of cards discarded (not the same thing). Basically Metronome ignores anything that says " IN ORDER TO". This would not affect the discarding.

  378. If Pidgeotto or Spearow gets attacked by a Self destructing Magnemite and survives could it use it to the next PKMN?
    Sure.

  379. Some players freely examine their own discard pile (or their opponent’s) whenever they want. Is this allowed? Or can a discard pile only be examined when you have official business there (like after playing Item Finder).
    Discard piles are open knowledge (either player could look through them).

  380. So, could I have a Misty’s Psyduck, Sabrina’s Psyduck, and a plain Psyduck in the same deck because they are named differently?
    Yes, that would be a DUCKY deck!

  381. And on the heels of that, what about a Slash attacks with a base damage of something other than 30 (Sandslash, for example)?
    NOPE! Swords Dance says During your next turn, Scyther’s Slash attack’s base damage is 60 instead of 30, SO the Slash attack done after the Swords Dance MUST have a base damage of 30.

  382. If you play Pokémon Flute and bring a Pokémon back to your opponent’s bench, can he evolve it on his next turn? Or does he have to wait until a full turn has passed?
    Yes he could.

  383. About Ditto doing Sword Dance, Would the 60 damage be only done on Scyther’s Slash than the other slashes i.e. Parasect. Cause it says “Scyther’s Slash does 60 instead of 30” so it only works on the slash on Scyther. Not “A Slash attack does 60 instead of 30”.
    Could be done on ANY slashes as long as they do 30-damage base. So if Parasect or Charmeleon were switched up AFTER the Ditto as Scyther did Swords Dance, then on the next turn you COULD use their Slash for 60.

  384. Is there a text errata on Ditto’s power? If so what?
    Nope, it’s all on the cards. If it’s hard to understand or confusing we can help you but there is no errata for Pokémon cards.

  385. When you use Pokémon trader, do you have to trade a basic for a basic, stage 1 for stage 1etc… or can you trade any Pokémon for any stage?
    You can trade for any stage.

  386. Can you use more than one plus power or defender on the same Pokémon on the same turn?
    Yes you can.

  387. Can you use a switch when you are paralyzed?
    Yes, your Pokémon is paralyzed. A switch card is played by the trainer.

  388. You can’t put down a Myst. Fossil and or a Clefairy Doll as a starting Pokémon, right? 2) I don’t know why you’d want to, but you can’t search for a mysterious fossil or Clefairy doll with Pokémon trader, right?
    You COULD put them down as your starting Pokémon as LONG as you have one other basic in your starting hand. And you are correct you can’t use Trader to pull one of them, as they are trainers when they are not in play.

  389. Defender protects against the Pokémon hitting itself right? (Ex. Arcanine Take down with Defender on him will only do 10 to Arcanine right?)
    Correct.

  390. Dark Charmeleon’s Fireball attack states “Use this attack only if there are any fire Energy cards attached to Dark Charmeleon”, does this mean that Clefable cannot Metronome a Fireball attack unless fire energy is attached to Clefable?
    You know, we are going to have to ask R & D on that one.

  391. If Vaporeon is hit with Mew’s devolution beam, and reverts to Eevee, can I then evolve Eevee into Flareon or Jolteon when I get the chance, or am can that Eevee only evolve into Vaporeon again?
    When it is your turn you could choose to have him evolve however you want (within the evolution rules of course).

  392. If Clefable uses its metronome attack on Chansey and uses double edge, does Clefable take the 80 damage?
    Yes (why do you keep asking this same question? I’ve deleted it 6 times already?).

  393. How long does the confusion effect last?
    Until that Pokémon is benched, evolved, removed from play, or the Full Heal trainer card is played on it.

  394. If you use electrodes (base) buzzap for energy does the opponent draw a card?
    Yes they do, it states for Buzzap KNOCK OUT electrode.

  395. I would like to ask a theoretical question, please. Last week it was ruled that Energy attached to Ditto simply counts as all Basic Energy types. Does this mean that if the Pokémon Ditto is copying has an attack that, say, does 10 damage to itself for each Lightning Energy attached to it when you use it, and Ditto uses that attack, that it would take 10 damage for each Energy card attached to it, since it all counts as all types, even though it says you "may treat Energy.” implying you have a choice?
    Correct. You would take the extra damage. R&D has said that you do NOT have a choice as to what the energy counts as, it counts as all basic types.

  396. Can the switch card be used to retreat a paralyzed, confused, or sleeping Pokémon?
    Yes, you can use a switch card to retreat a confused or asleep or paralyzed Pokémon.

  397. Does Magmar’s smokescreen affect when the Defending Pokémon evolves?
    Since Magmar’s Smoke screen attack references the Defending Pokémon, by it evolving, it removes that effect.

  398. Would I get a prize if I knocked out a doll/fossil?
    No, you wouldn’t.

  399. What is your suggestion of a good deck (# of basic, stage 1, stage 2, trainer, and energy.)?
    Hmmm, the making of your deck is a stage in the development of any maturing Pokémon trainer. For me to influence it would be shameless. ‘Sides, it’s more fun for you to learn it with your friends! BUT, I would look at some of the pre-con decks for basic ratio ideas.

  400. Let’s say player one has one prize left and has a Rapidash as active. Player two has a Ditto with 50 damage on it. Ditto KO’s Rapidash but player one has no other Pokémon. Does Ditto turn back into Ditto and get KO’ed or does player two win?
    Well it depends on how many prize cards Player two has left. If he or she only has 1 then they would win when they knocked out the Rapidash. If not, then it depends on whether Player one has any more Pokémon on its bench. Need more info for this question.

  401. Player two has 3 prizes left and player one has no more Pokémon on his/her bench P1’s Rapidash gets KO’d and P2’s Ditto has 50 damage on it. Who wins?
    Player two wins since Player One has his last Pokémon knocked out and doesn’t have anyone on the bench to move up.

  402. In your opinion what is the best type of deck to use against a Haymaker?
    Any deck that can win? A fast Raindance deck is hard to beat could also try the Psychic Barrier deck too.

  403. If a fossil Magmar uses smokescreen against a Charizard does Charizard discard energy before or after flipping a coin?
    Before, you still attempt the attack; the Smokescreen might just stop it from having any effect.

  404. Also regarding Dark Charmeleon’s Fireball attack: If Dark Charmeleon is confused, is the coin flip to see if the Confused Attack is successful done before or after the coin flip to see if the Fire Energy Card is discarded? I would assume before, since it isn’t a “requirement” per se to potentially discard the Energy until after the attack is already underway.
    Correct, you would do its flip AFTER checking the Confusion flip since it is NOT a Requirement of activating the attack.

  405. A week or three ago you gave us the ruling that “Energy attached to Ditto counts as all basic energy types at once.” If your Active Ditto is Ditto’ing a Pokémon with a dual-energy attack (say, an attack that requires 1 water and 1 psychic to power), would 1 Energy Card attached to him be sufficient to use that, since that one card would be providing both water and psychic energy simultaneously? I am assuming not, and guessing that situation would be handled much as the “Rainbow Energy” text is handled.
    Correct again, just like Rainbow energy. Energy attached to Ditto COUNTS as all basic types but only PROVIDES the normal amount of energy. So a basic energy card would provide 1 energy, a DCE would provide 2; a buzzaped Electrode would also provide 2.

  406. At my league we are divided on the question of weather or not plus power would work with Hitmonlee’s stretch kick?
    Yes it would.

  407. Does benching ALWAYS ‘reset’ the Pokémon completely? For instance, if I use Scyther’s swords dance one turn, and then he gets benched and comes back out next turn, how much damage will Slash do? 30 or 60?
    It would do 30; Benching always reset attack effects.

  408. If Ditto was facing a Scyther and had Sword danced, and is now facing a Parasect on the VERY next turn does the swords dance still applied to the slash attack?
    Yes it does. Good question.

  409. With Dodrio retreat costs can be reduced to 0 right?
    Correct.

  410. Does Aerodactyl’s Pokémon power cancel out a Pokémon breeder?
    Correct, you cannot evolve anything (even with a breeder) while Aerodactyl’s Pokémon power is active.

  411. Would the same apply to regular Charizard? Would you only discard after flipping to see if the confusion works or not?
    No, since it states IN ORDER TO on the discard for Charizard. You must attempt the attack BEFORE you flip for Confusion and so must pay its activation costs.

  412. If I do Scyther’s Sword Dance and my Opponent gusts of wind out another Pokémon during their turn, then I make Scyther active again; will his slash do 60?
    Nope, benching you Pokémon ended the Swords Dance effect…

  413. Mr. Mime PP Invisible Wall whenever an attack does 30 or more damage to Mr. Mime, prevents that damage. I had a kid at the league last week tell me that WOTC told him it is 40 and not 30. I said I go by what is on the card. So, until WOTC makes new?
    Sorry but he’s wrong. It’s still 30.

  414. MT on Q62 you said PlusPower would work with Stretch Kick, but the text says if the “Defending Pokémon” takes damage. Stretch Kick hits the Bench. I think you should rethink that answer.
    You are correct! Plus Power DOES state If this Pokémon’s attack does damage to the Defending Pokémon then add 10 so it would NOT help the Stretch Kick.

  415. With Venusaurs energy trans how many energy can you transfer in one turn?
    You are only limited by how much energy you have out (grass energy or energy that counts as grass energy). You must use this Power (as often as you’d like) BEFORE your attack.

  416. Can you play multiple energies if some of them are DCE’s? Example 2 DCE’s and 1 basic.
    You can only play 1 energy per turn (unless you use a trainer card or Pokémon Power or attack to change this rule).

  417. If an opponent was just de-evolved by Mew can they play the card back down on their very next turn? The online rulebook states that “you cannot evolve a Pokémon that you just played or evolved on that turn”.
    He can evolve it again. You devolved it on YOUR turn, not his.

  418. If my active Pokémon is the victim of Victreebel’s Acid attack, may I still use a switch trainer card to switch my active for a benched Pokémon?
    Yes you could. Playing a Trainer card is what the trainer does, Retreating is what the Pokémon does and is affected by the Acid attack.

  419. Is it possible to use swords dance twice and do even more than 60 damage?
    Nope.

  420. Does swords dance add 30 or double the damage?
    It specifically states that during your next turn, Scyther’s Slash attack’s base damage is 60 instead of 30.

  421. If ditto has 40 damage on him, and I use Electabuzz’s thundershock and paralyze him, would ditto be knocked out?
    Yes it would (it would revert to Ditto which only has 50 hp) and would be knocked out.

  422. Exeeggutor “big explosion”, will you flip two coins or one coin if there is a double colorless energy?
    It counts the energy, not the energy cards. That means a DC attached to Exeggutor nets you two flips, not one, for Big Eggsplosion.

  423. On Mew’s attack it says, “Just as if it had evolved”, since it de-evolved then it shouldn’t be able to evolve?
    Nope, you are using the attack against the other player on YOUR Turn. The statement of “just as if it had evolved” has to do with ending attack effects. The other player CAN evolve that Pokémon on their turn.

  424. Because in the rules it says you can only play 1 basic energy and DCE’s don’t count as basic energies so could you not use more then one?
    Actually the rulebook states “take an energy card from your hand and attach it to a Pokémon in play”. It doesn’t say BASIC only.

  425. If I had a Blastoise on my bench, and rain danced onto my Ditto (imitating a Staryu) and then made all the water energy grass energy, could I energy trans it to a waiting Pokémon, resulting in you realizing this scenario is insane?
    Yes you could do that. Who would have Blastoise, Venusar and Ditto in the same deck? And why would the other player EVER let you get them all out?

  426. If you have Kangaskhan out and have 2 double colorless energies attached to him, and Poliwarath does his whirlpool, how do you discard one energy from Kangaskhan?
    Take a double colorless energy off and discard it.

  427. Suppose you have an attack for 30 which is done to a defending Pokémon which is resistant (-30). If you have a Plus Power attached, does your attack do 0 or 10 damage?
    Read Plus Power carefully, it says: If this Pokémon damages the defending Pokémon AFTER applying weakness and resistance then Plus Power adds 10 to that damage. So in this case Plus Power wouldn’t do anything.

  428. Can you play a double colorless and a basic energy in one tern?
    No, you only get to place one energy per turn.

  429. Can you have more then 4-rainbow energies since it changes into a basic energy?
    No, since it’s not a basic energy you can only use 4 in a deck.

  430. Can you use 4 regular Porygon and 4 Cool Porygon in the same deck?
    Yes, that’d be…kewl.

  431. With energy recover can you bring two rainbow energies back to your hand or only basic energy?
    They’re not basic energy, so that would be tough to pull off.

  432. I have a confused Scyther, I am trying to do slash, and I flip a coin and get heads. Is Scyther still Confused?
    Yes, confusion lasts until he is benched, evolved, or a trainer card removes the effect.

  433. Can Ditto use his Pokémon power while its the other players turn?
    In what way? If he switches or retreats his Pokémon, then Ditto will automatically transform into it (if he is active and not asleep, confuse, or paralyzed).

  434. If I try to retreat my Scyther while he is Confused and I am not successful and I use a full heal, can I retreat again?
    Nope. You can only attempt to retreat once if it is paralyzed. If it fails, that Pokémon cannot attempt to retreat again that turn, whether it is still confused or not.

  435. Does Ditto automatically transform when the other player changes his or her Pokémon?
    Yup (again as long as his power still functions).

  436. Does Ditto have to transform when the other player changes Pokémon?
    Yup.

  437. Is there any purpose for the extra line of 10 10 point spots, (100 points) at the bottom of the badge book pages?
    No, just for a chance for you to show you can earn even more.

  438. Can Meowth’s cat punch be used on a benched Pokémon if it would knock it out?
    Yup.

  439. How does Clefable or Ditto copy any attack that requires you to discard a specific energy?
    Each Pokémon handles this differently, if you have specific questions about each, check out the chat logs from the last few weeks. We’ve really worked over this subject.

  440. If Scyther does sword dance, but is put to sleep the next turn, will it still do 60 damage if I wake it up?
    Right before your turn or right after?

  441. What’s your opinion on people using all the same deck hey makers rain dance, etc?
    At this point, there’s been so few tough to beat combos that it doesn’t really surprise me. I think Team Rocket will throw some new deck types into the mix.

  442. After you do sword dance and are put to sleep, will sword dances effect still be their?
    Check out the wording on Scyther. Swords Dance stays in effect for Scyther’s NEXT turn. If he’s asleep during his next turn, then he’ll miss his chance to double the base damage of his Slash attack.

  443. If your Scyther did swords dance one turn then the opponent used gust of wind and put him on the bench would the Scyther the next turn still do 60 damage if you get it as your active Pokémon?
    No, he’d lose the bonus if he’s benched. D’oh!

  444. Are you able to use Devolution Spray on a Pokémon, then evolve onto that Pokémon? I say no, they say Yes, What’s the verdict! (Example: I Use Devolution spray on my Kakana back into a Weedle, Am I able to evolve that weedle back into Kakuna (with the necessary cards) in the same turn?)
    Yes you can. Devolving a Pokémon does not count as evolving a Pokémon.

  445. On Devolution Spray, it says all status effects are removed, “just as if you had evolved it”. I assume this also mean that attack effects (Smokescreen, Agility) are also removed?
    Correct!

  446. Also, regarding Devolution Spray: can you re-evolve a Pokémon on the same turn you de-evolved them with Devolution Spray? As an example, de-evolving Charmeleon to Charmander, then immediately evolving him back up to another Charmeleon or Dark Charmelon?
    Yes you can.

  447. If you CAN immediately use Devolution Spray (if the answer to my last question was you can’t, just ignore this question), does that interrupt the normal flow of evolution? For example, on your turn can you evolve up from X to Y, use Y’s Pokémon Power?
    Sure, you can do any of these things on your turn before the attack (make sure you follow the particular Pokémon power’s specifics though).

  448. I play a Squirtle. opp. plays a mew. I play a breeder and a Blastoise. opp used devolution beam. What happens to my breeder card?
    The Breeder is a trainer card. After you play it, you discard it. It doesn’t sit on the Pokémon.

  449. You recently ruled that if Confused, the coin flip to see if the Confused Moltres can attack successfully would come before discarding the Energy Cards as an effect of the Wildfire attack. Am I correct in assuming the same sequence would be involved?
    Umm, what is the rest of the question?

  450. If your undamaged Ditto is facing a Mysterious Fossil, and the opponent is stalling, the only way you can break the deadlock (assuming you have no Switch or Scoop Up) is by discarding Ditto, and that will award the opponent a free prize?
    You could discard the Ditto BUT discarding is NOT the same as knocking out, no prize given.

  451. You recently ruled that if Confused, the coin flip to see if the Confused Moltres can attack successfully would come before discarding the Energy Cards as an effect of the Wildfire attack. Am I correct in assuming the same sequence would be involved for a Smokescreened Moltres, and other similar effects that might be on him?
    Correct! Kori, you do make us think here.

  452. Suppose I use Venomoth’s shift to shift into some color other than green (let’s say Blue), and it gets confused, does it go back to being green or stays blue?
    It stays as the last changed type but you can’t use it again while it is confused.

  453. What exactly does the Porygon Card do in the Game? It doesn’t have any attacks.
    You can use it in combination with other Pokémon.

  454. Hmm. Regards to the Devolution spray question. I tried it out in my TCG GB and it doesn’t work. I’m not saying that Devolution spray counts as the Pokémon being evolved. But rules states that a Pokémon has to be in play for at least a full turn in order to be evolved. And since De-evolving it is turned into a different Pokémon name. That Pokémon needs to wait a turn to evolve it since it’s not the same Pokémon before you used the Trainer Card. I hope everyone would agree on this but Am I r
    There intent is clear, even though that Pokémon has a new name (an earlier evolution) it is still the SAME Pokémon. So, you CAN evolve a Pokémon that you just devolved.

  455. In the Dark Charmeleon (in English) card, Fireball says “Only use this card if there are R energy cards attached to it” Isn’t that a bit redundant?
    Ok, that card did come out in Top Deck so I can talk about it. That wording is there to specifically interfere with someone Metronoming it. This defeats the Metronomes ignore attack requirements. If you Metronomed this attack, you would STILL have to have Fire energy on the Clefable/Clefairy in order to use that attack.

  456. Does Ditto copy Pokémon Powers that reference “when this card is knocked out” or not?
    Sure it does.

  457. Fair enough on the Ditto Dark Gyarados Question. How about this the: when Ditto is knocked out and is returned to the Discard pile, does he revert to boring old Ditto when he hits it, or does he hit it as Ditto-as-whatever-card-he-was-copying? If I am wording that comprehensively.
    He hits it as Ditto.

  458. If I have a Ditto-Blastoise, can I rain dance grass energy on to Ditto? A Lapras? This is assuming Transform is in effect, of course.
    Nope, RainDance says specifically only water energy from your hand. Ditto’s energy effect is only on energy attached to Ditto.

  459. Say I use Venomoth’s shift to change its type to psychic. Can I change it back to grass if the only other types of Pokémon are psychic and electric?
    You can use Venomoth’s Power once per turn before you attack (as long as it isn’t Paralyzed, Asleep, or Confused).

  460. What’s the point of Devolution?
    Devolving a Pokémon in play will remove any effects that the Pokémon is suffering from, like Poison.

  461. Will Aerodactyl receive any confusion damage?
    Yes, if he’s confused and fails an attack. Of course Aerodactyl is resistant to fighting, so the damage will be prevented.

  462. Can you play Devolution Spray on a basic Pokémon? The reason I ask this be because it says “Choose a Pokémon in play and a stage of evolution.” Then it says to discard all cards of that stage or higher attached to that Pokémon. So if I had a Basic Pokémon down I could choose Stage 1 and the basic doesn’t have any attached to it so I wouldn’t have to discard any right? Same for Stage 1 I could choose stage 2.
    For Devolution spray you can’t choose a stage in play.

  463. Does Mew’s Devolution beam bales you to choose any Pokémon?
    Any evolved Pokémon in play.

  464. Can I retreat more than one time per term? For example, can I retreat Spearow and put in out again?
