    I can’t see a reason why you couldn’t.

  465. Situation: My Jigglypuff does lullaby and the opponent flips at the beginning of his turn…fails… flips at the end and is successful…my turn now, right? It’s my turn to attack, right?
    That’s right. Sing another Lullaby.

  466. Need to make sure, does Ditto UTALIZE and USE Pokémon Powers that say, “when this card is knocked out” so that you would do the effects of the Power or not?
    You mean like Machamp’s Strikes Back? Then yes. (I reserve the right to be overruled by R&D)

  467. How long does Porygons attacks last?
    Just while the converted Pokémon is the Active Pokémon. Remember that anything other than damage that was the result of a Pokémon attack goes away if the affected Pokémon goes to the bench.

  468. Since Pokémon, need to wait until the end of their turn, in order to evolve, You can’t be able to use Devolution spray and evolve that Pokémon on the same turn since when you de-evolve it, it becomes a new Pokémon and it needs to wait until the end of your turn in order to evolve.
    Where did you get that Pokémon can’t evolve until the end of their turn? That’s not true.

  469. When Ditto uses Double Colorless energy against Moltres and uses wildfire each DCE discards one card, correct?
    I would say yes, but I’ll double check on this one for next week.

  470. Can mysterious fossil be a basic for any Stage 1?
    No, only the Stage 1’s that evolve from Mysterious Fossil

  471. For Mew’s Psywave, or Mewtwo’s Psychic, does a DCE count as 1 energy card, or 2?
    Only one energy CARD, but two energy.

  472. Also, If a Clefable metronomes a Mewtwo, will Barrier work?
    Yes

  473. If a Clefable metronomes Arcanine’s Takedown, Does Clefable do 30 damage to itself?
    Yup!

  474. If Raticate has a PlusPower on it, Does Duper Fang do half of the Defending Pokémon’s HP plus 10?
    Well, SUPER Fang would, yes.

  475. If I evolve a Pokémon this term does it take away the effect of Rhyhorn’s Leer?
    Yup.

  476. If you attach a Defender to Chansey, and then Alakazam Damage Swaps 20 damage to it, does it do no damage?
    Damage Swap moves COUNTERS; it does not count as causing Damage.

  477. If I agility, and flip heads, can Moltres use wildfire?
    Yes he can, that doesn’t affect Rapidash.

  478. If Ditto Transforms to a Lapras, then by some twist of fate gets 70 damage on it, then KO’s Lapras, and the only Pokémon on his bench is a Blastoise, does Ditto stay alive, or does it go to the discard pile?
    He would still be fine; he would transform into Blastoise, which has 100 HP.

  479. Let’s say I use Porygon’s convention 2 attack to change its resistance to fighting. And when my opponent attack with a fighting Pokémon, do I apply the resistance first or the weakness first?
    Weakness is always applied first.

  480. If Ditto KOs the Active, There is no active, so it is now a Ditto, right?
    No, it would then Transform into whatever the other player’s next active Pokémon is. If he doesn’t have one (any on the bench) the game is over and you win.

  481. Could Blastoise Raindance Rainbow Energy onto a Venusaur or Charizard?
    Rainbow Energy is from Rocket, so no rulings yet gang.

  482. So I put down a Mysterious Fossil and I am not allowed to evolve it until my next turn, correct?
    Correct.

  483. I have a question. Let’s say a Charmander is battling a Bulbasaur. If Charmander uses scratch does that do 20 damage? Or is it 10 damage since the energy needed is colorless?
    It does 20. It’s the type of Pokémon that affects Weakness and Resistance, NOT the type of energy that the attack uses.

  484. If your active Pokémon is asleep, do you have to flip at the end of each turn, or can you stay asleep if you wish?
    You have to flip.

  485. If you don’t want to attack, can you choose not to?
    Yes, you don’t have to attack.

  486. Does Venomoth’s power work even though that specific type you want to change into isn’t in play?
    Nope. Has to be a type that is in play.

  487. This is in regard to my earlier question. If I use Venomoth’s “Shift” to change it to psychic, can I change it back to grass (on my next turn) if the only other types of Pokémon are psychic and electric?
    No you can’t. Since there are no other grass Pokémon, you couldn’t choose that type.

  488. On the dark Charmeleon pre-release, isn’t the line about the Fire Energy really another requirement? I mean if you don’t have any Fire energy you can’t attack. Sounds like a requirement to me!
    Nope, it’s not a requirement, it is a condition. Requirements always have “IN ORDER TO” in their text.

  489. If Porygon changed Arkanines weakness to fire would it hit it self-30 or 60, gameboy tcg it hits 30 but thats not important.
    It would take 60 due to the weakness to fire. The gameboy TCG has some errors in it.

  490. Nidokings poison says it does 20 points, is that on each time of poison damage or just the first?
    Each time.

  491. Can you evolve evil Pokémon from normal ones?
    There are no Dark basic Pokémon so they all start there. If you evolve a basic into a Dark Pokémon though, then it is now Dark. You can’t evolve it into a 2nd stage non-dark. Once a Pokémon steps onto the Dark side, forever will it rule it steps? Or, something likes that.

  492. It stays dark unless you devolve back to its basic, right?
    Correct.

  493. If you evolve a basic into a dark then use a devolution spray, are you aloud to evole it into a normal?
    Sure.

  494. How can you devolve a Pokémon?
    Play the Devolution Sprat Trainer card on it. Or use Mew’s Devolution Beam attack.

  495. On my Dark Alakazam, it says that it evolves from Dark Kadabra. I wanted to know if Dark Alakazam could evolve from a regular Kadabra.
    Nope it cannot. The evolution rule for the Dark Pokémon is as follows: Since there are no Dark Basic Pokémon, you always start with a non-dark basic. Then you can choose to evolve it to a dark or non-Dark stage 1.
    Once it chooses to be dark or non-dark, it can only evolve to the stage 2 version of the same type So Dark Kadabra can only evolve into Dark Alakazam.

  496. Can movie promo Pikachu use Recharge to get a Rainbow Energy from the deck, or does it have to be a basic Electric Energy card? (If Rainbow Energy is OK, I assume it does not cause damage, since it is not played from the hand?)
    That would not work. Rainbow Energy only counts as all-basic energy types WHILE IN PLAY. This is not the case when it is in the deck.

  497. TR was Misprint City!! anyway Does Grimer’s Poison Gas actually makes the Pokémon fall asleep, or was it a misprint that it supports to make it poisoned…
    Grimer’s Poison Gas should result in poisoning the defending Pokémon, but as you know our TR version was misprinted and so it will only put them to sleep. Play this card as written.

  498. Will Aerodactyl (resistance to fighting) do confusion damage to itself?
    Nope, it has resistance to fighting.

  499. Dark Gloom is on my bench, the defender is Haunter, and I use Gloom’s Pokémon power and flip heads. Must I flip again due to Haunter’s transparency? Or is that unnecessary, since a Pokémon power is not the same as an attack, even if it does damage?
    You would NOT have to flip for Transparency. It has you flip for ATTACKS against it, not Pokémon Powers.

  500. Suppose Ditto is poisoned, then Snorlax becomes active opposite Ditto. Does Ditto’s poison cease? It says Snorlax cannot BECOME poisoned, but what if Ditto (as Snorlax) is already poisoned?
    The poisoning does NOT cease. Snorlax’s Power says it can’t BECOME poisoned but in this case, the Ditto as Snorlax already IS.

  501. Dark Primape is confused, tries to attack, and the attack fails. Does it do 50 damage to himself, or 20 damage to himself and 30 damage to the defending Pokémon?
    It does 50 to itself (OUCH!).

  502. Can TR Charmander’s Pokémon power be used to move a Rainbow Energy to TR Charmander?
    Yes you can.

  503. If opponent’s Ditto has 40 damage, on my turn if I retreat my active for an Abra with 30HP then immediately retreat the Abra for a Scyther, was Ditto knocked out at the moment it became an Abra?
    Yes it was.

  504. If MP Mewtwo attacks with Energy Absorption, and one of the cards attached from the discard pile is Rainbow Energy, that energy does not do any damage to Mewtwo (since the card was not played from the hand) but can still be consider psychic energy?
    Correct! That would work! Good question.

  505. If an opponent already has Nidoking’s Toxic double-poison, then next turn I use a “normal-poison” attack, does the opponent retain Toxic’s double-poison condition (20) or does it now become a single-poison condition (10)?
    It would gain a single poison effect (the new effect replaces the old one).

  506. If I use a Dark Vileplume with the error, what would it’s weakness be considered?
    As is on the card, Fighting.

  507. Clarification for Dark Hypno, the damage calculated by its Bench Manipulation attack is applied to the *defending* Pokémon, not to the benched Pokémon, right?
    Nope! Wrong! It’s as is, the number of Pokémon on his bench…
    Dark Hypno states the Your opponent flips a number of coins equal to the number of benched Pokémon he has in play. For each tails the attack does 20 damage to him.

  508. For Dark Charmeleon, would 3 Rainbow Energy and/or 2 “Buzzapped Fire Electrodes” satisfy the requirement of having “any fire Energy cards attached”?
    Yes they would (they both count as fire energy cards).

  509. If Jungle Primeape is already Confused, then attempts to do Tantrum and succeeds (confusion flipped heads), then the flip called for by the Tantrum attack is heads, is he still confused or not?
    He is still confused.

  510. On Alakazam’s Pokémon power, can you move as many as you want?
    You may move 1 damage counter, but you can use this power as many times as you want before your attack. You can move as many as you want before your attack, but you have to move them one at a time.

  511. What does dark Magneton’s magnetic lines attack do if your opponent has no benched Pokémon? Do you discard the energy card?
    Nope, you don’t do anything with it.

  512. Can you evolve dark Wartortle in dark Blastoise?
    Yup.

  513. Can Devolution Spray be played on a Basic Pokémon? It says to choose a Pokémon in play and a Stage of Evolution so I could choose a Basic Pokémon and choose Stage 1, then I wouldn’t have to discard any cards off of it and it would be healed of any status effects. Am I correct in assuming this?
    Nope, the assumption is that you are picking a stage of evolution that is in play.

  514. Am I correct in assuming that Dark Primeape’s Frenzy Pokémon Power (which adds +30 to all attacks when Confused) also applies to damage taken from a failed Confusion flip to attack? In other words, if a Confused Dark Primeape flips tails on an attack attempt, it ends up attacking itself for 20+30=50 damage.
    Correct (we are checking R&D on you previous questions Kori).

  515. In the game I have a choice of weaknesses with dark Vileplume: With the holo it’s grass; non-holo=fire, correct?
    No, the holo has Fire for Weakness, the non-holo has Fighting.

  516. Regarding why you do get a prize for KOing Ditto when he is copying a Clefairy Doll, you said “When a Pokémon hits the discard pile it reverts back to its normal type BEFORE you count it as a knocked out Pokémon or not.” So would this mean if Ditto is copying a Dark Gyarados and is KO’d, he would NOT use the copied Final Beam Pokémon Power because he would revert back to Ditto BEFORE being counted as a Knocked Out Pokémon (which is when Final Beam would kick in)?
    Okay, got the official answer. Ditto copying Dark Gyarados WOULD still check to see if it gets its final beam off. The official rule is that when a Pokémon gets Knocked out, you check for powers and other effects. Then the Ditto would revert to itself WHEN it hits the discard pile. And a prize card would be given. I know this is somewhat confusing. The ruling though is that when Ditto copies a Clefairy Doll or Mysterious Fossil and is knocked out, the other player still gets a prize card.

  517. Also regarding Ditto copying a Dark Gyarados – assuming that the KO’d Ditto CAN use Final Beam (if it can’t, please ignore this question :->), am I correct in assuming that it would do 20 damage for each Energy card of ANY type attached to Ditto, since all Energy Cards attached to Ditto are considered to be all types (including Water) simultaneously?
    Correct.

  518. Since Rainbow Energy counts as all types simultaneously when attached, am I correct in assuming that Rainbow Energy would also counts as Water towards calculating the damage done by Gyarados’ Final Beam?
    Correct.

  519. Dark Dragonite’s Pokémon Power does not have the “you cannot use this Power if your bench is already full” text like most other Bench-building powers and attacks do. Does this mean that by using Dark Dragonite you can bypass the normal five-Pokémon limit to your bench?
    C’mon. That’s silly. There isn’t room to put the reminder text on every single card. The rule is the bench can only have 5 max (EVER).

  520. If I have a Squritle on the bench and I Computer Search and then take a Pokémon Breeder and use a Professor Oak Than use a different Computer Search and take Item Finderand use Item Finder to take a Breeder can I use the breeder?
    Yes, trying to make an easy question harder are we? Hmm?

  521. On Rainbow Energy, it states “Doesn’t count as a basic Energy Card when not in play.” I assume from that statement then that it DOES count as a Basic Energy Card while in play?
    Correct.

  522. In the rules it states that when a Pokémon evolves it becomes free of Poison, Sleep, Confusion, Paralysis, or anything else that may be the result of an attack. Does this mean that damage is also taken off of it when it evolves?
    No.

  523. Earlier you had ruled that a Buzzap’d Electrode can only choose to provide the six basic energy forms. With Team Rocket’s addition of Rainbow, Full Heal and Potion Energy, has that list been expanded? And if so, how does Electrode handle abilities of special energy cards?
    When you choose a TYPE it can only be of the 6 basic forms (fire, water, etc). You cannot choose the special energies.

  524. On the Team Rocket Zubat, under it’s Sneak Attack Pokémon Power; it finishes with "Apply Weakness and Resistance.” but without a space between it and the preceding sentence. Since no other description so far has bothered to remind us to apply those, was this a misprint that was actually supposed to say, “Don’t apply Weakness or Resistance”?
    We miss a space and it changes the ruling? Geez you guys are a tough crowd. Nope. Play it as written. And you meant Dark Golbat not Zubat, correct? (Zap!)

  525. Does Ditto copy status or attack effects of a Pokémon? For example, if Ditto went up against a Pokémon that had been previously Converted by Porygon, would he copy the original stats or the Converted stats? What about copying a Shifted Venomoth?
    Ditto always copies the original. It does not copy any effects on the defending Pokémon (like Poison, or Shift or any of those).

  526. How does (TR)Porygon’s Conversion 1 attack? Does the attack last even after Porygon is retreated? If not, then what is the point of the attack?
    Yes it does. If the defending Pokémon retreats or evolves it would lose the effect but you can retreat Porygon and bring up a Pokémon that has attacks that are the same as the changed Weakness (that is the point of Porygon).

  527. I assume that if Dark Vileplume is active, Mysterious Fossil cannot be played?
    Correct.

  528. On Snorlax’s Pokémon power? If he can’t be put to sleep and all that stuff, then why does it say the power doesn’t work if he’s ALREADY asleep and stuff?
    There are ways to stop a Pokémon power (like Goop Gas attack). If Snorlax is put Asleep or Confused while his power is inactive., it would NOT come back on while that effect was still in place.

  529. How many Rainbow Energy cards can you have in your deck and how about the other TR Energy card?
    Four of any non-basic energy allowed per deck.

  530. If trying to evolve into, for instance, Dark Charizard, would you need to have a Dark Charmeleon out to evolve from?
    Yes, exactly.

  531. When you use Dark Hypno’s Bench Manipulation attack, the text is unclear as to whether the damage goes onto the benched Pokémon or if the damage goes onto the defending Pokémon. It says “this attack does 20x the # of tails” but to whom?
    Just the defending Pokémon, that’s all.

  532. If you have a Snorlax as your active Pokémon and use the Pokémon power of Drowzee (Rocket), would Snorlax’s Pokémon power resist Drowzee’s or would he become asleep?
    Snoralax’s Thick Skin Pokémon Power would resist it.

  533. What would happen if used Porygons conversion 1 attack and change a Pokémon weakness to the same as the Pokémon resistance
    You always calculate Weakness before Resistance. So you would double the damage (if it was of the appropriate type) and then subtract 30.

  534. If your Pokémon is confused and you failed to retreat it, can you still attack? (If you still have the energy to do it)
    Sure.

  535. What will the official ruling on Dark Vileplume’s weakness be?
    Play Dark Vileplume as it reads.

  536. So ‘effected’ Pokémon can retreat to become ‘cured’. And if the Pokémon that affected the Pokémon retreats, there is no curing of effect. For example, I changed Jigglypuff’s weakness to psychic with TR Porygon and I can retreat Porygon with the weak?
    It depends on the particular attack and whom it references. For example if it only mentions the defending Pokémon, then benching or evolving that one amends the effect.

  537. If it references the active AND the defending Pokémon, then benching or evolving either would end the effect.
    It all depends on who is mentioned in the text.

  538. If you use fossil Magmar’s smoke screen and your opponent retreats its Pokémon. Is the effect of the attack still on or is it canceled?
    It is ended (it is referencing the defending Pokémon).

  539. What happens when you Metronome Selfdestruct? Do you take the damage?
    Yes, you’ll still take the damage, if that’s what you meant.

  540. Regarding Dark Dragonite’s Summon Minions, if your bench is full (or only one slot left) can you keep the two cards in your hand or are you not allowed to use the power at all?
    No, you can only take one Pokémon from your deck in that case.

  541. I’ve heard Dark Vileplume has a Pokémon Power called Hayfever. What does it do?
    When that Pokémon is NOT Confused, Asleep, or Paralyzed and it is in play, NO Trainer cards can be played.

  542. Would pokedex, Here comes Team Rocket, and TR Rattata Pokémon power: Trickery be a good combo?
    Sure, also try Mankey from Jungle.

  543. On the trainer card challenge can you play a mysterious fossil or Clefairy doll?
    No you can’t. Those are Trainer Cards while they are still in the deck. You can only pull basic Pokémon from the deck with Challenge.

  544. Is it possible to knock out more than one of your opponent’s Pokémon at the same time?
    Sure!

  545. If you use the trainer, Here Comes Team Rocket, then you use the TR Ratatta’s Pokémon Power, would you switch your prize, then the top card of your deck would be face up or facedown?
    Does it matter? Your opponent will know what you’re putting there anyway? For the record though, put the Trainer face down on top of your deck.

  546. What if you play A Mulligan Mewtwo deck and all your Pokémon are in your prizes. What will happen?
    Well first of all, that is a lousy deck design, take the fun out of the game. You would keep reshuffling, never drawing a basic Pokémon, your opponent would stop taking extra cards, the game would never start, and people would boo you. If it was a tournament, you would get a delay of game penalty.

  547. If you Metranome on Moltras how many energy cards can you discard?
    As many fire energy cards as you have attached to Clefable/Clefairy.

  548. If you have an Alakazam move 30 damage from a Chansey to a Mr. Mime with its Pokémon Power on, does it put the damage on it, does it not take the damage? Or does it still?
    Ok, Alakazam can only move 1 damage counter at a time so Mr. Mime’s Power wouldn’t kick in. Secondly you are moving damage counters, NOT attack damage so again no effect.

  549. I was wondering what Venusaur you would recommend using in play? The Base set one or the Promo.
    That would be up to you, I think the base set Venusaur’s Energy Trans Power is more useful though.

  550. If you have a Clefairy Doll or Mysterious Fossil in hand, can you mulligan? Or are you forced to play it because it counts as a basic Pokémon.
    You can mulligan because it doesn’t count as a Basic Pokémon when it’s in your hand.

  551. If I use Mewtwos absorb and pull a rainbow energy do I damage my self
    No you damage Mewtwo.

  552. Earlier I asked about the Trainer: Challenge, what I meant was the Trainer CARD Challenge in the TR set.
    If you and your opponent both have space left on your benches, then Challenge! loads your benches. If your benches are full, then it’s baically another Bill card. You can’t have too many Bill’s, can you?

  553. Can you evolve a “Dark” card from a non-team rocket basic card; also could you evolve a base 1 Charmeleon into a dark Charizard or a Dark Charmeleon into a base 1 Charizard?
    All Pokémon start as basic, so you can go from Base 1 Charmander to Dark Charmeleon. You cannot go from Base 1 Charmeleon to Dark Charizard though. Once you start evolving a ‘Dark’ Pokémon you have to keep going that way.

  554. About that previous ruling on the Mewtwo mulligan deck… If you’re playing by the rules, wouldn’t you draw your hand and resolve mulligans before you lay your prizes out? and then how could the Mewtwo’s get into the prizes so you don’t draw a basic?
    Correct. Some players jump ahead and lay prizes BEFORE the y look at their hands (which as you mentioned is incorrect ) . Sorry gang, had to take a long AD&D call.

  555. You play with a raindance deck right? What team rocket cards have u added and why? I’m a fellow raindance player
    I play with a Here comes Team Rocket and a TR Rattatta to unlock my prizes. I also play with 2 Nightly Garbage Runs to bring cards back from the discard pile so I can oak again if need be.

  556. Is it possible to put 4 kadabras and 4 dark kadabras in the same deck?
    Yes it is, they have different names.

  557. Why does Nightly Garbage Run say 3 basic Pokémon, evolutions, or basic energy when it should say up to a total of?
    You take back 3 cards total, you can choose form basic energy or evolutions, or basic Pokémon.

  558. If Rainbow Energy acts as any Basic Energy Card, how many can you put in your deck?
    4 it is NOT a basic energy, only counts as one when in play.

  559. Can electrode be buzzapped into 2 Rainbow energy or Potion Energy?
    Nope, only basic energy.

  560. Can you have multiple Dark Muks so you have 2 colorless retreat cost on your opponent per Dark Muk?
    Sure! Each one adds 2 colorless to the retreat cost for the defending player.

  561. Ditto is active, and the opposing PKMN is Dark Arbok. Ditto has 40 damage on it. Dark Arbok does stare on Ditto. Is Ditto (now with 50 damage) knocked out because it’s PKMN Power stops working, or is it not because it’s still Dittoing Dark Arbok, a
    Correct, Ditto would revert to Ditto and 50 damage would knock him out.

  562. Dark Gyarados is active, and Dark Arbok is the opposing PKMN. Dark Gyarados has 60 damage and Dark Arbok uses Stare on it. Does Dark Gyarados still do Final Beam?
    No it would not; the Stare attack stops the defending Pokémon’s Power from working, so it would stop the Final Beam from working.

  563. Can Clefable copy dark Charizards continuous fireball?
    Yes. You’ll have to flip coins equal to the number of fire energy cards attached to Clefairy if you copy it though.

  564. Will Dark Vileplume still be able to use its weakness to fire?
    If you’re playing in a tournament, you’ll use the weakness of the Dark Vileplume that you have in play. Having two weaknesses to choose from when building your deck could be helpful depending on what decks you’re likely to face.

  565. On the ruling on Ditto/Myst. Fossil, when Electrode is Buzzap’d it is KO’d. But when Kabuto is KO’d the opponent gets a prize. The basics (Mist. Fossil is a trainer!) Are different, so could you clarify that a little better?
    I don’t understand this question. When you buzzap and Electrode the opponent also gets a prize. When Ditto is copying a Mysterious Fossil it reverts to Ditto when it is knocked out and so the opponent gets a prize. It is a Pokémon copying a trainer card that acts like a basic Pokémon. Make sense?

  566. I meant when Kabuto is KO’d, your opponent gets a prize, and it’s basic is a Trainer when it hits the discard pile. That shouldn’t count as a KO when a Buzzap’d Electrode counts as a KO. (Continues on next question or later)
    Ok, I get what you are saying but don’t try and use logic for this sort of thing. It doesn’t matter if a card actually hits the discard pile or not. Ditto is a Pokémon that is only COPYING a trainer card that acts like a Pokémon. When Ditto is knocked out, IT DOESN’T matter what he was.

  567. NO! Dark Muks have to be active! You can’t have multiple at 1 time!
    Correct, I made an error.

  568. Smokescreen: does it stay in effect even if Magmar is gusted back on the next player’s turn, as long as?
    Since Smokescreen references the Defending Pokémon, only benching or evolving that Pokémon will end its effect.

  569. Also with TR Magikarp. If I have a Ditto against it, with a Gyarados in my deck, could I use Waterfall Evolution to evolve Ditto into a Gyarados?
    We will check on this but Ditto says that it cannot evolve, period. The Magikarp ruling just lets you use that attack to ignore the Aerodactyl Pokémon Power. It still has the effect of evolving.

  570. If an Alakazam uses Teleport Blast and goes on the bench, while knocking out the opponents Active Dark Gyarados, do you use Dark Gyarados’ power on Dark Alakazam or your new active Pokémon?
    Damage is done BEFORE you switch Dark Alakazam back to the bench. So you would resolve the Knock Out effects BEFORE you Bench the Dark Alakazam.

  571. Normally Ditto can’t evolve on his own (for example, he’s copying a Charmander and you wish to play a Charmeleon in your hand onto him). However, TR Magikarp’s Rapid Evolution bypasses the rules of normal Evolution rules (since it isn’t affected by Aerodactyl and can “evolve” Magickarp the same turn it was played). Therefore, could then a Ditto copying TR Magikarp use Rapid Evolution to evolve himself into a Gyarados since Rapid Evolution overrides normal rules for evolution? Similarly, what about Metronoming Rapid Evolution?
    Nope. We explained this already (though we will check R&D for you to verify). Rapid Evolution still counts as evolving as in it has the same effects as. Since you are NOT playing a card from your hand this is not the Standard Evolution step so this is why it ignores the Aerodactyl power. It still COUNTS for the purposes of Ditto’s not being able to evolve, period. No matter how the evolution is done, Ditto CANNOT evolve, period.

  572. Is Dark Dugtrio’s Pitfall Pokémon Power cumulative in any way? For example, you have 2 Dark Dugtrios in play – does a retreating Defending Pokémon have to flip twice (once per each Dark Dugtrio in play) and suffer 20 damage per tails, or does it flip once and risk 40 damage (20 per Dark Dugtrio)? Or are it just one flip and 20 damage regardless of how many Dark Dugtrios you have in play? And if does involve multiple coin flips, do you stop after the retreating Pokémonfirst takes damage, or continue flipping for each Dark Dugtrio in question?
    They are cumulative. You would flip for each Dugtrio’s effect, whether any succeed or not.

  573. Can Spearow’s mirror move poison the opponent if (let’s say) the final result of the last attack was 30 damage and poison?
    Yup! It would do 30 damage and Poison.

  574. Concerning the refusal to issue errata for Pokémon: I would simply like to suggest a few things. 1) Errata would be much easier for players to understand than, say, the various Ditto rulings. Yet they’re already expected to know the latter. 2) The policy against fixing the errors doesn’t seem to make sense in this case since WotC doesn’t own the game, simply translates. The translations should be accurate. 3) Errata only effects DCI sanctioned tournaments when you get right down to it. Fixing the cards won’t hurt casual players. Not fixing them hurts serious tourney going players, however. 4) There’s no way the errata list would ever be more than a page. 5) A lot of us would sure appreciate that erratum.
    Ok, first please keep in mind that no matter how much some players may wish otherwise, Pokémon has a core younger audience. You cannot have the same expectations for the sophistication of the average player as you can with Magic or other more mature games. Most younger players play the cards as read. They do not even know what erratum is? We are aware that some of the misprints can be somewhat confusing but it will be even harder with errata for the average player. Nothing is written in stone so things may change as the sophistication changes. BUT, thank you for your comments.

  575. Okay, thanks for the ruling on Ditto and Rapid Evolution. However, what about Metronoming the attack? What would happen? Anything?
    That won’t work either. Gyarados and Drak Gyarados must be placed on Magickarp only, not a Clefairy/Clefable.

  576. Will benching a Pokémon end Agility’s effects?
    Only benching the attacking Pokémon since Agility only references it (like Rapidash).

  577. If you have two Dodrio’s on your bench, and a Clefable out active, will Clefable retreat for free?
    Yes.

  578. How much damage would Dark Weezing take if Clefable/Clefairy metronome’s the attack?
    20 damage for each Weezing, Koffing, and Dark Weezing in play, as usual.

  579. How do you use the Trainer card “Challenge” and the Rainbow Energy Card? I don’t get how to use them.
    Ok for Challenge, you ask the other player if he accepts the Challenge or not. If he says no, then you draw 2 cards and it’s done. If he says yes, you both can search through your deck and pull out basic Pokémon and put them on your bench (remember the bench can only have 5 maximum Pokémon on it). For Rainbow Energy, when you attach this energy to a Pokémon (from your hand), that Pokémon takes 10 points of damage. The Rainbow Energy now counts as all basic Energy types at the same time (grass, fire, water, psychic, lightning, and fighting).

  580. If you use plus powers on an Electabuzz, will it increase the damage it does to itself?
    No, because Plus Power only increases damage done to the defending Pokémon.

  581. Here’s a Haunter question. Say Chansey double edges my active Fossil Haunter. I flip heads. Does Chansey still do 80 damage to himself?
    Yes it does, Transparency only prevents effects of attacks done to Haunter only.

  582. Dark Weezing’s Mass explosion says it does 20 damage x the # of Koffing, Weezing, dark Weezing in play, then each Koffing Weezing and dark Weezing take 20 damage, so wouldn’t that mean Metronoming the attack would do 40 damage to dark Weezing?
    If there was only the one Dark Weezing and no other ones or Weezings or Koffings out in play anywhere, then yes, it would do 40 to the other Dark Weezing.

  583. Dk Blastoise’s HydroCannon says for extra-energy damage, “You can’t add more than 40 damage in this way”. I presume that means BEFORE applying weakness & resistance, right? If so, when fully pumped with 4W it’ll do a whopping 140 to most fire types.
    Correct!

  584. Re: “TR Magikarp” earlier: So although Aerodactyl’s PkmnPower says “no more Evolution cards can be played”, what you are telling us is that it really means “they cant be played FROM YOUR HAND” rather than “they cant be played AT ALL”. I dunno.
    Correct again! That is the ruling the R&D gave us.

  585. I play a 3 dark Blastoise and 1 base set Blastoise in my deck. Is this smart?(keep in mind dark Blastoise can do 70 damage with 4 energy)
    If it works for you, then go for it. I play 3 Blastoise and 1 Dark Blastoise so I can use Raindance more often.

  586. Well, since it seems to be a bit of a lull, I think I may have missed the answer to this one earlier: If a Dark Arbok uses Stare to KO a Dark Gyarados, does Final Beam kick in, or not (because of Stare’s Power-canceling aspect)? Answer? No it does not, Stare stops Pokémon Powers from working for the next turn. The Final Beam is canceled.

  587. Can I have an English dark Blastoise on the side while having a water energy with dark Blastoise written on it in my deck and play it in a tournament?
    No, you’ll have to use the Dark Blastoise.

  588. Similarly, what happens if a Dark Arbok Stares at a Kabuto? Will Kabuto Armor kick in?
    Pokémon powers will be applied before any effects of attacks are applied, so in this case, Kabuto’s Armor will kick in.

  589. And, since I’m looking through my folder, thinking about questions to ask, what about staring at a Fossil Haunter? Would Transparency kick in?
    I’m going to say yes based on my previous answer. However, I know you’ll all want an official answer so we’ll check on this with R&D.

  590. Will you be able to use Blastoise’s Pokémon Power: Rain Dance with Rainbow Energy if you change it to Water Energy?
    No, it does NOT count as all basic energy when it is in your hand, only when Rainbow Energy is in play.

  591. I play 4 Electabuzz, 3 Scyther, 2 Ditto, and 3 Hitmonchan. is this good?
    Sounds pretty good, what’s the trainer mix though. That’s where the real strategy lies.

  592. With jungle Scyther, if you do sword dance, then are gusted to the bench by your opponent, then either switch, retreat, or scoop up on your next turn, bringing back up Scyther, does sword dance still work, and do slash 60?
    The effect of Swords Dance ends when Scyther is benched.

  593. I have a movie Dragonite. Can I use the Pokémon Power with no cards in my deck, draw all the cards I can as the rulebook says (which is none), put a card onto my deck and never run out of cards?
    No you can’t use Special Delivery if you have no cards in your deck. Drawing a card assumes that there is a card available in your deck to draw from.

  594. Wait a minute, for Final Beam, you said the Star would not be activated. but Kabuto will? How’s that?
    Slow down, R&D are checking these answers for us. Since Kabuto’s Armor triggers from combat damage and Final Beam triggers when it is knocked out, they activate at different times. BUT hold onto these questions until we get an official answer.

  595. Does Aerodactyl stop Rocket Magikarp from using the attack that makes it evolve itself?
    No it does not.

  596. If I put 2 double colorless on base set Charizard would I have to discard them? (knowing they don’t count as basic energies)?
    Fire Spin requires that 2 Energy “cards” be discarded as a cost. One Double Colorless Energy card only counts as 1 card toward this cost (another Energy “card”).

  597. When Smokescreen stops an attack, does it stop all effects of the attack, even those that might be done to the attacking Pokémon?
    Yes, it stops all effects.

  598. I have 3 Porygons in a deck, including 1 Japanese one. Can I use the deck, using a scanned picture of one of the American ones as a translation (since I have no more actual American Porygons?)
    Technically no, you must have a copy of the English card available at all times for viewing (if it’s in your deck it might not be up yet).

  599. If I have a Ditto with 3 dc energy attached as active and the defending card is a base 1 Blastoise, can I do Hydro Pump for 60 or do I need water energy?
    All energy attached to Ditto can count as whatever basic energy type you want. You can have the 3 DCE counts as 6 water energy and Hydro Pump for 60.

  600. While playing Pokémon if your hand goes empty, do you draw 7 more cards or just use the ones you draw every turn?
    Just the one you draw every turn.

  601. What about cards that do not state when the effect ends? Like Fossil Magmar’s smokescreen? I think for only one turn (the opponents next turn), but some stupid apprentice people say it lasts until Magmar is benched!
    The effect says tries to attack during your opponent’s next turn, so it only works on the next turn after you use the attack.

  602. How would you go about attacking when the opponent is paralyzed? Asleep?
    Do you mean when your Pokémon is Asleep or Paralyzed? Either bench, heal, or evolve your Pokémon so you can attack (or use Scoop Up), or you have to wait until next turn (and hopefully not still be asleep).

  603. If Ditto is copying a Pokémon with a PKMN Power, does Ditto copy the power as well as the moves?
    Yes.

  604. Why do some attacks state “Any other effects that would happen after applying Weakness and Resistance still happen”? What effects happen after applying weakness and resistance?
    They mean any other attack effects like Poison or Confusion or effects like Agility or Smokescreen.

  605. Could I damage swap a damage counters to a Clefairy doll, since it says, “Clefairy Doll doesn’t count as a knocked out Pokémon”?
    Yes, you could. When Clefairy Doll is in play it counts as a basic Pokémon.

  606. If a ditto is copying another Pokémon (like Mr. Mime) does Ditto also copy the Pokémon Power (like Invisible Wall?)
    That’s right.

  607. Does Dark Charizard still have too flip for all of his energies when u do continues fireball? After you already KO’d the defending Pokémon?
    Yes, D. Charizard will have to finish flipping coins even after enough damage has been done to the defending Pokémon.

  608. Can Venusaur put other energies on fire Pokémon?
    Only other grass energy.

  609. Why are Mulligan Mewtwo decks horrible?
    They are unimaginative and exploit inexperienced players.

  610. Shouldn’t Dark Golbat and Dark Gyarados’s Poke Powers read “DO NOT APPLY weakness and resistance?”
    I don’t think so. That’s how they translated.

  611. If Porygon does conversion 1 on a basic Pokémon then u evolves would conversion 1 still be in affect? And will it still be if u retreat?
    No, it won’t be in effect any longer if you evolve that Pokémon.

  612. If you had two base set Magmas in a deck and no other fire Pokémon what is the best amount of fire energy to have in the deck?
    About 40 % give or take a few depending on the remainder of your deck

  613. If your bench is full and you wish to retreat your active Pokémon, can you do so? Is it a switch, or is the fact the bench is full prevent the retreat?
    It’s basically a switch, so you can do that.

  614. Does the Level 7 Promo Eevee’s Pokémon power, Chain Reaction (as described in the most recent TopDeck), also bypass the “wait one turn” rule of evolution, as Magikarp’s Rapid Evolution does? For example, on my turn, may I play a Lv. 7 Eevee to my bench, then evolve a pre-existing Pokémon, and use said Eevee’s Power to evolve him the same turn he was played?
    Hey Kori, you missed the opening announcements. R&D ruled last week that Magickarp does NOT ignore the wait one turn to evolve. They changed the ruling, so Eevee wouldn’t either.

  615. Level 7 Promo Eevee’s Pokémon Power, Chain Reaction, states that “This power can only be used when a Pokémon evolves.” Since it doesn’t specify, does this mean you may also use this power during your opponent’s turn, if he or she evolves one of their Pokémon?
    Good question, we will check that but my understanding is that it can only be used on your turn. Good catch though. We will verify this answer for you guys and tell you next week,

  616. Swords dance: Is it stopped when the opponent?
    Umm. When your opponent what? If your Pokémon is benched or Evolved that effect ends.

  617. If you use dark Vileplumes petal whirlwind and get 1 heads is Vileplume confused?
    No, you have to get 2 heads or more for it to be confused.

  618. What is the point of using devolution spray? I mean, its the worst full heal I have ever seen!
    Use it to ‘turn off’ restrictive Pokémon powers that YOU want to get around.

  619. You could also devolve to a less expensive (energy wise) version of your Pokémon for attacks or retreat costs.
    For those x-magic players: It’s like Twiddle and Winter Orb.

  620. What is the best way to Ko a Blastoise?
    He has a Weakness to lightning so try a lightning Pokémon.

  621. The rocket does Poison gas but puts Pokémon to sleep what’s with that?
    Already answered this question, Team Rocket did it.

  622. If you Scyther do a Sword Dance, and then you are paralyzed or sleeped, do you have to start the sword dance all over again? I think that may have been the question?
    If you sleep through the next turn, than yes. If you wake up right away than no.

  623. If I have 2 of the same Pokémon in play that have a Pokémon power, can I use that power twice?
    Sure, depends on the particular power though.

  624. If someone wanted to use the English / Japanese “Exeggutor” card, would it be legal to use, since it is partially in English (if they were using colored deck protectors to hide the backs)?
    Yes.

  625. If you put someone asleep, do you flip RIGHT after the first turn?
    Yes, you would.

  626. Hey, here me out, what would you think of a deck with Dodrio, Tauros, and other cards with rage into a damage swap deck, I have tried forever and never could get the right deck I wanted!
    Hmmm, I would call it Raindance food.

  627. You said in the announcements that if Clefairy/Clefable metronome the Quick Evolution then they can evolve into Gyradose or Dark Gyradose. If you use de-evolution beam on it, would it revert back to Clefairy/Clefable?
    Yes.

  628. Ditto copies all effects of the defending Pokémon too?
    Yes it does.

  629. Back to the multiple Pokémon power questions, what powers wouldn’t B useable twice, or more for that matter?
    Well it depends on the powers, if you had two Muks, then only one power is necessary.

  630. If you use Devolution Spray on a Stage 2 Pokémon do you have the choice to go back to either the Stage 1 or Basic card, assuming you didn’t use a Breeder?
    You would.

  631. Does Mr. Mime’s invisible wall prevent all damage 30 or more, or does it prevent the 30 or more damage above 20, therefore taking 20 points?
    If the attack does 30 or more points, then no damage is done (as long as the power still works).

  632. Noticed in past chat transcripts a question that didn’t look like it was answered fully: does a plus power work with Hitmonlee’s stretch kick attack?
    It does not, Pluspower only adds to the total if the attack does damage to the DEFENDING Pokémon only.

  633. Here’s a Question for pat and all trainers; if you play Dodrios Retreat aid, if the Pokémon has no retreat cost do you get to pick energy from your discard pile?
    Nope. Nice try though.

  634. Can you use Rattata’s Pokémon power trickery if you have no deck remaining?
    No, Ratatta’s Power says: “switch”

  635. Can a dark stage 2 Pokémon evolve from a regular stage 1 Pokémon?
    No it can’t. You start with a basic (non-dark Pokémon as there are no Dark basic Pokémon). When you evolve to a Stage 1 that is when you choose Dark or Non-Dark. When you evolve to Stage 2 it must follow the stage 1 type. Of course if you use Pokémon Breeder then you skip Stage

  636. I have a mono-fire deck with no rares. My problem is that they are all weak to water and I usually lose to good rain dance decks. My question is: How can I beat a Rain-Dance deck, without adding any rares? Please help me, I have a awesome deck it’s record so far is 10-2.
    Good question, you could use trainer cards like Gust of Wind and Energy Removal to keep him off balance. Unfortunately the Rain Dance deck is hard to beat without using some rare cards like dark Vileplume (but not impossible).

  637. If I had 4 Dodrios out could I retreat anyone for free?
    Just about, unless something else is raising the retreat cost.

  638. If Aerodactyl is Confused and hurts itself, would it take damage or not?
    Nope. Of course if Porygon used Conversion on it.

  639. I do not understand the rainbow energy can you explain it?
    It counts as all basic Energy types when it is attached to a Pokémon. If you play it from your hand and attach it to a Pokémon, it does 10 damage to the Pokémon you attach it to.

  640. Can I evolve a Dratini from the rocket set into a Dragonair from the first set of Pokémon?
    Yes.

  641. If the defending Pokémon has a status change (like poison) but and attack requires you to flip to see if the same condition is afflicted, do you still have to flip? (Eg - Weedle’s poison sting reads "flip a coin. If heads, the defending Pokémon is no?
    Yes, you have to though I can understand why you would consider it redundant.

  642. I am trying to make a fighting deck which would be my dream deck and could possible beat psychic, which is its weakness, but I can’t find the proper cards?
    Sorry but each energy type has a weakness and fighting has psychic. Good luck.

  643. Hello! I’m a beginner and I like to know how exactly the Sleep & Poison works: Sleep; flip a coin after the owner of the asleep Pokémon turn or after every turn; same for the poison; one damage after the owner turn or after every turn?
    After each player’s turn including the one in which a Pokémon was put to Sleep, you flip a coin. If heads, your Pokémon is awake and can act normally. If tails, it is still Asleep and cannot Attack or Retreat.
    For Poison, your Pokémon takes 10 damage after each turn (including the turn in which it was Poisoned). This lasts until your Pokémon is knocked out, benched, or evolved.

  644. I don’t know if this question has already been asked because I just got here, but anyways, here goes. Say I have a Drowzee (from Team Rocket on my bench) with a Snorlax active. If I use Long-Distance Hypnosis and the flip is tails, will my Snorlax be put to sleep?
    Nope, unless Snorlax’s Pokémon power isn’t working for some reason (like Muk is in play), he will not be put to sleep.

  645. If an attack knocks out Dark Gyrados, but also Paralyzes Dark Gyrados on a coin flip, does Dark Gyrados’s Final Beam work?
    Yes it does as being Knocked out is immediate and attack effects don’t happen until the end of the turn, so Gyarados would be Knocked out BEFORE he was paralyzed.

  646. If I used Ditto to copy Grimer and Grimer evolved to Muk will Ditto evolve too, if so if Muk uses toxic gas will my Ditto be useless?
    Yes Ditto would transform into Muk but then would revert to Ditto.

  647. If you use Gambler with no other cards in your hand, do you have to shuffle your deck?
    Yes you would still have to shuffle your deck.

  648. If my Pokémon fell asleep and it wakes up next turn will it be able to attack on that turn or the next?
    You flip at the end of each player’s turn. If it wakes up after the other players turn, BEFORE yours then it would act normal on your turn.

  649. What comes first weakness or resistance when you attack?
    You calculate Weakness first, and then Resistance.

  650. On Computer Error, can you draw 0 cards? Also, do you declare how many you are drawing, then draw, or can you stop before 5?
    Nope you must declare from 1 to 5 cards, and then draw that many.

  651. If I use Charizard’s Energy Burn Pokémon Power and turn a water energy into a fire energy, can I use TR Charmander’s power to move that energy onto it?
    Sure!

  652. If you knock out a Dark Gyarados, with an attack that can paralyze, does Final Beam stop working because Dark Gyarados is paralyzed as he goes to the discard pile?
    Nope! I answered this one last week. The damage is calculated first, which immediately knocks out Dark Gyarados. Appropriate Pokémon Powers are done BEFORE attack effects are done.

  653. If your Clefairy/Clefable is facing a Dark Charizard, and you Metronome Continuous Fireball, I assume that you would actually have to have Fire Energy attached in order to do a coin flip. Do you need 2 Energy (Dark Charizard requires 2, but Clefable only needs 1 to use Metronome) or can you do the attack with only 1? Do you have to discard the Fire Energy if you get heads and do damage to your opponent?
    Correct you would need fire energy for the effect of the attack (like Moltres’s Wyldfire). You could do the attack with just one fire energy though as per Metrome ignoring the Requirements of an attack. And yes, you would still have to discard energy for each heads flipped. This is NOT a requirement but an effect of the attack so Metronome does NOT ignore it.

  654. I’m not sure if you can answer this, but if promo Eevee evolves, can you use it’s power to evolve it to a different evolution?
    Good questions, I will check R&D to verify but I would imagine that that would not work. Since Eevee would already be another Pokémon (it evolved) and the power states that you attach the pulled evolution card to Eevee that is no longer in play.

  655. If you use Gust of Wind Trainer (or Pidgey’s attack) and the opponent has no benched Pokémon, what is the result?
    Nothing.

  656. When you flip tails with dark Raichu for the first time, do you still do the damage?
    Sure!

  657. Is it true that you can’t evolve a dark stage 2 from a dark stage one?
    That is not true, that is how it works.

  658. If you lay a DCE on Charizard, will the DCE turn into 2 fire energies or 1 fire energy?
    If you use Energy Burn, it would count as 2 Fire energy.

  659. Regarding Dark Wartortle, when a Pokémon like Kangaskahn does 80 damage to Dark Wartortle while it used Reflecting Shell attack, will Dark Wartortle do 80 damage back or only 60 since that is it’s max HP?
    It would do 80. It copies the amount of damage done, not damage taken.

  660. With Charizard’s attack, it says discard 2 energy CARDS! So if you had 2 double colorless, and you used energy burn, you’d have to discard them both, right (both double colorlessness)?
    Key-wreckt.

  661. Please make sure everyone here knows that if a Mr. Mime got paralyzed, his power would still be off until his next turn BEGINS, therefor an opponents Pokémon would be able to do 30 more damage.
    That is right.

  662. Your active is confused, and your opponent attacks with Smokescreen. Then you try to attack. Rulebook says Smokescreen flip is done before Confusion flip. So if Smokescreen flip is tails, is Confusion flip still done?
    Yes it is.

  663. When you use computer error is your opponent still able to attack?
    On his turn, sure.

  664. Is it possible to evolve Eevee into Flareon, Jolteon, and Vaporeon in a game?
    The same Eevee? I suppose so if you devolve it or scoop it up enough times.

  665. With the new Devolution Spray ruling… can I evolve something and then devolve it on the same turn (for what little good that may do)?
    Nope, Devolving COUNTS as evolving. You can only evolve a particular Pokémon once per turn. So you CANNOT use Devolution Spray on a Pokémon you evolved this turn.

  666. In TR set does a stage 2 Dark Pokémon have to evolve from a dark Pokémon or can I put it on a plain one.
    It has top evolve from a Dark Stage 1 Pokémon (unless you use Breeder of course).

  667. Is it true that you can’t evolve a Dark stage 2 card from a regular stage 1 card?
    Right.

  668. Wait a sec – Mr. Mime gets paralyzed, but he’d unparalyze before the attacker could attack a second time – so they couldn’t hit him while the power is off!
    Yeah! That’s right! Darn that Mike and his wrong answers! Let’s get him!

  669. Wouldn’t it be cheating to include 4 comp? Errors, 4 item finders, 4 comp. Searches, and 4 gamblers in a deck? Because you could deck the other person’s deck by just doing comp. Error for 4 turns, then doing item finders to find those 4 and do it again, and then gamble all the cards back into your deck. Wouldn’t that be cheating?
    Nope, not cheating, just another way to try and win.

  670. Is it possible to play six types of energy in one deck and win?
    Well it is possible but I might have some swamp land in Florida to sell you too.

  671. If we have four Mews in a deck can we have four Japanese counterparts like Myuu?
    Nope. 4 of the same name only max.

  672. Is Dark Dugtrio’s Pokémon Power, Sinkhole, cumulative or not? (I like the idea of having a chance of doing 80 damage when my opponent retreats.)"
    They are cumulative.

  673. If I use devolution spray do I remove damage?
    Nope.

  674. We had a discussion recently on “card memory.” Specifically, does Ditto “reset” itself when it retreats to the bench? For example, if he was opposite a Gengar, could Ditto use Curse while Active, retreat to the Bench somehow (thereby “resetting” himself?), then come back up again and Curse once more? I’d say no, but I figured it better to ask just in case.
    Well, Ditto turns into a new Gengar in this case. He has no memory of being one before and so you could use the Curse again.

  675. With computer Error card does your opponent *have to* draw 5 cards when you play it?
    Nope, he chooses how many to draw up to 5 cards.

  676. Is there a minimum requirement of how many basic Pokémon must be in your deck? Also, questions about Clefairy doll. What happens if your hand only includes Clefairy Doll (no basic Pokémon)? Do I have the option of playing him face down? Must I play him?
    There is no minimum but Clefairy Doll does NOT count as a basic Pokémon in your hand (it is a trainer card). If you don’t have another basic Pokémon then you MUST mulligan.

  677. Are you SURE about the “new Gengar” thing? Because if that’s the case, there may very well be some really broken combos out there that could be done with Ditto being able to swap in and out for free (say, with Dodrio on the Bench). Theoretically, that would allow you to use any Opponent’s “once per turn” Power and infinite number of times.
    Sure as long as you could continually retreat Ditto. It does seem sort of broken doesn’t it? I will talk with R&D on this one. I guess I would be careful playing Gengar now huh?

  678. Question regarding the “devolution” rule. Does this mean also when you are devolved by Mew that you can not re evolve immediately?
    Yes. Although that question is kinda moot because if you use Mew’s attack to do that you wouldn’t be able to evolve anyway. And if you devolved your opponent’s Pokémon they could still re-evolve it on their turn.

  679. Regarding Confusion & Smokescreen (#57). Smokescreen says “If tails, that attack does nothing.” So why could the Confusion flip be necessary?
    Because that attack may result with something that would not be prevented by Smokescreen, like discarding energy cards.

  680. Since the mulligan rule says you can draw up to 2 cards on a mulligan, and you can draw 0 cards; can’t you draw 0 cards on Computer Error?
    Yea, I suppose. Why?

  681. I don’t quite understand it when you said if you were de-evolved by mew you couldn’t evolve straight away. The turn would be over; there is no way you could evolve right away anyway?
    Right! That’s what I said. Right that’s what I said in my follow up.

  682. What will happen if two person use Ditto as their active Pokémon at the same time?
    Not a darned thing.

  683. What I know what Blastoise’s power does but I think I am using it incorrectly, how do I use the power correctly?
    Raindance allows you to play Water Energy from your hand on any one of your Water Pokémon. One energy at a time, but as many as you want per turn.

  684. Can I play an original Stage 2 card on a dark card? (Example: Machamp on Dark Machamp)?
    No, only Dark evolutions on Dark cards.

  685. Will you please get the rulebook and read what it says about parlays? I remember seeing that it didn’t say after your next turn", but something like “Until the end of your opponents next turn”
    We did read it. You are misinterpreting it. I paralyze you Pokémon on MY TURN. On YOUR TURN its paralyzed, and at the end of YOUR turn it is UNPARALYZED. Back on MY TURN, it is NOT PARALYZED, comprendez?

  686. If I have 2 Dark Dugtrios in play, if my opponent retreats, does that mean he takes 40 damage?
    It means he flips 2 coins, his retreating Pokémon takes 20 damage for each tails he flips.

  687. If I have a Ditto active and my opponents Pokémon is either KOed or retreats, does Ditto revert back to itself or does it automatically change to the new Pokémon?
    Unless your Ditto is paralyzed, confused, or asleep, it would automatically transform into the new active Pokémon its facing.

  688. What did you mean when I asked about what Rain Dance does? I was thinking more like the lines of this… “How many energies can you play on Blastoise a turn?”
    You can use the power as often as you want before you attack on your turn. So you could attach as much water energy to water Pokémon as you have in your hand in one turn if you want.

  689. If you flip tails on Sinkhole and it does 20 damage to your Pokémon, does your Pokémon still retreat?
    Sure.

  690. Can I evolve my Kadbra to Dark Kadabra?
    Nope.

  691. TR Charmander and its Pokémon power. Can I use a benched Pokémon Charmander’s energy to the active Charmander and move another fire energy from a different Pokémon on my bench for the active Pokémon 's power in the same turn?
    Nope, TR Charmander’s power can only move 1 fire energy to ITSELF (not to another Charmander).

  692. If I have a Chansey with 110 damage on it, then I use a scoop up will it be fully healed?
    Chansey would be returned to your hand. When you play him again he’ll have the full 120 HP.

  693. I say WOTC should change the rules to how ever many cards in a deck is 60, individual of 4 should stay, but any how can u boost it up to 70 cards? I need to add important cards in my deck and cant take any others out?
    Tough, you’ll have to cut some out of your deck.

  694. If I can attack (I have an active Pokémon with enough energy card) but I don’t want to attack, can I pass the turn or I must attack?
    You can pass if you want.

  695. What if I don’t wanna use Aerodactyle’s power huh?
    You don’t have a choice, if Aerodactyl is in play and its power is active, it’s active.

  696. If your opponents Muk is confused, and your Ditto transforms into a Muk, if it also copies Toxic Gas, does that mean ditto’s transform will be canceled and it will transform back to ditto?
    The end result is that Ditto is Ditto, not Muk.

  697. Can you use a Pokémon breeder on a basic Pokémon like Charmander to evolve it into dark Charizard?
    Sure

  698. With Blastoises Rain Dance, are you allowed to attach three or more energies to any Pokémon in the same turn?
    Sure, as long as you have that much energy in your hand already.

  699. How many cards do I draw without any cards in my hand when I use professor oak?
    umm 7

  700. Can you attach more than one Plus Power to a Pokémon? 2,3,4?
    Well you can have up to 4 in your deck, so if you had all 4 in your hand you could use them all at once yes.

  701. Are you allowed to mix up what you pick up with Nightly Garbage Run?
    Yes you are.

  702. What is the evolve form of gloom not a Vilepleme cause I heard that its in the hundreds
    Sorry but it is Vileplume.

  703. Does Dark Golbat’s Pokémon Power do 10 damage to a Pokémon if that Pokémon has a Defender on it? Defender stops damage from ATTACKS, but that’s a Pokémon Power?
    Yes, because Defender stops damage only from attacks. You’ve got the right idea.

  704. If you have out Clefairy and opponent Moltres can you use wildfire and discard their whole deck?
    Not unless you can discard enough fire energy from Clefairy. You need to do so, because that ability of Moltres is an option.

  705. A couple weeks ago, you said that if Clefairy or Clefable Metronomed Rapid Evolution, that you could evolve Clefairy/Clefable into Gyrados or Dark Gyrados. What if Ditto uses Rapid Evolution? Would Ditto evolve into Gyrados/Dark Gyrados?
    No, unfortunately, Ditto actually says on it: Ditto can’t evolve.

  706. If you use dark Alakazam’s teleport blast do you have a choice to switch? Remember it says: you MAY switch?
    Yes, you do.

  707. If I used Swords Dance with Scyther and it got knocked out or benched on my opponents turn, if I have another one will it do 60 damage with slash?
    No, Swords Dance is referring to _that_ Scyther; if he retreats or is knocked out, no double Slash attack.

  708. Is the MR Yuk deck way too weak to psychic?
    I’ll let Galen answer that one. [Galen] Which Mr. Yuk are you speaking of, the one I made, or the one Boss Mike altered? Mr. Yuk is most weak to fire…it would hold it’s own against a psychic I think.

  709. Do you have a final ruling on ditto’s “card memory”?
    You mean like when Ditto’s copying a Clefairy Doll and gets knocked out? If so, in that situation the player who knocked out the Ditto would _not_ draw a prize card.

  710. Energy that have been Burned by Charizard’s Pokémon Power are considered to be Fire Energy until the end of the turn. Once burned, do they still stay that way until the end of the turn if they are removed from Charizard (say, by TR Charmander’s Gather Fire PP)?
    Well, I believe that would be possible, but I’ll check on that one.

  711. Similarly, with regard to Energy Burn, if you accidentally put Charizard to Sleep (say, as a result of a failed Long Distance Hypnosis coin flip), do the Energy Burned Energies revert to their original types, or do they still remains Fire Energy until the end of the turn?
    They would remain Fire Energy until the end of the turn.

  712. For clarification from last week: with Computer Error, is it correct that you have to state how many cards you are going to draw before doing so, and also, that you may draw 0 cards if you wish?
    I don’t think that’s a rule, but it’s certainly the polite way to play.

  713. Or, to make it even clearer for those confused with the entire Devo Beam, Devo Spray, Rapid Evolution, Breeder, etc. Stuff out there: would it be correct to say that, simply, you may change the “evolution level” (Basic, Stage 1, or Stage 2) of any particular Pokémon only ONCE per turn, regardless of the method used?
    That sounds reasonable, yes.

  714. But on Ditto, it says that it copies ALL text on the opposing card. So wouldn’t Ditto copy the line of text which says that you evolve it into Gyrados/Dark Gyrados?
    Ditto will still know it’s own card text though, and that says: Ditto can’t evolve.

  715. On Pokémon powers, do you need to say them every turn like an attack, or do you only say them once and they keep working until that Pokémon is unable to use it?
    You don’t absolutely need to say them, but it is proper game etiquette I think.

  716. Last week a question was asked about Ditto opposite Gengar, with Ditto repeatedly retreating, becoming active, and doing Curse multiple times on the same turn. You guys said you would check and see if that was OK. Is it?
    I just checked and they answered in the affirmative for now, but they reserve the right to change that answer later. How’s that for vague? I would go ahead and play it like that for now.

  717. Can I have four base set Charmanders and four-team rocket Charmanders in a deck?
    No, because they both have the name Charmander. You’re limited to only four of any particular card.

  718. If I attach a pluspower to a paralyzed Scyther, then use a switch, then make my Scyther the active again, will the plus power still be there?
    My question to you is why don’t you do that before you attach the plus power? Then you won’t have to worry about it?

  719. If TR Porygon converts Ditto’s weakness (say, to grass), then retreats and is replaced by a Scyther, is the Ditto still weak to grass?
    Yes.

  720. Do you HAVE to have a basic Pokémon in your deck?
    Yup…otherwise you wouldn’t be able to start the game.

  721. Can you just play a card like Haunter, With out playing Gastly>?< because on the basic Haunter it doesn’t say Put Haunter on The Stage 1 Cards?
    No, you have to start with Gastly. No you cannot…the rule with that is that you cannot have more than 4 of the same kind of cards (excluding basic energy of course) with the same name, both Charmanders have the same name on the card. Therefore that would be like having 8 which is not allowed. It’s all in the name.

  722. Suppose my active Pokémon is asleep. My opponent’s turn ends. I draw a card, then realize that I didn’t flip to see if I wake up. Can I still flip? Or did I forfeit the opportunity to flip because I drew a card first?
    Yes, you can still flip.

  723. Your opponent Mulligans and you draw 2 more cards, one of which is a basic Pokémon. Can you make that Pokémon your starting active Pokémon, or can you only start with one from the original 7 cards you were dealt?
    Since you haven’t laid down the cards yet for play…it is still technically part of your turn…so the answer is yes.

  724. Can you evolve a base set Charizard on a Dark Charmelion?
    No you can’t…once you go to the dark evolutions, the next forward evolution must be the Dark Charizard.

  725. If I were building a deck, could I have 4 Dark _ and four-base/jungle/fossil __? I have been told both yes and no.
    Yes you could, my friend.

  726. Say Ditto is copying an Abra, and I attach a pluspower to my Abra, then use Psyshock, then it becomes paralyzed, would the Ditto still be alive?
    If Ditto’s copying a Base Set Abra, he’ll be knocked out by that attack.

  727. If you attached a PlusPower to a Pokémon (for this, Scyther) and then Scoop Upped it (yes, a very dumb person), what would happen to the PlusPower?
    It goes to your discard pile.

  728. If I use Scyther’s swords dance and on my next turn I get paralyzed asleep or confuse but I full heal, will I be able to use the slash attack for 60?
    Yes.

  729. If you have 2 Jungle Mankeys in play, can you use their Pokémon Powers (Peek) together, to look at the top 2 cards in your deck, or would they just let you look at the top card twice.
    You could only look at the top card twice.

  730. Referring to the Ditto on Porygon. If Ditto’s Weakness were changed to Grass, When Scyther gets bringed, Wouldn’t Ditto’s Weakness be changed into Fire?
    Nope, Ditto is still the active Pokémon and Conversion won’t end until the converted Pokémon is benched. We’ll double check on this one too, I understand that it’s kind of confusing.

  731. Can you have only 1 basic Pokémon in your deck?
    You could…but your opponents would have a field day with you unless you got a very lucky draw. Mulligans…bad…for you.

  732. Can you retreat with a full bench?
    Yes, you’ll just exchange your active with a benched Pokémon.

  733. If your Mr.Mime is paralyzed then on your opponent’s turn can he knock it out with 40 damage, Or does it become unparalyzed and the Pokémon Power is back on?
    He would get knocked out because his Pokémon power is ineffective when Mr. Mime is paralyzed

  734. I’m planning on making a Haymaker Deck, What cards do you recommend I insert into my new deck?
    Here’s the basic Pokémon necessary for Haymaker decks: 4 Scythers, 4 Hitmochans. From there, trainers customize according to what other decks are popular in their area. I’ve used Jigglypuff/Wigglytuff before, but now I use Electabuzz and Pincer.

  735. Can Rocket Magikarp’s Rapid Evolution be used on the first turn it is put down, by placing 3 energy with Rain Dance?
    No, Rapid Evolution still counts as evolving, so you can’t do it the first turn you put down Magikarp.

  736. Does Ditto’s HP stay the same or change to the defending Pokémon’s HP, and does resistance and weakness change?
    Weakness/resistance changes, so does the HP when Ditto becomes another Pokémon

  737. Does Ditto’s attack copy the effects like paralyzing, asleep etc?
    If the attack of the Pokémon he’s copying has those effects, so will Ditto.

  738. If you use a plus power then Prof. Oak, would the then ready to attack, would the plus Power still be there? Or, would you have to discard it if you attached it to you active, then professor Oaked, then attacked?
    If the active Pokémon that you attached Plus Power to is still your active after your Oak, it will still be in effect.

  739. If you go first, are you allowed to win the game before your opponent has a chance to have a turn?
    Yes I suppose so.

  740. In the TR Meowth, its attack says “don’t apply weakness and resistance for this attack”. Why put this text in when Meowth is a colorless Pokémon?
    It’s possible that a card that we expect to print in the future may effect the type of a Pokémon in play.

  741. Mr. Mime would NOT be knocked Invisible Wall would be back on, since Mime is no longer paralyzed after its players turn!
    Yeah. You are right I think I misread the question my apologies.

  742. Does my serious Fossil still count as a basic Pokémon when in the discard pile?
    No.

  743. Can you retreat if your Pokémon is poisoned and asleep?
    You can’t retreat, but you can play switch.

  744. My opponent plays a Challenge, and I accept. I place a Charmander on my bench. He ends turn. It is now my turn. Can I evolve Charmander into Charmeleon, or do I have to wait until my NEXT turn to evolve?
    You can evolve Charmander because he wasn’t played -that- turn.

  745. I’m trying to make a Wigglytuff deck and I need to know what Pokémon are good for backup. Can you help me?
    Anything, that allows you to get more Pokémon, on your bench.

  746. Can you evolve a dark Charmeleon into a Charizard?
    Nope.

  747. If you use a plus power on an attack that does 0 damage, will it do 10 damage? Like for example, Kangaskhan’s fetch will it do 10 damage with a plus power?
    No, Plus Power will only add 10, if damage is done. Fetch doesn’t do damage.

  748. Last week it was ruled, that if Ditto is against a Pokémon that has a “once-per-turn” Pokémon Power. Say, Gengar – and Ditto rotates out to the bench and then back up, it can use that “once-per-turn” Pokémon Power a second time during the same turn (or more, if he continues to do so). If you used Gust of Wind to drop the opposing Gengar back to the opponent’s Bench, the then brought him back up again to the Active slot with another GoW, would Ditto now also be able to use that “once-per-turn” again?
    R&D has said that benching Ditto in this situation would allow you to use Curse again, so I would imagine that the inverse is true as well. If you send the opponent’s Gengar back to the bench and then move him back up when Ditto’s still active, you could do Curse again.

  749. If you have a Promo Eevee in play, and your opponent evolves up into an Aerodactly, how does that resolve? Since you can use Eevee’s Chain Reaction during your opponent’s turn if he evolves, can you use it “before” Aerodactyl’s Power goes into effect, or are you prevented from using Chain Reaction? Or, as I suspect, is it like Rapid Evolution in which Aerodactyl doesn’t enter into the equation since you’re not technically “playing” an evolution card?
    You’re not technically ‘playing’ and evolution card with Eevee’s Chain Reaction.

  750. Some attack text, such as Harden, Stiffen and Withdrawl, say that they prevent damage done on the opponent’s next turn, but do not reference, where the damage is coming from. Will these prove effective against things such as a failed coin flip from Digger, which does 10 damage to the losing Pokémon?
    So it means anything on the next turn of your opponent so yes it would prevent that damage.

  751. Last week, you said that Energy Burned Energies remain as such even if Charizard is put to Sleep that same turn (say, as the result of a failed Long Distance Hypnosis coin flip). However, looking back through some previous rulings, you said a month or two ago that if Charizard is paralyzed, etc. then the energies revert to their normal type. Which is correct?
    The energies will remain Fire energies until the end of the turn, even if Charizard is put to sleep. Certainly, some of our rulings may change as R&D corrects or reverses older rulings.

  752. Scenario: you have an Active Ditto with, say, 2 Fire, 2 Grass and 1 Water energy on him, and he is opposite a Dark Charizard. He could do Continuous Fireball and flip five times, since all energies attached to Ditto count as all types (including Fire). However, for each heads he gets, he has to discard a Fire Energy. So let’s say he gets three heads out of the five flips – does he have to discard the two Fire Energies first, and then one of the others, or can he discard the two Grass and 1 Water instead? Or do you state “which” energy card you are flipping for when you flip, and discard that specific one when and if it’s heads?
    Because Ditto’s energies count as any type when they are attached to him…you could choose which energies you discard by the amount of heads you flipped

  753. If you attach a plus power to Scyther and then retreat for Hitmonchan and do jab, will Hitmonchan do 30 instead of 20?
    Plus Power will stay attached to the Pokémon you put it on. It will not be in effect for the Hitmochan.

  754. You mentioned the ruling with Plus Power; would the same apply to other attached cards, such as Defender?
    The correct interpretation is that it is attached to the Pokémon you put it on not necessarily attached to the active slot per se. Sorry for the mistake guys I goofed.

  755. Can Ditto change to any Mysterious Fossil or Clefairy doll. If so, is the ability copied?
    Ditto can copy either of those cards, but since Ditto can’t evolve, you won’t be able to use those cards to their full ability.

  756. Say, just a clarification for the record: ALL of Ditto’s abilities related to Transform are functional ONLY when he Active, including the “Rainbow” effect of attached energies, correct?
    As far as I know, yes.

  757. Concerning Rainbow Energy, the card states that when Rainbow Energy comes into play it deals 10 damage to the Pokémon it’s attached to. Does this 10 damage take place the one time it comes into play, or take place every turn?
    No you just take 10 damage when it comes from your hand and you put it on…it does no damage after words

  758. Just for clarification - If I use Mew’s De-evolution beam on my turn against my opponents active Pokémon, can he re-evolve it on his turn? I don’t see why he can’t as his turn is a different turn than the turn I did de-evolution beam on.
    Yeah totally you could evolve him on your turn.

  759. If Dark Charizard is confused and tries to attack with Continuous Fireball, what is the exact procedure (assume the confusion flip is tails)?
    Flip a coin to see if the attack is successful due to confusion. If it’s tails, do 20 damage to D.Charizard.

  760. Is Digger’s damage considered an “attack”? (If Haunter is damaged by Digger, does Haunter’s Transparency require another flip? Will Defender protect against damage caused by Digger?)
    No.

  761. Concerning Clefable’s Metronome, can I metronome Dark Charmeleon’s Fireball attack when I have energy other than Fire on Clefable?
    No.

  762. What is a good number of Gyarados’s to have in a deck?
    I would say 2 or 3 personally.

  763. Can you put more than 5 Pokémon on your bench by using the Challenge! card since it clearly says you can pick any amount of Pokémon?
    No because you only have five spaces on your bench.

  764. Concerning Clefable’s Metronome once again this time in relation to Hydro Pump (or similar attacks), since the initial energy is considering to cover the costs for the attack, if I have 2 Water Energies in excess of that first energy, will the Hydro P?
    Hydro pump specifies what kind of energy (water) you need to do excess damage so you would have to put extra (water) energy on Clefable in order to do more damage.

  765. Does smokescreen carry over if the person retreats or dies on that turn? For example, If fossil Magmar kills Oddish and the opponent brings up Gloom, does the opponents still have to flip?
    Smokescreen goes away, when the Pokémon affected retreats or dies or evolves so the upcoming gloom would not have to flip the smokescreen would not be in effect.

  766. Do you have to flip for an attack like fetch if the attack doesn’t do any damage?
    You mean if Kangaskhan is confused? Yes, you would.

  767. When using Raichu’s agility attack it states that if heads Raichu will not receive damage until after the opponents turn. If Raichu is poisoned and then gets heads will he take damage from poison at the end of his turn?
    Yes, Agility is referring to effects of attacks on Raichu during your opponent’s next turn.

  768. Referring to the question regarding Ditto and “once-per-turn” Powers: if Ditto can use said powers multiple times in the same turn if the opponent is Gusted out and back, is it because Ditto “resets” himself somehow when he Transforms? If so, this seems at odds with status effects, which are not lost when Ditto Transforms into a new Pokémon. Unless I’m just missing something, along the line here.
    No, Ditto doesn’t ‘reset’, but if he Transforms from Gengar to Ditto to Gengar, that second Gengar will be considered a ‘fresh’ one as far as the ‘once-per-turn’ use of Curse.

  769. If I attach a plus power to Dark Wartortle, and use Mirror shell, and the defending Pokémon does 20 damage to Dark Wartortle, does Mirror Shell do 20 or 30 damage back?
    No, the Plus Power will be removed at the end of your turn, so it won’t be in effect for the Mirror Move.
    It will do 20.

  770. When playing a rainbow Energy on a Pokémon, the 10 damage still occurs even if a Defender is played on that Pokémon, correct?
    Defender states that it only defends against damage done by attacks since that is not an attack the damage would be done if the Rainbow was played out of the hand on to the Pokémon in question.

  771. When playing a rainbow Energy on a Pokémon, will Mr. Mime’s Invisible Wall prevent that damage or not?
    No it would not.

  772. If you put defender on a Pokémon that has just been attacked by a Gastly with destiny bond will the defenders have any affect?
    The defenders won’t have any effect because Destiny bond has no value to the damage it does it simply knocks out the defending Pokémon.

  773. All my Dark Golbats say “Apply”, but it sounds like you have one that says “Don’t apply”. Please confirm for the masses. Thanks.
    Both of the ones I could find here say, “Apply weakness and resistance.”

  774. If there are 4 Snorlax on a bench, won’t that break the bench?
    Probably, but not in the game, for the Bench is just the place where they wait to battle and not actually a real bench you might have a picnic on.

  775. Can you play if most of your Pokémon cards use colorless attack if I don’t have any colorless cards?
    Well colorless attacks mean that you can use any color of energy to activate that particular attack you don’t just need the double colorless energy to use those attacks.
