  776. Below dark Raichu’s left foot, there is a ‘blob’ of something - is this a error or damaged card? Or are they all like that?
    I don’t know. I’d have to see the card.

  777. My brother tried to play a deck with no Pokémon at the super trainer showdown qualifier, but the deck check lady said it was illegal. I see no where in the rules where it says its illegal and a master trainer told me on chat that it was ok too.
    If you don’t have any Pokémon in your deck the game will never start. If you want to make a deck like that, you’re welcome to, but, be prepared to get kicked out of a lot of tournaments.

  778. Is 0 damage still damage? My friend said that his Hitmonchan with 2 plus powers on it did 20 damage, but I said NO. What’s the ruling?
    No, 0 is not damage. Hitmochan with 2 Plus Powers on it and no energy, will do 0 damage.

  779. Can you have 3 Lv. 12 Pikachu and 2 Lv. 14 Pikachu in one deck?
    Nope, you can only have 4 Pokémon of the same name in your deck it does not matter which set they came from or if they were different promo’s.

  780. I think this was asked a couple of weeks ago, but if an attack that knocks out Dark Gyarados also paralyzes him, does he get to use his Final Beam or not?
    No, he won’t get to because you’ll have to apply all the effects of the attack on D.Gyrados all at once. Since it will be paralyzed, it won’t be able to do Final Beam.

  781. Does the ruling on Plus Powers staying with retreated Pokémon also apply to other attached cards, such as Defender?
    As far as we know.

  782. In a translation by Scrye, it says that Dark Blastoise does 10 damage for each extra energy and Rocket Diglett’s Dig Under does 20. In the actual American cards, it is the other way around. Was that a mistake, or was Scrye wrong?
    Scrye and Inquest often have to submit their translations for the new sets before they see our cards, so it doesn’t surprise me that they may have been wrong or we may have changed the card’s wording.

  783. How many energy cards should a good deck have?
    Well, its whatever works best for you. I’ve played decks with anywhere from 7 to 35 energy cards. Usually 25-30 is a good place to start though.

  784. If Clefaible uses it’s metronome attack against Moltre’s wildfire, would Clefairible be able to force an opponent to deck itself?
    Not sure what you mean. If you Metronome Wildfire, you must still discard energy from Clefable in order to pay for the effect of the attack against your opponent.

  785. Does Mr. Mime’s Pokémon power work from the bench?
    Sure, but only for Mr. Mime of course.

  786. Can you retreat if you have a full bench?
    Sure, Retreating means you SWAP the active Pokémon for a Pokémon on your bench.

  787. If you have a Scyther out as your active Pokémon, and you have a Blastoise on the bench then, you place TR Magikarp on the bench, and retreat Scyther for TR Magikarp and Raindance three water energies on TR Magikarp, can you do rapid evolution, and evolve Magikarp into base Gyrados, that turn since you just played TR Magikarp that turn?
    Sorry, since Magickarp’s Raid Evolution counts as evolving, you CANNOT use it the same turn you played the Magickarp.

  788. On Kabuto, it’s Pokémon power says: Kabuto Armor: Whenever an attack (even your own) does damage to Kabuto (after applying Weakness and Resistance), that attack only does half the damage to Kabuto (rounded down to the nearest 10). (Any other effects of attacks still happen.) This power stops working while Kabuto is asleep, confused, or paralyzed. My question is, Could you play this power in a damage swap deck? Like for example, could you swap a damage counter to kabuto and use Kabuto’s armor to take the damage counter off you, since damage done to Kabuto is rounded down, which would be 10/2=5 rounded down is zero. Could you do that?
    Nope, Swap isn’t an attack. Kabuto’s Armor only helps against attacks.

  789. If you use dark Machamp’s fling, do you get a prize?
    Nope, nothing was Knocked out.

  790. How many double colorless energy cards can you have in a deck?
    4 since it is a non-basic energy card.

  791. In an earlier chat, it was said that Geodude could stop flipping after it got the required damage to knock out the opposing Pokémon. But would this be the case against Mr. Mime (say if Mr. Mime has 20 damage and Geodude flipped 2 heads, wouldn’t it have to flip again?)
    You are supposed to keep flipping until Geodude gets tails, regardless of whether it is enough to Knock out the other Pokémon or not.

  792. If you accept a Challenge, can you select zero Pokémon to add to your bench? (Is 0 “any number”?)
    Yup, zero (last I checked) is still a number.

  793. Back to the old Venusaur/Ditto energy trans question. Since Ditto’s Pokémon power starts with the quote “If Ditto is your active Pokémon.” does that mean that energy attached to Ditto is energy of any type only when Ditto is active? If this is the case, Venusaur could only trans energy from an ACTIVE Ditto and not a benched one, (unless the energy is grass, of course).
    Correct, that only works if Ditto is the active Pokémon.

  794. Suppose Ditto has only a Double Colorless Energy and is opposite a Dark Charizard. If Ditto does Continuous Fireball, how many flips are made?
    One, as you would only have 1 energy CARD (that gave 2 energy) attached to the Ditto.

  795. If Clefable has 1 fire energy attached, and is opposite a Dark Charizard, and does Continuous Fireball and flips heads, must the fire energy be discarded?
    Yup, it is NOT a requirement to do the attack so it is NOT ignored by Metronome.

  796. When Ditto has one double colorless energy can it do an attack that needs 2 fire energy (or any other combination of energy cards)?
    Yes it can.

  797. If Scyther swords dances, and is benched (e.g. gust), does swords dance stay in effect?
    The effect of Swords Dance is cancelled.

  798. Does Areodactly Pokémon power mean that I can’t play anymore-evolved Pokémon or I cant evolve Pokémon?
    Correct, unless Aerodactyl is paralyzed, asleep, or confused. Also the TR Magickarp Rapid Evolution attack could STILL be used.

  799. If a Ditto copies a Dark Charizard and has a DCE and uses Repeating Fireball, and gets a heads, it says to discard Fire energy card, but Ditto doesn’t have any, and what if he gets two heads, how would that work?
    First you would only flip 1 once since there is only 1 energy card. You would still have to discard the 1 DCE since it COUNTS as a Fire energy card that gives 2-fire energy (in this case).

  800. If it counts as evolving can you still attack rapid evolution?
    No, it is an attack itself (Rapid Evolution).

  801. Can a Snorlax every be put to sleep, confused, paralyzed or poisoned? If yes, when would that occur? I had someone last week say its power is always on, even before your first turn.
    Sure, there are ways to turn off Pokémon powers like while Muk is in play or the Goop Gas trainer card.

  802. Can you put 4 Dark Alakazams in a deck and 4 regular Alakazams in a deck since they have different names?
    Yes, you can.

  803. If a Dark Jolteon lighting flashes and defender retreats do you still flip.
    No, the effect of Lighting Flash will end if the defending Pokémon is benched.

  804. Say I have 2 Drowzee’s from the Team Rocket set on my bench. Is it possible to use long-distance Hypnosis twice or just once on my turn?
    You can use it twice (once for each Drowzee).

  805. I found an error that could make Wigglytuff Decks invincible. The challenge card states that “each of you searches your deck for number of basic Pokémon cards and puts them face down onto the bench.” This could allow you to fill it with tons more than 5 benched Pokémon since normally the card beats the rule. It should have said “up to 5 Pokémon (enough to fill the bench of 5) can be placed down” not any. This makes Wigglytuff decks invincible! Another example of card beating rule is when Jigglypuff attacks a Snorlax. Although according to the rules it should be asleep, it is not because the card said so. Give this a lot of thought and tell me if it is legal? Don’t give me a short answer please. Please put some thought into your answer?
    Ok, first of all you can only have 5 max Pokémon on your bench, period. That is a rule of the game and unchangeable. Just because it is NOT specifically written on the Challenge card does NOT mean you can break that rule. As for Jigglypuff attacking a Snorlax, as long as Snorlax’s Pokémon power is active; it will NOT put him to sleep. It will not. This is a break from tradition I know, but we think you can handle it.

  806. What type of deck is most popular nowadays?
    There are quite a few, Raindance, Haymaker, and Stall.

  807. Mike, You said that you could not use TR Magikarp’s rapid evolution during the same turn that it is played because it counts as an evolution, but you also said that you CAN use it when an Aerodacytl is in play. If it’s an evolution, how can you use it then?
    The Rapid Evolution Attack has you pulling an Evolution card from the deck and playing it. This is NOT the same as PLAYING an Evolution card, so Aerodactyl’s Prehistoric Power does NOT prevent you from being able to use this attack

  808. If you have a D Gyarados in your deck, and use Metronome to copy TR Magkarps Rapid Evolution, could you evolve Clefable into Gyarados? The same thing with Ditto. (I’m doing a test on Pokeschool and I want to make sure I have the official answers)
    Clefable you could do this with, but Ditto actually has text on it that says he can’t evolve.

  809. Venusaur’s energy trans states that you may take ONE energy from ONE of your Pokémon to another as often as you like but not about 4 energies from one Pokémon and bring them all to Venasaur… Can you take more than one energy from ONE Pokémon and bring it all to another?
    Yes, but you have to move them one at a time.

  810. What are the proper cards to make a perfect rain dance (including rocket)?
    There are many different Raindance decks and I don’t think any one deck is perfect. I suggest checking out Poke-websites for ideas.

  811. The rulebook I got in my Team Rocket theme deck says (p. 11); “…neither player can evolve a Pokémon on the first turn.” Does that mean that if I go 2nd and start with a lone Squirtle, on my first turn I can evolve him to Wartotle?
    No, that means that on either player’s 1st turn, that player may not evolve a Pokémon.

  812. About rainbow energy (just a little clarification) it does 10 damage when initially attached, but not when moved around thanks to powers, right?
    Correct. It only does the damage when it’s played from your hand.

  813. About my Clefable evolving into Gyarados question, are you sure? Cause Metronome says to copy the attack, and Rapid Evolution says to put the card on Magikarp. So, it should be that you can not evolve Clefable into Gyarados?
    Actually the rule is when you use Metronome and it copies an attack that self-references the Pokémon (like Magickarp’s Raid Evolution states Magickarp) then you replace te self reference with Clefable/Clefairy (whichever one you are using Metronome from). So, the Rapid Evolution now says Rapid Evolution: Search your deck for an Evolution named Gyarados or Dark Gyarados and put it on Clefable. (This counts as evolving Clefable.) Shuffle your deck afterward.

  814. Clefairy Doll and Mysterious Fossil both have 10HP, but on Mysterious it says that if knocked out, discard. On C. Doll when it’s knocked out do I discard?
    Knocking out specifically means to discard the card!

  815. About the two rare Team Rocket Trainer: Is it forever or until the end of the turn(I believe the cards are “Here Comes Team Rocket” and “Rocket’s Sneak Attack”
    Here come Team Rocket lasts for the game, Rocket’s Sneak attack only works the turn you play it.

  816. What if there is no benched Pokémon on your opponent’s bench when you use Dark Magneton’s second attack?
    It only moves the energy card IF he or she has a benched Pokémon, if they don’t the energy doesn’t move.

  817. If you have four Drowzee (Team Rocket) on the bench can you use their Pokémon power “long-distance hypnosis” four times or just once?
    4 times (once each).

  818. If you use team rocket, flip over your prizes, can you use another one to flip em back over?
    Nope.

  819. Say if there is an Aerodactyl. If you use Magikarp(Team Rocket) and use rapid evolution could promo Eevee use it’s Pokémon power: chain reaction to evolve or not?
    Yes.

  820. Do you necessarily have to evolve Dark Alakazam from Dark Kadabra, or can it be evolved from a regular Kadabra?
    Stage 2 dark Pokémon can only evolve form stage 1 dark Pokémon.

  821. If Venomoth uses Shift, does it’s energy costs change with it’s type?
    No it doesn’t.

  822. Can I have say 4 Blain’s Arcanine and four regular Arcanine?
    In one deck? Sure, they have different names.

  823. Is there any other way besides F.Gastly’s “Energy Conversion” to get a DCE straight back into your hand (not into the deck)?
    Hmmm, not that I know of. Does anyone else know of a way to do this, gang?

  824. When my ditto uses an attack that requires discarding of a fire energy, may I discard an attached grass energy since all energy on ditto counts as any color?
    Yes you can.

  825. If Dark Wartortle were facing against Mr. Mime would mirror shell affect Mr. Mime when Dark Wartortle is KO?
    It would depend on how much damage was done to Dark Wartortle, if it was 30 or more then the Invisible Wall would still prevent it (as long as Mr. Mime’s Pokémon Power still worked).

  826. How many Mew’s should I put in my deck?
    That my friend, is entirely up to you (4 max of course).

  827. Does Defender prevent damage from poison?
    Nope, it only reduces damage from Attacks, NOT attack effects like Poison.

  828. If Clefairy is against Executor and she uses metronome. Do you go by the energy requirement on Executor? I was told by a friend that because it says ‘without regard to energy requirements’ that you just flipped untill the opponent was dead? That sounds wrong.
    Right, your friend is wrong. You replace the word Exeggutor with the Clefairy when you use Metronome on the Big Eggsplosion attack. So you would flip as many coins as you have energy attached to the Clefairy.

  829. May I move a double colorless energy attached to a ditto onto my Charmander, using Gather Fire?
    Yes you could (since Energy attached to Ditto counts as any basic energy type).

  830. If Golduck uses Hyper Beam to KO a Dark Gyarados and the coin flip was head and Gyarados had two energies on it, would the attack to 20 or 40 damage?
    It would do 40.

  831. Can you have 4 basic Charizard in your deck and 4 team Rocket Charizard?
    Nope, they have the same name (Charizard); the set that they are from does not change their name. Now, Dark Charizard is a different name though, so you could have 4 of them and 4 Charizard.

  832. To clarify the “all energy on Ditto counts as energy of any color”, this is only the case when Ditto is active and it’s Pokémon power comes into play, correct?
    Correct.

  833. Would Dk.Wartortle’s MirrorShell stop working if the opponent benches their Pokémon first (same as Smokescreen)?
    Good question! It is worded a bit vague isn’t it? My guess is that it would end when the Defending Pokémon is benched but I will check on it.

  834. What does Dark Raichu’s attack does?
    Surprise Thunder: Flip a coin. If heads, flip another coin. If the second coin is heads, this attack does 20 to each of your opponent’s Benched Pokémon. If the second coin flip is tails, this attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent’s Benched Pokémon. (Don’t apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) DAMAGE 30. It requires 3 lightning energy attached, btw.

  835. What is a good ratio for total basic Pokémon to evolved Pokémon in a deck?
    Well, we usually recommend 4 basic to 2 Stage 1 to 1 Stage 2 Pokémon normally. Of course, you can vary it.

  836. Do you believe they should have a limit of 60 cards in a Pokémon deck? I mean, Magic you can have infinite cards, IT IS UNFAIR!
    Why? It’s always been a part of the rules ever since the Pokémon TCG came out 5 years ago.

  837. Ok, if I play a Computer Error, and I draw 5 cards, does my opponent HAVE to draw 5 cards too, or can he/she opt to draw a different number?
    They can draw UP TO 5 cards so they get to choose the number.

  838. A question on the damage caused from Rainbow Energy: If Mewtwo “energy absorbs” and then Venusaur "energy transfers it, do the receiving Pokémon take damage?
    Nope, it only does the damage when you play the card from your hand.

  839. Is Ancient Mew’s Pokémon Power the one where no evolved Pokémon can hurt it?
    That’s going to be for League members to figure out.

  840. Might want to check RD on the Golduck ruling. It seems you would carry out the attack and all its effects then knock out the Pokémon.
    Ok, according to the order of attack: The last step is if the attack does anything else other than damage do that. Since Dark Gyarados is being Knocked out from the damage (step h) BEFORE the Remove Energy effect goes off the energy card should still be there when Dark Gyarados is Knocked out and his Pokémon Powers resolves.

  841. Mew’s Devolution Beam works on the opponents benched Pokémon too, right?
    Yea, that’s right.

  842. If I evolve a Pokémon that is being effected by Smokescreen, does the effect go away?
    Yes.

  843. What’s the use of having 4 Charizard and 4 Dark Charizards in a deck when you can only have 4 Charmanders, which means you won’t use all of them? Isn’t it a waste of space?
    Yes, it’s probably wasted space. But if your deck is focussed on getting a Charizard into play…maybe you want it that way?

  844. When you use smoke screen does it affect all your opponents Pokémon because it says it makes the defending Pokémon flip a coin?
    Nope. It just effects the defending Pokémon.

  845. So your saying if my Gyarados was knocked out by a fossil Golduck, would it remove an energy card before Dark Gyarados used final beam?
    You keep asking guys, we have to check with R&D. My understanding is that it would be knocked out BEFORE the remove energy card effect and so the Dark Gyarados would do 40 instead of 20.

  846. Last week I asked about the Clefable Metronoming Rapid Evolution, and you said it could evolve, but Metronome says to copy the attack, and R. Evolution says put Gyarados on Magikarp, are you guys sure about this?
    Yup, R&D confirmed it. You would replace the work Magikarp with the word Clefabel (as the ruling for Metronome is, always replace self-referencing with the Clefable/Clefairy). It would work (though only if you had a Gyarados in your deck of course.

  847. Suppose I have a TR Rattata on my bench, no cards left in my deck, and one prize left. Can I use TR Rattata’s “Trickery” Pokémon Power to switch that Prize into my deck for the win?
    Nope, sorry.

  848. Does evolving a Pokémon remove smokescreen effect?
    Yes it does.

  849. What is the big deal with the order for the attacks, if you just do what the cards say, don’t you get it in the right order?
    It can get confusing if there are relevant trainer cards; Pokémon powers and attack effects all being done in one attack. You have to know which ones resolve first.

  850. I’m sure you knew this, but you apply all text from an attack before you decide final damage (and K-Oing the Pokémon) So first you would flip to see if an energy is discarded from Gyardos.
    WRONG! You apply the damage FIRST and then, if the attack does anything other than damage, then you do that (which would be the Energy Card removal effect for Goldduck). Take a look at the rulebook.

  851. Electabuzz does thunder punch with a plusepower and he flipped tails does it do 20 to Electabuzz?
    Nope, pluspower only adds to damage done to the defending Pokémon.

  852. Does Blastiose’s (Base Set) Hydro pump do 30+ or 40 +?
    40+.

  853. Do I have to have an actual fire energy card attached to Ditto to do an attack that requires discarding of fire energy? Or would a normal energy or rainbow energy work?
    You could use any energy as all attached to Ditto (when he is active) can count as all-basic energy types.

  854. Can you use Rocket Garbage run to recover an already discarded garbage run?
    Do you mean Nightly Garbage Run? If so, then no, you can only bring back energy or Pokémon NOT Trainer cards.

  855. If I have two Rainbow energy attached to a Dark Charizard, and I flip two heads, can I discard the rainbow energy or do I have to have fire energy cards?
    You could discard the Rainbow Energy as they do count as all-basic energy types.

  856. Is there any way other than F.Gastly’s “Energy Conversion” to put a DCE back into your hand (not into the deck).
    Can’t think of any off of the top of my head, Pat?

  857. I heard that the defending Pokémon has to be asleep for 2 turns in order to use base haunter’s dream eater… does the TR trainer Sleep! Change this?
    The Defending Pokémon just has to be asleep when you try and use the Dream Eater attack. It doesn’t matter how you put it Asleep.

  858. Can I use 4 Imposter Professor Oak cards in one turn?
    Yes, you could if you had the 4 of them in your hand.

  859. Can you Raindance Rainbow Energy?
    No. Because it does not count as any type in your hand.

  860. If dark Flareon use playing with fire, do I have to discard a fire energy even though I flipped a tail? Does the same rule apply on dark Charmeleon’s fireball attack?
    For Dark Flareon you only discard a Fire Energy if you flip Heads. Same for Dark Charmeleon.

  861. What are Dark Muks attacks?
    Sludge Punch and the Pokémon Power Sticky Goo.

  862. If I put defender on my active Pokémon, then I put a rainbow energy on the Pokémon, the defender prevent the damage right?
    Nope. Defender only prevents damage from attacks only.

  863. If I have a Ditto as my active Pokémon and my opponent retreats his active Pokémon does Ditto change into the new Pokémon?
    Yes it does (as long as Ditto is not Asleep, Paralyzed, or confused).

  864. Can you ever knock out Mr. Mime on the first hit without him being asleep, confused etc.?
    If he does not already have damage on him? Nope.

  865. I was just talking about the Mr. Mime thing; I remembered about Nidoking’s toxic whatever… it would do 20, then 20 again for the poisoning, right?
    Yup! Very good, that would work.

  866. Are the rules difference because of the gym leaders? I ask this question because the gym I play in only allow 1 trainer card per term!
    Probably. There shouldn’t be any limits like that that I’ve heard of.

  867. Ditto’s active with 20 damage, they put mysterious Ditto’s active with 20 damage, they put mysterious fossil as their Pokémon is Ditto KO?
    I’m assuming you mean they retreat and bring up Mysterious Fossil. Ditto transforms into Mysterious Fossil, only has 10 HP but already has 20 damage so it goes to the discard pile. It does NOT count as a Knocked out Pokémon (last ruling by R&D) as it is a copy of Mysterious Fossil, which does not count as a Knocked out Pokémon.

  868. What exactly does curse do?
    POKÉMON POWER: Curse once during your turn (before your attack), you may move 1 damage counter from 1 of your opponent’s Pokémon to another (even if it would Knock Out the other Pokémon). This power can’t be used if Gengar is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed. It is a Pokémon Power on Gengar.

  869. How much damage is done to each Pokémon if Rapidash uses Agility(Heads) followed by opponent Dk. Wartortle’s Mirror Shell followed by Rapidash’s Agility(Tails)? Is it 0, 30, or 60? Take your time and think about this one carefully please. THANKS.
    We already have been thinking about this one and you will have to wait until we get an answer from R&D. My guess is that it would be 60 as Agility would NOT prevent Mirror Shell (it doesn’t refer to Rapidash). Then if Rapidash did 30 to Dark Wartortle the Mirror Shell would attack back for 30 (the word ATTACK is in the Mirror Shell description) and since Rapidash is weak to water it would be doubled to 60. However! That is my opinion and we will talk with R&D for the final official ruling.

  870. What does the DCI plan to do about the combo of Imposter Oak’s Revenge, Rocket’s Sneak Attack, and Team Rocket’s Trap? Or can’t you discuss that?
    No combo is unstoppable. I’m sure you clever Pokémon Masters out there can beat it.

  871. If Muk stops a Snorlax’s Pokémon power and poisons it, and Snorlax defeats it with Body Slam, is it still poisoned? (The power stops if confused, paralyzed, or asleep. Not poison.)
    Good question!!! Thick Skin states that Snorlax can’t BECOME asleep, confused, paralyzed, or poisoned. In this case he already is poisoned and I don’t think that the reactivation of the Thick Skin will remove the existing Poison.

  872. Do you feel Wigglytuff, is too powerful of a Pokémon? With the ability to do 60 damage resistance to Psychic and only two retreat, it can be absolutely devastating?
    Personally? Hmmm, he is fairly strong but not unstoppable.

  873. Can you evolve a Dark Alakazam from a Kadabra?
    Nope.

  874. If Alakazam uses Damage Swap on a Pokémon with Defender, is the transferred damage prevented?
    Nope, Defender only prevents damage from attacks, not from Pokémon Powers. Besides you do realize that you can’t use Damage Swap on the other player’s Pokémon, right?

  875. What’s the difference between Dark Pokémon and regular ones?
    Dark Pokémon are the Pokémon that have been raised by Team Rocket. Which means they are sneaky, conniving, and drink milk directly from the carton. They have different powers and attacks and usually have lower hp than the non-dark versions.

  876. Can you attach double colorless energy then another energy since it is not a basic energy card?
    Nope, you can only attach 1 energy card per turn (whether basic or not).

  877. If I have 4 electric energy on an active Zapdos and another Zapdos on the bench with one energy, can I use thunderbolt and discard the energy off the benched Zapdos?
    No, it means discard the energy off of the Zapdos that is doing the attack.

  878. At recent tournament: Clefable Metronomed Dark Wartortle’s MIRROR SHELL. On opponents next turn, Dark Wartortle evolved into Dark Blastoise, and it was ruled that Clefable’s metronome of MIRROR SHELL would have no effect on players next turn. What are R&D’s current ruling on that?
    I will have to check, it is unclear as to whom the attack SPECIFICALLY references. While it does mention the defending Pokémon it is only as a target of a possible future attack not as whom the effect specifically targets.

  879. Will a Pokémon that is retreated and activated the turn after Dark Jolteon’s lightening flash still have to suffer the coin flip? I would say yes, and as a precedent: jungle Eevee’s tail wag says “benching either Pokémon cancels the effect” yet Dark J?
    The Lightning Flash attacks effect references the Defending Pokémon. If that Pokémon is benched, evolved, or Devolved on the Defending player’s turn, then the effect is ended.

  880. Okay, Ditto vs. D. Charizard. Ditto has a DCE and uses repeated fireball. It doesn’t have an Fire energy cards, so can it not use it or something?
    Remember when Ditto is the active Pokémon, energy attached to Ditto can count as any basic energy type so he could use it.

  881. Okay, Mew vs Venomoth or something, Mew uses Devolution Beam on Venomoth, can he evolve back into Venomoth next turn?
    On the next turn? Sure.

  882. You said no combo is unstoppable. However, with heads flipped, the IOR-RSA-TRT combo used first-turn leaves the opponent with one card (the draw) in their hand. This doesn’t leave much in the way of countering the combos. Why not just ban IOR?
    Pokémon is supposed to be a game for fun, NOT hardcore competition (yeah I know we’ve been over this before). At this time (AND IT COULD CHANGE!) there are no plans on banning any cards. Besides 3 card combos don’t happen that often.

  883. Can a rainbow energy be used as colorless, dark, and steal energy?
    No, it can only be used as basic energy types.

  884. Can you use goop gas attack when Dark Vileplume is in play?
    Only if Dark Vileplume’s Pokémon power isn’t active.

  885. When you use Pokémon Trader, do you shuffle a Pokémon card into your deck or do you discard one?
    You shuffle it back into your deck.

  886. Can promo Eevee’s Pokémon Power be used on the same turn that Eevee comes into play?
    No, but you would be able to use it on the turn following that. In other words, if your opponent tries to evolve a Pokémon the turn after you brought Eevee into play, you could use Eevee’s power then.

  887. Can Dark Charmeleon evolve into Charizard, or does it have to evolve into Dark Charizard?
    Once you start down the dark path, forever will it dominate your destiny. (So, no, you cannot.)

  888. Is it possible for a Fossil Magnemite to use 2 Defenders to stay alive?
    You mean Magneton, right? Yes, you could save him with 2 Defenders

  889. When Charizard uses Energy Burn would it count as 2 Fire Energies on a Double Colorless Energy?
    Yes.

  890. Why does Dark Flareon’s playing with Fire say “only use this attack if there are any fire energy attached to Dark Flareon”?
    This type of wording is used on Dark Charmeleon as well and it’s designed to force Ditto players to actually have a Fire Energy on their Ditto to copy that attack.

  891. What if you put a Double Colorless energy on Ditto. What kind of energy does it produce?
    Two energy of any type.

  892. If you have a Clefable and your opponent is a Ditto, and you have only one energy attached to it, can you use Metronome to use Minimize?
    Yes, you can. Sorry 'bout that one…that question just about caused a brain hemorrhage.

  893. I am sure that DCE cannot be used to count for any specific energy like 2 water energy. Is this true?
    Well, not entirely, when a DCE is used on certain Pokémon it can sometimes count for 2 Fire energies, for instance.

  894. What does the suprise thunder of Dark Raichu?
    Surprise Thunder: Flip a coin. If heads, flip another coin. If the second coin is heads, this attack does 20 to each of your opponent’s Benched Pokémon. If the second coin flip is tails, this attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent’s Benched Pokémon. (Don’t apply Weakness and Resistance for this attack)

  895. Would you say that an energy removal deck is good against a Haymaker or not?
    Energy removal decks are not very successful against the new school Haymakers. The ones that use the movie promo Mewtwo.

  896. What is the advantage of a 4 basic energy type deck?
    There’s no advantage on it’s own, but if you use a wide variety of Pokémon with the 4-color energy supply, you will often have a good Pokémon for several different situations.

  897. Is there rule for Pokémon that allows the opponent to shuffle each others deck before starting the game. because people I play with stack their deck and they don’t allow me to even cut their deck.
    I don’t know if there is a specific rule on that (I’ll check for next week) but I would assume that they would at least have to shuffle it in front of you or cut their deck.

  898. Are the only basic energy cards the following: Fire, Water, Psychic, Fighting, Grass, and Electric?
    Correct.

  899. Could I use base set energy burn on a double colorless than use Team Rockets Charmander gather fire to move to it than evolve it to dark Charizard with Pokémon breeder and then could I use its fire ball attack and would I only flip once for it?
    Nope, Gather Fire will only be able to move one Fire energy and the DCE counts as 2 after you Energy Burn it.

  900. If you attach plus power to your active Pokémon and retreat it is it discarded?
    No but it only lasts until the end of the turn.

  901. If my Pokémon use Agility and get heads then on my opponents tern he benches his Pokémon does that end and if that Pokémon was knock would agility be still their for the next Pokémon that he sends up.
    Since the Agility Attack references Rapidash, only benching or evolving him ends the effect.
    Also since it only refers to Rapidash it would still be effect if the other player benched.

  902. Is Tentacool and Alakazam a good damage removing strategy via Pokémon powers moving 20 damage to Tentacool then removing him from play then playing him again then repeating it until all damage is gone?
    Yup, saw someone use that at the Seattle Mall Tour. Good idea.

  903. What do I do when I use an Energy Retrieval, do I discard the card do I trade to the discard pile or put in my deck?
    You trade it to your discard pile (essentially discarding it) to pull 2 basic energy from the discard pile to your hand.

  904. Can you lay a energy that’s basic and another that isn’t on the same turn?
    Nope.

  905. Can you use the Trainer Pokémon Breeder to evolve a Basic Pokémon into a Dark Stage 2 Pokémon?
    Sure.

  906. Can you use the attack Call for Family just to shuffle your deck?
    If you have one of the Pokémon in you deck you must put it on the bench. If you don’t (even if you know you don’t), you could still use the attack, look and not find the card, and then shuffle your deck.

  907. If you have a Kangaskhan in play and want to retreat it (retreat cost of 3) and the only energy you have on it is 2 double colorless energy cards, what happens?
    You would have to remove both DCE’s.

  908. Can you use cards that let you search for Pokémon (like Pokeball) to get a Dark Pokémon?
    Sure.

  909. My opponent’s active Pokémon is Vulpix, on his turn he attaches Clefairy Doll to Vulpix and says Clefairy Doll will “shield” Vulpix (take all damage) from my next attack. Is this correct?
    Not at all. You cannot attach Clefairy Doll to any Pokémon.

  910. Dark Charmeleons attack states that the attack may only be used if any fire energy is attached. Does this mean that Rainbow energy doesn’t work?
    No, Rainbow energy can count as fire energy.

  911. If you have two different basic Pokémon on your bench, can you evolve them both on the same turn (assuming it’s not their first turn on your bench)?
    Sure.

  912. If Dark Charizard is confused, and it’s tails and does 20 to itself, it doesn’t discard any energy right?
    Correct.

  913. Anytime during a battle, is you, or your opponent allowed to shuffle your deck?
    NO!

  914. Can you move 40 damage to Mr. Mime with Damage Swap and will it be prevented?
    Mr. Mime’s Invisible Wall only protects against attack damage, not damage moved there from a Pokémon Power.

  915. Earlier I asked about the fire energy only on Dark Charmeleon. If Rainbow Energy works, then what is the card referring too?
    It is worded that way so the other player could NOT Metronome that attack without fire energy (or a rainbow energy) being attached to the Clefable/Clefairy.

  916. Let’s say I have a promo Eevee and I go second. On my opponents second turn he evolves a Pokémon can I evolve Eevee?
    Sure.

scratchdesk June 26, 2017, 7:28pm 12

FAQs Continued:

Click on each spoiler to view entire log:

Pokémon Tournament and League FAQ - Circa 2000

Pokémon Tournament and League FAQ

ANNOUNCEMENTS

  1. Here is lots of info on the upcoming Super Trainer Showdown. When: July 22,2000 10 am- 7 PM Where: The Queen Mary Long Beach, CA. What is it? A Swiss Style Invitation-only tournament for 3 age division: age 10 and under, 11-14 years old, and 15+ and up.

  2. How do I earn an invitation? There will be qualifying tournaments at each stop of the Pokémon Mall Tour, which is listed on our web site. The top 10 ranked DCI Pokémon players will get an automatic invite. There will be International Invitations in each country to be earned/given out.

  3. And lastly, ANYONE who has earned 3 or more badges in the Pokémon league can take part! Other stuff: There is no admission to take part and there are lots of cool prizes to be given, including the winner of each age group will be given the “Master Trainer Champion” title!

  4. We are working on East Coast stops for the Pokémon Mall Tour, which should include Qualifying events for the Super Trainer Showdown in July in Long Beach, CA. Remember though, if you earn 3 badges through the Pokémon League, you can also be in it.

  5. We are aware of several misprints in the Team Rocket set. Any misprints that DON’T effect game play (such as Arbok’s 23000 copyright, Rapidash missing the word “length”, and the non-foil Dark FDragonite incorrectly numbered as 5out of 82, and Dark Raichu’s incorrect “Put Raichu on Pikachu” instead of Dark Raichu) will all be corrected in future print runs. The misprints that DO affect game play (The non-foil Dark Vileplume having Fighting as its Weakness and Grimer having a Poison Gas attack that puts the other Pokémon Asleep) will NOT be corrected. The game play effect misprints will be played as is, on the cards. When playing in an English League or Tournament, you will play these cards as is. If playing in an International event, then the cards will be played, as they originally should have been. This will be announced at those events beforehand.

  6. Pat and I (Mike) and our boss (Mike) will be at the Mall Tour Stop at the Sea-Tac Mall this weekend as well. Feel free to stop on by and show us your deck and try and stop Boss Mike’s “fearsome” Mr. Yuk deck!

  7. The STS Invitational Tournament (main event) will include three age categories: 10 & under, 11-14, and 15 and up. You must bring your badge book with three stamps, or invitation from a tournament win to participate in the main event. The event is Swiss format. Every player in this tournament will receive a minimum gift of a tee shirt and Tournament certificate.

Three first place winners (one from each age division) will receive a Gold Medal, 32 boosters, and a “Master Trainer Champion” Event Jacket and Cap. Three-second place winners (one from each age division) will receive a Silver Medal, 28 boosters, and an Event Jacket and Cap. Six third place winners (one from each age division) will receive a Bronze Medal, 20 boosters and an Event Jacket and Cap. Twelve fourth place finishers (four from each division will receive a Tournament Plaque, 16 boosters, and an Event Cap. Twenty-four fifth place winners (eight from each division) will receive a Tournament Certificate and 12 boosters. Forty-eight sixth place winners (16 from each division) will receive a Tournament Certificate and 8 boosters. Four hundred Sixteen runners up will each receive a Tournament Certificate. The 10 and under and 11-14 categories will be required to play with Base set and Jungle cards only.

The 15 and up category can use cards up to and including the Team Rocket set. There will also be King of the Hill Tournaments and various other side events. There will be NO admission fees charged for this event.

  1. Mall Tour changes: The June 24-25th Mall Tour stop in Oklahoma City has been changed to Houston, TX. The correct location for this event will be: The Woodlands Mall, 1201 Lake Woodlands Dr., and Houston

  2. Most of you have probably already heard that the STS format changed for the 2 youngest age groups. Here is the letter that is being sent out:

Dear Master Trainers,
Its true! Due to amazing customer feedback we have decided to add these two sets into the Pokémon card sets that can be used at this event in July. All age groups will be able to use Base Set, Base Set 2, Jungle, Fossil and Team Rocket. In addition all promo cards that have been released in English can be used as well. We feel that this will create the most exciting and interesting play experience for all the master trainers coming to the Super Trainer Showdown. Good Luck, Master Trainers, and have a great time!

  1. The STS will be a DCI Sanctioned event meaning some of the shenanigans we’ve heard about at some of the Qualifying events will NOT be allowed. If you are unsure of what the DCI rules for Pokémon Tournaments are check them out on our web site.

  2. Here is the TENTATIVE East Coast Mall Tour schedule. It is still being worked on and will most likely change but we wanted to give you an idea anyway:
    August 26-27 Troy, MI
    Sept 9-10 Towson, MD
    Sept 16-17 Cincinnati, OH
    Sept 23-24 Schaumburg, IL
    Sept 30-Oct 1 Independence, MO
    October 7-8 Alpharetta, GA
    October 14-15 Braintree, MA
    October 21-22 King of Prussia, PA
    October 28-29 Nanuet, NY
    Nov 4-5 Miami, FL

  3. Secondly Wizards is investigating the “alleged” incidents that took place at the Dallas STS qualifier. We cannot comment any further on this at this time.

  4. And last, we want to clarify about the STS. It is not a DCI sanctioned event (since it is tied in so closely with the Pokémon League) but it WILL follow and be run using the DCI floor rules along with the judging system.
    FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

  5. How can I tell where tournaments are being held?
    Check on our web site at events.wizards.com/dcitournament/Default.asp?game=PK

  6. Where will I get a dark Gyadose. Will I get it at the Pokémon league? there was none last week since it was Easter?
    The Pre-release Dark Gyarados’s were given out at all North American League locations last Saturday. If your location didn’t have any, call and check again, they might have been delayed.

  7. How do you join the league? I’ve looked on the website?
    Go to the closest league locations (such as Toys R Us) and sign up there. We have a list of all locations on our web site.

  8. What are the rules on foreign cards in DCI play?
    You can use cards that are copies of already released English cards only. And you must have at least 1 English copy with you for translation purposes.

  9. I’ve heard about a website that trainers can look up their own stats. Is that true? And If it is, what is the website?
    The web site is events.wizards.com/pARRanking/ . Keep in mind it takes us a while to get your stats in so it may be a bit behind.

  10. How much is it to join the Pokémon league? Is it free?
    Each location is different, most are free, some charge up to $5. Check your local location.

  11. How come the people who run the league at the wizards of the coast store charge a $1 every week to lay and $5 for a badge book when both of these are free at Zainy Brainy?
    It actually costs the stores money for the league supplies. Larger chains can probably afford to pay for it, and smaller stores probably cannot.

  12. Hey; I was wondering, what your plans were for the people who collected all 8 badges and 16 tms at the end of the Pokémon league and also when it is over will you guys be making a new league with the 16 badges and new tms from gold and silver?
    Hmmm, well we are still working on the plans for what happens at the end of this league (ends this July or so). Beyond that, we are still working on it.

  13. Are promos legal in tourney and league play? At one league store they say they are and at another they say they’re not?
    Promo cards are legal in tourney and league play (English promo cards that is).

  14. At my local Pokémon league, they gave away boxes and boxes of Mews (I got 64). Were they allowed to do that?
    Well, we did send out quite a few copies to make sure you all could get one. Exactly how they gave them out (as long as they are free) is up to each site.

  15. I’ve been to the Pokémon League personal web page and I want to know about the prices of cards and purpose there for do you send them to us or are they there just for show?
    They are just for show.

  16. Do you know if there are any plans to have Pro Tour type events with large prizes? Or is this the wrong person to ask?
    There are no plans for a Pro Tour yet. We are working on tournament formats for the future though.

  17. Any idea of plans for DCI accrediting of Pokémon Judges any time soon? I would assume that would go hand-in-hand with the tournament formats in the works? A customer service rep once told me that WotC considers Pokémon primarily oriented towards ‘casual’ play, but how can there be ‘serious’ play without accrediting and professional formats?
    Good question. There are no plans for official accrediting of Pokémon Judges at this time.

  18. Can online tournaments be sanctioned if the tourney director is a DCI judge?
    We don’t have any plans for sanctioned online tournaments at this time.

  19. Why do none of the Pokémon tours come to Canada?
    We are still working out this year’s Pokémon tour dates and locations, so I don’t know about this year’s yet. I believe the choices are made based upon population and mall interest.

  20. What plans are there for future Pokémon league giveaways?
    You join the League to earn your Pokémon badges. Anything else is just extra, it happens when it happens.

  21. I have agreed to run our Pokémon League’s first tournament in a month or so. Do you have to be a DCI member to be either the organizer or the head judge? In a related vein, is there a way to become a DCI member online, or only at existing tournaments?
    If you organize a tournament you automatically get a DCI number. Otherwise, you can get a DCI number through a tournament or through the League.

  22. What’s going to happen to league after all the cities have been traveled to?
    The League is in over 2700 locations in North America every week. If you mean the Mall Tour it is still being set up for this year.

  23. I am a DCI Member how come my personal web page won’t work?
    There are many thousands of league members and we are putting up your information as fast as we can. There is a bit of a lag though.

  24. How come the Pokémon tours always stop in NJ and not NY? So far only 1 tour has stopped in NY.
    Since the tour is so big, locations are based upon a mall’s willingness to host it.

  25. When do the seasons start of the Pokémon League?
    Different League locations are on different schedules, but I think season #4 should be starting soon.

  26. Will DCI sanctioned Pokémon tournaments allow Base Set 1 and Jungle Set after the release Base Set II?
    Yes, they will.

  27. How do you receive pre release Aerodactyl from a league?
    That card was sent out to Leagues last year. We do not have any more of them. Check the secondary market.

  28. Is there additional info on running DCI tourneys aside from the technical rules and regs available online?
    No, sorry there isn’t. I would contact others that have run tournaments and get their input.

  29. In The League, will Base 2 cards count towards completing the Base or Jungle Sets or must I complete Base 2 separately?
    No, they are different sets with different collector numbers.

  30. Will the web site continue to tell consumers about upcoming promos like with Mew and Jigglypuff?
    We certainly hope so.

  31. Can I get the Mew anywhere else besides the League?
    Like any card you can try to trade someone for a Mew if you were unable to get one at the Leagues.

  32. If I use Scotch tape to tape up one of my worn out card selves, will it be considered as “marked” in a Pokémon tournament?
    Yes, it would, sorry.

  33. Do you know of any stores that regularly host tournaments in the Seattle area? It seems like top-rated players talk of playing every week in a tourney though it seems around here (Seattle) it’s hard to find tourneys (ironic in the home of WotC).
    Have you tried our Game Center in the U district? I know they run them frequently.

  34. Do all Toys R Us 's have to have Pokémon Leagues? What if they don’t?
    In the US, yes.

  35. Do I have to have energy in my deck to play a DCI sanctioned tournament (ex: Super Stall with intent to deck opponent)?
    You don’t have to…how exactly are you trying to stall your opponent?

  36. How many badges are there total? So far I have seen 6 or 7 so far?
    There are 8.

  37. How does a store sign up to run Pokémon league at their location? (I want to run league at my store.)
    You would contact our Merchant Services department at 1-800-821-8028. They can help you with that.

  38. Do you have to sign up for the league to get the Arcanine promo card (my league is full)
    Probably, check other league locations in your area if that one is full.

  39. In DCI sanctioned tournaments can I discard a card because I don’t want it because it was an evolution I only had 1 of?
    No.

  40. Any plans for another Pokémon Card Tour (like current Stadium tour, but for TCG)?
    There will be a mall tour this year. I think they’re finalizing the schedule now.

  41. Are there any restrictions to using the “paper” coins that come with the preconstructed decks in tournaments or league play. ie: if they become worn, with curled up edges?
    None yet. When you start weighing one side down, I suppose we’ll have to do something.

  42. I have a Pokémon League question. My kids just finished up their first 6 weeks or “season”. Since they are new to this, they were unable to earn enough points to get a badge. Are these points now lost? Will they have the opportunity to get this back?
    They keep their points and continue working on badges until they get it. Then they start on the next one at that time.

  43. How long is each season of Pokémon TCG League?
    Generally 6 weeks.

  44. Any plans yet to have Wizards organize more ‘serious’ Pokémon gameplay, such as providing a means to become authorized DCI Pokémon judges, etc.?
    Again not that I am aware of. Pokémon is seen as a more introductory game into the world of TCG’s and strategy. Other games like Magic, or Star Wars, or 7th Sea, is a good place for people to go looking for more serious gameplay.

  45. If I did host a tournament for Pokémon, would it be counted as an official DCI tournament?
    If you get it sanctioned yes. Were have informational and the forms needed to get an event sanctioned available on our web site.

  46. Anyway to start an official Pokémon league without a store sponsor?
    Unfortunately, not at this time.

  47. Regarding the Pokémon League, is there a basic outline as to how they are run, or is it up to the location? Some I’ve seen only allow 12 and under to participate, while others don’t. Some give out Promos upon arrival, others when you get so many points, etc.
    This stuff is really up to the store or chain in question. We provide guidelines and suggestions, but every store has a different way of doing those things.

  48. Yesterday I received the new promo Mewtwo in the mail. Can I use it in a DCI tournament this weekend?
    If you’re talking about the movie Mewtwo, then yes.

  49. What is going to happen to the league after the seasons are all done and all the badges have been collected?
    Well, I do know that they are working out the logistics for a possible 2nd season. That’s all I know so far.

  50. Some of the gym leaders who run the league don’t know squat about the game, so many times I got screwed cause of it
    If you feel that the league location you go to isn’t being run well, first volunteer to help them run it. It’s a lot of work! Secondly you could talk with the manager of the store and thirdly you could email us about it as well.

  51. Speaking of Leagues and Gym Leaders unfamiliar with the rules and all… this was asked last week, but I think it was Pat who answered. In your opinion, what would be the best way for the masses (us) to impress upon WotC that we would like to see some sort of Pokémon Judge accreditation program, like MtG has? I think this would be a great step towards having Pokémon treated as more than just a ‘casual’ game.
    Well, pass along commentary to this forum like you have, send letters or email to WOTC but to be honest, I don’t ever see Pokémon being seen as more than a casual intro to strategy TCG games game. There are so many other higher level strategy TCG games out there, why would you want Pokémon to have banned/restricted lists, accreditation, etc? Most of the players are younger children that would have no chance against a hard-core card flopper, how fair would that be?

  52. I have a complaint about the Pokémon League I go to. Where should I send e-mail to Wizards about it?
    Send it to custserv@wizards.com and we will look into it for you.

  53. IF I REGISTER IN ONE OF THE LOCAL STORE, CAN I PLAY EVERYWHERE I WANT?
    Yes you could, though if you play at a location that is a season behind where you are at, they can let you earn points there, but you would need to go back to your original location to get the later badge.

  54. Is it Ok to use proxy cards with the original (like a Charizard) next to the deck in a top loader?
    As far as I know, proxies aren’t allowed in league or sanctioned events. Amongst your friends is up to you.

  55. I was reading the things set up a DCI tournament but I don’t know if you have to be approved in any way (I know you do for magic or to judge it)
    Not really, if you want to run a sanctioned event, you must submit the forms shown on our web site a few months in advance of the event and of course have space set up for the event.

  56. I read on www.wizards.com/Pokémon about a TCG tour in the UK. Will there be one in Ireland and if so, will they give out promo cards?
    Not sure, I would write to UK@wizards.com and ask them.

  57. How long does it take to have a personal trainer page on PAR?
    It should be up within 2-4 weeks after you earn your badges. If not, please ask your league to resubmit your DCI membership card information. Many leagues are not sending this in.

  58. ARE GYMLEADERS Allowed to give kids gym leader shirts for 20 dollars a piece and let them be gym leaders and give out free stamps to anyone that they want to?
    I don’t think so…

  59. How do you become a gym leader?
    You can become a coach by taking the coach’s test at the Pokémon Leagues, but to become a Gym Leader you have to work for one of the League Locations.

  60. So is the DCI number for LEAGUE and TOURNAMENT? And if it is for Tournament, how do we get tournaments in our area? I have not seen any yet!
    Yes, it is the same number for both. Check our tournament listings on our web site at events.wizards.com/dcitournament/Default.asp?game=PK. Just enter your state and change it to future events.

  61. So what if you have like 5000 points in the league already? Do you automatically get 2 mews?
    Nope, you start earning new points for the Mews when they come out.

  62. In the Official rules & regs for the Pokémon TCG League does it state anywhere that you may not battle a person twice in a row & still get the points earned? Can a Gym Leader make such a rule? We’re talking about 6 & 8-year-old boys here.
    Yes it does. It is stated in the rules that the Gym Leaders are being given.

  63. Where can we get more information about the Brock and Misty Challenge, if our league hasn’t heard about it yet? Or when will it begin at ALL the leagues?
    If it is not there yet, it should be there soon.

  64. My Pokémon Trading Card League Location allows trainers to battle a trainer up to three times. Is that legal?
    Nope, you are supposed to play a different Trainer after each match.

  65. How can I get a copy of the rules that the gym leaders are given so we don’t have any more surprises?
    Those are only available for the League Gym leaders. If you think that something is run awry, give us a call at Customer Service (1-800-324-6496).

  66. I registered with DCI at session 1 and haven’t seen my number on the DCI rankings (number is not valid) or some thing. Should I reregister we have a new gym leader I don’t know if the old gym leader sent them in?
    Yes you should reregister (but put your old DCI number on the form).

  67. Were there any world tournaments for Pokémon last year or was there something like that?
    There was the Tropical Mega Battle in Hawaii.

  68. What was that like? Did it have tournaments or was it just a show? And who won?
    We have several articles about it on our web site just search for Tropical mega Battle on our web site.

  69. Ok I am a gym Leader and is there any way to become an Elite Four Leader? Or is there such a Leader for the League?
    Not that I’ve heard of.

  70. What do you think of the thefts going on in many TCG tournaments, is Wizards taking steps to make TCG events a little safer for your cards?
    Of course we aren’t happy about that. We warn everyone to NEVER walk away from your stuff. You would never leave your wallet lying around, you should think the same way with your Pokémon cards.

  71. When will the Pokémon league end?
    This summer though there are already plans for another one after that.

  72. How are they going to keep track of the “points towards Mew”; is there going to be a separate League book for that?
    Nope, there should be a separate sheet for keeping trading.

  73. Do you know if there’s any time limit for earning the 250 points (i.e. eight weeks only)?
    Yes, you have the 6 weeks of the correct season to earn the 250 points.

  74. Does it cost anything to be a league center?
    No, but you must be a store.

  75. Since the players are taking Pokémon more seriously than planned will there be more and larger tournaments in the future?
    If the fan response continues to be high, yes.

  76. I’m from Fort McMurray, Alberta, Canada.we Don’t have a TCG league outlet. Could I still join in Edmonton, Alberta?
    Yes, you can still join there if they have room for you.

  77. Is Dark Charmeleon(from top deck) usable in DCI tournaments? By the way, the Rocket cards pictured in that mag look cool.
    Yes it is.

  78. I’m in the Pokémon league and they guaranteed that each member had a sort of dci ranking, yet I don’t have one. What’s wrong with the poke league?
    What do you mean? If you are not seeing yourself listed on our League Web Pages then your league didn’t send in your DCI sign up cards and you would want to ask them to re submit them.
    Actual DCI rankings are based on points you earn in sanctioned tournaments NOT through League play.

  79. If the Pokémon League has a DCI rating, then do just playing at the Pokémon League count for the rating or does the Pokémon League need to have some kind of tournament?
    No, they are two different things.

  80. Why are all the Pokémon leagues in Canada behind? I got my pre-release Aerodactyl 2 weeks ago!
    They started a few months later.

  81. Reading through transcripts sent to me, I noticed the past two weeks that you have said Wizards has another Pokémon event planed. And I know you are quite infamous for dodging the juicy questions! So all I want to know, is it going to be 12 and under again, or will you be doing it open to all ages or keeping it limited again?
    It will have 3 age groups, allowing all Pokemaniacs a chance to compete.

  82. Are gym leaders allowed to take all the extra promos and sell or trade them off? Because I know someone who does this?
    No, that is breaking the rules. If your league has this happening, please call cust serv at 1-800-324-6496 and report it.

  83. When I went to a mall tour the paper they gave me said you can post strategies on the official Wizards page of Pokémon. How do you post?
    We post strategies, but if you have some, send them in to cust serv.

  84. Regarding Proxies (copied cards): I have been using them for a while…and all of a sudden last week I get hounded for using them. I use black shield deck protectors. So there’s no cheating involved…can I be blamed for wanting to protect my Rare/Holos?
    Well, according to the DCI rules, the league and sanctioned tournaments don’t allow proxies. You still have to play with the cards to use them, sorry.

  85. First, I just want to say that you guys got good timing on releasing the holo mew the day before my b-day. And now to the Q: when I bought the Pokémon movie a few days ago, packaged with the Mewtwo card was a card saying “premier league qualifying events are on their way”. Whats that mean?
    Ah, there are plans for upcoming premier events similar to last year’s Tropical Mega Battle. When plans are finalized we will post the info on them on our web site.

  86. Is the promo Jigglypuff tournament legal, Is the promo #14 Mewtwo tournament legal and is my #10 GB Meowth tournament legal?
    Promo cards are only legal once they are officially released, so the Jigglypuff and the #14 Mewtwo are, the #10 Meowth is not.

  87. When is dark Gyarados coming to league?
    The pre-release Dark Gyrados will be in League stores starting April 22nd.

  88. What is the purpose of TM’s in the Pokémon league?
    Technical Machine stickers are something for league members to earn if they have already earned their badge for that current season.

  89. What happened to the contest for base set 2 and how down I get a winners list?
    Send us an email at custserv@wizards.com and we can send you a copy of the winner’s list.

  90. Will there be a Pokémon Trainer Showdown Battle (or something like that.) this summer?
    Yes, there are plans for a premiere event this summer. When we have details on it, it will be posted on our web site.

  91. The Pokémon League has a new activity called “Brock’s Challenge” where you get a special sticker if you get ten “victory points”. First question: is that 2pts.
    For win & 1 pt. for lose or ten distinct wins total? 2 points for a win, 1 point for a loss.

  92. What is the deal with the Brock and Misty Challenge in the League?
    They are just extra actives (like the TM stickers) for members to do once they’ve earned their badges.

  93. “Brock’s Challenge” rules state that you must play with “at least 5 Level 2 evolutions in your deck”, but what is considered a “Level 2 evolution”? Using the Gastly family as an example is Haunter considered Lvl 2 or is it Gengar?
    They mean Stage 2 cards, not level 2. So in this case it would be Gengar.

  94. What season (badge) is League supposed 2 be on?
    I think it’s the Soul Badge.

  95. Is it possible to get two badges in a season?
    Only if you are a new member and you are catching up.

  96. Are there any awards or “prizes” given away for completing the “Brock’s Challenge” and “Misty’s Challenge”?
    The cool shiny Brock and Misty stickers! woo hoo.

  97. What (if any) are the requirements for the Brock/Misty challenge?
    Once you’ve earned your badge that season, you can go for them.

  98. Is there a way to get the TM’s, after you get all of the badges, but you never got the TM’s.
    No sorry, the TM’s can only be earned in the current season after you win the current season’s badges. If you came in late, you missed out on the earlier TM’s.

  99. Do you have an idea what to do after the eight season ends?
    Seriously, there will be a new league starting soon thereafter.

  100. If you are a new member, can you skip the TM’s and go on for the next badge when you receive a badge before the end of the season, or will you have to wait until the next season?

  101. I meant: If you are behind several seasons, can you skip the TM’s on the season you are on, now that isn’t on the current season…

  102. Will Dark Charizard be released in the league?
    Not that I know of. Only in the booster packs.

  103. In the Pokémon league are they going to come out with the orange league badges?
    Dunno, keep in mind the cartoon is pretty far ahead of where our card releases and leagues are.

  104. Just to comment, The Orange league is the new Pokémon league in the show, its got 4 new badges and they are inquiring about the new league after the 8th season is over.
    Yeah, we figured it out. Though I don’t know what season, if any, we’ll be going to after season 8.

  105. Will you be able to get points for battling in the card game for gameboy?
    No, but you can work on your trainer skills.

  106. I checked up on my DCI rating lately and I am pretty upset. It has messed up my rating for the past 2 tournaments. The first time it got my number of wins right but it didn’t like add them up cause before I had 1834points and when they got my new rating it didn’t change and every signal time it changes. Also the second time I was cheated two wins and again my number of points didn’t change. And I’ve dropped from 90 in the world to 153 in the world. What can I do to change my rating how it should be?
    E-mail dci@wizards.com, for this kind of question.

  107. Do you need a DCI card 4 tourneys?
    Yes but you can sign up for a free DCI membership at sanctioned events.

  108. How do you become a Gym Leader?
    Own a business that is running the league. You can offer to become an Assistant Coach though at the league and earn points by teaching others how to play.

  109. How many points does it take to get a prerelease Gyrodos?
    Actually you don’t need points to get it.

  110. Is there an age limit to joining the league or is it up to the store?
    It’s up to the store. We don’t recommend age limits but if they have limited space or staff they may need to limit it to maintain a good space for the kids.

  111. How will you Clairify that anyone can get the card, with mew at my local league, they thought it was for league members only. Will their be a notice for it on the WOTC website so people can print it and show to league owners it’s not just for the league?
    We have sent out notices to the stores about this (like we did with Mew). If your local store does not follow this policy, contact us and we will fix it.

  112. Do you have to do a League Activity to get the PRERELEASE Aerodactyl?
    Nope, they were given out a while ago. We are out of them though.

  113. Oops, sorry, what I meant was do you have to do a League activity to get Dark Gyarados?
    You are given an activity when you get the card, your call whether you do it or not though.

  114. My Local League Store only has about 18 HOLO Mews that they just got in. They need more. Isn’t each store supposed to have 50?
    Each store was sent more than that. If they don’t have enough, they need to contact us (though I am suspicious of only 18).

  115. How do Gym Leaders get new promos?
    They are automatically sent to official league locations.

  116. 1Is it true, the badges are mixed up? One store I go to, is stamping the page with the badge pic and the other is stamping the next page witch one is right and they are mixing up every thing I don’t want two of the same badge and none of the other.
    The pictures of some of the badges were put in the wrong seasons in the book, yes.

  117. If everyone has received the new promo what does the gym leader do with the extras?
    Hold onto them for later members.

  118. What page should they be stamping?
    The correct season page (regardless of the picture).

  119. My Pokémon League store (Toys R Us) has been out of books for MONTHS, literally. Is there anything I can do to help them get their quota like e-mailing someone at WOTC?
    Ask them if they are contacting the correct person. If it is a chain store, they should be going through their District Managers. If they still have trouble, have them contact us.

  120. If I could not find holo mews any were, could you ask WotC to send you one?
    Unfortunately, no. You’d have to travel to the nearest city with a Pokémon League and camp out there until you earned the Mew.

  121. When will the poke-league come to England?
    Good question! I’ve heard it will be starting there soon! I would contact the UK WOTC office for specifies at UK@wizards.com.

  122. Out of the ten stopover locations listed on the new Pokémon TCG Tour, only two of those locations are east of the Rockies – one in Minnesota and one in Indiana. Will we be seeing more locations or additional opportunities to place for the Pokémon TC?
    We are working on setting up other Mall tour locations and they will be posted as they are finalized.

  123. All right so if you win a qualifier, will Wizards support you to get out to CA or do you have to provide your own ticket?
    Those kinds of specific questions are still being worked out. Watch the web site for further details.

  124. What’s “Swiss Style”?
    Points earned, paired against equally rated individuals pair you up.

  125. Why are all the Super Trainer Showdowns in the western half in the country? What about the East?
    It’s the only dates we have set so far. And its Mall tours that happen to have qualifying events. Anyone can join the league and earn 3 badges and go to the Super Trainer Showdown.

  126. How can “anyone with 3 or more badges” take part? Is there going to be a special side-event for non-invited players?
    No, anyone with 3 or more badges can just show up and register and take place in the main tournament (though there will also be side events as well).

  127. I have a tournament on Saturday. Will Team Rocket cards be legal or not?
    Yup, they would be legal, as they are released on that day.

  128. Are the Top 10 DCI Ranked automatic invites for each state or US or each country or global?
    Global.

  129. What if you cannot attend the mall stop in your area? I’m going to be out of town during mine but I really want to take part in the Super Trainer Showdown.
    Then earn 3 badges in the Pokémon League! Anyone can do it.

  130. If the Super Trainer Showdown is on July 22, and the mall tour ends then, if there are going to be more dates, I PRAY there will be a second Showdown, right?
    There are no plans for a second Showdown this year BUT there may be other upcoming events (and I have NO info to release yet so please don’t ask).

  131. If anyone with 3 badges qualifies for the Super Trainer Showdown, and then there will many, many thousands qualified. Can you handle it? (I’d hate to make the trip only to be told, “sorry, no more room.”)
    How many people are actually going to go all the way there to Long Beach though?
    If thousands show up, then we will handle thousands.

  132. What proof do you need to show that you have earned 3 or more badges at the league? Our Gym Leader didn’t send forms in and new GL is working on it.
    Provide the 3 or more badges you have earned.

  133. Will Prerelease TR cards be legal before the release date? Same thing for future series?
    Well, the prerelease card is coming out on the release date for Rocket so no issue there. In other cases, those pre-released cards are legal since they were released.

  134. I hear you, Pat, and “Da’ Boss” will be in the Twin Cities this week at Mall of America. I can’t make it sadly, but will you guys be at the STS and will you be on the Mall Tour?
    Pat has been bad and is grounded. I will be at the Mall of America though. Pat will be at Origins and I will be at Gencon. Come find us if you dare!

  135. Can you have tourneys in Pokémon league?
    Officially there is no support for that. The League and tournaments are two different things.

  136. What the rules on gym leaders having member help them, giving stamps giving promos, badges and cleaning.
    Gym leaders can give out points to members that help them organize, clean up, etc.

  137. K, I didn’t want to hang out on the chat all night. As an older player, do I have to complete an entire League season, or can I just test anytime to become a Coach?
    You can test anytime.

  138. Where can we find the rules regarding the Coach positions? Our local league (Gym Leaders anyway) state that we have to earn 600 points and take the test provided by I think DCI.
    The individual store has the right to set whatever requirements they want.

  139. I was checking my personal web page at wizards and u guys made a mistake. It says that I have already earned my volcano badge but has not yet reported that I got my rainbow and thunder badge how can you fix this.
    If there is a mistake you should email the correction to dci@wizards.com and webmaster@wizards.com. They will work on fixing it.

  140. I think they ought to have a 30+age category at the Showdown for all us PokeMoms & Dads who play the game with their kids?
    I will pass that suggestion along.

  141. Is there a way I can participate with the team rocket event if I live in California?
    We are suggesting all members go to their League locations on that same day to help defeat Team Rocket.

  142. Is there a way to participate in the super trainer showdown in Long Beach besides going to one of tcg tour locations and entering there?
    There will be update on our web site all that day, log on and watch the event.

  143. For the Brock’s Challenge I need 5 stage 2 cards in the deck can I have just the basics and breeders or do I need the stage one cards two. Can you recommend a good deck for this?
    You can use the Breeders to skip the Stage 1. As for a good deck? That would be what up to you to figure out.

  144. About the Misprint Vileplume? You mean if we go to league we use its weakness as fighting? Shouldn’t that be fixed?
    There is no way of doing errata for Pokémon cards. Keep in mind that most players are fairly young and play the cards as they read them.
    Think of it as an advantage, now you have 2 versions to choose from.

  145. Does the extra Dark Gyarados Prerelease get called back or does the Pokémon League continue to give them out until they’re out?
    They give them out until they are gone.

  146. Do all Leagues HAVE to do the Brock/Misty challenge thing(everywhere I go, the Leader goes “huh?”)? And What exactly is it
    No, those activities are optional for those trainers that finish earning their badge for that season.

  147. Does this mean that if I simply get 3 badges at a Pokémon league and transportation to California, I’m guaranteed to have a free cruise and entrance into the Super Trainer Showdown thing? Or is it-limited capacity?
    There is no cruise. The Queen Mary is dry-docked. But yes you could participate if you have 3 badges and get there.

  148. Will there be place for 15+ Pokémon players in the league?
    Depends on your location. We do not have an age limit set for the league. I do know some places have to limit due to space limitations.
    Try going to a larger league location in your area.

  149. Will the Dark Raichu be legal at international battles?
    Good question! To be honest, I’m not sure, I will find out though.

  150. Why did you chose to do single elimination in the Super Trainer Showdown? Wouldn’t double or Swiss rely on more skill instead of losing because of a bad draw?
    Because we’re expecting LARGE numbers of people at these and it’s difficult to keep the attention level required for several hours of Swiss-style play for many of the participants.

  151. When is Pokémon tournament in Long Beach?
    July 22, 2000

  152. If you were a winner in the Team Rocket contest, when will WoTC be contacting the winners for info to send the prizes?
    Not sure, you should hear from them soon.

  153. How do I get my information (badges earned, etc) sent in so I can qualify?
    Make sure that your league gym leader is sending in the forms every week. For the tournament, just show up with your 3 or more badges.(it may get verified against our master list).

  154. Can you get as many dark Gyrados as you want?
    I think they limit it to one per person as long as supplies last.

  155. Why does the Pokémon league ignore weakness and resistance?
    It shouldn’t be ignoring that.

  156. If I play in a DCI sanctioned tournament and use a misprinted Dark Vileplume, should I consider its weakness to be fighting or fire?
    If it is an English tournament, play the card as is. If it is an international tournament, play it as the correct version (fire).

  157. Will the organizers of a DCI tourney be able to tell the players to use the proper wordings of misprinted cards (Dark Vileplume’s weakness, Grimer’s Poison Gas), for the tournament, assuming of course they announce this before the tournament?
    The official answer is that you play the cards as is in any non-international tournament. If it were an international tournament you would play the cards with the corrected wordings.

  158. I was very surprised to hear that the Super Trainer Showdown Qualifying Tournaments (and thus probably the STS itself) are not being conducted under DCI tournament rules. After all, what’s the point of having DCI sanction Pokémon tournaments if not for major events exactly like this one?
    To be honest, I have not heard of this. We will look into it for you. Keep in mind though, that sanctioned tournaments are for serious competition. The Mall Tours are for players of all ages and levels and are to bring in new players as well as give the continuing players something fun to do. I don’t know the specifics though but we ill get an answer for you next week. Promise!

  159. Will gym 1 come out in June?
    Expect the first Gym set to make an appearance in late summer (probably August) are you already tired of Rocket? I think there’s some decent new cards in there.

  160. Do you have any information on the Poketour 1999 Pikachu? I want to know if Wizards officially produce it.

  161. Does Wizards have any plans to come in Virginia (close to Richmond) with a tour or something?
    We are working on setting up East Coast mall tour stops for later this year.

  162. Do many places in the U.S. have DCI sanctioned tournaments? And will they become more common?
