  163. Ok, so can someone sanction a DCI tourney under “international rules”?
    Nope, not unless its an international tournament.

  164. You said, “Keep in mind that sanctioned tournaments are for serious competition” in regards to the STS. And what would a national Tournament with multiple qualifying tourneys in over a dozen cities across the US be considered, if not a serious tournament?
    Guys! You can get into the National Tournament by earning 3 badges in the league. These qualifiers are a chance for some players to earn a free trip to the event.

  165. This is on behalf of Koribouros, who typoed and doesn’t have copy/paste: Mike, Pat – we understand that the core group in Pokémon is a younger audience. But I think WotC is not giving the kids a lot of credit. As I mentioned in a letter to WotC, kids can understand better than you might think. Errata: “Sorry, but that card was misprinted – when you play it, pretend that it’s a Fire weakness as opposed to a Fighting weakness.” “Oh, okay.” That’s not really that complicated, really. The only kids at my league who wouldn’t grasp that concept are those that don’t bother playing by the written rulebook to begin with, so where are they going to be harmed by errata?
    Okay, the question is, “are those card changes (mistakes) game-breakers?” They are not, so why are you pushing for errata? Didn’t you see the question where someone didn’t know what it was? Many people do understand errata but many others don’t. There is no official forum for errata to be spread out AND we can’t make changes from the original Japanese cards anyway so why are you pushing for a list of changes from the printed cards? Again, nothing is set in stone so this COULD change in the future BUT for now, this is the way it is.

  166. How do you get a free trip to the Super Trainer Showdown?
    You can win one through the mall tour and other possible avenues that are still being worked on.

  167. My question “What does errata mean?” was answered with a reference to tools . . . Is Tim Allen making a guest appearance or will you be able to define the term?
    Errata are wording that is added to a card to clarify how it works in certain game situations. Since the errata is usually distributed via the web it’s hard for some people to keep up on. Furthermore, sometimes people who have not been informed of current errata on cards will show up at tournaments and find out that their prized combo doesn’t work as they expected.

  168. Let’s talk about the errata a little more. It could be said that Mike and I have jobs because of the MOUNTAINS of errata on Magic cards. However, we both feel, and so does the people in charge of Pokémon organized play, that to start issuing errata for Pokémon cards would be starting on a road that we’ve already been down with Magic. Once again we will say that this COULD change in the future if need be. These mistakes do NOT seriously effect the game, if we made a mistake that did, of COURSE we would correct it. At this time, we believe that not issuing errata is the right choice for now so that everyone can compete without having to track the latest rulings on your favorite cards on the Internet.

  169. If you compete in the Pokémon Trading Card Game Tour, and you win the qualifier to go to the Long Beach Calif., will Wizards pay to fly me there?
    One person from each age group will win a trip at each Mall Tour stop.

  170. Where are we supposed to get our errata? Could you give a reliable source?
    Right now you don’t have to worry about keeping track of errata for Pokémon at all, because there is none.

  171. Ok, we just got some info. The Mall Tour qualifier uses standard Pokémon game rules NOT DCI sanctioned rules (as they are NOT sanctioned events).

  172. An opponent I was playing wanted to use a Japanese Dark Blastoise as a ‘proxy’ for a base set American Blastoise–claiming he recently lost the American Blastoise and couldn’t translate the Japanese card anyway. Is this legal for league play?
    Nope, they must have an English copy of the card with them in order to use a non-English card as a proxy.

  173. Of the top 50 rated DCI Pokémon players, 20% (10 of them) are in New York. Is there any reason why the Pokémon tour doesn’t have a stop within 500 miles of New York?
    The Tour did come to New York last year and we are working on East Coast stops for this year.

  174. What age do you have too be to have DCI tournaments for your own tournaments?
    There is no age limit per se, but there are location and space limitations though. We have the forms and process on our web site to get an event sanctioned.

  175. If you look it up, there was a Bilingual Exeggutor given away to Japanese & American kids in the Tropical Mega Battle last year. So is it legal for tournament play?
    Sure.

  176. You said you are looking into East Coast tour stops. Does this mean there may be additional stops before the July 22 event, or a second tour and second “finals” event?
    The East Coast stops will probably be later in the year (in the fall perhaps). We are also looking into a possible East Coast Premier event.

  177. If I understood a reply correctly, you can attend the July 22 even if you have 3 badges? you don’t have to get a gold invitation on the tour? Can you list what alternate ways you are allowed to attend the July 22 event besides making it to round 4 in
    Win a Qualifying event, earn 3 badges in the league, and be in the top TEN DC! ranked players in Pokémon, or finally, there will be invitations given to overseas countries that they will dispense as they see fit.

  178. Do all Pokémon leagues have the Brock/Misty challenge?
    It was sent to all locations, as to whether they choose to use it or not.

  179. How will the verifying be done? For example, I have the badges, and I have a DCI card, but I don’t have the book because my local League has an age limit…
    If you did not earn the badges through the league, then they will not be valid. Most league locations do NOT have age limits, I would recommend joining another location.

  180. I’m a local Gym Leader in New London, CT. Other stores in my area are giving away promos when they are not earned, or are stamping for seasons right up until the Earth Badge. What should I do if someone who has extra stamps comes to my location and wants more (and more promo cards) from my store?
    Well first of all if you know of any stores that are breaking the rules, please contact us and let us know so we can correct it. I would just inform these players how it is supposed to be done and that you will be doing it correctly. They should only earn and receive the promo cards from their original location.

  181. I want to take on the Mr. Yuk deck at the Mall Tour this weekend, where will you guys be at the tour?
    We’ll be milling about in disguise of course. You’ll find us. We will be at either League location at the Sea-Tac Mall, come find us.

  182. About Promo#16 “Computer Error”, my league started season six on Monday with no grids for points, do you think they will transfer points to it?
    They should, if they started season six already. Keep us informed if there are any troubles with this ok?

  183. How will Eevee and Computer error cards be obtained in the league?
    They can both be earned, like Foil Mew was.

  184. If I win a match and want to earn the holo Mew and/or the Computer Error card how will my book and grid be stamped?
    You earn points the same as usual. They should double stamp your book, once in the badge area and once on the card grid.

  185. At the TCG Tour, how have the qualifiers been going? How many have qualified to date?
    72 players get qualified at each Mall Stop. There have been 2 stops so far, so 144 have qualified through that. But don’t forget anyone that earns 3 badges at the League is also qualified.

  186. Any reason the latest tournament tour is not coming anywhere along the East Coast?
    We are working on setting up East cost stops.

  187. What is a link to all of the facts for what is going on at the Super Trainer Showdown?
    I believe they will be updating and posting information on it soon on our web site.

  188. Hey I live in Kentucky and I can’t seem to find these “tourney tours” or at least never heard of em, anyway I can find out about em?
    We have a tournament locator on our web site at events.wizards.com/dcitournament/Default.asp?Game=PK
    Check it out!

  189. Will MT Mike or MT Pat or Boss Mike be at the Del Amo Fashion Center in Torrance, Ca.? Or do we have to “catch” you at the Queen Mary?
    Some of us will most likely be at the Super Trainer Showdown, details still being worked out (Meaning we are still begging to go).

  190. Are you guys working on new badges to earn at the league?
    We’re looking into a Pokémon League year 2.

  191. I heard that there aren’t many DCI Pokétourneys yet. Why don’t y’all try sending out info to different League stores or something? I would love to join one of those tourneys.
    Actually there have been over 7400 sanctioned Pokémon tournaments since it all started over 2800 this year alone 9around the world).

  192. What are the usual hours for the tournaments that wizards are hosting?
    It all depends on the location, contact them for their hours.

  193. To clarify a past question: in the league, are players supposed to play other players only once per session?
    No, but you shouldn’t play the same player twice in a row.

  194. How many leagues received the prerelease Clefairy?
    You mean the prerelease Clefable? I don’t know exactly how many stores got it, but I know it was one of the first promos released. Many of the stores that received it were test locations for the league before it was launched.

  195. At my league we are only aloud one holo Mew. Are they aloud to do this and what can I do?
    Yes they’re allowed to do that, though you _should_ be able to earn two.

  196. What is Pokémon League?
    A place where people who enjoy Pokémon get together every week to play, trade, and talk. Check out our web site for league locations in your area.

  197. Is it legal to use a Japanese Mew at a tournament at which promos are not allowed?
    Dunno, English promos are usually allowed.

  198. If our league has not received Computer Error, whom can the gym leader contact to find out more information?
    Depends on which league location. They should contact whom ever orders their supplies. For chain stores like Toys-R-Us it’s usually their DM’s. For individual stores, they would call our Merchant Relations department.

  199. My Gym leader says he has Dark Persian Promo #17 in fact he might bring it in on Monday for me to see. Do you know how he could have got it?
    Yes.

  200. Do you guys ever tell league locations these rulings?
    We do our best to get the info out. It is also up to you as Pokémon players to inform them too. We do have a newsletter we send out every month to them.

  201. Is it possible to lose your League at a store if it adopts the Japanese ruling of banning certain cards?
    Dunno, they would have to talk to our League folks on that one.

  202. Is it possible to earn all 8 badges as of now?
    Nope, its up to Season 6 so at most you can have earned the first 6 badges

  203. In the league, are Japanese cards allowed without having English translations? At a WOTC league (my first visit at this location) they allowed Pinsir & Zubat in this boy’s deck. Pinsir’s HP was different than the English version, so it was not the s?
    No. The rule is you MUST have an English translation of that specific card there to use any Japanese cards.

  204. Will Pokémon have a national tournament like Magic?
    Not quite the same way no, but the Super Trainer Showdown is a premiere event. We are working on setting up one for the East Coast later this year too.

  205. What will be the reward for playing and winning (fingers crossed) in the STS in LA (besides of course bragging rights)? Will this tournament and qualifiers be DCI rated?
    The qualifiers are not DCI sanctioned since we wanted to be able to get the most number of people through so everyone can try. If it was sanctioned it would take a lot more time registering people and signing up people for the DCI. I don’t know if the STS will be sanctioned or not.

  206. How do you get 10 points in the tcg league for having the complete team rocket set?
    Show the league leader and they will stamp your book.

  207. What is the league consensus on penalizing cheating?
    It all depends on the circumstances. If it were deliberate and continual then the League would have the right to ask someone to not come for a week in order to show them the severity of what they are doing.
    But it really does come down to the situation.

  208. What happens when all seasons are over? What will happen to the Pokémon Leagues?
    There are future events being planned.

  209. Are there any rules about distributing promo cards in the tag league, some gym leaders only give one to each person?
    Each card is different. Most of them you can earn 2 of.

  210. Can I use a copy of a card instead of the card itself?
    This is usually called a proxy. This is not legal for tournament play, but you’re welcome to do this in informal play if you want.

  211. Is there a second online TCG League Newsletter in the works yet?
    Yes, there is, though I don’t know when it will be sent out.

  212. Will there be multiple Super Trainer Showdowns, or only the one in Los Angeles?
    We are hoping to have that one in LA…and perhaps later…one on the east coast…remember, this is all hypothetical.

  213. What promo do you get with the soul badge?
    I believe that one is #16 Computer Error.

  214. Will you ever bring a huge league from Wizards Of the Coast To Green Bay Wisconsin?
    The league is already there…just check your local Toys R Us, Zany brainy, or Waldenbooks to see if they have one. If they do, sign up at one of those stores.

  215. How can I obtain a Prerealse Dark Gyarados can you send me one?
    You can check to see if your local league location still has those to give out. They were originally given out when TR came out.

  216. Do you have to be invited to play at any of the Super Trainer Showdowns (apart from LA) or can you just show up?
    You can just show up…but make sure you have obtained at least 3 badges.

  217. Tournament question: I play an unsanctioned tourney every weekend, but I’d like to get ranked. Is there any way I can start a sanctioned tourney, or get a League location to start one?
    Sure, check out the DCI sanctioning section on our website for more info.

  218. Will there be something after you get the earth badge and tms and the stickers and certified coach in league?
    I have been told that Wizards is working on something for people who have all the badges.

  219. If you didn’t win a tournament to enter the STS is there another way to get in besides the contest?

  220. At the TCG Tour we were told that only people who qualified at the Tour could participate in the STS. However, on previous chats we were told if you had 3 or more badges you could participate. Which one is correct or are both correct?
    Both statements are correct actually. Earning 3 badges counts as qualifying.

  221. To show proof that you have 3 or more badges MT Pat told me in an e-mail to bring those badges and my DCI number. All of my family member’s DCI numbers are not in the system. One registered in Oct. 99, another in Jan. 2000 and I, on April 1st.
    I’ve been told by the person setting up the STS that trainers should bring their badges and DCI #, if you’re not in the system yet(as far as the DCI #'s are concerned) don’t worry about it.

  222. At the TCG Tour I came across some people who roll a die instead of flipping a coin for status effects. Is this legal in a DCI sanctioned event?   223. Can the Gym Leaders request more copies of the forms for Brock’s and Misty’s Challenge?

  224. Is there any new info on rules, tournament format (Elimination or Swiss)or other new details for the Super Trainer Showdown on July 22nd?

  225. To qualify for the 7/22 tournament, you need 3 badges correct? Does the league pretest badge count?
    No, only the 8 main badges count.

  226. Are we supposed to charge kids to join Pokémon League?
    That’s entirely up to the store you can choose to charge or you can choose not to.

  227. I’m a Gym Leader and I received Misty and Brock stickers and sheets, but NO instructions on using them. How do they work?
    Give us a call at Customer Service and we’ll try to get an answer for you.

  228. Nothing in my instructions said the kids can only earn Holo Mews during one season, but I heard that’s true. Is it? I still have lots of kids with stickers, and quite a few mews.
    You have authority to continue letting kids earn those if their wasn’t specific instructions prohibiting this.

  229. I’ve seen reference to “signing up for next season”. What does that mean? I thought they fill out DCI card once, get a book, then that’s it. They come when they can.
    Well, you should still keep a sign-up sheet so you only sign-up as many people as you can handle.

  230. Is the Brock and Misty challenge coming to Canada? Our league never seemed to get it?
    I imagine that you’ll get those activities eventually.

  231. My league location temporarily shut down. Will they replace the promos they missed?
    That depends if your League organizer continued to order the League kits.

  232. Will Dark Raichu be legal for international tournaments?
    I think it will depend on how fast the distribution goes for the Rocket Cards internationally.

  233. If we finally finish handing out enough Mews to fill the replenishment sheet, is it too late to send it in to get more?
    I believe so, though you’re welcome to try.

  234. Am I the only one that thinks letting anyone with 3 badges in to the STS will allow too many people in? Is there any limit?
    Don’t know that yet first they have to get to L.A. ya know?

  235. Is it true that you can only use Base, Jungle and BS2 cards in your deck for the STS for all age categories? Will movie promos (First Movie or P2K) be allowed?
    Well, as answered in the opening notes, the age 15 and up group can use Fossil and Rocket as well and it looks like promos will be allowed BUT that is still being verified.

  236. Our Gym Leader said we could not do Lt. Surge or Erika’s Challenges until we earn the Soul Badge. Is that true and why?
    The Challenges are activities that are there for active League members to do AFTER they have already earned their badge for that month (like the TM stickers).

  237. How long does it take to receive your invitation to the STS? Who do you contact if you still haven’t received it, especially by July 22?
    Well, it takes a few weeks after the event you were in. If you don’t receive it after a while call us at Cust Serv at 1-800-324-6496 and we will help you get it. They will have a list of the Winners at the door of the STS too BTW.

  238. Will there be a cost to get on the Queen Mary to attend the STS?
    NOPE.

  239. Can the 15+ age group use fossil cards at the super trainer showdown?
    Yup, and Rocket too.

  240. Why the heck are only Base and Jungle allowed at STS for 14 and under? It like Type II from he|| or something!
    There will be players from Europe taking part and they do not have Fossil and Rocket available to them yet. It’s to keep it a fair and balanced tournament for all participants.

  241. Will Cool Porygon come to the league?
    Yes, eventually.

  242. Why did you only make the STS for the West Coast? There are good players over here on the East Coast. Will you make a STS for the East Coast?
    Actually anyone can take part in the STS as long as they’ve earned 3 badges or won an invite. There are plans for an East Coast tour and an East Coast Premiere event for later this year though.

  243. I got an STS invitation, but not a free trip. Can I enter the free trip contest on wizards.com to try to win a trip?
    You are eligible to enter, yes.

  244. Will we be able to use promos in the super trainer showdown?
    As far as we know (and this may change), you can use any English released promo cards.

  245. What promo cards, if any are allowed at the Super Trainer Showdown?
    All English ‘released’ promos.

  246. I know the Base/Jungle rule at STS is supposed to be fair, but in the end it’s not fair to US players. We have specially built decks around Fossil and Jungle cards, and without that, we will be ruined.
    Just deal with the format and be a good sport about it.

  247. At the mall tour, will Fossil and Rocket cards be allowed?
    Yup.

  248. Is League Cool Porygon being changed? And it is season 8’s promo?
    I don’t know for sure at this time. I don’t think it will be part of season 8.

  249. Tournament Organizer Question: Is it a requirement that a player under 10 not play against a player over 15, or is that just a guideline? If the last 2 undefeated players are under10 and over 15, shouldn’t they play against each other?
    For sanctioned tournaments; yes. For others; it just a guideline.

  250. Can you use a Japanese card if it is printed in us?
    Its the usual rules, you can use a Japanese card as long as it was already printed in English AND you have an English copy of that card with you for translation purposes.

  251. This is Scott Gerhardt, Assistant Webmaster for Pojo.com. We have heard rumors as to the prize support for the STS in Long Beach to be nothing more than a box of packs, a medal, and a jacket.
    Do you know what the prizes were for the first Magic nationals? Less than is being offered for the STS.
    The point of Pokémon and the STS is for the enjoyment of the game and of Pokémon. NOT trying to make a buck. There is NO charge for admission for the STS. There will be plenty of side events AND people do not have to go if they don’t feel it is worth there while. Plus, the prizes will be spread out over many more participants. This isn’t supposed to be National championship guys. This is a community event for the enjoyment of the game. There will be all sorts of free stuff for all who participate.

  252. Why are stores based against older players?
    I don’t know, a store may have to limit the amount of players that they can handle and sometimes use age as a limiter.

  253. How come they won’t have the mall tour go to Oklahoma City?
    The Mall that it was scheduled in for Oklahoma City canceled it on us so we had to relocate it quickly.

  254. Will Wizards post the STS information somewhere on their website?
    It should be up soon one it is finalized.

  255. Are there any requirement’s to hold a league tourney?
    Well, we have information on getting a tournament sanctioned on our web site.

  256. What is the King of the Hill Tournament?
    It starts with 48 players, 24 will win. Those 24 stay to play another 24. This continues until each person loses once (and they are done) or they win 3 games. Then the best records and score will win overall.

  257. How will the Gym cards be layed out? Where will the Gym leader badge go?
    I believe they will look the same as the originals.

  258. How can I become a master trainer?
    Join the Pokémon League and earn all 8 badges.

  259. How do you plan to handle a tournament of such magnitude in a single day? Seems that would be an awful of people to try to get going in a 9-hour period.
    We will have a very large staff handy and it is a single elimination contest (for the main event anyway). There will also be many side events. We have run large events for many years now and know how to do it.

  260. Is there any limit to people at the STS? And if so, do people who won invites have a better chance of getting in the door?
    No limit that we know of. Whatever the limit is for the Queen Mary.

  261. Will there be a tropical mega battle this year?
    It is being worked on.

  262. Will either Master Trainer Mike or Pat be at the Queen Mary?
    Yes we will be there.

  263. Will Eevee Promo be gotten by doing the same thing for Holo Mew / Computer Error?
    Yup, gotta earn them points!

  264. In the Pokémon TCG League, what will happen after all the seasons’ end?
    That is still in the works (along with a possible 2nd year of the League).

  265. So. Want to make ANY comments on the Dallas, TX STS and anything you have heard about it?
    Well, like mentioned in the opening announcements, we were sad to hear of “reported” unsportsman-like conduct. Rest assured that the STS will be a DCI sanctioned event and that sort of “ruining the game for everyone” won’t take place. To be honest, we never suspected that this sort of thing would happen. Our bad in being too trusting I guess.

  266. What shenanigans are you referring to about the qualifier? The 4-minute turn? What is the time limit for a turn?
    Can’t comment on specifics as we were not there and we are hearing about it second hand. Check out the Pokémon DCI tournament rules on our web site to learn what is and isn’t allowed.

  267. Are any of the master trainers going to play in the STS? Your self included? Can you please give the names of the master trainers that will be playing?
    Well, Master Trainer Pat and I will be there and so will Boss Mike and possibly some of the other Trainers here from WOTC. We won’t be playing in the STS but we will be there to help run the whole shebang.

  268. Will Ancient Mew be tournament legal?
    Not for the STS no. Beyond that, I dunno.

  269. Is it possible for a league to ban a person because the person is “too old”? (Over 12)
    Each league location runs the league as they see fit. I’ve heard of some locations having to limit (due to pace consideration) and have been using age as a way to do so. The are allowed to do this if they choose. Yes, that’s up to the League stores.

  270. Your letter about the STS rules changed starts “due to the amazing customer feedback…”, just how many people called/wrote and complained?
    Well Pat and I whined a lot!

  271. All right, I’m gonna try and juice this out of you guys. The East Coast tour will happen after the Super Trainer Showdown in July no doubt, but are there any plans for another STS of sorts… or will the East Coast tour gain people entrance to Hawaii Tropical Mega Battle 2000… or is it just for fun?
    No, seriously, they’re looking at doing an “STS” type event for the East Coast there’s just nothing concrete we can tell you right now.

  272. What season should the league be on?
    I think it should be on season #7(Volcano Badge)

  273. Is their any prizes on the tournament on the Queen Mary?
    Yes, the list was given last week. I know I saw it posted on Pojo.com.

  274. How come some people at the Pokémon TCG League in Monrovia California let people use fake cards? I don’t mean counterfeit but home made fan cards?
    Ummm…they shouldn’t be (not for the League anyway). If this is the case, please email and tell us about it and we will look into it.

  275. Is there any other way to go to the STS on the Queen Mary besides three badges and an invitation?
    There have been some contests and the top 10 DCI ranked Pokémon players in the world get an automatic invitation as well.

  276. Can you be disqualified at the STS by having a disability (wheelchair, for example)?
    Of course not!

  277. Will tickets be required for entry to STS like the Showdown battles last year, or will it be first come, first serve? Because if it is first come first serve, that’ll be really hard for people like me coming from Texas.
    It will be first come first serve though line cutting and stuff like that WON’T be allowed.

  278. Will the tcg tour stop by New York? I live here and there are not many tournaments or events.
    There are a LOT of tournaments in New York. Check out our online tournament search engine at events.wizards.com/dcitournament/Default.asp?game=PK There will be an East Coast Mall tour and premiere event later this year.

  279. Will there be any independent vendor tables at the STS, like the ones at conventions?
    Good question! To be honest, I have no idea. I will try and find out.

  280. Will there be another Tropical Mega Battle in Hawaii? How do you qualify for it?
    There are plans for it. Specifics on it will be posted when they are ready.

  281. If Ancient Mew is double sided, won’t that make it illegal in tourney play without opaque slips?
    IF it ends up playable, then yes, that would be true.

  282. You said that the Queen Mary STS will be “first come first served”. Will those with invitations be allowed in ahead of those with 3 badges? Or must we all get in line at 6:00 a.m.?
    Guys, to be honest, not THAT many people will make long trips to this event, it will be mostly the trip winners and local players. We are planning on handling as many people that show up though.

  283. Is Pokémon TCG for 10 and up? (My friends don’t believe me, they think I’m too old)
    It is for whomever wants to play it.

  284. I meant, is the game marked for 10 and up. I thought I saw it on the waterblast deck, but I lost my box…
    It is recommended for ages 10 and up.

  285. How many rounds of Swiss, for the STS?
    It is usually 5 rounds (though this can vary due to size).

  286. I will be attending STS with my very young son, both of us will be playing in the main tourney - will it be organized enough that I don’t need to worry about him getting lost and confused about where he is supposed to be?
    It will be organized but it will be a very large tournament. If you feel your child might get confused you should probably stay with him until he knows where he is going.

  287. Will you be giving special promo cards to the winners at STS?
    Not that I know of but they will get medals and special jackets, hats, and free product.

  288. Will the Pokémon league stop after season 8?
    There are plans for future League events and possible continuance, no specific info available yet.

  289. Have the Europeans been informed that we (Americans) will be using Rocket and Fossil cards? What will happen when they don’t know what a card does and has trouble reading English?
    They are aware and they will be taught about the new cards before they get here.

  290. When does the STS begin, end, and how long does it last?
    July 22nd, scheduled 10am-6pm on the Queen Mary in Long Beach, CA.

  291. What is the prize for winning STS in your age group?
    The overall winner will get a gold medal, event jacket and hat, and lots of Pokémon cards.

  292. In the STS, will the prizes taken in each match determine the score of the tournament or just the outcome of a match?
    Read up on the DCI Pokémon floor rules, they will cover the specifics. Other details to follow.

  293. A trivial question yes, but what kind of boosters is the STS’s going to have as prizes?
    My understanding is that it will be a combo of different Pokémon sets.

  294. Since the league is almost over for the Pokémon tcg, are there any plans for a new one?
    It is being worked on.

  295. I’m 35, and I want to start a gym how can I make it official?
    The official Pokémon League is a program run through participating retail locations only. If you have a storefront then contact our Merchant Relations department and they can help you set it up.

  296. What are the ways to qualify for the super trainer showdown?
    Win an invitation at one of the qualifying tournaments, win an invitation in Europe, the top 10 DCI ranked Pokémon players get an automatic invitation, or earn 3 or more badges through the Pokémon League.

  297. Will the super trainer showdown be DCI sanctioned and count towards our records?
    No, it is not DCI sanctioned but it WILL be ran using the DCI floor rules and judging system.

  298. Why aren’t Japanese proxies allowed at STS? (Like say, if I use Japanese Full Heal or something, or Japanese Scyther)?
    You can use Japanese cards as LONG as you have an English copy of the card with you for translation purposes, it is a card that has been already released in the states, and lastly you must use opaque card sleeves since the Japanese cards have different backs on them.

  299. Will there be promo cards given out to winners of the STS?
    There might be a promo card given out to all participants.

  300. What do you plan to do about people who have 3 badges, but couldn’t make their local STS qualifier and can’t afford to pay for the trip themselves?
    This is just a tournament much like any other one that takes place across the country. Do they pay your way there? If you have earned 3 badges and plan on going to the STS please bring your badge book along as verification.

  301. Can I receive points at Pokémon League for completing Team Rocket?
    Yes, though I don’t think there’s a place to check that one off. Just have your Gym Leader write it in.

  302. Will the master trainer showdown be held aboard a boat, or is the Queen Mary a place?
    The Queen Mary, as I understand it, is a decommissioned luxury liner that is now used for conventions and stuff.

  303. Pardon me, but if Pokémon is supposed to be just for fun and not for hard competition then why do you guys have leagues?
    Leagues serve other purposes too. Like providing a place for people to gather and play and helping people learn how to play the game.

  304. I have heard allot about the League, and is it true that the games are timed? If so, how long do you get to play one game?
    That would be up to the individual location. I’ve not heard of league games being timed.

  305. Why doesn’t Wizards hold the STS in Seattle? It would be easier for you and me guys!
    We like to travel. Also LA is a larger local market.

  306. Are adults allowed to join the Pokémon TCG League?
    Generally, yes.

  307. Is there an upper age limit for Pokémon Tournaments?
    It depends, the STS has 3 ages groups, 10 and under, 11-14, and 15 and up.

  308. Since there’s players coming from all across the US, and even from Europe as well, wouldn’t the STS be the perfect time for DCI sanctioning? And it’s not going to be? is that for sure?
    The STS is very closely tied in with the Pokémon League, which is NOT a DCI sanctioned event. Since many of the players coming have not ever taken part in an actual sanctioned event it was deemed that it would be too intrusive to do so. However, we will be following the DCI floor rules and judge system to help maintain a fair and fun tournament for all.

  309. I am a gym leader at Toys R Us how can we get information on having a league tournament.
    If you are looking to run a sanctioned event, we have the submission process on our web site.

Pokémon Miscellaneous FAQ - Circa 2000

Pokémon Miscellaneous FAQ

ANNOUNCEMENTS

  1. Once again we’d like to say that we do read through the various popular unofficial web sites and see and pass along your concerns. Nothing is set in stone here at Wizards and there are always ongoing discussions about Pokémon and its future. Please feel free to pass along any comments or questions you have to us here at Customer Service at custserv@wizards.com and we will always pass them along for you.

  2. A big thank you to Evil Bob and to Koribouros for sending me a Weedle card for the upcoming Space Weedle. Thanks guys! So if you TOO want to be a part of Space Weedle history, please send your extra Weedle cards to Master Trainer Mike c/o Wizards of the Coast PO Box 707 Renton, WA 98057. Please sign the front of the Weedle card and when we get enough we will build the Space Weedle and get pictures of it up on the web for you. If we get enough cards in time you may also see it at the Super Trainer Showdown and other events in the future as well.

  3. I also wanted to thank all of you that have been sending in the much-needed Weedle cards. You all rock! The Space Weedle will be up soon! If more of you want to be a part of it, then please send your extra Weedle cards to:
    Master Trainer Mike c/o
    Wizards of the Coast
    PO Box 707 Renton, WA 98057

Don’t forget to sign the front of your cards so the world can see how generous you are. Once it is up we will post pictures and I will list all of the great contributors to this cause.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIIONS

  1. Ok, and will you put in Japanese rules soon?
    We don’t have anything to do with the Japanese rules per se.

  2. Do you plan on bringing the gold and silver Pokémon from Japan, into English conversion?
    There are no specific plans as of yet. We are still negotiating with Nintendo about that possibility though.

  3. Does WOTC release print run statistics? If not, why not (You are a publicly held company now?)
    Though we are a publicly held company, we are not obligated to release that sort of information.

  4. I heard that DCI is going to ban the cards Computer Search, SER, and Pro. Oak, is that true?
    There are no plans to ban any cards at this time.

  5. I don’t know if this is Wizards area, but what sets will be available in the Pokémon card game for the Game Boy. I know in the Japanese there is promos and up to Fossil but since we have none of the promos in the game, will you add cards from the Rocket version or any other sets?
    Sorry but that is up to Nintendo.

  6. Are there any plans for wizards to make their own Pokémon cards not from Japan?
    There are no plans at this time to do so.

  7. Some people are saying, with all the cards and added confusion, Pokémon will be like MTG. Any plans to avoid doing this?
    Pokémon is much more basic than Magic, think of Pokémon like Checkers and Magic like Chess (but with many more pieces).

  8. How much does 1st edition worth right now?
    Sorry, but we don’t keep track of card prices; a card is worth whatever you can get for it.

  9. I missed the Pokémon Jr. Adv. chat. When will Pokémon Jr. 2 be released? What licensing problems are you having? When will the more advanced version of Pokémon Adventure (RPG) be released?
    We are still working out schedules and negotiations with Nintendo for the expansions for the Pokémon Jr. Adventure game, so we don’t have specific dates yet, sorry.

  10. Does WotC have the ability under their contract to alter or adjust rules? And are they likely to?
    The answer is yes but we have no plans on doing so, outside of making it easy to understand.

  11. Is there any plan for a Pokémon Duelist style magazine?
    TopDeck has articles on Pokémon every month.

  12. Will anymore CDs be released with promos like Japan with there 10 promos in one CD?
    There are no such plans that I know of.

  13. Where can Pokémon TCG fans make suggestions to Wizards of the Coast?
    Send email to custserv@wizards.com

  14. Do you plan to have a card list like Decipher.com/ use to look at cards for Pokémon TCG?
    We do have card lists on our website already. We are working on an improved list that will be up soon.

  15. Will Pokémon accessories like coins, damage counters and such are sold separately licensed by Wizards of the Coast?
    We will be looking into making other Pokémon accessories available.

  16. Where can I get the Pokémon TopDeck magazine and is it ALL about POKÉMON?
    You can find it at hobby, game and bookstores. It covers a lot of different TCG’s and other games.

  17. When will the Pokémon Strategy guide come out?
    I believe the release date for that is March.

  18. Are planning on having an online Pokémon TCG game like you do with Magic the Gather?
    There are no plans at this time, sorry.

  19. Will the upcoming CD-ROM for Base Set 2 be released separately or only as part of the new Starter sets?
    Our plan for now is only with the starter sets.

  20. In Japan, Media Factory has Professor Ooyamo as the card expert. Who is the card expert for Wizards of the Coast?
    We have a staff of 14 trainers that exist on donuts and Mountain Dew that answer questions.

  21. Are you guys, and the Moderators too, employees at WotC, or just appointed volunteers coming in from other locations?
    We are employees.

  22. What’s it liked to work at WOTC?
    We get paid to play the games and answer the questions; all in all I would say it was pretty cool.

  23. I’m new to TCG’s. What does DCI stand for?
    Duelist Convocation International.

  24. What does promo mean?
    A promotional card.

  25. What is the quiet room?
    The quiet room is a place where trainers who do not listen go to wait until they can learn to join the rest of us in proper conversation. No, really it is a place to hear this chat without having to hear all the other chatter.

  26. Why are there 15 types in the Game Boy game, but 7 in the TCG?
    Because we are a card game and they are a video game.

  27. Does WotC employ/contract it’s own artists for artwork related to the TCG, or is all the artwork used “Japanese imports?” (If you’ll pardon the phrase).
    Most of the art is from the original Japanese cards; we have artists on hand if reworks are called for.

  28. What are your opinions on Pojo.com?
    It’s a good unofficial resource.

  29. If there is a tear in my card sleeve from shuffling and its on purpose, is that considered “marked”?
    I would consider it marked. Your opponent may require you find a new sleeve or de-sleeve your entire deck.

  30. How would one go about becoming an employee for Wizards, maybe like a play tester?
    Living in the Seattle area is a good start. Most play testing is done internally though there are ways to get involved through. Fan clubs and such.

  31. What is an L5R booster? (Sorry if that was a dumb question.)
    Legend of the Five Rings, another TCG that we make based on feudal Japan.

  32. Has WotC made any games besides magic, and all the others rip offs of Japan?
    Sure, Rage, Spellfire, Vampire, Dungeons and Dragons, Robo Rally, What were you thinking? Guillotine, etc etc etc.

  33. Are there any plans to bring the vending machine cards to the U.S.?
    No immediate plans but you never know.

  34. What does AKIMBO mean?
    Waving your arms around disjointedly. (Ahem), He ran across the room with his arms all-akimbo.

  35. Will there be any other Pokémon games? (Ex. an rpg card game)
    There is the Pokémon Jr. Adventure Game (already out) and the Pokémon Master Adventure Game out later this year.

  36. Will there be a WotC section at the Stadium 2000 tour?
    We will have a small presence in that tour, yes.

  37. Do I have to pay full price (pay for each pack) if I buy a box at Wizard’s store?
    Yes.

  38. Will there ever be an extensive rulebook?
    In Base Set 2, the rulebook has been improved. There will also be an official Pokémon guide out soon.

  39. Are you guys going to put prices on the boosters and theme decks because where I live they charge me 10 dollars a booster and 25 dollars for a theme deck! So I thought if you can put the prices on the products so they can’t charge me higher
    We’ve looked into that but Pokémon is becoming an international product. It would cost quite a bit more to make different wrappers in the local currency for each locality. Unfortunately we cannot dictate what a store sells our products for (that would be price fixing and is illegal). If a store is charging too much, don’t shop there. We sell the cards at the regular $3.29 a booster pack through our web site and we also have a retail locator on our site that could help you find other stores in your area that might not charge as much.

  40. Any chance for a Mac OS version of the tutorial CD?
    That is in the works.

  41. Does PCS publishing have a website or e-mail address?
    Sure, it’s topdeck@pcspublink.com

  42. What is that Pokémon card game for the gameboy all about? I haven’t read much on it.
    Nintendo is making a game a trading card game for the game boy based on our cards that are based upon the original Pokémon game boy game.

  43. So, is there a "Pokémon division over at WotC? Or do the play testers, marketing people, etc. deal with all WotC products as the need arises?
    There certainly is a Pokémon division, but since it takes a pretty hardcore gamer to take a position of this nature, most of our representative’s crossover and cover several different games.

  44. You guys are opening a new Wizards of the Coast store at the Westminster Mall in CA, how can I apply for a job? Not like a manager or something, just a cashier or stock person
    Check out our web site for information. Sometimes they will post an address to contact for employment. Otherwise if we have another store in the area you can apply there or just wait until it opens and apply.

  45. Will there ever be some sort of consistent “repository” for Pokémon rulings (as opposed to simply having FAQs and logs, which, believe me, is a good first step)? It seems if you ask three different people at WotC about a rules question, you are likely to get three different answers, presumably because there is little or no baseline/precedent for them to refer back to.
    Hmmm, well you SHOULD get the same answer when you ask different people here. Keep in mind since we don’t own Pokémon it is harder for us to make definitive rulings (we are dealing with other companies as well). We are working on giving you consistent interpretations though.

  46. Does WOTC have their own store in New York City?
    Not yet, but I think one just opened in Garden City New Jersey.

  47. Sorry, dumb questions, but what does CCG and TCG stand for?
    Not a problem, CCG is collectible card game, TCG is trading card game.

  48. I understand about it being an entry-level game, but having it taken seriously doesn’t mean that it can’t also stay a casual game. After all, MtG has Starter and Advanced and Expert rules… each one viable in and of them selves. But thanks for the comments anyway.
    Not a problem. Since Pokémon is geared towards a younger audience than most other TCG’s, it will most likely remain more of an entry-level game (like MTG:Starter, which doesn’t have Pro Tours or Judges specifically for it either). It is a fun game and I understand wanting to make it more serious though.

  49. With regards to Kori and accreditation, etc.: There are always people of varying skill with regards to any given game. With mtg., you aren’t going to see a lot of 8 year olds at PT. Same with any possible Poke equivalent. I think, however, that there are more 17-18+ Poke players than realized. As far as strategy goes: Just because the rules are simple doesn’t mean there’s no depth. The WCW TCG brand manager said something like this once.
    True. Now I will venture more of my opinion only (not official WOTC line). Since there is a much smaller amount of cards available and the game is simpler in some ways, there are far fewer deck archetypes than many of the other games. Can you name more than 6 or 7 archetypes (not counting variations)? This would limit true originality in a higher level competitive field. And we do know that there are many older players but there are MANY younger players.

  50. What is DCI and what does it do?
    DCI - Duelist Convocation International. They are the organization that tracks ratings and rankings in sanctioned events and for players that play in sanctioned events.

  51. Do you think Pokémon is going to be a round for a while?
    Yes I do. Through league play and further expansions we are planning on Pokémon staying around (even if it does slow down a bit in the future).

  52. I cant play magic mom has seen a few cards and banned me from playing them, I would like a more series game play for Pokémon should I try to change my mom or Wizards.
    Well, I would explain to your mom how magic is played and what the cards mean or don’t mean. As far as Pokémon goes, your comment has been heard and will be passed on. You could also check out other TCG’s like Star Wars, & the Sea, etc.

  53. How long dose it takes to become a member of this chat I submitted last week and it still did not come.
    Hmmm, not sure on that. If you haven’t received it yet, I would send an email to community@wizards.com.

  54. Will the suggested retail price be raised anytime soon? Because I think it’s rather expensive right now?
    Nope.

  55. How do you enter the DCG ratings?
    You can get a DCI membership number by playing in the Pokémon Leagues or by going to a DCI sanctioned tournament.

  56. Why do u charge 3.29 for the packs when it only costs 5 cents to make the card?
    Marketing, packaging. Distribution, License fees to Nintendo, and MORE than 5 cents a card, guys.

  57. Do you have an e-mail address Master_Trainer?
    Send questions to custserv@wizards.com.

  58. Will Wizards post a checklist of Team Rocket on their site as soon as they are available for purchase?
    We will as soon as they are available on the marketplace, yes.

  59. What’s a Brook and Misty’s challenge?
    Those are extra events you can do at your Pokémon League top earn special shiny stickers. Only after you have earned your badge and TM sticker for that season though.

  60. So you can only get it through the Nintendo Power Subscription deal?
    Dunno, I would contact Nintendo about that (1-800-422-2602).

  61. Does WotC sell individual cards?
    Nope.

  62. Will WotC ever do like Japan and let kids send in Pokés and then make a card of it and send it back?
    There are no such plans that I know of.

  63. The card game isn’t really related to the game boy game, is it? TCG makes fire Pokémon with high hp, but in the game Boy game they’re actually sort-of weak…
    It is based on it but not exactly the same.

  64. What is a Pokémon Showdown Battle thing?
    There are plans for a Pokémon Premier event sometime this summer likes last year’s Tropical Mega Battle. No details yet though.

  65. Is TopDeck Magazine the same thing as Duelist?
    It took the place of Duelist.

  66. Are there any plans on putting more cards in each pack?
    Nope.

  67. Is there really a 3-month pattern on the release of sets?
    Not necessarily, though we have found with our experience with Magic that a new set about every 3 months works well.

  68. I read in a magazine that there are going to be some “Pokémon Cruises” where you can pay to spend 7 days or so on an ocean liner where DCI-sanctioned tournaments will be held, etc. Is there any information on this? If not, thanks anyway.
    NO, though you can be sure I’ll look into it.

  69. HOW MANY SETS OF Pokémon ARE OUT AND HOW MANY MORE WILL BE DISTRIBUTED?
    There’s four out in English so far; I’m not sure how many more we’ll be releasing.

  70. Do you know if there are going to be contests for the new sets, like the deck building contests before?
    Yes, there will be. The best place to get information about those is in TopDeck magazine or on our website in the Pokémon section.

  71. How do you get a subscription to “TopDeck”?
    You can call 1-800-395-7760 to order a subscription with a credit card, or you can fill out one of those postcards that come inside TopDeck.

  72. What should you do when you’ve realized you’ve bought fake cards? Contact police? Wizards?
    First ask the merchant for a refund and explain that selling counterfeits is illegal. If they don’t help you should contact the Police, Better Business Bureau, and could also contact us with the name and address of the store and we will pass it on to Nintendo for investigation.

  73. How do I contact someone to be a pokeleague center?
    Contact Merchant Relations at Wizards of the Coast. You must be a store to be a League Location.

  74. Do you always release your sets on Monday/Tuesday?
    No.

  75. If we are a creative person and have ideas for cards, would we send them to Wizards or Gamefreaks?
    Gamefreaks.

  76. Will there be a new rulebook (Version 4) coming with TR’s pre-cons? Will this clear up many questions we have regarding certain card texts? Any idea to make a card set errata like in magic for Pokémon anytime soon?
    Not sure if there will be an updated rulebook or not. Answers DO get posted in the Pokémon chat logs. Otherwise we are working on FAQ’s for the game.

  77. Are you intending on combining Pokémon and MTG to a sort of package?
    Nope, two separate games.

  78. Because the Pokémon Marril is a recurring character on the TV show, can you release cards or character?
    We are translating existing Japanese card sets. When we get to the Japanese set that has Marril, you may see him in English.

  79. I’ve been looking for the Top Deck Magazine with the Dark Charmeleon, but it isn’t at my local WOTC or GameKeeper. Where can I find it, besides ordering a subscription?

  80. What would be your standing if someone made a program, like apprentice for Pokémon?
    I think Nintendo (who owns the license) might have a problem with that.

  81. Do you think you would be able to sponsor a program made for Pokémon TCG like you did with apprentice?
    Online play is being looked into.

  82. Is there a reason to buy the TopDeck maganize besides the card?
    There are strategy articles, puzzles, and news about other games and products. If that isn’t enough for you, then no.

  83. Is WotC the ticker symbol for this company? If so, why is so cheap?
    Nope, we are part of Hasbro now, it’s symbol is Has.

  84. If Pokémon dies will you make Pokémon cards anymore?
    Remember Pokémon don’t die, they feint. We plan on supporting it as long as players want to play.

  85. How come magazines like Scrye have the Japanese cards translated, but WotC takes a longer time?
    Scrye is an unofficial magazine, Top Deck is official. Translations have to be approved by Nintendo, Game Freak, Media Factory, etc. Takes time.

  86. Why does TopDeck have official Japanese translations? Before WotC, too.
    Sometimes (but keep in mind WOTC makes TopDeck).

  87. How come wizards of the coast is selling preorder rocket for more then retail are store sells preorder boxes for $144 plus tax?
    If a store wants to sell boxes at a loss to them, they certainly can. We sell for the regular suggested retail price.

  88. Why can’t you have a counterfeit watch sign every place where they sell Pokémon?
    Nintendo owns the Pokémon license and does investigate and prosecute counterfeit sales. Keep in mind it takes a lot of time to investigate.

  89. If you wanted to buy a BOX of TR cards, US, how many packs do you get?
    36 packs come in a box.

  90. Will TopDeck be giving away a Pokémon booster in its next month’s issue, or a booster from another game?
    The next issue should have a Magic Nemesis booster in it.

  91. Who makes up the card’s attacks, damage, and powers?
    Creatures Inc.–the people who made the game in Japan.

  92. Why don’t you use translations from the Scyre to translate future sets?
    Scrye magazine is not an official Pokémon publication. Their translations are only approximations and not official.

  93. What methodology is used to balance the cards, or is there one used? Some cards just seem useless.
    You would have to talk with Creatures Inc. in Japan, they design the cards, and we basically just translate them.

  94. Where can I find a picture of a holographic Pokémon card?
    Hmmm, I would check out good unofficial web sites like the Pojo, or the PokeGym, or even on E-Bay.

  95. Is it legal to make fake Pokémon cards (as in joke, not counterfeit)?
    I think that is copyright infringement.

  96. What is the current number of Pokémon?
    In our English card game there are 151, with several versions of them. As for Japanese? Dunno.

  97. Since Top Deck is put out by WOTC why don’t you put the same list on your website and talk about the cards, even though they aren’t released yet?
    Because sometimes magazines are wrong. They are printed months in advance and things sometimes change.

  98. Would you please verify the correct pronunciation of the word “Devolution”? I am certain that it is pronounced just as it looks, but some individuals believe the correct pronunciation is “De-evolution”.
    Use it however you want. We do not have official pronunciations here. Pat likes to pronounce it as “throck warbling mangrove”.

  99. How do you become a Master Trainer?
    Well, first you have to get a job a Wizards of the Coast, then you have to demonstrate that you know more about Pokémon than is healthy for a person to know.

  100. If you cannot get first edition packs at wizard of the coast stores where can you get them?
    You should be able to get them at stores, just not online (I don’t think so anyway). Try other premier stores like Barens & Noble, Toys R Us, Borders, Waldenbooks, Software Etc, Electronics Boutique, Zany Brainy, Books a Million, Noodle Kadoodle. Odd names huh?

  101. I think your magazine needs to work on making good decks. Who makes the decks in those magazines?
    I would write in to them with your own deck suggestions then.

  102. Well if you want a good deck then just ask me and you have to put it in the magazine. Ok?
    Umm, send in your ideas to the magazine, ok?

  103. How do I send the ideas to the magazine?
    Write to TopDeck c/o Wizards of the Coast PO Box 707, Renton, WA 98057

  104. Why can’t you make a stage 3 evolution?
    We only make the translations here; we don’t design the game. Ask Creatures Inc. in Japan.

  105. How much cooperation was there between WOTC and Nintendo (if any) regarding development of the TCG for GameBoy?
    Lots of cooperation.

  106. What happens to a store if they charge more than retail price for the packs and theme decks?
    Nothing, though they might find that their repeat business drops dramatically when people find a different place to get cards for less.

  107. If someone created a new TCG would you guys take a look at it and possibly print it?
    Yes, I would refer that person to the game submission guidelines on our website. If you present your game idea in a professional manner, it makes a better impression.

  108. Are you gonna turn Pokémon into a MTG game?
    No.

  109. If I live in Chicago and am 14, can I get a job testing out Pokémon Cards (i.e. you send me cards to be released before you release them, and I give you my input to improve them)?
    I’m sorry I think we only do that in the Seattle area. That’s a positive for living in a place where it rains so much.

  110. What was WotC’s involvement in the GB TCG? Was it just getting the attack names and effects correct, or did it include suggestions for tweaking game mechanics and so on?
    As far as we know, they made that game on their own.

  111. Well, not exactly a question, but since there aren’t a whole lot more in the queue… I just want to thank you guys at WotC for starting to take the Pokémon game a little more seriously. I know it’s been a big sore spot for some of us, and I know you get sick of hearing some of us as well, but a lot of us older players like the game and like the strategy involved, and so it’s nice to hear of larger, organized events, like this summer’s STS, being organized. And especially what with it having a 15+ category. So will we see you there competing?
    Glad to be able to help. We enjoy the game as well. We are looking into other ways of helping you all with higher level strategy and deck design issues as well. We want to keep this chat also open for new and young players but we also want to acknowledge the older and more advanced players as well.

  112. I heard from my gym leader that stores cannot sell the Team rocket boosters yet, but they can sell singles is this true?
    Stores are not supposed to be selling ANY Rocket cards until the official date on this Saturday. If you know a store that is breaking this date, please contact cust serv at 1-800-324-6496.

  113. Its true that you can buy Pokémon cards 1st edition online?
    True. Go to our online store at store.wizards.com/ and you can order them there.

  114. What issue of top deck is it that has the checklist?
    #6

  115. Does they have Spanish cards from WotC?
    There will be Spanish cards sold in Europe soon.

  116. I got a Devastation theme deck, and I got a sheet of cardboard “coins” with “10” printed on them. What exactly are they?
    Those are the new improved damage counters.

  117. Are there deck boxes, styled for the team rocket series?
    Yes there are, coming out soon.

  118. Now that WotC has passed the first hurdle and designed their own ‘in-house’ card (Dark Raichu), do you think we may be seeing similar WotC-exclusive cards in future sets, or was this pretty much a one-time deal?
    It is extremely difficult to get permission to make new cards, BUT. Ya never know, do you? We must get permission every time and it’s a difficult a lengthy approval process

  119. Why weren’t the misprint Team Rocket cards discovered as misprints before printing began?
    I talked with the brand team. There are literally THOUSANDS of lines of text on all the cards that go through many many processes. Our company’s release of cards (and all of our products) runs at a 99.67% accuracy, which is darn amazing. You have to realize that it is not a simple process to release a set of cards and a .33% error rate is pretty darn good.

  120. What is your favorite deck type(s)? And your favorite trainers and your strategy to that(those) trainer(s)?
    Wow, that’s al long question. I play a Raindance variant and like the Professor Oak trainer. Pat plays a Haymaker variant.

  121. What would your favorite Team Rocket Pokémon be? Mine would be Dark Dragonair and it’s awesome Pokémon power: evolutionary light.
    I’m digging Dark Vileplume cause Mike always bats me around with his Rain Dance deck and that depends heavily on trainer cards.

  122. What made wizards put a secret card in the team rocket expansion? (I think it was a cool idea)
    We’ve wanted to do something like that for awhile just to add something interesting that is not in the Japanese sets.

  123. Does Wizards have a page were you can translate Japanese cards?
    Nope. Once we translate a set, we release it. Anything unreleased is not allowed in North America.

  124. Where on the web can I buy Pokémon cards on the web for a reasonable price?
    Well. www.wizards.com sells them, and will deliver in 7 to 10 days.

  125. Should I download roms of Pokémon games?
    That is in violation of Nintendo’s copyrights. We do not make those egames but I don’t recommend getting caught doing anything like that.

  126. Did you read about what the Pope said about Pokémon? He praised it!
    We did hear of that yes.

  127. My question “What does errata mean?” was answered with a reference to tools . . . Is Tim Allen making a guest appearance or will you be able to define the term?
    Errata are wording that is added to a card to clarify how it works in certain game situations. Since the errata is usually distributed via the web it’s hard for some people to keep up on. Furthermore, sometimes people who have not been informed of current errata on cards will show up at tournaments and find out that their prized combo doesn’t work as they expected.

  128. You say you don’t care about errata but you know kids know lots about ditto and you think they understand a simple You play dark Vileplum with weakness to fire but what if you printed imposter professor oak but is said draw 70 cards that’s not fair game?
    I’m going to assume this question is in some way commenting on our decision to stay away from official errata. It’s not that I don’t think players can handle it. It’s just that, that is what our decision is at this point. If there are other cards that get misprinted at a later date, we’ll take a look at the issue again.

  129. I get the impression that Pokémon isn’t treated as seriously as other games. You won’t correct the game because kids can’t figure it out. Your major tournament event in Colorado was filled with problems; my league doesn’t turn in our information (which means I may not get to go to the LA event); I went to a Wizards store and the employees had no clue what Topdeck was and no idea about any TEAM ROCKET related events for the following weekend. My question is why is this treated, as such a second rate game when the profits are so great? Is it taken less seriously because the age range is broader than other games?
    We take Pokémon very seriously here. Keep in mind that this is the largest selling game in the world and in HISTORY. We never expected the game to take off like it did and in some ways we are still playing catch up. Keep in mind that we are all human and we are doing the best we can. This internet chat for example, started because we want to communicate better with you than we have with other game sin the past. We understand that errors can be frustrating for the public, we don’t like them either. Pokémon is such a HUGE thing now that even a few errors (which can’t be avoided we all are human after all), can seemingly multiply. Many MANY more players have gotten into the TCG field due to Pokémon 's unrivaled popularity. Many resources that were set up for the smaller market with Magic and other TCG’s are now being inundated with the new Pokémon card fans. We really do want this to be a great experience for everyone involved and will continue to do our best for you all.

  130. When was TopDeck released?
    September 1999.

  131. When was TopDeck #7 released?
    Should be just coming out now. Here’s a hint, Mr. Yuk was a sticker used to mark items that would poison children if ingested. (please don’t tell anyone I said anything, it could mean my job).

  132. Volume 2 Issue 4 of TopDeck mentioned on page 18* that there will be a Pokémon: Damage Counter Dice, Holo Card Sheets, and Pocket Poster. When will these come out?
    I have heard about the dice only. Those will be part of an upcoming product.

  133. When you release issues of TopDeck, why don’t you put a different booster pack in each magazine so people could always get booster packs for the TCG they’re interested in?
    That would greatly increase the production costs and then the price of the magazine.

  134. Can you give any info on that upcoming product that will have the dice? Dice are so much easier than damage counters…
    The upcoming Starter Gift Box is slated to come with Dice for keeping track of damage. It might also have a metal Pokémon coin it it.

  135. If I were to send my deck idea to wizards would they publish it in there magazine? If they did then would they give me credit for making it like would they put my name at the bottom of the deck idea?
    You would need to send them into TopDeck c/o Wizards of the Coast PO Box 707 Renton, WA 98057. Sometimes they print deck ideas in the magazine.

  136. Where do I get a sheet to fill out for the contest to win a trip?
    It is on our web site at www.wizards.com/Pokémon/showdownform.asp

  137. Does WOTC have any plans to make a program to allow people to play the Pokémon TCG online?
    It is being looked into.

  138. Will a playmat like the official Japanese one ever be released in the states? The cloth one that came out a while back is OK, but the official Japanese one looks cool… and what about the official Pokémon Center card protectors?
    Dunno. Sounds good though doesn’t it? Those types of things are released by other companies though, not us.

  139. Have you guys seen any changes in TCG since Team Rocket was released?
    More people are playing and not just collecting, and there are more deck variants in play (which is goods).

  140. What is Pokémon League?
    A place where people who enjoy Pokémon get together every week to play, trade, and talk. Check out our web site for league locations in your area.

  141. What rules are the good one Base 2 or the 1st rules (in the Wizards page rules appear the 1st rules)?
    The Base Set 2 rules are a bit more detailed (they came out later) but they are both basically the same.

  142. Any chance for the nice plastic flips coins that were in the Japanese starter decks and Gym Leader decks to be released in the US? The paper coins trebly don’t cut it.
    We’ve passed that concern along. I know they are looking into all sorts of possibilities.

  143. If we never received our Movie promos from ticket stubs that were sent off who can we call to get them?
    Warner Brothers did that one. Call them at 1-800-824-9588 and leave a message at the end of their recording.

  144. Please tell me what R&D is. Ive heard the term before but don’t know what it means.
    R&D is Research and Development (not Raichus & Digletts if that is what you were thinking!)

  145. I just wanted to compliment Wizards on the STS. Despite some rather shaky reports from the initial stop, everything I’ve been hearing since then has been very complimentary. However, EVERYBODY seems to be raving about these darned hats you get for making it to the fourth round! What’s up with those? I haven’t seen them yet – are they plated in gold, or something?
    Well, thank you. They are nice hats (though I have such a big melon on my shoulders that mine barely fits). I don’t think they are made of gold though.

  146. What happened to the release of the Pokémon damage counter dice? I haven’t seen them yet.
    Last I heard, Creatures Inc. put the kibosh on them.

  147. Will Pokémon have a national tournament like Magic?
    Not quite the same way no, but the Super Trainer Showdown is a premiere event. We are working on setting up one for the East Coast later this year too.

  148. Does Creatures, Inc have a web site? I found Game Freak’s. And what about Media Factory?
    Not that I know of, sorry.

  149. I signed up to become a member and lost my password! It wasn’t even sent to me (pikae3@yahoo.com)
    Write to community@wizards.com about this.

  150. I don’t want to get in trouble now or in the future so can you folks check my website at the address travel.to/pikachu and if it violates any copyright rules, tell me to take it down?
    You should be sure to check out the ‘contact info’ section of our website for legal info like that.

  151. Can we buy by the box directly from wizards? I see the packs, but I’m looking for boxes.
    We don’t usually get boxes in the online store; we just get bulk booster packs.

  152. Who is Ken Sugimori? (Printed on the card)
    One of the artist’s that does the card artwork.

  153. So where do I send them? (You or the artists)
    The artists; if you want them to sign your cards.

  154. Do you guys sell promos that can’t be gotten anymore on the net?
    Unfortunately we do not sell individual cards

  155. Just what is the line between “play it as it is” and “unplayable, let’s fix it”?
    That’s for R&D and the DCI to decide not us.

  156. Are your coins weighted or something? They land on heads a lot more than tails?
    Not for me they don’t…gosh, I wish I had your luck?

  157. Are the edition 1 cards on your website corrected from errors?
    Probably not…the misprints will probably be there.

  158. What other ideas do you have for use for extra common cards not needed?
    Maybe decorate your car with them. Give them to charity. You see Pat is the good guy

  159. How does a store get to order Wizards of the Coast products to sell. My family started up a store recently and we’d like to know?
    Contact Wizards of the Coast Merchant Relations, call us and press the extension for ‘retailers’ for the phone number.

  160. Why did Giovanni put himself on the cover of a Pokémon card wrapper in a set called Team Rocket without revealing to the Pokémon league that he’s the team rocket leader. The Pokémon league will take away his gym. What was he thinking? Does he have a bigger ego then common sense?
    Nope, just an ego worthy of comparison to Ken Griffey Jr.'s

  161. What was the reason for the 2.99-3.29-price hike?
    Costs associated with printing and producing the cards.

  162. Why doesn’t WotC put a price on the wrapper like $3.29 in the corner so stores don’t over charge them? I’m fairly disappointed at how some stores charge $10 for a pack it’s ridiculous and why can’t the just make them $3.29?
    Because our cards are sold all over the world and to put just an American MSRP would be pretty shortsighted. We do our best to publicize the correct price of the cards and to make them available for that price on our website.

  163. Can you tell me the truth about Base Set 2? Why did you make it?
    Well, we thought the Pokémon game would mature differently at that time. We thought that producing one set with most of the important Pokémon from Jungle and Base set 1 in it would help get the game into the hands of more consumers and lower the average price consumers were paying for cards.

  164. Will new card sets be released any faster? For example, wouldn’t it be better if Neo was released soon after Gold and Silver came out?
    Sure it would if we wanted to burn out the market. Keep in mind that it takes months of pre-production, translation, and approval before a set can be released and shipped out. Also the rest of the world is after these cards as well and we can only make them so fast.

  165. What happens if you go to an old movie theater? The one playing Pokémon movies has been around since the 50s and hands out raffle ticket as movie tickets, unlike new theater that give printed tickets for each movie. This creates a problem that if there’s a promo mail in offer to redeem stubs, all I’ll have is half a raffle ticket.
    Well, Warner Brothers has told us that they will be better prepared than last time and that you should NOT have to ever mail in a ticket to get the card you should have received at the theater.

  166. What do you think about Fake Card makers?
    As long as you only use them for fun, then go for it. BUT try and make money or spoof anyone and your karma will go down!

  167. How can you tell if a card is fake?
    The light test is the best way. Hold the card between you and a light source. If you can see the printing on the back of the card through the front, it’s fake.

  168. Can I submit an idea for an American promo?
    We appreciate your interest in our products and love to hear that our creations are inspiring others. Unfortunately, we are not currently accepting submissions for expansions based on Pokémon, nor can we accept any single-card submissions.

  169. I would like to go to a gym but I don’t know where to find them do you know?
    We have a League Locator on our web site at events.wizards.com/pWherePlay/Default.asp? Arena

  170. Would Wizards start a store where players of the TCG can buy cards for low prices?
    We do have stores that we sell our products (and other games) at. In some cases our prices are lower than what other stores are charging.

  171. Might want to know this: Pokémon the Movie 2000 comes out July 21st according to the official Web Site.
    Yea, thanks, I’ve marked that on my calendar…

  172. If I have a Pokémon ‘rules’ question, and cannot attend this chat session, who at wizards could I email, and how soon might I get a response?
    custserv@wizards.com, put ‘Pokémon’ in the subject line.

  173. How do you feel about all that junk one had to go through to get the Jiggly promo? Will it happen again with the new soundtrack?
    That was my concern with another soundtrack promo. We were not happy with our promotional partners in that instance and are working to ensure that that sort of thing doesn’t happen again.

  174. Where did the idea for Pokémon come from?
    Mr. Ishihara in Japan created it.

  175. Will there be an English contest to draw pictures of Pokémon and be official cards?
    Possibly.

  176. When are they going to get caught up with the “personal web pages” on the WOTC page?
    We have hundreds of thousands of reports coming in, it is now the major convention season, AD&D 3rd edition is out soon, as is X-Men, and we just released WCW and MLB2000. Unfortunately we are a bit overworked. They are going as fast as they can.

  177. Why don’t you make a Pokémon encyclopedia like you have done for MTG?
    We own Magic, we only license Pokémon from Nintendo and Creatures. We do not get to decide what products get made.

  178. Why do you put 15 cards in a pack of magic cards but only 11 cards in Pokémon when they cost the same price?
    Pokémon cards cost more to make (the foils especially). Also we own Magic and so don’t have to pay licensing fees whereas we have to pay licensing fees to Nintendo for Pokémon.

  179. Will WoTC having a Pokémon presence in Origins and GenCon?
    There will be a small presence for Pokémon at both events. Master Trainer Pat will be at Origins, I will be at Gen Con. Come find us!

  180. Are there going to be Pokémon TCG Promotions at the all-star Baseball game?
    No, Mike and I have not heard anything about that.

  181. How old is the oldest person you know that plays the Pokémon TCG?
    A grandma called me on the Game Support line the other day that was 73…and yes, she knew how to play!

-fin

zorloth:

Skimming through the first few, found an interesting question/answer:

– 69. What is the ratio of first edition cards to Unlimited cards?
1st edition are printed for 3 days only, the unlimited are still print, so whatever 3 into infinity is. –

Is this common knowledge? And is it possible this is true? If this is true, it’s a bit odd because certain sets (i.e., Team Rocket) are much easier to find in 1st Edition relative to Unlimited than others (i.e., Base). Unless, of course, the print run for Team Rocket was much shorter (which doesn’t seem to be the case since it had a large print run)?

EDIT: a later Q&A partially answered my question:

– 120. Is it true that Heroes was not printed in 1st edition as much as other sets?

Master Trainer Mike: I heard that it was printed in a smaller amount than Rocket was (which was overprinted). –

Maybe not “common knowledge”, but it’s been known for some time and has been mentioned on here at least once.

Gotcha; I searched around but couldn’t find anything. Thanks!
